jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description Backbase Americas is seeking a skilled and motivated Backend Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable, and high\-performance backend systems. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills, experience with server\-side development, and an understanding of modern distributed application architecture. In this role, you will help develop technology solutions for digital banking platforms, build reliable backend services, and collaborate with engineering and product teams to deliver innovative financial technology solutions. Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and services. * Build and integrate RESTful APIs and microservices. * Develop secure and efficient server\-side software components. * Work with relational and NoSQL database systems. * Optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability. * Implement authentication, authorization, and data security practices. * Troubleshoot technical issues and resolve software defects. * Participate in code reviews and technical architecture discussions. * Collaborate with frontend engineers, QA specialists, and product teams. * Support automated testing, deployment, and continuous integration. Technical Skills * Strong programming experience with Java, Kotlin, or similar backend languages. * Knowledge of Spring Boot and microservices architecture. * Experience developing REST APIs and backend integrations. * Understanding of SQL databases and data modeling. * Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms. * Knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing. * Understanding of secure software development practices. * Experience with Agile development methodologies. About the Company Backbase is a global financial technology company founded in Amsterdam in 2003\. The company specializes in digital banking software and provides technology platforms that help financial institutions modernize their banking services. Its Banking Operating System supports digital customer experiences, banking operations, and financial service delivery across web and mobile channels. Backbase works with banks and financial institutions worldwide to improve digital engagement, streamline banking processes, and deliver modern financial technology solutions. Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Relocation assistance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cloud Administrator - POSE-059
jobs.description: Job Description Poseidon is seeking a Cloud Observability Engineer to design, operate, and enhance monitoring and reliability capabilities across cloud native environments. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in distributed systems, enjoys solving complex operational challenges, and is passionate about building resilient, well instrumented cloud platforms. In this role, you will collaborate with product managers, software developers, DevOps engineers, and cybersecurity personnel to ensure our systems are observable, reliable, secure, and aligned with best practices in cloud operations and governance. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain observability solutions supporting monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting across cloud native platforms. Analyze system performance and telemetry to detect anomalies, identify trends, and recommend improvements. Support incident response activities, participate in on call rotations, and contribute to post incident reviews. Diagnose and resolve system level issues using structured triage and root cause analysis. Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy and manage containerized workloads using Kubernetes and Helm Charts. Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions to automate provisioning, configuration, and operational workflows. Maintain and continuously improve operational runbooks, SOPs, and documentation supporting cloud operations and governance. Work within Agile/Scrum teams to deliver cloud based solutions aligned with cloud service provider (CSP) and organizational best practices. Ensure compliance with security, governance, and operational standards across cloud environments. Required Skills Observability \& Performance Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining observability systems, including monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting within cloud native environments (e.g., CloudWatch, ELK Stack, Logstash, Icinga). Demonstrated experience analyzing system performance, reviewing telemetry data, detecting anomalies, and identifying opportunities for reliability improvements and cost optimization. Incident Response \& Troubleshooting Demonstrated experience troubleshooting incidents and participating in on call support rotations to ensure system reliability and availability. Demonstrated experience diagnosing and resolving system level issues through structured triage and root cause analysis. Cloud Platform, DevOps, \& Microservices Demonstrated experience with AWS services such as S3, RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL), EC2, ECS, Lambda, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, CloudFormation, and Route 53, as well as DevOps tools including GitHub, Jenkins, Docker, and CI/CD pipeline development. Demonstrated experience deploying and managing containerized workloads in microservices based architectures using Kubernetes and Helm. Demonstrated experience developing and operating cloud based IT solutions in alignment with cloud service provider (CSP) best practices and customer requirements, standards, and architectural guidelines. Cloud Operations \& Automation Demonstrated experience with cloud environment provisioning, lifecycle management, Auto Scaling configuration, and the automation of operational tasks using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash). Demonstrated experience managing infrastructure, application, and monitoring patching processes, including vulnerability remediation and coordinated maintenance activities across cloud native environments. Demonstrated experience managing TLS/SSL certificate lifecycles, including issuance, renewal, rotation, and integration with cloud native services and load balancers. Process \& Governance Demonstrated experience working with Agile/Scrum teams and using collaboration and documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence. Demonstrated experience applying compliance and security practices, including authentication, authorization, access control, and operational governance within cloud native environments. jobs.title: Database Administrator Enterprise Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Benefits:** * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Flexible schedule **Database Administrator (DBA) / Enterprise Data Engineer** **Estimated Level of Effort:** 75–80 hours per month **Position Summary** The South Carolina Department of Probation, Parole, and Pardon Services (SCDPPPS) supervises individuals placed on probation, parole, and other community\-release programs. SCDPPPS relies on custom, mission\-critical applications while modernizing its core Offender Management System (OMS). The Database Administrator (DBA) / Enterprise Data Engineer supports the development, integration, security, modernization, and sustainment of these applications and their supporting data environments. The position designs and maintains enterprise data architecture; manages legacy\-data migration and validation; enables reporting, telemetry, and analytics; and administers and optimizes databases supporting OMS, PIC, PAC, IIMS, SSO, and other assigned systems. **Reporting Relationship** Reports to the Program Manager, Chief Information Officer, Data Architect, or designated technical lead. **Key Responsibilities** **Enterprise Data Architecture and Engineering** * Design, develop, and maintain an enterprise data warehouse, data lake, or comparable data platform supporting structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data. * Define data models, schemas, metadata, integration patterns, storage approaches, and lifecycle\-management practices. * Establish standards for data ingestion, transformation, storage, access, retention, lineage, cataloging, quality, and security. * Develop and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for batch, near\-real\-time, and real\-time data processing. * Design secure, reliable interfaces among enterprise applications, reporting platforms, analytics tools, and data repositories. **Legacy Data Migration and Validation** * Plan, execute, document, and support migration of legacy data to the enterprise data environment. * Assess source\-system structures, data quality, business rules, integration dependencies, and technical constraints. * Develop data mappings, transformation rules, migration procedures, reconciliation methods, validation criteria, and rollback plans. * Migrate and validate data associated with OMS, PIC, PAC, IIMS, SSO, and other assigned applications. * Perform data profiling, cleansing, standardization, deduplication, reconciliation, and exception resolution to ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity. * Produce validation results, discrepancy logs, remediation recommendations, and migration\-completion documentation. **Business Intelligence, Reporting, and Telemetry** * Develop and maintain Power BI reporting pipelines, semantic models, datasets, dashboards, and reports. * Implement telemetry\-based reporting to support visibility into application activity, system health, performance, and operational metrics. * Develop real\-time and near\-real\-time ingestion workloads for reporting, monitoring, analytics, and decision support. * Optimize reporting data models, refresh processes, queries, and dashboards for performance, security, accuracy, and usability. * Work with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, key performance indicators, data definitions, and dashboard enhancements. **Database Administration and Performance Management** * Perform database design, configuration, administration, maintenance, optimization, and operational support for assigned databases and data platforms. * Monitor database health, availability, capacity, storage, performance, query efficiency, replication, backups, and telemetry. * Resolve performance issues through indexing, query tuning, partitioning, caching, archiving, configuration improvements, and capacity planning. * Execute database\-maintenance activities, including backup and recovery validation, integrity checks, statistics maintenance, patch coordination, and monitoring. * Implement and maintain database security controls, including role\-based access control, least\-privilege access, authentication, authorization, encryption, auditing, and logging. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience, education, training, or certifications may be considered. * Experience in database administration, data engineering, data architecture, or a related technical role. * Experience designing or supporting enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, or comparable platforms. * Experience developing ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, transformations, and system integrations. * Experience with legacy data migration, mapping, profiling, cleansing, reconciliation, validation, and remediation. * Proficiency with SQL, relational database design, normalization, indexing, query optimization, backup and recovery, and performance tuning. * Experience developing Power BI data models, datasets, dashboards, reports, and refresh pipelines. * Knowledge of data quality, governance, metadata, lineage, security, and access\-control principles. * Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver reliable support within an estimated commitment of 75–80 hours per month. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or comparable cloud data platforms. * Experience implementing streaming, event\-driven, telemetry, or real\-time data\-ingestion solutions. * Experience with data cataloging, master\-data management, and data\-governance tools. * Experience supporting public\-sector, regulated, criminal\-justice, or security\-sensitive environments. * Familiarity with DevOps, DataOps, CI/CD, source control, automated testing, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices. * Relevant cloud, database, data\-engineering, or Power BI certifications. **Work Schedule and Requirements** This is a part\-time position requiring an estimated **75–80 hours per month**. Duties may include recurring operational support, planned migrations, reporting releases, and response to database or data\-pipeline issues. Work may be remote, on\-site, or hybrid, subject to program and customer requirements. The incumbent may access sensitive, proprietary, controlled, or government information and must comply with all applicable security, privacy, data\-handling, background\-screening, and customer\-access requirements. Occasional work outside normal business hours may be required for maintenance, releases, migrations, or incident response. Flexible work from home options available.

Your impact: Reliable, scalable models help teams make better\-informed decisions and deliver more useful data\-driven solutions. **Responsibilities** * Prepare data through extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL), data mining, and linked data workflows; support database design and SQL databases. * Train and evaluate AI models using TensorFlow and other machine learning frameworks, including approaches such as unsupervised learning and natural language processing. * Develop predictive modeling, statistical modeling, and machine learning/AI\-based analysis; document findings for research and analytics. * Deploy and monitor models using AWS, machine learning cloud services, and scalable big data systems. * Collaborate on AI implementation and Spark implementation across big data environments. **Skills** * **Core:** Python, machine learning, model training, model evaluation, model deployment, SQL, and experience with machine learning frameworks. * **Data and analytics:** Statistical analysis, statistical analysis for research, data analytics, analytics, statistical analysis tools, and predictive modeling analysis. * **Platforms and tools:** AWS, TensorFlow, Spark, Hadoop, Talend, Looker, and familiarity with big data systems and machine learning cloud services. * **Additional technologies:** Java, C, R, SAS, VBA, and Bash (Unix shell); experience with generative AI and AI models is useful. * **Preferred:** Knowledge of scalability, linked data, and quantum engineering concepts. Pay: From $225,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Professional development assistance * Relocation assistance Education: * Master's (Preferred) Experience: * GPU programming: 3 years (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Lead Software Developer
jobs.description: **PRIMARY PURPOSE OF POSITION** The Lead Software Developer \- Oracle Fusion Applications is the technical leader for development, integration, reporting, extension, deployment, and production\-support activities across the Oracle Fusion Cloud application portfolio. This role provides hands\-on technical leadership across all supported Fusion pillars, including ERP/Finance, Supply Chain Management, Human Capital Management, Payroll, Projects, Procurement, and related enterprise integrations. The Lead partners with Systems Analysts, business support teams, product owners, architects, developers, security, infrastructure, and external partners to translate functional requirements into secure, reliable, scalable, and supportable technical solutions. The position remains hands\-on while setting technical direction, promoting common standards across pillars, coordinating complex development work, mentoring developers, and leading resolution of high\-impact production issues. The Lead is accountable for cross\-pillar technical consistency and supportability, not business\-process ownership or unilateral functional solution design. **EXPECTATIONS OF ALL TEAM MEMBERS** * High\-quality, professional work performed with initiative, productivity, collaboration, and accountability. Team members are expected to support an inclusive work environment, build effective relationships across diverse backgrounds and organizational levels, follow established work rules and procedures, accept constructive feedback, and align with Mortenson values, ethical standards, and applicable policies.**KEY RESULT AREAS (ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS)** **KEY RESULT AREAS (ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS)** * **Fusion Technical Leadership:** Provide hands\-on technical leadership for Oracle Fusion application development and support across all pillars. Establish reusable patterns and promote consistent engineering practices across ERP, SCM, HCM, Payroll, Projects, Procurement, and connected applications. * **Solution Design and Architecture:** Lead technical discovery and design with Systems Analysts and appropriate business and technical stakeholders. Translate approved functional requirements into technical specifications, integration designs, data models, security considerations, deployment plans, and support models. * **Cross\-Pillar Support:** Maintain sufficient breadth across the Fusion portfolio to coordinate and resolve issues that span modules, data domains, integrations, reporting, security, environments, or upstream and downstream systems. Engage pillar specialists when deeper functional or technical expertise is required. * **Development and Integration:** Design, develop, review, test, deploy, and support integrations, APIs, reports, data extracts, data loads, extensions, user\-interface components, and other technical solutions within the Oracle Cloud ecosystem. * **Production Support Leadership:** Lead technical triage and resolution for SEV1, SEV2, critical, and high\-priority incidents. Coordinate logging, diagnostics, root\-cause analysis, remediation, validation, communications, and Oracle Support service requests as needed. * **Standards and Governance:** Define and maintain development, documentation, code\-review, testing, source\-control, release, deployment, observability, and support standards. Ensure solutions follow established architecture, security, change\-management, and environment\-promotion controls. * **Technical Quality:** Conduct design and code reviews for accuracy, maintainability, performance, security, reuse, and alignment with approved standards. Identify technical debt and recommend practical remediation priorities. * **Release and Deployment Leadership:** Coordinate technical readiness for releases and deployments, including sequencing, dependencies, migration artifacts, rollback considerations, validation, monitoring, and transition to production support. * **Team Leadership and Mentorship:** Provide day\-to\-day technical direction, coaching, knowledge transfer, and mentorship to developers. problem\-solving skills, curiosity, and willingness to develop expertise across the full Fusion portfolio. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, applications, including significant hands\-on Oracle application development experience. * Experience leading technical design, development, code review, deployment, and production\-support efforts in jobs.title: Manager, Applications and Data Operations
jobs.description: Vocate is a non\-profit higher education and workforce solutions provider dedicated to closing the nation's talent gaps in critical industries such as healthcare. Through its entities including Ultimate Medical Academy, American Institute, Nasium Training and Global Education Group, Vocate serves more than 20,000 adult learners nationwide, primarily in under\-resourced populations. Backed by more than 130 years of combined experience in higher learning across its institutions, Vocate delivers accessible, career\-aligned programs enhanced by employer partnerships and comprehensive student support services. This is a hands\-on, technical, people\-management role responsible for coaching and developing a team of 8–10 software engineers, DBAs, and data engineers while providing practical technical guidance across applications, databases, data platforms, integrations, orchestration, and production support. The Manager ensures solutions and services are secure, reliable, scalable, supportable, and delivered with strong quality in a collaborative, lean, cost\-conscious shared\-services environment. **What You'll Do:** * **People Leadership and Team Development:** Directly manage, coach, and develop 8–10 software engineers, DBAs, and data engineers; set clear expectations, establish accountability, provide regular feedback, and support hiring, onboarding, performance management, and professional growth. * **Hands\-On Technical Leadership:** Provide practical technical guidance, review designs and implementations, troubleshoot complex issues, and serve as a technical escalation point across software development, database administration, and data engineering. Maintain the ability to contribute directly to technical work when needed. * **Software Engineering and Integration:** Oversee support of cloud\-native applications, APIs, SaaS integrations, orchestration workflows, CI/CD, and related services, ensuring solutions are maintainable, secure, testable, observable, and supportable. * **Data and Database Operations:** Manage day\-to\-day operations of databases and data platforms, including performance, availability, backup and recovery, monitoring, incident response, change management, production support, capacity, and operational resilience. * **Delivery and Quality:** Work with business analysts, architecture, quality assurance, governance, security, and delivery teams to translate business needs into practical solutions and ensure work meets expectations for scope, quality, functionality, timeliness, security, supportability, and cost. * **Technical Problem Solving:** Investigate complex application, database, integration, pipeline, and data issues; coordinate root\-cause analysis and corrective actions; and remove blockers affecting delivery or operational stability. * **Platform Improvement:** Identify and implement opportunities to simplify, automate, consolidate, and optimize applications, databases, data platforms, integrations, and workflows to improve reliability and reduce operational overhead. * **AI\-Assisted Development and Modern Tools:** Encourage responsible use of AI\-assisted development tools and modern cloud\-native practices to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and support outcomes. * **Perform other duties as assigned**. **Career Level Expectations:** * Typically manages a team or small unit. * Owns short to mid\-term (1\-3 years) execution of functional strategy and the operational direction of a team. * Handles often difficult and complex problems and that require extensive investigation and analysis. * Requires ability to influence others to accept practices and approaches, and ability to communicate with executive leadership. * Desire for growth and professional development. **Required Skills and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. * 10\+ years of progressive experience in software engineering Intelligence, and Agile delivery practices. * Ability to review, understand, troubleshoot, and if needed contribute to application code, database objects, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment automation, even when the role is not routinely writing them. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure services and cloud\-native application and data patterns, including secure configuration, monitoring, identity, networking, and operational support. * Experience with database administration and enterprise data platforms, including performance tuning, high availability, backup and recovery, monitoring, incident response, and production support. * Strong understanding of data, including data architecture, modeling, quality, lineage, security, integration, lifecycle management, and analytics enablement. * Ability to translate business needs into scalable, secure, maintainable technology and data solutions and communicate technical information clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Exceptional analytical, problem\-solving, prioritization, communication, collaboration, and people\-leadership skills in complex environments. **Preferred Skills and Experience:** * Advanced degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. * Experience with Microsoft Azure application and data services, Azure SQL, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Cosmos DB, AKS/Kubernetes, and API Management. * Experience with SaaS integration, orchestration platforms, data integration, data warehousing, lakehouse architectures, BI/analytics enablement, and data observability tools. * Experience with GitHub or Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, CI/CD automation, infrastructure or configuration as code, and DevSecOps practices. * Experience with AI\-assisted software development tools and practices, including appropriate review, testing, security, and responsible\-use controls. * Experience with higher education technology and systems such as Anthology, Brightspace/D2L, or comparable student, learning, and business platforms. * Relevant cloud, software development, database, data engineering, security, or Agile certifications, and proficiency with Microsoft Office and Teams. **Compliance:** * Demonstrate knowledge of, and carefully follows all applicable state laws and rules, federal and state compliance requirements and regulations including those prescribed by the U.S. Department of Education, accrediting agencies, state regulations and internal policies and procedures. * Effectively communicate compliance requirements to other staff as appropriate and quickly escalate any compliance concerns to the Compliance department. **Work Environment/Physical Demands:** * This is a full\-time remote position, with occasional onsite travel required. * Home office set up, quiet place to work, ability to be on camera, and ability to hard wire into high\-speed internet connection. * May require setup of computer equipment; accommodation consideration available upon request. * Flexibility to work evenings and weekends, as needed. ### **OUR CORE VALUES** ### where everyone can belong and thrive. ### **EMPOWER** **We unlock potential.** We empower others by fostering continuous learning, activating strengths, and creating connections that enable opportunities — laying the foundation for transformative change.

These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. jobs.title: Research Associate, Applied Cell Line Development & Customer Programs
jobs.description: Prolific Machines is ushering in a new era of biotechnology with light. Our first\-of\-its\-kind optogenetic platform delivers unprecedented control, precisely guiding cellular behavior when and where it matters most. Unlike existing tools used to control biology, our technology enables dynamic, tunable control over virtually any cellular function in any cell type. We're enabling partners to unlock robust efficiency, quality, and reproducibility advantages across the most complex pharmaceuticals and therapeutic proteins. Prolific is supported by leading investors, including Bill Gates’s Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Mayfield and SOSV. We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented Research Associate to help advance our mammalian cell line development and protein production capabilities. At Prolific, we use light to control the expression of biotherapeutic proteins, with the goal of increasing titer and improving quality attributes. In this role, you will play a key part in generating and characterizing cell lines that support both internal research and customer programs. The ideal candidate enjoys hands\-on laboratory work, takes pride in delivering consistent, high\-quality results, and is eager to learn and grow in a fast\-paced startup environment. You’ll collaborate with scientists and engineers across multiple disciplines, with opportunities to expand your technical expertise, take on increasing ownership, and contribute directly to Prolific’s success. This role is based on\-site in our headquarters in Emeryville, CA. ### **Responsibilities:** * Own and drive workflows using mammalian cell culture, primarily working with suspension HEK and suspension CHO * Generate stable cell lines via transfection (ie electroporation) and selection as well as serving as the primary technical owner of many genetically distinct cell lines at once * Handle protein production workflows at different scales \- deep well plates and shake flasks, potentially including small scale bioreactors such as the Ambr system * Execute downstream readouts such as cell counting (Celleca, nucleocounter), metabolite measurements (Nova / CEDEX), Octet BLI, flow cytometry * Perform single cell isolation using methods such as FACS, cell deposition, or Beacon * Execute plasmid cloning and molecular biology techniques including PCR and ddPCR * Conduct experiments independently, collect and analyze data in a timely manner, maintain detailed documentation in electronic lab notebooks, and data visualization and presentation in team meetings ### **Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in Biology, Bioengineering, Biotechnology, or a related field, with relevant laboratory experience in mammalian cell culture. Candidates will be considered at the Research Associate I, Research Associate II, and Senior Research Associate levels based on their experience, technical proficiency, and demonstrated independence. * Proficient in mammalian cell culture, preferably with experience in cell line development, and are well versed in sterile technique, transfection, and clone isolation * Comfortable with readouts such as cell counting, metabolite measurement, Octet BLI and flow cytometry * Comfortable with developing and proposing experimental plans, conducting experiments, and troubleshooting analytical techniques and methodologies * Proficient in precisely following protocols, designing and executing experiments independently, and managing multiple tasks in a fast\-paced setting * Self\-starter who’s committed to team science and effective independent work * Strong organizational skills with an interest in creating and maintaining organizational infrastructure for both lab experiments and with data analysis * Excellent interpersonal and communication skills * Excitement for working in a fast\-paced startup environment and comfort with evolving project scopes and shifting priorities We recognize that strong candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If you have a solid foundation in mammalian cell culture, a commitment to high\-quality laboratory work, and enthusiasm for learning, we encourage you to apply. This role is salaried, exempt, and paid semi\-monthly. Starting salary will be dependent upon specific experience, knowledge, and skillset. The range depending on exact level will typically fall between $72,500\-$87,500 for Research Associate I, $87,500\-$102,500 for Research Associate II, or $102,500\-$117,500 for Sr. Research Associate. **Benefits**: Generous equity package in an early stage company, retirement plan with company contribution, flexible PTO with healthy time off minimums, company\-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, career coaching, mental health support, free team lunches everyday, great snacks, and companywide social events! **Diversity:** Prolific Machines values diverse perspectives, backgrounds, experiences, and ideas. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where all employees can bring their authentic selves to work and have equal opportunities to succeed. Prolific Machines is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. **Location:** The San Francisco Bay Area (Emeryville, CA)

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer (Forward Deployed) [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event\-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco. **About the role** ------------------ Applied AI is where Concurrence meets the real world. Our core engineering team builds the platform. We take it into health systems and build what each customer actually needs on top of it, as durable software that runs in production. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you own an entire customer use case, not a ticket or a slice of one. You take a deployment from brief to production. You make the architecture calls inside it, commit the timeline, and carry the outcome. Success isn't your agent staying up. It's the customer's number moving: more intake handled, fewer denials, faster time to billing close. Your work doesn't stop at one customer. We build custom first, on purpose. When the same shape shows up under two customers, you're the one who sees it, and the pattern you proved becomes part of the platform everyone builds on next. Applied AI runs ahead of the platform, not behind it. Our field work is the R\&D that decides what Concurrence becomes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own a whole use case, end to end.** You run the build from the deployment brief to production and beyond. You set its internal design, commit the timelines, and ship at a bar that doesn't need anyone checking behind you. * **Build agent systems that hold up in clinical settings.** That means hierarchies of agents and skills rather than one monolith, and evals that measure distributions, not vibes. Nothing reaches a patient until it clears our safety floor and eval gate. * **Take on the integration reality.** EHRs, legacy systems, and customer data come in every shape. You find the path from what the customer has to what the platform needs. * **Make it compound.** You turn field\-proven patterns into first\-class platform capabilities. You also push proven work down from agent reasoning into deterministic data lookups, the move where twenty tool calls become one. That's how we grow without turning into a services shop. * **Push back early.** When a spec was never vetted, an integration isn't supported, or scope quietly changed mid\-build, you raise it before the build pays for it. * **Raise the people around you.** Mentor the engineers on your use case and help set how the team builds. Write documentation good enough that a coding agent or a new hire could pick up your work. **You might be a great fit if you** ----------------------------------- * Have shipped and owned complex production systems end to end, with real users depending on them. * Have real experience building with LLMs and agents in production, or the engineering depth to get there fast. * Treat non\-deterministic systems with rigor. You know three runs of an agent is a feeling, not evidence. * Hold the near term and the long term at once: what a decision costs now, and what it makes easier or harder for the team later. * Are comfortable in the room with customers and clinicians. You'd rather understand the workflow than wait for a perfect spec. * Care about craft. Your systems fail loudly to you before they fail to a customer, and they keep working while you're on vacation. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Healthcare experience: EHR integrations (Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth), HL7, FHIR, or clinical workflows. * Experience with Databricks, voice agents, or forward deployed or customer engineering. * Time at an early\-stage startup. **Why this role** ----------------- * **Stakes.** Your work runs inside health systems and touches patient care. * **Ownership, early.** You own whole use cases from the start. At a 35\-person company, scope arrives fast. * **Leverage.** What you build in the field becomes the platform. Few roles let you shape the product this directly. * **A clear path.** Our Applied AI ladder runs from Senior to Staff or Tech Lead. You move up by the kind of work you can be trusted to own, not by how much you ship. * **A week built for deep work.** Collaborative in\-office sprints early in the week, a protected focus day on Thursday, and Friday to consolidate what we learned. **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $200K \- $260K

jobs.description: Description: ***Are you Ready to Change the Industry Together?*** Milestone is a technology\-driven platform modernizing aggregate distribution. We connect customers, carriers, and suppliers through real\-time visibility to deliver the service standard the industry has always needed. Operating across Florida, Texas, and South Carolina, we're committed to raising the standard of service in aggregate distribution. Milestone is powered by NewMile, the technology behind everything we do. NewMile builds the products and services that run our operations, from dispatch and real\-time visibility to the AI\-driven tools that will shape what comes next. It's a fast\-growing team that embraces technology and elevates the experience for our customers, carriers, and team members. We are seeking an experienced, AI\-first Software Engineer to be a pivotal player in building what lies ahead. Based in Jacksonville, FL and reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will design, build, and ship AI\-powered products and agent workflows across the NewMile platform, including our web, mobile, and API services. You're a seasoned engineer who uses AI as a force multiplier every day: you pair with AI coding tools to move faster, you know when to trust the output and when to rewrite it, and you're excited about putting LLMs and agents to work on real problems in aggregate transportation. Whether it was building an agent workflow last month or testing a new model last weekend, your curiosity and enthusiasm make you the right fit. * **Mission:** We are a family of brands committed to raising the standard of service in the aggregate distribution industry. * **Vision:** Accelerating the world’s infrastructure. **Our Values** * **1% Better, Every Day:** Continuous growth is a part of who we are as professionals and people. We are committed to being better today than yesterday, so we are ready for who our organization needs us to be tomorrow. * **Promise \& Deliver:** Pick up the phone, respond, then get it done. We are reliable in every sense of the word and deliver quality work and customer service no matter our role. We own our areas and are accountable to ourselves and each other to build trust. * **Find a Way or Make a Way:** There is no problem we can’t solve. We work together and do hard things to simplify the lives of clients, haulers and each other. We find the best way and are open\-minded to innovation, technology and new ways of working because we are building an organization to change our industry. * **Candid, but Kind:** We tell each other the truth and challenge when we don’t agree. We build real relationships rooted in kindness and thoughtfulness. Our people will always be our \#1 unique and we will never lose sight of that. * **Rev it Up:** Positive energy fuels us to get us to our vision. Each of us contribute to our culture by bringing consistent energy and passion that ripples through our teams like a fire. We celebrate and praise each other’s contributions and strive to create a place we all want to be. **Who You Are** You're a builder who thinks like an engineer, an architect, and a product owner. You have a strong software engineering foundation: you've designed systems, shipped production code, and owned what you built. And you've leaned hard into AI. You use AI coding tools to accelerate development without sacrificing quality, and you can design, build, and evaluate AI\-based systems, including LLM integrations, agent workflows, retrieval and data pipelines, and the guardrails that keep them reliable. You're language\-agnostic and pick up new stacks quickly (we build in Elixir/Phoenix, Flutter/Dart, and SQL). In a small team, you work independently: you take a problem from idea to production with minimal oversight, translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical partners. Experience moving between engineering and product, architecture, or solution design is a big plus. **Why This Role Matters** NewMile is building the future of aggregate transportation, and AI is how we'll get there faster. In this role, you'll turn that ambition into working software: finding where AI can remove manual work, sharpen decisions, and improve the experience for haulers, customers, and our internal teams, and then building it. You'll own the design and delivery of AI\-powered features and agent workflows across NewMile while keeping the core platform performant, secure, and scalable. On a small, fast\-moving team, your ability to architect sound solutions, ship independently, and use AI to multiply your output directly expands what our technology team can deliver. Join us in shaping the future of logistics technology, where your skills and dedication matter every day. **Who Your Internal Customers Are and How This Role Delivers Value to Them:** * **Leadership Team:** You translate strategic priorities into practical AI and technology solutions, giving leadership clear o able, and easy to use, you create products that meet and exceed their expectations. **Your Impact:** **Build AI\-powered products and agent workflows that move the business.** * Design, build, and deploy AI agents and LLM\-powered workflows that automate manual processes and improve decision\-making across NewMile. * Integrate AI capabilities (LLM APIs, retrieval/RAG, tool use, Model Context Protocol and similar frameworks) into our web, mobile, and API services. * Build in evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails so AI features are accurate, secure, cost\-effective, and trustworthy in production. **Architect a robust, scalable, AI\-ready platform.** * Design and develop server\-side functionality and data access (Elixir/Phoenix, Ecto, SQL) that supports both core platform needs and AI use cases. * Shape system architecture and data structures so NewMile's data is clean, accessible, and ready to power AI. * Ensure new functionality meets internal standards for performance, quality, security, and scalability. **Use AI as a force multiplier to ship faster without cutting corners.** * Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic development tools to accelerate design, coding, testing, and documentation. * Review, test, and own AI\-generated code with the same rigor as your own, knowing when to trust the output and when to rewrite it. * Triage and resolve technology issues promptly to keep users and operations running smoothly. **Bring a product mindset to every build.** * Partner with business stakeholders to understand problems, scope solutions, and prioritize the work with the highest impact. * Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on AI\-driven ideas, then take the winners from concept to production. * Own work items end to end with minimal oversight, keeping the CTO and stakeholders informed along the way. **Lead AI adoption and continuous learning.** * Stay current on emerging AI models, tools, and practices, and recommend where they can give NewMile a competitive edge. * Share knowledge, document patterns, and help raise the AI fluency of the tech team and the broader organization. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field preferred (or equivalent experience). * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production applications, ideally in a small\-team SaaS or similar environment. * Strong full\-stack fundamentals: back\-end development, APIs, data modeling, and SQL, plus front\-end experience. Proficiency in at least one modern language; Elixir/Phoenix experience is a plus (or the ability to ramp up quickly). * Hands\-on experience building AI\-based systems: integrating LLMs, designing agent workflows, prompt engineering, retrieval/RAG, and evaluating AI output for accuracy and reliability. * Daily, practical use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with sound judgment on code quality, testing, and security. * Experience with systems design or software architecture; a background in technical product management, solution architecture, or product development is a strong plus. * Experience with mobile app development (Flutter \+ Dart, React Native, or similar) is a plus. * Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms, including deploying and monitoring services. * Proven ability to work independently, own projects from concept to production, and troubleshoot complex issues without heavy guidance. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a pragmatic bias toward shipping effective solutions over perfect ones. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical and AI concepts to non\-technical partners. * Experience with Git, Agile development practices, and basic project management. * Understanding of data privacy, security, and responsible AI practices. * Collaborative, curious, and committed to continuous learning. * Based in or willing to relocate to Jacksonville, FL.

jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Engineer (Forward Deployed) [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event\-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco. **About the role** ------------------ Applied AI is where Concurrence meets the real world. Our core engineering team builds the platform. We take it into health systems and build what each customer actually needs on top of it, as durable software that runs in production. As a Staff Applied AI Engineer, you own our most complex customer use cases and set technical direction across deployments. You take a deployment from brief to production. You make the architecture calls inside it and across shared systems, commit the timeline, and carry the outcome. Success isn't your agent staying up. It's the customer's number moving: more intake handled, fewer denials, faster time to billing close. Your work doesn't stop at one customer. We build custom first, on purpose. When the same shape shows up under two customers, you're the one who sees it, and the pattern you proved becomes part of the platform everyone builds on next. Applied AI runs ahead of the platform, not behind it. Our field work is the R\&D that decides what Concurrence becomes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own our most complex use cases, end to end.** You run the build from the deployment brief to production and beyond. You set technical direction within and across deployments, resolve tradeoffs with the platform team, commit the timelines, and stay hands\-on in the hardest parts of the build. * **Build agent systems that hold up in clinical settings.** That means hierarchies of agents and skills rather than one monolith, and evals that measure distributions, not vibes. Nothing reaches a patient until it clears our safety floor and eval gate. * **Take on the integration reality.** EHRs, legacy systems, and customer data come in every shape. You find the path from what the customer has to what the platform needs. * **Make it compound.** You turn field\-proven patterns into first\-class platform capabilities. You also push proven work down from agent reasoning into deterministic data lookups, the move where twenty tool calls become one. That's how we grow without turning into a services shop. * **Push back early.** When a spec was never vetted, an integration isn't supported, or scope quietly changed mid\-build, you raise it before the build pays for it. * **Raise the people around you.** Mentor engineers across deployments and help set the team's architecture and engineering standards. Write documentation good enough that a coding agent or a new hire could pick up your work. **You might be a great fit if you** ----------------------------------- * Have shipped and owned complex production systems end to end, with real users depending on them. * Have set technical direction across multiple projects or teams, and helped other engineers make sound architecture decisions. * Have real experience building with LLMs and agents in production, or the engineering depth to get there fast. * Treat non\-deterministic systems with rigor. You know three runs of an agent is a feeling, not evidence. * Hold the near term and the long term at once: what a decision costs now, and what it makes easier or harder for the team later. * Are comfortable in the room with customers and clinicians. You'd rather understand the workflow than wait for a perfect spec. * Care about craft. Your systems fail loudly to you before they fail to a customer, and they keep working while you're on vacation. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Healthcare experience: EHR integrations (Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth), HL7, FHIR, or clinical workflows. * Experience with Databricks, voice agents, or forward deployed or customer engineering. * Time at an early\-stage startup. **Why this role** ----------------- * **Stakes.** Your work runs inside health systems and touches patient care. * **Ownership, early.** You own complex use cases and shared technical decisions from the start. At a 35\-person company, scope arrives fast. * **Leverage.** What you build in the field becomes the platform. Few roles let you shape the product this directly. * **Technical leadership.** Set direction across Applied AI while staying close to the code. Your impact grows through the decisions and patterns the whole team builds on. * **A week built for deep work.** Collaborative in\-office sprints early in the week, a protected focus day on Thursday, and Friday to consolidate what we learned. **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $240K \- $300K

workflows, including orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex * Expert\-level experience building on Snowflake, including Snowpark, Cortex AI (Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst), and jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II — Regression Infrastructure, Trainium Manufacturing Infrastucture
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Our Annapurna Labs team at Amazon is looking for a Software Development Engineer to own the regression infrastructure that every manufacturing software release depends on. Before new test software reaches a production line, it is validated on real hardware, both in our lab and at our manufacturing sites. You will own those regression systems end to end: the hardware they run on, and the software that keeps them configured, connected and healthy at all times. You'll build the automation that detects problems and repairs systems without manual work, so regression is always ready to gate a release. This is a software role at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, hardware and networking. AWS Trainium is at the center of the AI infrastructure race, and our mission is "Silicon never waits." This is a new, high\-visibility area with no existing owner, so you'll have wide room to define the architecture, choose the approach and grow the scope as we scale to more sites and new platforms. Key job responsibilities * Own the regression infrastructure in our lab and at manufacturing sites, and extend it to every site * Build software (Python, Go, TypeScript, Java or C\+\+) that configures, monitors and maintains the servers, firmware and network devices regression depends on * Automate repair: detect failures, recover systems through software, escalate only when hands\-on work is needed * Keep software and firmware versions consistent across lab, manufacturing and fleet environments * Feed infrastructure health into release pipelines so releases reflect real hardware state * Partner with hardware, firmware, network and test teams to set standards and clear ownership * Write runbooks, join on\-call, and lead root\-cause reviews A day in the life You might start by reviewing overnight health reports for the regression systems and checking that every system is configured, connected and ready. Then you could dig into a recurring failure, write the automation that detects and repairs it, and add a health check so that release pipelines see the result. In the afternoon you might review a teammate's design, join a call with hardware or network engineers to agree on a recovery approach, or plan the next site rollout. Your work keeps releases moving, so every hour you save is an hour sooner that new hardware reaches customers. About the team Manufacturing Automation \& Deployment, part of Annapurna ML, builds and runs the software platform that tests and validates AWS Trainium hardware at manufacturing sites worldwide. We deliver test software to active production lines with the release discipline of a cloud service: staged rollouts, regression gates, automated alarming and fast rollback. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer III, AWS AI/ML Servers
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS runs the world's largest fleet of AI/ML accelerator servers. When a model with billions of parameters trains across a large scale of GPUs, the software that provisions, monitors, and heals that fleet is what keeps training on track. We build the services, control planes, and data platforms that turn hundreds of thousands of servers into a reliable, self\-managing system. If you want to build software at the intersection of large\-scale distributed systems and the physical infrastructure powering frontier AI, this is the role. We are seeking a Software Development Engineer to design and build the software that operates our accelerated compute fleet: fleet\-management services, orchestration and remediation control planes, telemetry and analytics pipelines, and the APIs and tools that engineering, operations, and partner teams depend on. You will own software from design through production, working across multiple teams and organizations to deliver scalable, reliable services. What You Will Do You will design and build distributed services and data platforms that manage the fleet end to end. You will turn ambiguous problems into well\-architected software: designing APIs, choosing data models, making the latency, availability, and cost trade\-offs that come with operating at fleet scale. You will build the control planes that automate provisioning, health evaluation, and remediation, and the pipelines that transform raw telemetry into signals other teams act on. When your service catches and routes a failing node automatically before it disrupts a training job, that is your impact. Why You Will Love It Your software runs across a large scale of servers in the cloud, and you see its impact on fleet availability within days of shipping. You solve genuinely hard distributed\-systems problems, own services end to end, and work close enough to the hardware to understand exactly what your software is managing. The team is small enough that your design decisions shape the architecture, and large enough that you always have experts to learn from across software, hardware, and operations. The Ideal Candidate You are a strong software engineer first: you design clean abstractions, write high\-quality, testable code, and reason about correctness, scalability, and failure modes. You care about the customer of your software, whether that is an operations engineer, a partner service, or an internal tool user. You communicate clearly, raise the engineering bar for your team, and can partner with hardware, firmware, and operations engineers to build software that reflects how the fleet actually behaves. Key job responsibilities Service \& Platform Development 1\. Design, build, and operate scalable distributed services and control planes that automate fleet provisioning, health evaluation, and remediation across a large scale of servers 2\. Design APIs, data models, and system architectures that balance latency, availability, durability, and cost at fleet scale 3\. Own software end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations, following engineering best practices for code review, source control, and CI/CD Data \& Telemetry Platforms 1\. Build data and telemetry pipelines that ingest, correlate, and transform signals from across the fleet into actionable insights and automated actions 2\. Develop analytics and reporting services, dashboards, and alerting that give engineering and operations teams real\-time visibility into fleet health 3\. Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to process high\-volume telemetry efficiently and reliably Reliability \& Operational Excellence 1\. Improve the resilience, performance, and cost of the services you own, and reduce operational load through automation 3\. Produce clear, maintainable documentation for services, APIs, and runbooks so others can operate and extend your work Technical Leadership \& Collaboration 1\. Decompose complex problems into well\-scoped components that you and other engineers can deliver in parallel 2\. Partner with systems, firmware, hardware, and operations engineers to translate fleet behavior into software requirements and correct abstractions 3\. Review designs and code, mentor engineers, and set engineering standards for the team May require occasional ( A day in the life You start the day reviewing a design document for a new remediation control\-plane API, leaving feedback on the data model and failure handling. Mid\-morning, you pair with a teammate to debug elevated latency in the telemetry ingestion service and ship a fix. In the afternoon, you review overnight metrics from a service you own, then write code for a new fleet\-health scoring pipeline. You end the day in a design review with a partner team, aligning on the API contract your service will expose to their tooling. jobs.title: Recruiter, GTM
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Anthropic is looking for a talented and driven Recruiter to partner with our Go\-To\-Market teams. In this role, you'll help build the teams that bring safe, frontier AI to the organizations that depend on it, spanning Sales, Partnerships, Public Sector, and Beneficial Deployments. GTM is one of the fastest\-growing parts of Anthropic, and the market for this talent is competitive and fast\-moving. The people we hire need an unusual combination of commercial ability and genuine domain depth. You'll own full\-cycle recruiting for a portfolio of GTM roles, act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to hiring managers and leaders, and help shape how we assess commercial talent as we scale. You'll develop a real understanding of each hiring manager's goals, the markets they serve, and the profiles that succeed against them. Many of the roles you support will be new or evolving, and you'll have significant influence over interview loops, calibration practices, sourcing strategy, and how we talk about this work to candidates who have options. You'll also be one of the people candidates remember. For many, you'll be their first real window into what it's like to work here. This is an individual contributor role with meaningful autonomy. We expect you to run your searches independently, make judgment calls without waiting for direction, and be the person your hiring managers turn to first on anything talent\-related. It's a strong fit for someone who is energized by a high bar, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and genuinely interested in the mission our GTM teams are selling. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own full\-cycle recruiting for GTM roles, from intake through offer and close, with a strong emphasis on candidate experience and stakeholder partnership * Build and maintain strategic relationships with hiring managers and leaders, serving as their primary partner on hiring and translating their goals into calibrated role requirements, must\-have skills, and assessment criteria * Become an expert in the markets our GTM teams serve, understanding where the talent sits, what motivates it, and what distinguishes a strong candidate from a plausible one * Build and execute sourcing strategies for competitive, specialized commercial talent, including targeted outreach campaigns, market mapping, and cultivating talent pools that don't yet exist as pipelines * Advise GTM leaders on talent market conditions, compensation dynamics, pipeline health, and realistic timelines, including when a search needs to be reframed * Design and refine interview loops, intake practices, and assessment approaches for roles that are new or evolving, partnering with hiring managers to define what "good" looks like before the first candidate enters the process * Maintain an inclusive and consistent process, using structured interviews and calibrated criteria that reduce the influence of bias on hiring decisions * Partner with Recruiting Operations to use pipeline data and metrics to diagnose bottlenecks and inform resourcing decisions, process improvements, and candidate experience * Serve as a thought partner to hiring managers on organizational design questions, including what a team actually needs, how roles should be scoped, and where a hire will and won't solve the problem * Represent Anthropic's mission, culture, and approach to AI safety authentically to commercial candidates **You May Be a Good Fit If You** -------------------------------- * Have 5\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting experience, including sourcing, assessing, and closing candidates, ideally with time in a high\-growth technology company * Have recruited for commercial or Go\-To\-Market functions such as Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Partnerships, or Marketing * Have a demonstrated ability to partner with and influence hiring managers and senior stakeholders, including pushing back when a search is mis\-scoped * Have strong written and verbal communication skills, including a knack for writing outreach that specialized candidates actually respond to * Are able to use pipeline data to diagnose problems and inform decisions * Are proficient with an applicant tracking system and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter * Can manage competing priorities and operate with autonomy in a fast\-changing environment * Have a passion for AI's potential to positively impact the world, along with a realistic assessment of its risks and limitations * Bring an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality and are a true team player **Strong Cand  degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: AI Software Evaluation Engineer, Siri AI Quality
jobs.description: Summary Play a part in the next revolution in human\-computer interaction and redefine mobile computing through voice interaction! Apple's Siri AI Quality team is looking for a passionate and skilled AI Software Evaluation Engineer to join our mission of delivering the highest\-quality AI experiences to millions of users worldwide. We own the end\-to\-end Siri pre\-ship evaluation dataset and the synthetic personas that power it. In this role, you will combine agentic engineering, data analytics and AI evaluation experience to help us catch quality issues early, automate repetitive eval operations, and expand coverage as Siri's features and platforms grow. Description In this role, you will build the systems that evaluate Siri's AI experiences and turn the results into action. Your work will span multiple areas of focus: \* Evaluation data insights. Investigate why test scenarios regress and which issues recur. Turn failure and bug data into root\-cause findings and recommendations that product, engineering and partner teams act on. \* Coverage analysis. Find gaps across app intents, features and product areas, and partner with domain owners to close them. Build and report on dataset quality, issue trends and coverage. \* Agentic scenario generation, triage and auto\-fix. Design agentic workflows that propose, ground, validate, triage and nominate new evaluation scenarios with minimal manual effort. Extend automated screening, triage and fix tooling to new domains and device platforms. You will work with engineering, product, evaluator, persona and data\-platform teams to define quality standards and deliver evaluation systems that guide Siri's development. If you are a self\-motivated engineer with a strong analytical mind, a bias toward automation and a desire to improve a product used by millions, we encourage you to apply. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with agent frameworks and developer tooling, such as MCP servers, skills or plugins, and agentic testing. * Experience with voice assistants, conversational AI or multi\-turn dialogue evaluation. * Experience with data schemas, validation frameworks, and structured data formats (e.g. JSON). * Experience with data visualization and BI tools (e.g. Tableau) and with data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake). * Familiarity with coverage analysis, traffic or taxonomy analysis, and root\-cause analysis of flaky or regressing tests. * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment with shifting priorities. jobs.title: AIML - Sr Machine Learning Platform Engineer, Evaluation
jobs.description: Summary We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced machine learning engineer to join AIML Evaluation to build the systems that evaluate and refine Apple's foundation models and agents. As a key member of the team, you will help design and develop benchmarks, evaluators, simulation environments, and prompt and context optimization pipelines that drive quality improvements across Apple's AI experiences. You will collaborate with product teams and the foundation model team to close the loop between observation and improvement, contributing datasets, environments, and reward signals that drive model and agent quality. Description Most model evaluation stops at a scorecard. The failing traces get thrown away, even though they're the most relevant training signal we have. Our team puts them to work. We evaluate across offline benchmarks, device\-in\-the\-loop simulation, and on\-device observation in production, and we turn what we find into persona\-grounded datasets and reward signals for foundation model post\-training. In this role, you will build the systems that connect failure analysis to measurable model and agent improvements across a broad range of AI products at Apple. The path from finding a problem to fixing it is short: the loop you build finds the failure, produces the data and checks the result. The work reaches millions of users.
