Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS\&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes. Description On Marcom Engineering's AI Experiences team, we build AI\-powered tools for Apple's marketing and creative teams, from AI\-assisted copy workflows to AI Optimization (AIO), along with the AI foundations that help our engineers, and the AI agents working alongside them, ship on\-brand work faster. We are hiring a Frontend Architect to set the technical direction for AI across our frontend. You will define how AI powers the tools our marketing and creative teams rely on, how it changes the way our engineers build, and how our design system becomes the foundation AI tools reach for when they generate UI. This role sits at the intersection of frontend architecture, applied AI, and design systems: you'll shape the strategy, design the systems that make it real, and bring partners across Apple along with you. If you thrive on ambiguity, think a step ahead of the industry, and want to shape how Apple builds for the web as AI changes the craft, we want to hear from you. Minimum Qualifications * 10 years building production web applications, including 3\+ years in a senior or architect role setting frontend direction across teams * Expert\-level TypeScript and React, jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, AI/ML Model Quality
jobs.description: Summary Would you like to contribute to Machine Learning and Generative AI technologies? Are you passionate about the integrity of the data that powers AI systems at scale? Do you believe that trustworthy data is the foundation of every great model? We truly believe it is! We are defining what exceptional data quality looks like for machine learning across Wallet, Payments, and Commerce. As a Machine Learning Engineer, AI/ML Model Quality, you will build and maintain intelligent systems, validation frameworks, synthetic data generation models and monitoring pipelines that keep our data ecosystem healthy — ensuring that every model we build is trained, evaluated, and deployed on data we can trust. Your work sits at the foundation of every ML feature that reaches hundreds of millions of users. You'll work at the intersection of machine learning, statistical rigor and production systems, collaborating closely with Data Engineering, Privacy, and Legal teams. This unique opportunity puts you at the center of ML and AI quality — owning the health of training and validation datasets, defining and analyzing observability metrics, building models to calibrate \& measure robustness, and leading telemetry analysis across GenAI workflows — ensuring Apple's financial features are built on the highest\-quality data, whether powering conventional ML models or the latest generative AI systems. Description The ideal candidate is detail\-obsessed who understands that model quality starts long before training — it starts with the data. You have strong statistical instincts, know how silent degradation and data drift manifest in production systems, and can translate raw quality signals into insights that drive real decisions. You will own the health of the data ecosystem that underpins ML and GenAI features across Wallet, Payments, and Commerce — building validation frameworks, defining observability metrics, and leading telemetry analysis that keeps every model trained, evaluated, and monitored on data teams can trust. Your work sits at the foundation of every ML feature that reaches hundreds of millions of users. Minimum Qualifications * A Bachelor's degree with exceptional hands\-on experience in ML/AI model quality or applied research or a M.S or Ph.D in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field is strongly preferred. * 3\+ years of experience in defining and tracking ML model health metrics in production — model performance monitoring, feature drift detection, and observability instrumentation. * 3\+ years of experience in Machine Learning, data science or a closely related analytical role, with a strong focus on data quality, model evaluation, or ML observability in production environments. * Proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-learn), common ML frameworks like PyTorch and SQL for complex data analysis, metric creation, and validation. * Experience querying and analyzing large\-scale datasets using distributed computing frameworks (e.g., PySpark, Spark, or distributed SQL). * Solid understanding of statistical methods — hypothesis testing, distribution analysis, data drift detection, and statistical process control. * Experience with GenAI or LLM systems, including common quality failure modes, output evaluation approaches, and telemetry instrumentation. * Strong communication skills — ability to translate complex data quality findings and model health risks into clear, actionable insights for both engineering and non\-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools (e.g., Tableau, Apache Superset, Databricks) to present complex ML telemetry. * Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g. LangSmith) or techniques like LLM\-as\-a\-judge. * Experience with Bayesian or causal graph\-based approaches to synthetic data generation. * Familiarity with confidence calibration techniques and uncertainty quantification. * Experience with ML monitoring or observability platforms (e.g., MLflow, Weights \& Biases, or equivalent). * Experience working with privacy\-constrained data or under regulatory compliance frameworks (GDPR, DMA). * Background in financial services, fintech, or consumer payment products. At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Summary Imagine what you can do here. Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their lives best work. Together we create products and experiences people once couldn't have imagined, and now, can't imagine living without. It's the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. Description APPLE INC has the following available in Cupertino, California and various unanticipated locations throughout the USA. Develop new reliability tests procedures and specifications by performing failure modes effects and analysis (FMEA) to identify design and process specific failures and their corresponding use cases, detection methods, and performance evaluation criteria. Design of experiments to characterize user behavior to inform test spec development. Analyze instrumented study data to quantify subjective user experience. Prepare concise and detailed test plans and analyzing test reports. Weibull statistical analysis of data to provide quantitative risk assessments of anticipated exposure in the field by considering stress\-strength analysis, acceleration factors, user perception/behavior, and test\-to\-field correlation. Present tests, test results, and risk assessments in a confident and positive manner to the cross\-functional and leadership teams. Research new technologies to understand unique failure mechanisms by driving quantification of subjective user perception such as using machine learning image processing techniques. Guide design and interact with diverse groups to improve product reliability. Investigate failures during reliability testing to determine root cause and drive mitigations. Guide failure analysis to determine root cause through familiarity with characterization techniques such as SEM, TEM, FTIR, CT, etc. Collaborate with design teams to develop mitigations for failures in Reliability testing by leveraging expertise in mechanical engineering/materials science to inform solution space and scope feasibility of fixes prior to implementation. 40 hours/week. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Multilingual AI - Siri
jobs.description: Summary Siri is used by people all over the world, in their own languages on billions of Apple devices. Global Siri makes that possible, working across engineering teams to bring Siri and the Apple Intelligence experiences built around it to users in every supported language and region. This is a pivotal moment. Siri is evolving from a voice assistant into a deeply personal, agentic AI that understands your personal context, reasons on what's on your screen, and takes action across your apps, all built on Apple's foundation of privacy. Bringing that experience to every language and every culture is one of the hardest and most consequential problems in applied AI today: it requires close integration across large language models, speech technologies, multimodal understanding, agentic evaluation, and the large\-scale data and platform systems that tie them together. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a multi\-team AI engineering organization, at the intersection of feature development, engineering architecture, and global language readiness. You'll define the strategy and execution for how Siri's next\-generation intelligence reaches international users, set the technical direction, grow an exceptional group of managers and engineers, and partner with global regional teams to bring these experiences to users worldwide. If you want deep technical challenges, global product impact, and the satisfaction of seeing your work reach people in their own language across the world, this is the right role. Description As Senior Engineering Manager for Global Siri, you will lead a group of engineering and machine learning teams, responsible for internationalization architecture, cross\-functional integration, and engineering readiness of next\-generation Siri and Apple Intelligence features. You'll be accountable for end\-to\-end outcomes: from defining the technical strategy and scalable ML architecture, through model development, data, and evaluation, to shipping production systems that run on\-device and in Apple's Private Cloud Compute. Your organization's scope will cover the full stack of international language technologies including: \- Language understanding and LLMs: establish multilingual and locale\-specific scaling technologies. Work with foundation model and features teams on architecture, model behavior, adaptation, evaluation of intentional experiences, reasoning, and generation, including personal context and on\-screen awareness. \- Speech and multimodal input: automatic speech recognition (ASR), text\-to\-speech (TTS), speaker understanding, and fusion of voice, vision, and text input across languages, accents, and dialects. \- Agentic capabilities: ensuring Siri can reliably take action across apps and services for users worldwide, accounting for regional apps, conventions, and expectations. \- Evaluation and data science: building state\-of\-the\-art multilingual and agentic evaluation that tells us, with rigor, how good Siri is in each market and where to invest next. \- Data and platform: scalable systems for data collection, annotation, synthetic data generation, and language\-specific representations and conventions, plus the tooling and pipelines that make launching a new language faster with each release. You'll partner closely with Siri's Speech, Experience, Platform, and Foundation Model teams, as well as product, design, research, data science, and regional engineering organizations, to turn ambitious goals into shipped products. You'll be a visible leader across Siri and Apple Intelligence, providing regular updates to senior leadership and influencing roadmaps well beyond your own organization. What you'll do \- Lead and grow a multi\-team organization of ML engineers and software engineers, including managing first\-line managers and senior technical leaders. \- Set the technical strategy and multi\-year engineering plan for bringing Siri and Apple Intelligence capabilities to international markets, and translate it into clear priorities, milestones, and owners. \- Own key decisions on ML architecture and language technologies across Siri products and technologies; shape model and platform requirements through partnership with the teams that own those systems. \- Build scalable, repeatable systems and processes that reduce the cost and time of adding and improving each language, so quality scales with the number of markets rather than against it. \- Establish rigorous, data\-driven evaluation for each locale, including agentic and end\-to\-end evaluation, and use it to guide investment and launch decisions. \- Lead data strategy, including annotation programs, data quality, and the definition of language\-specific representations, conventions, and guidelines. \- Partner across Siri and Apple Intelligence, influencing teams throughout the stack so that international is designed in from the start rather than added later. \- Champion modern engineering practices and reusabl team organization, with a track record of developing first\-line managers and senior engineers. * Hands\-on technical background in software and/or ML engineering, with depth in at least one of: LLM\-based products, language technologies, speech systems, or multimodal AI products. * Proven track record of shipping ML\-powered products at scale, with a detailed understanding of development, evaluation, integration, and release readiness. * Strong leadership, planning, and prioritization skills, with demonstrated ability to deliver complex, cross\-functional programs. * Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting to executive leadership and working effectively with people across a wide range of backgrounds and technical depth. * B.S. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Linguistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, ML
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. **JOB SUMMARY** Apptronik is seeking a Staff MLOps Engineer to own the technical direction of our MLOps platform — the system of record for datasets, experiments, model artifacts, and serving paths that connects teleoperation data collection on one side to deployed autonomy on Apollo on the other. In this role, you will set the architecture for the platform layer above the training cluster: dataset lifecycle, experiment tracking, model registry, evaluation harnesses, and the serving / packaging path that delivers trained policies to robots in the field. You will lead by influence across MLOps, Autonomy, Data Platform, and TeleOp — establishing the standards, contracts, and tooling that turn one\-off research code into a repeatable, auditable pipeline from data to deployed model. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role, not a management position; you will be a primary contributor while mentoring the engineers around you, and partnering closely with the Training Infrastructure engineer who owns the cluster layer beneath the platform. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** **Platform Architecture \& Ownership** * **Technical Direction:** Own the technical direction for the MLOps platform — define subsystem interfaces, drive architecture decisions, and establish engineering standards for how datasets, experiments, and models move through Apptronik's systems. * **Cross\-Team Authority:** Serve as the primary technical point of contact for Autonomy, Data Platform, and TeleOp on all matters of model lifecycle and platform contracts. **Dataset Lifecycle \& Versioning** * **Versioning \& Lineage:** Design and operate the dataset layer end\-to\-end — versioning, lineage, splits, and labeling\-integration handoff. * **Reproducibility:** Ensure every trained model can be traced back to the exact data and code that produced it. **Model Registry \& Artifact Management** * **Registry:** Build and operate a first\-class model registry — versioned artifacts, metadata, evaluation results, lineage, and approval workflows. * **Promotion Path:** Define the promotion path from "trained" to "qualified" to "deployed to robot." **Evaluation \& Qualification Harnesses** * **Automated Evaluation:** Define the offline benchmarks, simulation rollouts, and policy\-gating harnesses that any model must pass before reaching Apollo. * **Metrics Framework:** Develop the metrics framework that the autonomy team trusts to gate releases. **Serving, Packaging \& Deployment to Robot** * **On\-Robot Path:** Own the path from registered model to running inference on Apollo — packaging (ONNX, TensorRT, torch.compile), versioning on\-robot, rollback, and observability of deployed policy behavior. * **Telemetry Seam:** Coordinate with Connect and Data Platform on the deploy\-and\-telemetry seam back from the fleet. **Mentorship \& Cross\-Functional Leadership** * **Mentorship:** Mentor mid\-level and senior engineers on the MLOps team through code review, design review, and direct collaboration. * **Influence:** Partner with the Training Infrastructure engineer on the cluster/platform contract, and influence research workflows across Autonomy to standardize on the platform's primitives. **SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS** * Deep proficiency in Python and at least one systems\-level language (Go, Rust, or C\+\+), with demonstrated ability to make and defend architectural tradeoffs in production ML platforms * Proven experience owning and delivering an MLOps platform end\-to\-end — dataset lifecycle, experiment tracking, model registry, evaluation, and serving — at a company that ships models to production * Expertise across the model lifecycle: dataset versioning (DVC, LakeFS, Delta, or equivalent), experiment tracking (MLflow, W\&B, Determined), model registry, and policy serving * Strong background designing service\-oriented systems on Kubernetes; comfortable with the contract between platform APIs and underlying compute infrastructure * Experience defining evaluation and qualification frameworks for ML models where the cost of a regression is high (robotics, safety\-critical, or production\-customer\-facing) * Experience leading technical projects end\-to\-end: architecture, implementation, validation, and iteration * Demonstrated ability to lead by influence across teams — setting standards that other engineers adopt voluntarily, and mentoring engineers around you * Proficiency with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), Docker, Git, and modern CI/CD workflows **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field preferred; Bachelor's considered with exceptional experience. * 8\+ years of professional software engineering jobs.description: Job ID 26WD101846 **Job Requisition ID \#** 26WD101846 **Principal Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions** **Position Overview** Autodesk Technical Advisory is seeking a highly technical and customer\-focused **Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions** to join our new Embedded Engineering (forward\-deployed engineering) team. You will work directly alongside strategic Autodesk customers to discover high\-value workflows, model the **data** those workflows depend on, and build the **AI systems** for their Design \& Make workflows to enable customer’s measurable business outcomes. You will move fluidly from understanding a customer's workflow and architecture to writing code. You will spend your weeks writing production code to build agents and orchestration, retrieval and graph services, connectors and APIs \- inside customer environments, alongside customer engineers. What you ship is concrete: AI agents, MCP servers and tools, domain and semantic models, knowledge\-graph extensions, retrieval and context\-resolution pipelines, integrations into ERP, PLM, BIM, enterprise data platforms, and eval harnesses to move new capabilities into production. Unlike traditional project delivery, Embedded Engineering works deeply inside customer environments, connecting Autodesk technology and data with the rest of the enterprise. Insights developed through customer work will be translated into reusable agents, connectors, reference architectures, engineering patterns, and direct product feedback that shapes Autodesk's platform roadmap. The successful candidate combines strong software and AI engineering skills with curiosity, customer empathy, business judgment, and the ability to operate independently when the problem is not yet well defined. jobs.description: **When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.** A seasoned Red Team professional with experience dealing with AI systems. You will also play a key role in driving red teaming best practices, ethical alignment, and safeguarding the integrity of generative AI models. **Job Description:** **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities,** including but not limited to: 1\. Lead and execute red team operations, including targeting AI/ML systems, simulating adversarial attacks such as prompt injections, data poisoning, model inversion, and evasion techniques to identify vulnerabilities in generative AI, computer vision, or natural language processing models. 2\. Evaluate AI systems for ethical risks, biases, fairness issues, and harmful content generation, collaborating with trust and safety teams to assess compliance with responsible AI standards and mitigate potential societal impacts. 3\. Develop and deploy custom tools, exploits, and automated testing frameworks for AI security assessments, including infrastructure for adversarial input generation and privacy\-preserving attacks on federated learning environments. 4\. Conduct research on emerging AI threats, publish findings on offensive AI techniques, and integrate AI/ML tools into red team methodologies for enhanced threat simulation and anomaly detection. 5\. Mentor junior engineers in AI\-specific red teaming practices, lead small teams during engagements, and collaborate with blue teams to validate detections against AI\-targeted attacks like jailbreaking large language models. 6\. Stay Current: Stay up\-to\-date on cutting\-edge AI security research, adversarial machine learning techniques, and ethical AI frameworks to ensure robust red teaming practices. 7\. Collaborate with AI Teams: Work closely with machine learning engineers, data scientists, product managers, and AI researchers to evaluate model performance under adversarial conditions and provide actionable recommendations for strengthening AI defenses. 8\. Provide technical support to incident response teams, analyze vulnerabilities during investigations, and assist with corrective measures. 9\. Collaborate with blue teams, purple teams, and broader security groups to stress\-test systems, validate detection mechanisms, and improve enterprise readiness. 10\. Plan, coordinate, and execute full\-lifecycle red team operations, including reconnaissance, command and control setup, lateral movement, and adversary emulation to simulate real\-world attacks and test organizational defenses. **Minimum Qualifications:** Education: BS Preferred Licensure, Certification \& Registration: Preferred to have certificates: * Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), OSCP, OSEP, or similar offensive security certifications * AI/ML security certifications Experience: • 3 – 5 \+ years of experience in offensive security, penetration testing, or red teaming * 1 – 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with AI/ML systems and frameworks Skills, Knowledge \& Abilities: • Expertise with red teaming tools (Kali Linux, Metasploit, Wireshark, Burp Suite, etc.) Preferred Qualifications \& Skills: * Understanding of machine learning fundamentals and model architectures * Experience with AI model interpretability \& automation tools * Traditional penetration testing and red team methodologies **Pay Range:** $125,000\.00 USD – $160,000\.00 USD The pay range listed for this position is the annual base salary range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at this time. jobs.title: Senior Backend & DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **The role, at a glance:** The Senior Backend Engineer is a 3\-month contract position that develops cloud services, APIs, and infrastructure for Biamp’s audiovisual conferencing solutions used worldwide. Exposure to REST or gRPC is also valuable * Experience with SpiceDB, OpenFGA, or other Zanzibar\-style permission systems * Experience designing relationship\-based, hierarchical authorization models (ReBAC), including inherited and delegated access * Experience with SQL and relational databases * Experience working in Linux environments, including administration and shell scripting * Experience with agile development practices * Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work independently and in a team **Some nice\-to\-haves:** * Experience with Kubernetes, Docker * Experience with Zitadel, Auth0, or similar OIDC providers * Experience with SCIM provisioning and SSO identity providers (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID) * Experience with message systems such as NATS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ * Experience with Terraform for building and managing infrastructure * CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Bitbucket * Experience with Microsoft Azure **Tools \& Collaboration** Bitbucket, Jenkins, Docker, Azure Kubernetes Services, Terraform, Jira, and Confluence. **Work Environment:** This is a 3\-month, on\-site contract position. Biamp does not have a remote or hybrid work policy for this role. **Who is Biamp?** We make the world’s most extraordinary audio and video solutions. For over 50 years, Biamp has created and innovated professional audiovisual solutions that enable great communication. From the smallest of rooms to the largest of venues, we empower true human connection in every space. As we grow to meet our customers’ needs and evolve to address the challenges of tomorrow, one guiding principle remains the same: Biamp connects people through extraordinary audiovisual experiences. **About our company:** At Biamp, we believe the employment relationship should be reciprocal. We champion a supportive and dynamic environment filled with passionate people who choose continuous improvement over perfection. We insist on clear, explicit decision making, believe in taking calculated risks, and celebrate tough decisions even when they don’t succeed. We look for people who desire the best from themselves and encourage the same from their coworkers. Our commitment to one another and to the common goal is the most consistent reliable path to recurring success for all of us.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description: Today we are a large health insurance agency selling coverage nationwide. We have grown through multiple market shifts, from Medicare Advantage to ACA plans, and built a team with many people who have been here for years. That's not an accident, and it's the thing we're most quietly proud of. We're not here to save the world. Health insurance is a complicated, often frustrating product to sell and service, and we don't pretend otherwise. We care about building something worth showing up to: a company where the work is real, people are treated well, and the clients we serve actually get helped. We also run a direct\-to\-consumer subscription e\-commerce business in a regulated category. Both businesses have outgrown off\-the\-shelf tools. As our first full\-time engineer, you'll work directly with the founder to build platforms that replace them and turn them into SaaS products we sell to other businesses. ### ### **What you will build** * A subscription commerce platform: product catalog, recurring billing with retries and dunning, order routing to fulfillment partners, shipment tracking, a customer self\-service portal, and the admin screens our team works in every day. * A multi\-tenant commission dashboard for insurance agencies, sold as a product: carrier commission statements in, clean numbers out for each agency, agent, and downline, covering revenue, chargebacks, persistency, payouts, and forecasts. * An AI sales assistant that works leads over SMS and turns them into customers: it qualifies, answers questions, handles objections, sends checkout links, and hands off to a human when needed. It plugs into both platforms and is also sold on its own. An early version exists; you will finish it or rebuild it. * The shared foundation under all three: auth and roles, tenant isolation, background jobs, webhooks, audit logs, and a design system. ### **What you bring** * 7\+ years building production web products, with at least 3 years of senior work before 2023\. * SaaS or e\-commerce products you built and shipped: checkout, subscriptions and recurring billing, orders and fulfillment, customer accounts. * Deep TypeScript, React, and Next.js; Postgres data modeling; typed APIs (tRPC or similar) with schema validation. * Multi\-tenant B2B SaaS: organizations, roles, data isolation enforced on the server, and subscription billing for your own customers. * Back\-end workflow experience: state machines, job queues, retries, webhooks that are safe to receive twice. * LLM features in production: prompt and tool design, testing conversations before they ship, guardrails, and keeping model costs under control. * Messaging and CRM integrations: SMS providers, CRMs such as GoHighLevel or HubSpot, and consent and opt\-out rules (TCPA, 10DLC). * Real third\-party integrations shipped, including messy data such as CSV or PDF files from partners. * Money and reporting you trust: you reconcile totals against the source system before you show a number. * A high bar for UI and UX. You design and build polished, original interfaces yourself: clear hierarchy, considered typography and spacing, every state handled (loading, empty, error), accessible, and fast. Show us a portfolio of interfaces you designed. * Creative problem solving. HIPAA, PCI, or insurance\-industry experience is a strong plus. ### **How we work** * Small team, direct line to the founder, fast decisions. * You own architecture, and you ship to production weekly. * We judge work by the running product, not by tickets closed. * Design is part of engineering. Our products are used by customers and sold to other businesses, so every screen has to look intentional and trustworthy, never like an AI template. ### **First 90 days** * Weeks 1 to 2: learn the existing systems, set up the codebase, CI, and the AI workflow (codebase map, handoff notes, acceptance checklists). * Weeks 3 to 6: commission dashboard MVP live for our own agency, multi\-tenant from day one. * Weeks 6 to 9: AI sales assistant finished and working our own leads, with every conversation logged and reviewable. * Weeks 9 to 12: the subscription commerce platform running in shadow mode next to the current vendor, with the first product line cut over.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Join us at **BOXABL**, the most exciting tech start\-up on the planet, located in fabulous **LAS VEGAS**, Nevada. Microsoft Azure is our primary cloud, and we're bringing it all together there. ### **Job Summary** As our **AI Engineer**, you'll own the BOXABL data platform on **Azure**: the one place where all company data lands, stays in sync and is safe to use. keep the AI Agent Register current. * Monitor what agents read and write, especially outreach bots working in Microsoft 365 and HubSpot. **Secure it** * Manage access through Entra ID (Azure AD) SSO, role\-based access and least privilege. * Support SOC 2: access reviews, audit logs, change management and documented runbooks. * Enforce Boxabl's AI acceptable use policy: no company or customer data in unapproved tools. ### **Experience and Education** **Required** * 4\+ years in data or platform engineering, 2\+ running production workloads on Azure. * Strong SQL and Python. * Built and maintained API integrations with HubSpot, NetSuite or similar CRM / ERP systems. * Shipped at least one production app on LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude or similar). * Entra ID, role\-based access and secrets management on Azure. * CI/CD with GitHub; You will shape the data model, workflows, and AI capabilities that help teams manage leasing, maintenance, payments, and accounting. ### **What You'll Do** * Build the data model and workflows for a property management operating system. * Develop AI systems that use property context to complete work, identify missing information, and escalate issues to people when needed. * Make practical engineering decisions in high\-stakes areas, including payments, financial records, and resident communications. * Ship software to users, learn from its limitations, and improve it based on feedback. ### **What We're Looking For** * Senior\-level, broad\-based software engineering experience spanning deployment, development, operations, and user adoption. * Experience at a startup or hypergrowth startup, with a track record of taking projects from problem definition through launch and iteration. * Experience building and shipping production software end to end, in a backend or full\-stack capacity. * Familiarity with TypeScript, Python, and PostgreSQL, or the ability to learn them quickly. * Experience with AI or LLM systems, payments, accounting, or property management software is relevant. * Ability to take ownership, learn quickly, and work effectively amid ambiguity. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $150,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, United States. Candidates must be based in the Bay Area or willing to relocate.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Design Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a growing team building AI infrastructure for creating and evaluating reinforcement learning environments. You will design and build product experiences that help users understand agent behavior, improve training data, and make informed decisions. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and build interfaces across the platform and marketplace, from early concepts through release. * Make agent runs, evaluation results, reward signals, and quality feedback clear and actionable. * Work with research and engineering to turn complex reinforcement learning and evaluation workflows into useful tools. * Talk with users, observe challenges, and improve the product based on feedback. * Develop reusable interaction patterns and maintain strong usability, visual quality, and implementation standards. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of experience as a design engineer, product designer, or in a similar role shipping product interfaces, with a primarily full\-stack engineering background. * Front\-end engineering skills and experience turning design work into working product interfaces. * A portfolio demonstrating shipped design\-engineering work and visual design quality. * Experience shipping products, learning from users, and iterating based on feedback. * Technical education or background, clear communication, and experience working closely with engineers and researchers. * Developer tools, data\-rich products, research software, AI agents, evaluations, reinforcement learning, training data, or early\-stage company experience are useful. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $130,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, with remote arrangements also available.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer, Reinforcement Learning
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Build the product interfaces, backend services, and internal tools that support an AI reinforcement learning data platform. You will work with research, operations, and external partners to turn complex needs into useful tools for creating, evaluating, and improving training data. ### **What You'll Do** * Develop tools for browsing environments, inspecting trajectories, reviewing task quality, and understanding model behavior. * Build partner workflows for creating, submitting, testing, and iterating on reinforcement learning environments and training data. * Create dashboards and observability tools for environment quality, evaluation results, data collection progress, and pipeline health. * Design backend services and APIs that connect task authoring, data collection, evaluation, quality review, and training systems. * Collaborate across research, operations, and go\-to\-market teams to ship and improve products. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of full\-stack software engineering experience building and shipping production systems, with a technical field of study or equivalent technical foundation. * Proficiency in Python and a modern web stack such as React, TypeScript, or Next.js. * Hands\-on experience with AI, machine learning, or reinforcement learning, and experience owning products end\-to\-end from design through deployment. * Experience building backend services, APIs, and databases, along with cloud infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD, and production debugging. * Experience creating dashboards, monitoring or observability interfaces, and tools for data inspection, review, or quality assessment. * Experience with data collection, annotation, or evaluation platforms, or with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, or Grafana, is valuable. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $130,000 to $225,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship and relocation support are available for eligible full\-time candidates moving to the United States or Singapore. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Remote candidates may be considered if they can maintain 70% to 80% time zone overlap with San Francisco or Singapore.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** We're an early\-stage open\-source MLOps infrastructure startup building the orchestration layer for ML pipelines and AI agent workflows. We're looking for a **GTM Engineer** to own our entire US presence and community from the ground up — a one\-person outpost role based in San Francisco, reporting directly to the founding team. This isn't a traditional marketing or sales role. You'll be the connector, the voice, and the person who turns conversations into traceable pipeline. The mission: make this company a known name in the SF AI\-infra scene through events, community, and authentic technical evangelism. ### **What You'll Do** * Own and run the SF developer community from zero — including hosting a bi\-weekly meetup series that becomes the go\-to event for the ML\-infra crowd. * Work the AI\-infra meetups, hackathons, and conferences that matter; build a visible personal brand and network across the Valley. * Be the connector — the person who knows everyone, introduces them to each other, and turns relationships into community momentum. * Evangelize credibly through talks, blog posts, social content, and short demo videos rooted in real community insights. * Demo the product live in front of technical audiences, answer real questions, and hold your own with ML engineers. * Instrument community and product signals (Mixpanel, GitHub, CRM, enrichment tools) into an automated flow — enrichment, scoring, follow\-up — so every conversation becomes a traceable pipeline rather than a forgotten business card. * Serve as the eyes and ears in the Valley: what people are building, what frustrates them, who's evaluating what — and feed that intelligence directly back into product and GTM strategy. ### **What We're Looking For** **Must\-haves:** * 1–3\+ years in DevRel, community building, growth, or developer\-facing GTM roles, with a demonstrated track record of hosting events and converting attendee engagement into measurable business outcomes. * Ability to demo and explain Python frameworks live to technical audiences, read and understand code, work with APIs, and communicate technical concepts to ML engineers (you don't need to be an engineer yourself). * Experience building and scaling developer communities or running technical events from zero, with a track record of growing attendance and engagement. * Proficiency with modern GTM stack tools: CRM platforms, data enrichment tools (Clay or similar), API integrations, and basic automation workflows. * Experience instrumenting and measuring community/event initiatives using product analytics (Mixpanel or similar), GitHub signals, and CRM data to track pipeline and ROI. * Demonstrated ability to create and distribute technical content (blog posts, demo videos, social media) that resonates with developer audiences. * Proven ability to convert manual, one\-off community activities into repeatable, scalable, measurable systems. * Comfortable operating in a self\-directed, early\-stage environment with minimal hand\-holding. * Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate — **this role is on\-site and does not work remotely.** **Nice\-to\-haves:** * Existing professional network within the SF AI, ML infrastructure, or MLOps community. * Prior experience building or contributing to open\-source communities and familiarity with GitHub\-native developer behaviors. * Familiarity with the MLOps, LLMOps, or AI agent infrastructure landscape. * Experience running product\-led growth (PLG) or usage\-based GTM motions. * Visible personal brand: public speaking, conference talks, or recognizable community presence. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** * **Salary:** $120,000 – $250,000 USD annually, depending on experience. * Direct access to founders and outsized early\-stage impact. * Visa sponsorship is **not available** for this role. ### **Location** This is a **fully on\-site role in San Francisco, CA**. Presence in the local AI/ML community is central to the job — remote work is not an option for this position.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer (Mid-Level)
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Build and deploy production machine learning systems in a fast\-moving product environment. You will own work across the ML lifecycle, partnering with product, engineering, and domain experts to deliver models that address real business needs. ### **What You'll Do** * Design, train, and evaluate machine learning models for production use cases. * Build end\-to\-end ML pipelines, from data preprocessing through model serving and monitoring. * Work with product and engineering partners to turn business requirements into ML solutions. * Debug and improve production model performance using monitoring data and real\-world feedback. * Write maintainable code and contribute to ML infrastructure and tooling. * Participate in code reviews and share technical knowledge with teammates. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of professional machine learning or software engineering experience, including hands\-on ownership of production ML systems in a startup or fast\-moving product environment. * Strong ML fundamentals, including model selection, evaluation, feature engineering, and validation. * Proficiency in Python and hands\-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit\-learn. * Experience implementing production ML pipelines that cover data preprocessing, model serving, and monitoring. * Experience deploying and maintaining ML systems at scale with tools or platforms such as AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, Kubernetes, or Docker. * Experience with production A/B testing or experimentation frameworks, and optimizing models based on results. * A completed university degree and professional employment experience after graduation. * Ability to work through ambiguity and prioritize practical impact in a dynamic environment. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California.

jobs.title: Mid-Level Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage AI recruiting technology startup as a full\-stack Product Engineer. You will build reliable, user\-focused products that bring AI capabilities into practical workflows, working closely with product and design to deliver measurable outcomes and help shape technical direction. ### **What You'll Do** * Own product features end to end, from scoping requirements through production deployment. * Design APIs and data models, and build frontend and backend functionality. * Ship and improve user\-facing experiences using customer feedback and product metrics. * Integrate AI and LLM capabilities into product workflows with a focus on reliability. * Build scalable backend services, data schemas, and operational tooling for testing, monitoring, and deployment. * Collaborate with product and design on priorities and success measures, and contribute to architecture and roadmap discussions. * Make pragmatic technical tradeoffs suited to a growing startup. ### **What We're Looking For** * 2 to 8 years of software engineering experience, including delivery of user\-facing products. * Production full\-stack experience with TypeScript and React or Next.js, plus backend development in Python or Node.js. * Practical experience integrating LLMs or other AI services into production applications. * Experience with PostgreSQL and AWS or GCP. * Strong product judgment and end\-to\-end ownership, with comfort working in a small team and navigating ambiguity across frontend, backend, and infrastructure work. * Experience with multi\-tenant or enterprise\-ready systems, APIs, real\-time systems, or high\-throughput applications is valuable. * Background in regulated industries or complex internal tools is a plus. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $150,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer (Kubernetes)
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage infrastructure team building tools that simplify production Kubernetes operations for demanding AI workloads. You will help develop the platform and systems behind reliable, multi\-cluster infrastructure. ### **What You'll Do** * Build platform features in Go, including custom Kubernetes operators and controllers. * Design GitOps workflows with ArgoCD to streamline continuous deployment. * Create infrastructure\-as\-code patterns with Terraform and Helm to provision and manage clusters. * Work on distributed storage using Ceph and WEKA. * Build observability systems with Prometheus and Grafana to surface cluster health and performance. * Optimize container networking with Cilium and related technologies. * Design federated Kubernetes architectures for multi\-cluster management. * Automate recurring infrastructure work and reduce operational overhead for production workloads. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 2 years of software development experience, with around 5 years preferred. * Hands\-on experience writing Go for Kubernetes environments, including production\-scale cluster management. * Experience with distributed storage such as Ceph or WEKA and federated, multi\-cluster Kubernetes architectures. * Experience with GitOps and ArgoCD, plus infrastructure as code using Terraform, Helm, or comparable tools. * Familiarity with container networking, CNI plugins, service meshes, and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. * Experience with cloud Kubernetes offerings, bare\-metal infrastructure, or GPU workloads is useful. * Automation experience and contributions to Kubernetes or other open\-source infrastructure projects are valued. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $180,000 to $210,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer, Biotech
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a biotech AI team building data infrastructure that turns clinical, genomic, imaging, and other biomedical data into reliable, model\-ready assets. You will help design and operate the platform, with a focus on secure, governed data systems and production infrastructure for scientific and machine learning teams. ### **What You'll Do** * Build and maintain cloud data platform components, including object storage, lakehouse architecture, catalogs, lineage, dataset versioning, and query and access layers. * Design and operate data warehouses and governed systems for clinical records, molecular features, metadata, retention, and dataset releases. * Develop reproducible bioinformatics workflows for omics data, using containerized pipelines and cloud batch compute. * Implement data quality checks, biological validation, and visualizations that help teams identify issues across processing steps. * Deliver versioned, training\-ready datasets and data deployment interfaces for model use in partner environments. * Operate production infrastructure, including Kubernetes, CI/CD, workload orchestration, security, reliability, observability, and cost optimization. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to five years of experience building data infrastructure and production pipelines as a platform engineer in biotech, diagnostics, biobanking, health data, or a related field working with sensitive biological or clinical data. * Production experience operating Kubernetes clusters, writing infrastructure as code with Terraform or similar tools, and shipping tested, documented Python and/or Go code. * Experience designing CI/CD and deployment systems, orchestrating distributed workloads, and owning infrastructure reliability, observability, security, and cost. * Familiarity with a major cloud provider, preferably AWS, plus Docker, workflow managers such as Nextflow, lakehouse and warehouse design, data catalogs, and orchestration. * Experience with large\-scale data pipelines, machine learning infrastructure, or GPU workloads is valuable. Knowledge of omics workflows, bioinformatics tools, OMOP, FHIR, R, or SQL is also relevant. * Experience implementing compliance controls and audit evidence for standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, or SOC 2 is beneficial. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $180,000 to $240,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** Hybrid role based in San Francisco, California. Candidates must be local or willing to relocate.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a product engineering team building a platform and marketplace for reinforcement learning environments. You will combine product judgment, interaction design, and full\-stack engineering to make complex workflows clearer for environment creators and AI research teams. ### **What You'll Do** * Work with product, design, engineering, research, and go\-to\-market partners to identify user friction and prioritize improvements. * Speak directly with users to understand challenges in creating, testing, evaluating, and discovering reinforcement learning environments. * Own product improvements from problem definition and prototyping through implementation, launch, and iteration. * Build frontend and backend features for onboarding, environment submission, review, and discovery workflows. * Design interfaces that help users understand agent runs, evaluation results, reward signals, and quality feedback. * Use user feedback and product data to refine experiences and inform tradeoffs. ### **What We're Looking For** * Experience shipping software products end\-to\-end, from understanding user needs through implementation and iteration. * A technical degree and full\-stack web application experience, including polished frontend interfaces and backend services or APIs. * Experience interviewing users and using qualitative feedback and product data to improve shipped products. * Strong interaction design and product judgment, especially for complex technical workflows and making decisions with incomplete information. * Background in developer tools, data\-rich products, marketplaces, or products serving distinct user groups. * Familiarity with AI agents, evaluations, reinforcement learning, training data, or workflows involving review, debugging, and quality feedback. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary range: $100,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** Remote candidates are welcome, with 70% to 80% time zone overlap required with San Francisco or Singapore. Office locations are available in San Francisco and Singapore.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a consumer fintech product and engineering team building tools that help people manage cash flow and build credit. You will own backend features from design through production, contributing to reliable and accessible financial products. ### **What You'll Do** * Build product features end to end, including domain models, business logic, and API integrations. * Deliver and iterate on product milestones through data\-informed, incremental releases. * Use SQL and analytics tools to assess product and system performance. * Debug complex state machines in event\-driven systems to support a seamless user experience. * Ship through CI/CD, own implementations in production, and respond to incidents as needed. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of experience building backend features end to end for production systems. * Proficiency designing and consuming REST APIs, including authentication, authorization, and rate limiting. * Experience with event\-driven architectures and message queues such as Kafka or Pub/Sub, including debugging complex workflows. * Experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL, data modeling, query optimization, and SQL\-based analytics. * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, version control, automated testing, and code review. * Experience building consumer\-facing products and working in an early\-stage startup or similarly high\-velocity environment. * Strong computer science fundamentals and experience with distributed systems. * Go and GCP experience are useful. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $120,000 to $200,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Candidates based in Seattle or willing to relocate to San Francisco or Seattle may also be considered.

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Consumer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Own the full lifecycle of consumer products, from identifying user opportunities to building and shipping polished experiences. This hands\-on role combines product strategy, design, and full\-stack engineering, with a focus on learning from real users and improving engagement and retention. ### **What You'll Do** * Define product positioning, scope features, and identify the smallest complete version to build. * Design consumer user experiences, including onboarding, activation flows, and interface copy. * Build frontend and backend systems with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js. * Implement APIs, SQL data models, authentication, payments, and subscriptions. * Set up analytics, experiments, and production monitoring to measure user engagement and retention. * Deploy applications, debug production issues, and maintain reliable core functionality. * Use user feedback and product data to guide iteration and product decisions. * Ship polished MVPs or substantial product iterations in roughly three to seven days. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least three years of experience shipping consumer products end\-to\-end, from concept through production. * Experience building and shipping a product in an early\-stage startup or through independent product work, with evidence of real users. * Strong production experience with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js, plus APIs, SQL databases, and data modeling. * Hands\-on experience implementing authentication, payments, and subscriptions, and deploying and debugging production applications. * Experience designing consumer product interfaces and using analytics and experimentation to evaluate engagement and retention. * Consumer apps, social products, communication tools, or cross\-platform development experience is valuable. * Familiarity with PostHog or similar analytics tools and AI development tools, while maintaining sound architectural judgment and code quality. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $200,000 to $350,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship policy was not provided. ### **Location** On\-site in Palo Alto, California, United States.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage AI infrastructure company as its first QA engineer, owning quality across a Kubernetes\-based GPU fleet management platform. You will test conversational and web interfaces alongside the backend systems that manage production clusters, helping ensure that user requests are handled accurately and safely. ### **What You'll Do** * Test the conversational interface end to end, including command accuracy and the actions it performs on live clusters. * Build evaluations for AI agent behavior, checking answer quality, safe actions, and handling of ambiguous or invalid requests. * Develop end\-to\-end tests for the web interface and verify consistent behavior across interfaces. * Write Go integration tests for multicluster backend workflows, including installation, upgrades, and failover. * Create and tear down Kubernetes test clusters to validate controllers, operators, and custom resources across Kubernetes versions. * Verify alert delivery across monitoring and user interfaces, and ensure alerts trigger appropriately. * Gate releases in CI and turn bugs and incidents into regression tests. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of experience in QA, SDET, or test automation, building or delivering test suites and automation frameworks. * Strong Go experience writing integration tests or backend test automation, and experience building end\-to\-end web UI tests. * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, React, RPC systems such as gRPC, CI/CD, and Linux fundamentals. * Experience testing infrastructure or distributed systems; familiarity with multicluster tooling, chaos engineering, or Kubernetes testing tools is useful. * Familiarity with Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Playwright, Slack apps, or GPU and bare\-metal infrastructure is a plus. * Experience building test infrastructure from scratch or evaluating LLM\-powered and conversational products is valued. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $180,000 to $200,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Build privacy and anonymization systems for an AI infrastructure team, helping make sensitive real\-world data safe and useful for model training. You will own production methods that protect private information while preserving the structure and signal needed for training and evaluation. ### **What You'll Do** * Build systems to detect PII, quasi\-identifiers, credentials, and other sensitive information, and choose transformations suited to each data type and use case. * Develop and benchmark detection methods combining rules, statistical models, classifiers, and LLM\-based approaches. * Create production pipelines that anonymize raw data before downstream processing, training, evaluation, or synthetic data generation. * Build evaluation frameworks for privacy risk and retained utility, including recall\-weighted metrics, leakage tests, and adversarial re\-identification attempts. * Design robust systems for new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats, and sensitive information in unexpected fields. * Partner with engineering, research, operations, and customers to turn privacy requirements into practical policies and safeguards. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 2 years of experience building production data or ML systems in Python. * Hands\-on experience detecting, removing, or anonymizing PII while preserving useful data characteristics. * Experience with information extraction, named\-entity recognition, classification, or related techniques for detecting sensitive or rare content. * Experience building end\-to\-end data processing pipelines and benchmarking approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost, and data utility. * Understanding of redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization, and synthetic data generation. * Strong experimental skills and experience handling schema drift, unusual formats, and edge cases. * Technical education or equivalent background; experience with privacy\-enhancing technologies or sensitive data in healthcare, finance, or security is valuable. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $130,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

jobs.title: Robotics Engineer, Autonomous Systems
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an engineering and R\&D team as a Robotics Engineer focused on autonomous systems. You will design, build, integrate, and test drone\-based robotic systems from prototype through field validation, supporting safe and reliable delivery operations. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and integrate robotic mechanisms, sensors, actuators, controllers, and drone payload systems. * Develop control, navigation, path\-planning, and obstacle\-avoidance solutions. * Build robotics software with ROS or ROS 2 and C\+\+ or Python, and validate systems in simulation. * Integrate flight controllers, companion computers, communication links, and telemetry with drone systems. * Build, troubleshoot, and independently validate robotic systems in the field. * Collaborate with mechanical, electronics, and software teams on prototypes and deployments. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 2 years of hands\-on experience building or delivering robotics, UAV, or autonomous systems. * Strong fundamentals in kinematics, dynamics, control theory, PID, and system integration. * Proficiency in C\+\+ or Python, ROS or ROS 2, and Linux; MATLAB familiarity is useful. * Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, flight controllers, motors, ESCs, and batteries. * Knowledge of IMU, GPS/RTK, LiDAR, sensor fusion, and GPS\-denied navigation. * Embedded systems experience with microcontrollers, Raspberry Pi or Jetson, actuators, and hardware debugging. * Familiarity with CAN, UART, I2C, drone telemetry, simulation, flight\-log analysis, and field testing. * A degree in robotics, mechatronics, electrical engineering, aerospace, computer science, or a related field. * Computer vision, machine learning, SLAM, Gazebo or Webots, CAD, or BVLOS experience is a plus. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in Indianapolis, United States.

jobs.title: Senior Android Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a product\-focused engineering team building a consumer financial technology app. You will help scale its Android experience and shape product direction through pragmatic problem solving and close collaboration with product, engineering, and business partners. ### **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and maintain the Android application. * Contribute to platform development and Android architecture. * Solve product and engineering challenges pragmatically. * Help inform product design and direction. * Communicate and collaborate effectively across teams. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 5 years of mobile app development experience, including 2 or more years building and shipping production Android apps and 3 or more years in a startup environment. * Strong Kotlin skills and hands\-on experience with Jetpack Compose and MVVM or Clean Architecture. * Experience building consumer\-facing mobile applications and integrating Firebase Authentication, Firestore or Realtime Database, and Cloud Messaging. * Proficiency with protobufs, REST, and gRPC, ideally in data\-heavy or distributed systems environments. * Experience with Android unit, instrumentation, and UI testing, as well as mobile CI/CD pipelines. * Demonstrated mentorship or technical leadership supporting junior engineers, strong communication, and a solid university background. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $160,000 to $200,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California.

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer, Perception
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Lead perception engineering for a defense technology team developing autonomous systems. You will own the perception stack, from detection and tracking to sensor fusion, and help ensure it performs reliably on real hardware in demanding field conditions. ### **What You'll Do** * Set the perception architecture for detection, tracking, classification, and sensor fusion. * Develop ML models and training pipelines, then deploy models to embedded devices. * Fuse EO/IR and other sensor data relevant to the system. * Optimize real\-time perception performance for embedded compute and latency constraints. * Work closely with robotics, controls, and hardware engineers to deliver practical system capabilities. * Mentor perception engineers while contributing directly to implementation. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 5 years building and shipping perception systems on physical hardware. * Strong Python and production C\+\+ skills, with experience in computer vision, detection, and real\-time tracking on live sensor data. * Experience deploying ML models on\-device with TensorRT, ONNX, or equivalent, and optimizing for embedded compute and tight latency budgets. * Experience building ML training pipelines through deployment and shipping systems tested against real\-world targets. * Background in perception, robotics, autonomy, aerospace, or defense systems; research\-only or offline\-only experience is not a fit. * Helpful experience includes aerial target tracking, moving\-camera compensation, thermal imagery, EO/IR or other sensor fusion, radar or RF perception, and small or long\-range target detection. * BS, MS, PhD, or equivalent experience in computer science, electrical engineering, robotics, or a related field. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $190,000 to $222,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. The role includes field testing.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Banking
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Lead a core banking product area at a Series C fintech serving small businesses. You will shape payment experiences, account services, platform reliability, and customer security, making complex financial products simpler and more trustworthy. ### **What You'll Do** * Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across deposit accounts, money movement, cards, and banking infrastructure. * Improve the end\-to\-end experience for account opening, funding, deposits, ACH, wires, transfers, bill pay, and card transactions. * Partner with Engineering on the ledger, payment rails, and card systems that power these experiences. * Use customer research and usage data to identify opportunities through a rigorous, cohort\-based discovery process. * Write clear product specifications, define success metrics, and ship reliable, secure features with Engineering and Design. * Build risk, fraud, security, and regulatory needs into product development in partnership with Risk, Compliance, and Legal. * Manage product relationships and integrations with banking partners and third\-party vendors. * Track activation, engagement, retention, multi\-product adoption, and reliability metrics. ### **What We're Looking For** * Product management experience appropriate to a senior role, with the source indicating a 5 to 15 year experience range. * Strong experience with non\-card payments and money movement, including ACH, wire transfers, or RTP. * Practical understanding of payment rails and ACH return reasons; card payments experience alone is not sufficient. * Demonstrated banking product experience, including familiarity with backend systems and collaboration with backend engineers. * Experience working with agentic tooling. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $160,000 to $200,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** Hybrid, with 2 to 3 days onsite in New York City, New York.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** This customer\-facing role bridges pre\-sales solution design and implementation for a logistics software platform focused on temperature\-controlled supply chains. As part of the commercial organization, you will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Delivery to carry customer solutions from discovery through go\-live. ### **What You'll Do** * Lead technical and process discovery with customer stakeholders across supply chain, quality, logistics, and IT. * Deliver tailored product demonstrations based on customers' workflows and handle technical objections. * Design solutions that define applicable modules, required data, integrations, phases, and scope. * Turn solution designs into sequenced implementation plans and scoped statements of work, identifying effort, dependencies, and risks. * Partner with Sales on proposals and commercial documents to ensure commitments are technically deliverable. * Lead solution workshops, guide software configuration, and remain accountable for the design through customer go\-live. * Coordinate technical handoffs and delivery sequencing with Product, Data, and Engineering teams. * Develop reusable solution designs, discovery frameworks, scoping templates, and integration patterns. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 5 years of experience as a Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Account Manager delivering enterprise software implementations. * Experience owning solution designs from pre\-sales through implementation and go\-live. * Experience with tailored demonstrations, technical sales discussions, and managing objections. * Background in supply chain, cold chain, logistics, or quality management workflows, ideally in a regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, food, or healthcare. * Hands\-on experience configuring or implementing enterprise software, along with familiarity with data integrations, APIs, and system interoperability. * Proficiency with Figma, FigJam, or equivalent design tools, and Linear, Jira, or similar project tracking systems. * Ability to coordinate cross\-functional delivery and create reusable implementation resources. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $140,000 to $180,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in Chicago, Illinois.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join the platform team at an early\-stage AI company working in manufacturing supply chains. You will build the backend services, data systems, and AI capabilities that support reliable procurement and movement of materials through complex workflows. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and scale backend services with Next.js API routes, background jobs, and serverless functions for high\-throughput order processing. * Build and productionize LLM\-based agents, AI/ML infrastructure, and RAG patterns for quote analysis and supplier recommendations. * Design PostgreSQL schemas, migrations, and complex queries for materials, quotes, orders, and supplier relationships. * Build reliable event\-driven pipelines for order state management, notifications, and cross\-system synchronization. * Implement caching and rate limiting to support dependable external API integrations. * Establish monitoring, alerting, and observability practices, and own incident response for backend systems. ### **What We're Looking For** * Staff or Senior Staff\-level experience and a track record of building products and systems from the ground up, with 4 to 12 years of professional experience. * Professional TypeScript experience and recent hands\-on experience with Next.js, plus full\-stack experience across TypeScript, Python, and Go. * A strong data engineering background, including data pipelines and large\-scale data processing. * Hands\-on AI development or AI infrastructure experience, including production LLM products, LLMOps, model evaluation, and familiarity with the broader AI/ML lifecycle. * Experience with AWS or other cloud infrastructure, including security and data privacy, and with owning internal tools and systems end to end. * Manufacturing supply chain, procurement, or logistics domain knowledge is valuable. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $160,000 to $250,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** Remote within the United States. Primary location: San Francisco, California.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage team building software to automate mission\-critical integrations for supply chain connectivity. You will work across AI coding agents and the infrastructure that hosts and runs integrations, helping establish foundational systems and engineering practices. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and build purpose\-specific AI coding agents for supply chain connectivity. * Develop and maintain infrastructure for hosting and running integrations. * Own core systems end to end, from the agent platform through the integrations runtime. * Make foundational architectural decisions and shape engineering patterns as the team grows. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to five years of experience as a full\-stack or backend software engineer, with a primarily software engineering rather than ML\-focused background. * Strong TypeScript skills and experience with modern full\-stack product development. * Experience shipping and owning complex products end to end, including building systems from scratch with a high degree of autonomy. * Hands\-on experience building with AI agents or LLMs using current approaches. * Experience with backend or infrastructure systems such as runtimes, orchestration, or cloud platforms, beyond product UI work. * Familiarity with technologies such as React, Bun, Effect\-TS, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, and AWS. * Early\-stage startup experience and a record of initiative, demonstrated through founding work, standout projects, or other notable engineering achievements. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary range: $150,000 to $300,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

jobs.title: US Founding Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage financial technology team building core banking infrastructure for digital assets and AI. As a founding engineer for US operations, you will own backend systems end\-to\-end and help shape a programmable banking platform. ### **What You'll Do** * Ship production code early while learning the codebase, product, and banking domain. * Lead major individual\-contributor projects from initial design through production. * Turn complex financial and banking requirements into reliable software that operates at scale. * Make system design, data modeling, and architecture decisions for production systems. * Work with engineering, product, and clients to evolve core banking capabilities. * Build automation that reduces recurring manual work, favoring simple, maintainable solutions. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of hands\-on backend software engineering experience and 1 or more years in an early\-stage or small startup. * Production backend or systems engineering experience, including work on banking, financial systems, or core infrastructure at scale. * Experience owning significant projects from conception to production and making technical decisions in live systems. * Ability to ship and iterate promptly while maintaining clean, reliable code. * A strong sense of ownership and comfort working in new domains without an established playbook. * Interest in core banking systems and financial infrastructure. * Willingness to work on\-site in New York or relocate. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Annual base salary of $200,000 to $400,000, plus equity. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, relocation support, and professional development resources. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in New York, New York. Relocation support is available.
