jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, AI Model Lifecycle
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About This Role:** The Senior Staff Software Engineer for the AI Model Lifecycle team will play a crucial role in building a comprehensive managed platform for the entire application development lifecycle, with a specific focus on leveraging Machine Learning models, including Large Language Models (LLMs). **What You’ll Be Working On:** * Manage fine\-tuning systems for large foundation models (SFT, PEFT, LoRA, adapters), including multi\-node orchestration, checkpointing, failure recovery, and cost\-efficient scaling. * Implement and maintain end\-to\-end training pipelines for Large Language Models. * RFT and Reinforcement learning to the fine tuning and training sections * Distillation and reinforcement learning pipelines (e.g., preference optimization, policy optimization, reward modeling). * Dataset, model, and experiment management: versioning, lineage, evaluation, and reproducible fine\-tuning at scale. **What You’ll Bring to the Team:** * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 4\-5\+ years of industry experience leading and driving impactful projects in the AI Space * Experience in Generative AI (Large Language Models, Multimodal). * Hands\-on experience training, fine\-tuning, and aligning LLMs using Reinforcement Learning and Reinforcement Fine\-Tuning (RFT) techniques. * Proactive and collaborative approach with the ability to work autonomously * Passion for building cutting\-edge AI products and solving challenging technical problems. **Bonus Points:** * Proficiency in Golang or Python for large\-scale, production\-level services and PyTorch * Contributions to open\-source AI projects such as vLLM or similar frameworks. * Performance optimizations on GPU systems and inference frameworks. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off \& paid holidays * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $250,000 \- $300,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Sr. Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Entity:** CSL Behring **Job Category:** Engineering **Job Family:** Technical Services \& Maintenance **Job Type:** Full Time **Location****:** Kankakee, Illinois, United States **Employer Reference:** R\-294509 **Job Description** ------------------- **Position Purpose** This position is responsible for the equipment reliability and maintenance strategy of utility and manufacturing equipment through continuous monitoring of equipment operational performance and implementing actions needed for improvement (Reliability\-Centered Maintenance). Develops engineering solutions to repetitive failures and all other problems that adversely affect plant operations by applying data analysis techniques (statistical process control, reliability modeling and prediction, fault tree analysis, Six Sigma (6σ) methodology, etc.), root cause analysis (RCA), root cause failure analysis (RCFA), and failure reporting, analysis, and corrective action system (FRACAS). **Reporting Relationships** **Role that this position reports to:** Head of Reliability Engineering **Role/s that report to this position:** N/A **Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities** **Technical Lead for Equipment Reliability:** § Serve as the reliability leader within the organization, mentoring and coaching junior engineers and technicians on best practices in equipment reliability and mechanical integrity. § Lead reliability improvement teams and collaborate with other departments (e.g., Operations, Maintenance, Engineering) to address equipment issues and improve overall plant reliability. § Use reliability engineering tools like Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to analyze maintenance and integrity data trends § Promote a culture of reliability and continuous improvement through proactive leadership, problem\-solving, and cross\-departmental collaboration. § Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive maintenance strategies and mechanical integrity (MI) plans for plant equipment, including pressure vessels, piping, and rotating equipment. § Continuously improve maintenance programs (PMs), Bill of Materials (BOMs), and spare parts inventories to ensure regulatory compliance. § Collaborate with engineering teams on equipment classification, SAP location hierarchy, asset information population, and acquisition of equipment manuals **Reliability Analytics:** § Utilize advanced data analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning algorithms to analyze equipment performance data and predict potential failures. § Develop predictive maintenance models to forecast equipment failures and implement proactive maintenance actions, minimizing unplanned downtime and extending equipment lifespan. § Identify and implement opportunities for reliability and mechanical integrity improvement to enhance equipment uptime and performance. § Develop Power BI dashboards to visualize reliability data and performance metrics, enabling better decision\-making and communication of reliability improvements to stakeholders. **Mechanical Integrity and Inspection Programs:** § Oversee mechanical integrity programs to ensure the safe and reliable operation of pressure vessels, piping systems, and rotating equipment. § Implement and manage risk\-based inspection (RBI) programs to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements (API, ASME, OSHA). § Recommend and implement improvements to ensure the effectiveness of maintenance and mechanical integrity programs. § Ensure that all equipment meets mechanical integrity standards through regular inspections and the application of non\-destructive testing (NDT) methods. **Management of CMMS Data Integrity \& Reliability\-Centered Maintenance (RCM):** § Ensure CMMS data integrity to support preventive, predictive, and condition\-based maintenance processes, including mechanical integrity requirements. § Oversee maintenance planning processes and the evaluation of new predictive technologies. § Lead the application of predictive maintenance (PdM) technologies and non\-destructive testing (NDT) methods to minimize downtime and ensure the structural integrity of critical assets. **Predictive Maintenance Technologies:** § Lead the application of predictive maintenance technologies to monitor and improve equipment reliability. § Oversee the use of the following technologies for condition monitoring: 1\. **Vibration Analysis** 2\. **Ultrasound Scanning** 3\. **Infrared Scanning** 4\. **Oil Analysis** 5\. **Eddy Current** 6\. **Liquid Penetrating Testing** 7\. **Dynamic/Static Motor Current Testing** § Use these tools to detect early signs of equipment degradation and take proactive maintenance actions to prevent unplanned downtime **Asset Health Monitoring:** § Implement and manage condition\-based monitoring programs using IoT and sensor\-based technologies to monitor the health and mechanical integrity of critical assets. § Utilize real\-time sensor data to detect early signs of eq nce and engineering experience within biopharmaceutical, pharmaceutical, or regulated manufacturing environments. * Strong background supporting GMP manufacturing operations (aseptic, fill/finish, bulk, fractionation, or utilities preferred). * Experience with reliability engineering, maintenance strategies, and CMMS systems * Knowledge of Six Sigma/Lean principles is a plus. * Experience with CMMS platforms (e.g., Maximo, SAP, TrackWise Digital). * Strong understanding of reliability engineering principles and asset management best practices. * Strong shop\-floor leadership presence with the ability to make timely operational decisions. * Certified in Data Analysis (Preferred but not required). * Certified Maintenance \& Reliability Professional (CMRP) (Preferred but not required). * Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) (Preferred but not required). * Certified in Mechanical Integrity (API 510, 570, or 653 certification preferred). **Competencies** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication abilities. * Technical Expertise in Asset Management * Data\-Driven Decision Making * Change Leadership \& Transformation * Cross\-Cultural Collaboration * Commitment to CSL values, ethical behavior, inclusive teamwork, and modeling a positive, respectful culture. The expected base salary range for this position at hiring is $108,000 \- $128,000\. Please note this salary range reflects the minimum and maximum base pay that CSL expects to pay for this position at the listed location as of the time of this posting. Individual base salary for a successful candidate is determined by qualifications, skill level, experience, competencies and other relevant factors. In addition to base salary, total compensation for this role may also include incentive compensation and equity. Different qualifications or responsibilities may apply based on local legal and/or educational requirements. Refer to local job documentation where applicable \#GTA **About CSL Behring** --------------------- CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients' needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. CSL Behring operates one of the world's largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/. **Our Benefits** ---------------- For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well\-being \| CSL. **You Belong at CSL** --------------------- At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future. To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion\-and\-belonging **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility\-statement.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **POSITION SUMMARY** The Senior Data Engineer will design, build, and support data engineering solutions on Google Cloud Platform, with a focus on scalable data pipelines, database integration, and ETL processes that enable analytics, reporting, and downstream application consumption. The role is responsible for data ingestion and transformation using GCP\-native services such as BigQuery, Spanner, and Dataflow, alongside integration with enterprise databases including Oracle, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server. The Senior Data Engineer will possess strong hands\-on experience with GCP data and compute services, relational and distributed databases, ETL tooling, and Unix/Linux environments. This individual will contribute to the design, development, performance tuning, and operational support of data platforms, working closely with senior engineers and architects to deliver reliable, efficient, and well\-monitored data solutions. *Expectations for the Role* * Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines using GCP services including BigQuery, Cloud Spanner, and Dataflow for batch and streaming data processing * Build and support ETL/ELT workflows that extract, transform, and load data across Oracle, Spanner, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and other relational databases * Develop and optimize BigQuery datasets, tables, partitioning, and clustering strategies to support efficient querying and reporting * Implement and tune Dataflow pipelines for data transformation, enrichment, and movement between source systems and target data stores * Monitor and manage Compute Engine VMs, including CPU utilization, resource allocation, and performance tuning across GCP workloads * Support and troubleshoot other core GCP technologies such as Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, Pub/Sub, and IAM as part of end\-to\-end data workflows * Apply data warehousing concepts including dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and data mart design * Develop and support ETL workflows using tools such as Informatica, integrating with GCP and on\-premise database systems * Work extensively in Unix/Linux environments including shell scripting, file system navigation, permissions management, and log/file handling * Schedule, monitor, and troubleshoot batch jobs using Control\-M, ensuring timely and reliable execution of data pipelines * Participate in Agile/JIRA\-based development processes, including sprint planning, ticket tracking, status updates, and defect management * Collaborate with senior engineers and architects on performance tuning, query optimization, and database design across multiple platforms * Troubleshoot data pipeline failures, performance bottlenecks, and data quality issues across the stack * Document technical designs, operational runbooks, and support procedures for the platforms being built * Stay current with emerging AI/ML and GenAI tools and proactively apply them to improve productivity, automate repetitive tasks, and streamline development and data engineering workflows **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or database development * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) products, especially BigQuery, Cloud Spanner, and Dataflow * Strong experience working with multiple database platforms, especially Oracle, Spanner, SQL, and PostgreSQL * Working knowledge of Google ETL technologies and other core GCP services (Compute Engine/VMs, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, Pub/Sub) * Experience with performance tuning, including CPU utilization analysis and resource optimization on GCP compute resources * Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts (dimensional modeling, fact/dimension tables, ETL design patterns) * Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica for data integration and transformation * Strong Unix/Linux experience, including shell scripting and file system handling * Experience with job scheduling tools such as Control\-M * Strong SQL development skills and ability to write/optimize complex queries **PREFERRED QUALIFICATION**S * Good troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills * Awareness of AI/GenAI tools and techniques, with a willingness to continuously learn and upskill to adopt new technologies that improve engineering efficiency * Experience with additional databases such as MongoDB, MySQL, or Cassandra * Exposure to Cloud Composer (Airflow) for workflow orchestration * Experience with Kafka, Pub/Sub, or event\-driven data architectures * Familiarity with Terraform or Infrastructure as Code practices. * Experience with GKE/Kubernetes * Exposure to CDC (Change Data Capture) tools and replication technologies * Experience in Agile/SAFe environments within large enterprises * Healthcare or retail industry experience * GCP certification (e.g., Professional Data Engineer) preferred * Familiarity with Agile methodologies and JIRA for project tracking and development workflows **EDUCATION** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience (High School Diploma and 4 years relevant experience) **BUSINESS OVERVIEW** Bring your heart to CVS Health Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human\-centric health care for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver. Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make health care more personal, convenient and affordable. We strive to promote and sustain a culture of diversity, inclusion and belonging every day. CVS Health is an affirmative action employer, and is an equal opportunity employer, as are the physician\-owned businesses for which CVS Health provides management services. We do not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotion, or any other personnel action based on race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We proudly support and encourage people with military experience (active, veterans, reservists and National Guard) as well as military spouses to apply for CVS Health job opportunities. **Anticipated Weekly Hours** 40**Time Type** Full time**Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $83,430\.00 \- $222,480\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short\-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. **Great benefits for great people** We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments. We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/16/2026 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

jobs.description: **Software Developer** **Caltech** **Job Category:** Parttime Term **Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Overtime Eligible **Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based Caltech is a world\-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community. **Job Summary** We're hiring a software developer to help build and maintain MathDB. https://mathdb.com/ MathDB is a large\-scale community database of definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems in mathematics, tracking the latest breakthroughs, and providing a new platform for research and collaboration. Mathematical knowledge is growing at an extraordinary pace. New results, methods and questions are arriving faster than the literature can absorb them, making it increasingly difficult to keep track of what is known, what remains open and how developments fit together. We need a shared database that grows with the subject: a living resource that the mathematical community can continually expand, correct and refine. Much of mathematical knowledge is scattered across papers, books, lecture notes and informal conversations. We aim to bring this knowledge together in a knowledge graph, connecting definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems through implications, equivalences, examples and shared ideas. Making these relationships explicit can reveal connections that are otherwise easy to miss, help researchers navigate unfamiliar areas and accelerate the discovery of new mathematics. Formalization offers another way to make mathematical knowledge precise, reliable and reusable. We are integrating Lean formalizations and automatic proof verification into MathDB, connecting mathematical statements and their explanations with proofs that can be checked by a computer. Our goal is to make it easier to contribute formal proofs, inspect their assumptions and build on verified results, while keeping the relationship between a formal statement and its mathematical meaning clear. We're looking for someone who has experience building web apps and AI agents, and who can join our effort in building and maintaining web apps, mobile apps, backend servers, databases and Lean formalization pipelines for MathDB. **Essential Job Duties** * Assist in the development and maintenance of interactive web and mobile applications for MathDB. * Support the development and pipelines for MathDB. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field. * Experience developing interactive web and mobile applications. * Strong attention to detail in application design, performance, responsiveness, visual presentation, and user interface/user experience (UI/UX). * Ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and incorporate jobs.description: **Staff Scientist** **Caltech** **Job Category:** Fulltime Regular **Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Exempt **Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based Caltech is a world\-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community. **Job Summary** IPAC (https://www.ipac.caltech.edu/), part of the Physics, Math, and Astronomy Division at Caltech (www.caltech.edu), provides science operations, user support, data and archive services, and scientific vision to enhance discovery with observatories both in space and on the ground. IPAC invites applications from highly qualified individuals for a full\-time scientist position to work with the NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED; http://ned.ipac.caltech.edu). NED's mission is to accelerate astrophysical discovery within NASA's strategic plan by capturing the most reliable census of extragalactic objects, where fundamental object attributes and multi\-wavelength data from the published literature and catalogs are joined. NED currently provides data for more than 1\.1 billion objects, accessible to researchers and the public worldwide through user\-friendly interfaces and programmatic query tools. NED also offers a Gravitational Wave Followup (GWF) service to facilitate searches for electromagnetic counterparts to gravitational wave events. This service is based on a curated Local Volume Sample of galaxies (Cook et al 2023\). This is an immediate opening for a scientist who is excited by the prospect of monitoring data quality across our ingestion flows and services, performing database analysis to ensure internal consistency, and exploring new extragalactic archive science enabled by NED. The primary responsibility of this position is to contribute to the NED mission by enhancing the accuracy and rate of data ingestion, particularly in view of the rapidly growing volume of data in the astrophysics literature. **Essential Job Duties** As a NED Staff Scientist, you will: * Apply NED's current methods for locating, extracting, transforming, and integrating data into the system. * Perform science\-based validation of NED data, including vetting the results of automated cross\-matching software. * Develop new tools (e.g., powered by AI) for validating data quality on larger scales from heterogeneous data sources * Work with scientists and engineers on the team to develop and apply new tools to accelerate the flow and fusion of data into NED. * Respond to user support requests related to the scientific content of NED. * Help design and validate NED services and interfaces to enable science use cases for NED data. * Conduct research, including archival research exploiting NED's content and data synthesis. **Basic Qualifications** If you have the following in your background, then we want to hear about your interest in joining our team: * PhD in astronomy, physics, computer science or a related field. * Two years of post\-PhD experience in astronomy. * Knowledge of astronomical coordinate systems, nomenclature, astrometry, photometry, galaxy classifications, and observational techniques. * Demonstrated experience in at least one stage of the production, validation, or analysis of astronomical data sets. * Experience in computer programming. **Preferred Qualifications** These are a set of skills and experiences which will add to your ability to contribute to the roles and responsibilities of the position. The following attributes would make you a better fit for this position, but even if these do not describe you or your experience, we would still like to hear from you: * Two years or more of experience in computer programming as a research astronomer or data scientist. * Peer\-reviewed publications in areas of extragalactic astronomy that are synergistic with the functional work on NED. * Experience with Machine Learning or Artificial Intelligence. * Proficiency in Python. * Experience manipulating large, diverse and complex data sets. * Experience with large databases. **Required Documents** * Full resume or CV. * Cover letter. * Names and contact information for 3 professional references. **Application Details** * Complete applications submitted by December 11, 2026 will receive full consideration, but review of applications will continue until a suitable candidate has been identified. * This is an on\-site position at the Caltech campus in Pasadena, California. Remote workdays are typically allowed 1\-2 days per week after training. **Application Details** IPAC is located on the campus of the California Institute of Technology in Pasadena, California, near the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains. Caltech is a world\-renowned science and engineering research and education institution, as well as a thriving community of curious and passionate individuals who collaborate to understand and solve complex scientific and societal challenges. Caltech also operates large\-scale research facilities such as the Palomar Observatory, Keck Observatory, and LIGO, which in 2016 observed gravitational waves from colliding black holes for the first time. **To be considered for this position please visit our web site and apply on line at the following link:** **https://hr.caltech.edu/work/job\_openings** *We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* je\-a45ed44468814d36a3a509a29a7454bc

jobs.title: Manager, R&D Test Lab
jobs.description: **About Carlsmed** Our mission is to improve outcomes and decrease the cost of healthcare for spine surgery and beyond. The Carlsmed aprevo® personalized surgery platform is designed to improve the standard of care for spine surgery one patient at a time. **Position Description** As **Manager, R\&D Test Lab**, you will support the Product Development team’s goal of improving patient outcomes by developing new implants, instruments, and complementary surgical planning and quality production systems that integrate with our universal platform. You will be responsible for **leading the R\&D mechanical testing laboratory supporting development and verification of spinal implants,** instruments and associated technologies. You will own the lab capability, equipment, capacity, test method quality, scheduling, and technical execution while partnering closely with R\&D engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations. You will have autonomy and be expected to identify solutions to problems on your own. To be successful in this role, you must be a team\-player, **self\-motivated**, and **invested in improving patient lives.** **Responsibilities** * Establish and lead day\-to\-day operation of mechanical testing lab and test frames including capacity planning, prioritization, scheduling, maintenance, calibration coordination and equipment uptime. * Provide technical leadership for static, fatigue, torsion, compression, bending, pullout, subsidence, construct and instrument testing per the associated ASTM standards and as applicable to the product portfolio. * Oversee development, qualification, and execution of mechanical test methods, fixtures, protocols, and reports, and support formal design verification and validation activities in accordance with the company’s QMS and applicable regulatory requirements. * Support coordinating cadaveric and animal studies with external research laboratories. Develop study protocols in collaboration with engineers and scientists and manage external testing partnerships, study execution, and technical reporting. * Maintain awareness of applicable ASTM/ISO standards and FDA expectations relevant to spinal implants and instrumentation. * Provide best practices and reference guidance to ensure testing is technically sound, repeatable, traceable, and appropriately documented. * Partner with engineers to translate design questions and product requirements into meaningful mechanical experiments acting as a true research laboratory. * Lead or partner with engineers to investigate complaints or field issues, production issues, anomalous results, equipment issues, test failures, and method variability. * Drive improvements in fixtures, automation, data acquisition and aanalysis, test throughput, laboratory workflows, and documentation. * Strategically partner to establish equipment and capability roadmaps based on the R\&D and business pipeline. * Own or contribute to and maintain lab CAPEX planning and equipment selection. * Establish lab KPIs surrounding utilization, turnaround time, uptime, on\-time completion, OPEX savings, and capacity and clearly communicate to leadership. * May manage and develop test engineers, technicians, and/or lab specialists. * May coordinate with outside lab testing and equipment manufacturers to complement in\-house testing execution. * May require flexible scheduling to align with testing demands. **Qualifications** * Education: Bachelor’s degree in **Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Biomechanical Engineering**, or related field. * Experience: **7\-10** years of **relevant engineering/testing experience.** A MS may supplement years of experience depending on focus. * Experience collaborating with junior and senior engineers and providing technical guidance and support. * Experience with spine or orthopedics is highly desired. * Experience operating electromechanical test systems (or servo\-hydraulic systems) such Instron or MTS, load cells, fatigue testing, fixture design, and statistics/data analysis. * Extensive familiarity with standards and test approaches associated with interbody devices, spinal constructs, fixation systems, screws, rods, plates, and instruments. Experience with motion\-preservation, corpectomy, and other unique spinal constructs is also preferred. **Skills** * Excellent verbal and written communication; comfortable creating presentations and delivering them to senior management. * Strong ability to write and review technical memos, protocols, and reports. * Operates with comprehensive understanding of product risk. * Thorough and detail\-oriented – able to execute complex technical work without errors or need for rework. * Willingness to wear multiple hats when needed to support Carlsmed’s mission. * Autonomous, self\-motivated, and driven to build a service department supporting cross\-functional teams. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Carlsmed is an equal opportunity employer. Carlsmed is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. Individual compensation is determined based on factors such as experience, skills, education, certifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in incentive compensation programs and receive a comprehensive benefits package. Our benefits reflect our commitment to the health and well\-being of our employees and their families and include 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums, a 401(k) plan with employer matching, and unlimited paid time off (PTO). Your recruiter can provide additional details about our total rewards package during the hiring process.

moving custom code to newer Odoo versions * Troubleshoot and fix bugs, performance problems, and data issues in client databases * Work in Odoo.sh and on\-premise deployments, using Git for version control and staging environments for testing * Estimate work, document what you build, and keep our team updated on progress What We're Looking For * 5\+ years of hands\-on Odoo development experience, including custom module development and at least one major version upgrade * Expert Python and PostgreSQL skills, and deep knowledge of the Odoo ORM, XML views, and QWeb * Experience with inventory valuation posts to the general ledger * Experience with Odoo Inventory, Manufacturing, Sales, and Purchase customizations * Experience with recent versions (Odoo 17 and later) * Experience migrating data into Odoo from QuickBooks or other accounting systems * Odoo certification **Compensation \& Benefits** * Pay: $65–$80/hour, based on experience * Bonus: Annual performance bonus of up to $3,000, based on estimate accuracy, quality, on\-time delivery, and documentation, determined at your yearly review * W\-2 employment: we handle payroll taxes, so there's no self\-employment tax * Schedule: about 15–25 hours per week, set around your availability * Location: fully remote within North Carolina * Steady work: a consistent pipeline of Odoo projects from our existing client base jobs.title: Principal Security Engineer - AI Security & GenAI Data Protection
jobs.description: **Description** **Principal Security Engineer, AI Security \& GenAI Data Protection** Citizens is seeking a Principal Security Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and enterprise rollout of its AI Security and Generative AI (GenAI) data protection capability. This individual will serve as the technical owner of the AI Gateway platform, driving evaluation, deployment, policy engineering, inline remediation, governance, and ongoing operations across sanctioned and unsanctioned AI usage. The role partners across Cybersecurity, Data Protection, Technology, Risk, Privacy, Legal, and business teams to reduce data loss risk while enabling responsible AI adoption. **Work Arrangement**: Hybrid – 4 days onsite, 1 remote in one of the following hubs: Johnston, RI \| Boston, MA \| Marlton, NJ \| Pittsburgh, PA \| Phoenix, AZ \| Irving, TX \| \| Cleveland, OH \| Columbus, OH \| Philadelphia, PA (We are open to considering remote talent requiring executive approval). **Key Responsibilities** * Own the end to end AI Gateway capability across evaluation, proof of concept, selection, deployment, configuration, policy tuning, operational support, and continuous improvement. * Develop and execute a phased rollout from monitor mode to warn and coach to targeted blocking, using observed AI traffic and risk metrics to establish baselines and control implementation. * Engineer and tune controls for GenAI prompts, file uploads, browser traffic, embedded copilots, and sanctioned and unsanctioned AI applications. * Implement inline remediation controls including redaction, quarantine, user coaching, warning, and blocking. * Establish instance aware controls that distinguish corporate from personal accounts and reduce data leakage risk. * Assess AI and agentic integration risks involving AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), non human identities, third party integrations, and emerging access paths. * Integrate AI Gateway telemetry with SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, identity platforms, data protection solutions, and evidence repositories. * Define and operationalize governance standards, policy lifecycle processes, exception handling procedures, escalation paths, and ownership models. * Measure and report program effectiveness through coverage, policy accuracy, false positive and false negative trends, remediation outcomes, audit evidence quality, and user experience metrics. * Partner with business leaders and AI platform owners to introduce coaching and enforcement controls with minimal disruption. * Stay current on AI security threats, GenAI data loss trends, agentic AI developments, MCP capabilities, and evolving security technologies. * Contribute to standards, procedures, training materials, and enterprise communications related to secure AI adoption. * Support risk, audit, and regulatory readiness through maintenance of defensible security evidence, policy decisions, exceptions, and enforcement outcomes. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 7\+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security engineering, or related technical disciplines. * 2\+ years of hands on experience with Data Protection, SSE, SASE, CASB, DLP, AI Security, GenAI Security, or similar inline security technologies. * Direct AI Gateway experience strongly preferred. * Deep understanding of GenAI data flows and security risks across prompts, uploads, browser traffic, embedded copilots, APIs, AI agents, and third party integrations. * Experience implementing enterprise security controls capable of monitoring, coaching, redacting, quarantining, or blocking risky data movement in real time. * Strong knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, identity management, and security orchestration workflows. * Experience with identity and access management concepts including corporate versus personal instances, least privilege, non human identities, OAuth, OIDC, and service to service access. * Understanding of data protection, governance, risk management, and regulated industry control requirements. * Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical risks into actionable business guidance. * Proven experience leading cross functional security platform rollouts and balancing risk, usability, and business objectives. Preferred Qualifications * CISSP, CCSP, CISM, or comparable security certifications. * Experience with AI Security, DLP, SSE, SASE, CASB, DSPM, or related data protection platforms. * Experience with Cyera Omni, Netskope AI Security, AISecOps, or similar technologies. * Familiarity with Python, PowerShell, APIs, automation, reporting, and workflow orchestration. * Experience working in financial services, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries. * Experience developing governance standards, risk based enforcement models, exception management processes, and control evidence frameworks. * Experience securing agentic AI environments, MCP enabled integrations, AI agents, non human identities, prompt and upload workflows, and GenAI data leakage scenarios. **Pay Transparency** The salary range for this position is $130,000 \- $195,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn additional incentive earnings. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Note, Citizens’ paid time off policy exceeds the mandatory, paid sick or paid time\-away policy of every local and state jurisdiction in the United States. At Citizens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive culture that enables all colleagues to bring their best selves to work every day and everyone is expected to be treated with respect and professionalism. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, qualifications, performance and capability. **Background Check** -------------------- Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the candidate successfully passing a background check, which may include initial credit, motor vehicle record, public record, prior employment verification, and criminal background checks. Results of the background check are individually reviewed based upon legal requirements imposed by our regulators and with consideration of the nature and gravity of the background history and the job offered. ---------------- **Additional Required Knowledge, Experience, And Training** **Knowledge of:** * Proficiency with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL systems (MongoDB, Familiarity with debugging and profiling tools (SQL Profiler, Fiddler) * Experience with IDEs such as Visual Studio, VS Code, and SQL Management Studio * Competence in source control systems (Git, jobs.title: Engineering Technician II
jobs.description: **Nature of Work** ------------------ Performs para\-professional civil engineering work in the development and implementation of City projects. **ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS** Position may work either primarily indoors or outdoors, depending on specialization; outdoor work involves exposure to all weather conditions, dust, noise, heavy traffic conditions, construction equipment and animals. **PHYSICAL FACTORS** Position involves light to moderate physical activity; ability to lift and carry items weighing up to 60 pounds; may involve squatting, bending, stooping, balancing, traversing, crawling, kneeling, crouching and climbing into and out of channels and trenches; ability to move about construction sites; visual acuity to evaluate field conditions; oral and listening abilities sufficient to perform essential job functions; safety clothing includes hard had, steel toe boots and traffic vest. **WORK SITUATION FACTORS** Position involves competing demands, performing multiple tasks, working to deadlines, occasional work beyond normal business hours, and responding to customer issues. Regular attendance is an essential function of this job to ensure continuity of services. Position is subject to drug testing in accordance with applicable State and Federal regulations and City of Las Cruces policies. FIRST CONSIDERATION MAY BE GIVEN TO CURRENT CITY OF LAS CRUCES EMPLOYEES WHO MEET ALL THE MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS. Meeting or exceeding the minimum qualifications does not guarantee an invitation to participate in the process. **Position will be advertised as continuous until filled, with periodic review of applications.** **This recruitment will be utilized to fill a full\-time, regular, FLSA non\-exempt position in the Public Works Department. However, it may be used to fill other** **full\-time, part\-time, temporary, contract, or similar positions that become available in various City Departments.** Full\-Time; Regular; Non\-Exempt This position is graded at RN14\. **Duties and Responsibilities** ------------------------------- * Designs City projects, including street lights, roadways, traffic systems, parking lots, drainage systems, utilities, earth work and other related projects for review by a professional engineer; collects field data and/or receives survey information; prepares drawings according to field conditions and in accordance with City design standards. * Reviews commercial plans to ensure compliance with City design standards; meets with engineers, architects and designers to discuss designs. * Performs three\-dimensional modeling of buildings, landscapes and architecture; creates various presentation materials, including power point, brochures and posters of projects. * Conducts surveys using GPS instruments; downloads GPS information and produces drawings of utilities. * Reviews subdivision plans and documentation; researches legal documents to verify utility easements; uses GPS to mark locations of easements and utilities. * Provides information to private entities regarding water surface rights; updates and modifies water rights data and GIS maps regarding surface water land; researches technical trends regarding water rights, water supply and water transfers. * Researches the validity of water rights presented for sale or lease to the City. * Drafts design projects using technical manuals and computer\-aided design equipment; creates engineering drawings from field data, sketches, rough drawings, raw data, diagrams and verbal or written narrative instructions. * Prepares contracts, contract documents, material specifications, specifications, written reports, cost estimates, schedules, bid tabs and correspondence. * Reviews contract documents and plans against actual construction; maintains record drawings. * Coordinates project design and construction with contractors, government agencies, outside utilities and the public. * Reviews contract documents and plans internally and externally for engineers, architects, developers and contractors. * Conducts traffic plan reviews as part of private development plans; conducts traffic studies. * Maintains and organizes data; analyzes findings; and performs calculations to obtain data for accident statistics and high accident locations; recommends corrective actions. * Designs, bids and prepares City Council action forms and resolutions for maintenance contracts; processes payments; maintains records of maintenance contracts. * Coordinates activities in resolving neighborhood traffic problems; schedules meetings with residents and/or City staff; initiates the field data collection process; obtains necessary resources/equipment. * Responds to phone or personal inquiries from the public regarding various questions, problems or concerns; supplies information and documentation for various projects. * Researches property and right of way information; collects field data; creates a plat of survey, subdivision plat and summary plat; submits plats for review; files and makes copies of plats; maintains notes and files. **DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS**: This is the senior level in the Engineering Technician job series and as such employees are expected to apply a greater degree of technical knowledge to assignments of greater complexity and broader responsibility; serves as the technical resource to other technicians. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Associate Degree in Engineering Technology or related field PLUS three years of experience in civil engineering operations, including plan review, design and GIS. A combination of education, experience, and training may be applied in accordance with City of Las Cruces policy. **LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS** Valid driver's license required; position requires an acceptable driving record in accordance with City policy. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** ------------------------------------ **Considerable knowledge of:** Principles and practices of civil engineering; utility permits, drafting, traffic, surveying, mapping, GIS and GPS technologies; engineering design and construction project procedures; water rights. **Ability to:** Communicate technical information in writing; read and interpret engineering plans, specifications, plats, maps and other related documents; read and understand regulations and ordinances; perform complex mathematical calculations; establish effective working relationships; operate a motorized vehicle; operate a personal computer and various software applications; use drafting equipment. **Skills in:** Personal computer and equipment use. Benefits \- Home

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** The Office of the District Attorney, Bronx County (“BXDA”) is charged with the twin goals of ensuring public safety and striving for equal justice for the over 1\.4 million members of the Bronx County community. By “Pursuing Justice with Integrity,” the BXDA places a focus on assistance for crime victims while simultaneously ensuring fairness to defendants. Moreover, the BXDA aims to balance the need to seek appropriate punishment for certain crimes while recognizing when punitive measures do not adequately advance justice. By recognizing these significant distinctions and acting accordingly, BXDA has established a standard of excellence in the representation of the Bronx community at large, which continues to grow stronger every day. In furtherance of this mission, the BXDA seeks experienced and enthusiastic IT Systems Engineer. jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Title: Systems Engineer Location: Houston, Texas Type: Direct Hire Salary: $140,000 \- $145,000 Summary: The Systems Engineer will serve as a technical lead and subject matter expert responsible for the design, architecture, implementation, administration, operation, and ongoing support of Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions. This role will focus on leveraging Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and Okta to deliver secure, scalable, and effective identity and access management capabilities. Duties: * Demonstrate advanced knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID features and capabilities, including Conditional Access Policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Application Registrations. * Manage and maintain PIM configurations, including the assignment and administration of roles and IAM permissions across Azure Management Groups, Subscriptions, and individual Resources. * Manage Application Registrations, Enterprise Applications, Service Principal Names (SPNs), and Managed Identities, ensuring adherence to least\-privilege principles when assigning Microsoft Graph API permissions. * Maintain and support identity security capabilities, including Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), Self\-Service Password Reset (SSPR), and Windows Hello for Business (WHfB). * Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to support administrative tasks, automate processes, and schedule data management activities within Azure. * Administer and maintain Microsoft Intune policies and Windows Autopilot configurations. * Monitor new Entra ID functionality, emerging security practices, and industry developments, recommending enhancements and improvements to existing solutions. * Administer and support large\-scale Active Directory environments spanning multiple geographic locations, numerous domain controllers, and 5,000\+ users. * Maintain expertise in Active Directory infrastructure, including DNS, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), user accounts, organizational units (OUs), and directory administration. * Apply Microsoft security tiering methodologies and demonstrate a solid understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) principles. * Configure and maintain delegated permissions throughout the Active Directory domain and OU hierarchy. * Create and manage PowerShell scripts, automation processes, and scheduled tasks to streamline administrative operations. * Understand and execute Active Directory disaster recovery procedures, including the steps required to restore domain services following a major outage or disaster. * Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of IAM standards and technologies, including identity federation, Single Sign\-On (SSO), SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), MFA, Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC), and least\-privilege access principles. * Serve as an Okta subject matter expert, providing guidance on application integrations, IAM capabilities, platform functionality, and the Okta product roadmap. * Architect, configure, and deploy Okta platform solutions that support the overall technical architecture and meet customer business and technical requirements. * Lead and assist with integrating customer applications into Okta\-based IAM environments, identifying and resolving technical challenges throughout the integration lifecycle, including before, during, and after implementation. Requirements * Minimum of 5 years of relevant, progressively responsible professional experience in Identity and Access Management, infrastructure, or a related technical discipline. * Oversee Azure infrastructure administration, including user accounts, security groups, conditional access policies, Intune, mobile device management (MDM), and endpoint security. * Support and maintain Windows Server environments, with experience spanning Windows Server 2016 through Windows Server 2025\. * Understand and manage Flexible Single Master Operations (FSMO) roles to preserve Active Directory domain security, stability, and integrity. * Experience with CyberArk is a plus. * Familiarity with Rubrik is a plus. * Microsoft, Azure, and/or Okta certifications are highly desirable. Education * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience.

jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer, Americas
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ SF \| Boston **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Department** -------------- Customer Support **Compensation** ---------------- * $140K – $180K **About CodeRabbit** -------------------- CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship. We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge. CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open\-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1\.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion. Locations: San Fransisco, CA or Boston, MA (Boston preferred)\- Hybrid **Role Overview** ================= At CodeRabbit, we seek an exceptional Support Operations Engineer who identifies operational gaps, designs solutions autonomously, and executes end\-to\-end. You will own the full lifecycle, from spotting inefficiencies in how support operates, to architecting the fix, to building and deploying the solution yourself. You'll be hands\-on with code, automation, integrations, and data systems. You'll think strategically about frameworks and processes, then immediately build what's needed without waiting for someone else. You work across Product, Engineering, Services, and Support to understand pain points, but you drive the technical solutions yourself. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Conduit Health** ------------------------ Conduit Health is transforming one of the hardest, most outdated corners of post\-acute care — getting essential medical equipment and supplies into patients’ homes. We’ve built the first vertically integrated, AI\-powered platform that unites ordering, telehealth, prescriptions, insurance, and fulfillment into one seamless experience. We're the easy button for one of the least\-easy parts of managing a chronic condition. We’ve raised $22M\+ from some of the best VCs across the country, growing fast, and building the team that will define the future of post\-acute care in the U.S. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for software engineers who are excited to build the next generation of Conduit Health’s patient experience. You’ll be responsible for owning and shipping high impact products that directly affect outcomes. You'll join a small (but quickly growing!) team of engineers building the platform that's transforming patients’ access to medical equipment. Our product\-market fit is proven and demand is growing every day. We are scaling up our engineering team to meet that demand. You'll implement major features end\-to\-end, make architectural decisions that affect the entire platform, and have the ability to directly influence the engineering culture and how we build software. You can expect to tackle a wide range of challenges: * **Streamlining fulfillment**: turning complex manual workflows into elegant automations, leveraging a combination of traditional deterministic approaches and modern AI/agentic tools. * **Enhancing our end\-user experience**: building high growth customer\-facing applications that directly impact our patients and their caretakers * **External integrations**: Building external facing APIs and other creative AI\-driven solutions to give our partners ways to automate their workflows * **Being scrappy**: Running experiments, proof of concepts, and being genuinely curious in ways that shape the product roadmap. All while elevating the bar of how Conduit Health approaches engineering. This role reports directly into the Head of Engineering. **You’re the right fit if:** ---------------------------- * You’re a builder who enjoys being hands on and excited about owning features from 0 to 1 * You're a product minded engineer who likes to be involved in the "what" and "why" of the features we build * You're a strong communicator, both technically and non\-technically. * You’ve worked in early stage, high growth startup environments where you’ve had a measurable, direct impact * You have a team\-oriented mindset: you are low\-ego, deeply value good communication, documenting your thought processes, giving/receiving constructive feedback, and embracing collaboration. * You’re comfortable working across the stack (although we understand when folks lean towards one side) * You have deep experience in at least some parts of our stack: Python, Typescript, React, Postgres, MongoDB, Kubernetes, AWS * Your workflow involves deep usage of LLMs/agentic tools, and you know how to use them most effectively * You know how to stay nimble, flexible, and deal with natural ambiguity in a growing startup environment **Bonus points if:** * You have experience in the healthcare industry * You’ve dealt with compliance requirements (HIPAA, SOC2, etc) **Working with us** ------------------- Conduit Health is based in NYC, with an office in Union Square. Our engineering team works mostly remotely, with a preference for team members within commuting distance for ad\-hoc team rituals. **Why join us** --------------- * Opportunity to have a real impact on the patient experience * Competitive base salary \+ equity * Unlimited PTO \+ 9 company holidays * Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits * 401k **What to expect in the process?** ---------------------------------- * Introductory call with the Head of Engineering * Cross functional interview with Product team * Technical assessment * Meet the founders * Offer Compensation Range: $150K \- $225K

jobs.title: Research Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About \[C]Worthy** -------------------- \[C]Worthy is a tightly coordinated team of scientists, developers, and leaders moving quickly to accelerate and de\-risk ocean\-based climate solutions. We are building C\-Star, an open\-source modeling platform that systematizes ocean modeling through automated, reproducible workflows, enabling reliable, high\-fidelity simulations of ocean circulation and biogeochemistry. We use this software to support a range of applications, including ocean\-based carbon dioxide removal (CDR), an emerging technology with the potential to make significant contributions to stabilizing the climate system. We are working with external partners to establish a broad user\-base within academia, industry, and the larger ecosystem of climate\-solutions actors. ### **Role Overview** We are seeking an experienced scientific software engineer to contribute to C\-Star, our open\-source modeling toolkit. C\-Star encompasses a wide range of tools and concepts that range from scientific algorithms, data processing pipelines, workflow management, schema and software lifecycle management, and more. The successful candidate will have a strong foundation in Python software development and scientific modeling applications, and the ability to learn quickly and contribute in areas outside their current expertise. As we are actively incorporating AI into our tools and development workflows, we are seeking a candidate who is eager to utilize the latest AI\-assisted tooling to move quickly, while also understanding the fundamentals of good coding practices and displaying a commitment to learning and improving an existing codebase. The primary impact of this position is the software that you will help design and build. While opportunities to author or co\-author scientific publications may present themselves, they are not a core focus of this position. \[C]Worthy is headquartered in Boulder, CO, and a candidate who can work in\-office three days per week is preferred. Relocation expenses or fully remote positions may be considered for exceptional candidates. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, test, \& maintain C\-Star software components alongside a multidisciplinary, scientifically\-oriented team. * Quickly generate working software prototypes to address emerging needs and user feedback. * Independently execute on projects, keeping a focus on high\-level goals while maintaining flexibility to diagnose and solve problems as they arise. * Assist fellow developers via code reviews, design discussions, and testing. * Support internal and external users via issue review, troubleshooting, tutorials, requirement\-gathering, and documentation. * Contribute to an organizational culture of cooperation, learning, and adaptation to a changing world. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s, Master’s, Doctorate degree, or equivalent work experience in a technical field (e.g., oceanography, atmospheric science, physical science, applied mathematics, computer science). * Understanding of computationally\-heavy scientific modeling workflows, their challenges, and typical user needs. Ocean modeling experience is preferred, but similar earth system modeling experience will also be considered. * Excellent problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills; ability to understand both scientific and software systems, and tackle abstract problems in the overlap between them. * 3\+ years of experience writing clean, maintainable, object\-oriented software in Python * Experience with AI\-assisted coding tools is strongly preferred, but we will consider candidates with a strong interest in AI\-assisted development and a demonstrated ability to learn and apply new technologies quickly. * Experience working in small, interdisciplinary, fast\-moving teams with shared projects and tasks; demonstrated ability to focus on objectives, iterate towards solutions, and adapt to changing requirements. * Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to translate scientific requirements into software specifications and convey technical results to non\-specialist audiences. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working with multi\-dimensional scientific datasets in Python (e.g., netcdf/zarr formats and Pangeo libraries, particularly Xarray, Numpy, Scipy, and Dask). * Experience with HPC/supercomputer environments (SLURM, MPI, distributed file systems). * Expertise in TB/PB\-scale data engineering. * Knowledge of workflow management tools (DAGs, state machines, tracking databases). * Experience building software intended for reproducibility of results (data versioning, schema versioning, logging, audit trails). * Experience or interest in natural language interfaces for complex scientific problems (e.g. building AI primitives and skills for running ocean models or interrogating results). * Familiarity with FORTRAN. * Experience with GPU\-accelerated computation (e.g., CUDA, CuPy, JAX, PyTorch) and running or optimizing numerical/modeling codes on GPUs. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **APPLY** --------- **Senior AI Engineer** \[Onsite] **No Visa Sponsorship is available for this position.** **This position is 100%** **on\-site** **and located on the Cornell University Campus in Ithaca, New York.** **About Information Technology at Cornell** Information Technology (IT) is a strategic enabler for many functions at Cornell University, with staff located across colleges, administrative units, and campuses throughout the institution. While comprised of many organizations, IT operates as one partnering closely with faculty, staff, and students to support teaching, research, and business operations. By being embedded where the Cornell community is, IT is well positioned to provide support ranging from day‑to‑day needs to large, complex initiatives that advance major academic, research, and operational objectives across the university. Check out this link to find out more about IT@Cornell **What will you do:** The **Senior AI Engineer** serves as the technical lead for the AI Engineering team, providing expert‑level guidance, architectural leadership, and hands‑on development in support of Cornell’s enterprise AI services. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining complex production‑grade AI applications and systems, ensuring they meet the highest standards of security, scalability, and reliability. The Senior AI Engineer mentors developers and technical leads, establishes engineering best practices, and ensures AI projects remain on the correct technical trajectory throughout the development lifecycle. This position directs and evaluates advanced AI solutions, leads the development and enhancement of enterprise AI systems, and formulates standards and methodologies that shape how AI applications are built across the university. The Senior AI Engineer collaborates closely with the Principal Solutions Architect for the AI Platform to define patterns and reference architectures that ensure all AI Innovation Lab applications are production‑ready and aligned with Cornell’s secure AI infrastructure. The role applies deep technical expertise across Generative AI technologies, API development, authentication and identity protocols, and cloud‑native architectures. It also integrates AI Innovation Lab services with Cornell enterprise systems using standards such as OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, JWT, LDAP, and Microsoft identity services. Additionally, the Senior AI Engineer develops or refines procedures to address the most complex challenges related to system capacity, operational constraints, and distributed AI system performance. As a senior leader within the AI Innovation Lab, the Senior AI Engineer provides technical direction to project teams—including project managers, business analysts, subject‑matter experts, developers, and quality‑assurance specialists—ensuring that solutions are well‑designed, well‑implemented, and aligned with institutional strategy. While position responsibilities vary, every member of our community is expected to foster a culture of belonging and a healthy work environment by communicating across differences; being cooperative, collaborative, open, and welcoming; showing respect, compassion, and empathy; engaging and supporting others regardless of background or perspective; speaking up when others are being excluded or treated inappropriately; and supporting work/life integration of oneself and others. **What We Need** * A **resume** is required for further consideration for this position. A **cover letter** outlining your interest and how your experience and goals align with the potential for mutual success in the role are strongly encouraged for consideration. When applying through our system, please remember to attach your application materials (Cover Letter and Resume) in PDF format. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * 5–7 years of professional software engineering experience, demonstrating progressively advanced responsibility in designing and developing production‑grade applications and services. * Proven ability to design, build, test, deploy, and maintain complex AI or ML‑driven applications in a production environment, ensuring high levels of security, reliability, and scalability. * Strong experience developing cloud‑native applications and services, preferably in AWS or a comparable cloud platform. * Demonstrated expertise with Generative AI technologies, API development, and distributed systems engineering. * Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity and authentication systems, using protocols such as OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, JWT, LDAP, and Microsoft identity services. * Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor developers and technical leads, establish engineering best practices, and guide solutions throughout the development lifecycle. * Strong University, please exit this website and log in to Workday using your Net ID and password. Select the Career icon on your **Home** dashboard to view jobs at Cornell. **Online Submission Guidelines**: Most positions at Cornell will require you to apply online and submit both a resume/CV and cover letter. You can upload documents either by “dragging and dropping” them into the dropbox or by using the “upload” icon on the application page. For more detailed instructions on how to apply to a job at Cornell, visit How We Hire on the HR website. **Employment Assistance:** For general questions about the position or the application process, please contact the Recruiter listed in the job posting or email mycareer@cornell.edu. If you require an accommodation for a disability in order to complete an employment application or to participate in the recruiting process, you are encouraged to contact Cornell Office of Civil Rights at voice (607\) 255\-2242, or email at accommodations@cornell.edu. Applicants that do not have internet access are encouraged to visit your local library, or local Department of Labor. You may also request an appointment to use a dedicated workstation in the Office of Talent Attraction and Recruitment, at the Ithaca campus, by emailing mycareer@cornell.edu. **Notice to Applicants:** This notice contains important information about applying for a position at Cornell as well as some of your rights and responsibilities as an applicant. **EEO Statement:** Cornell welcomes students, faculty, and staff with diverse backgrounds from across the globe to pursue world\-class education and career opportunities, to further the founding principle of “... any person ... any study.” No person shall be denied employment on the basis of any legally protected status or subjected to prohibited discrimination involving, but not limited to, such factors as race, ethnic or national origin, citizenship and immigration status, color, sex, pregnancy or pregnancy\-related conditions, age, creed, religion, actual or perceived disability (including persons associated with such a person), arrest and/or conviction record, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression and/or identity, an individual’s genetic information, domestic violence victim status, familial status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Cornell University embraces diversity in its workforce and seeks job candidates who will contribute to a climate that supports students, faculty, and staff of all identities and backgrounds. We hire based on merit, and encourage people from historically underrepresented and/or marginalized identities to apply. Consistent with federal law, Cornell engages in affirmative action in employment for qualified protected veterans as defined in the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) and qualified individuals with disabilities under Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. We also recognize a lawful preference in employment practices for Native Americans living on or near Indian reservations in accordance with applicable law. 2026\-11\-05 ### **About Us** Cornell University is an innovative Ivy League university and a great place to work. Our inclusive community of scholars, students and staff impart an uncommon sense of larger purpose and contribute creative ideas to further the university's mission of teaching, discovery and engagement. With our main campus located in Ithaca, NY, Cornell's far\-flung global presence includes the medical college's campuses on the Upper East Side of Manhattan and Doha, Qatar, as well as the Cornell Tech campus located on Roosevelt Island in the heart of New York City.
