jobs.title: AI PC Performance Engineer
jobs.description: **AI PC Performance Engineer** Dell's Client Product Group (CPG) is seeking an AI Performance Engineer to join the PC Systems Performance team. In this role, you will build foundational expertise in system\-level performance engineering by using AI and working alongside senior engineers to optimize the design of next\-generation PC platforms. You'll tackle performance characterization, power efficiency, thermal optimization, and acoustic tuning across mobile and desktop systems. Our team thrives on creativity and enjoys significant design freedom to bring the latest technologies into Dell's award\-winning consumer and commercial products. **What you’ll achieve:** As an AI PC Performance Engineer, you will work at the forefront of technology, driven by a team that has a passion for innovation, harnessing each other's strengths, \& radiates a strong sense of camaraderie. Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as an **AI** **PC Performance Engineer** on our **PC Systems Performance** team in **Austin, Texas**. **You will:** * Contribute to developing autonomous tools for the execution of performance benchmarks, lab automation, and system characterization tests on PC platforms. * Develop/apply AI\-assisted tools to analyze performance data to identify optimization opportunities and present findings with clear visualizations and recommendations * Collaborate with performance architects, firmware teams, and product managers to drive performance strategy and deliver competitive solutions * Learn performance engineering fundamentals including benchmarking methodologies, power efficiency, thermals, and competitive analysis * Perform hands\-on technical work including test system setup, hardware configuration, and basic troubleshooting **Take the first step towards your dream career** Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role: **Essential Requirements** * Proficiency with Windows operating systems, system configuration, and BIOS interfaces * Understanding of PC hardware (CPUs, GPUs, memory, storage, thermals) and how components impact system performance * Detail\-oriented, self\-motivated, and organized—able to manage test runs independently and maintain accurate records * Comfortable with data tools (AI Harnesses, Excel, Vibe code, Python, SQL) and hands\-on technical work (hardware assembly, configuration, troubleshooting) * Strong communication and collaboration skills; ability to present technical findings and work effectively across teams **Desirable Requirements** * BS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related engineering field * Experience with performance benchmarking (Cinebench, 3DMark, PCMark) or PC building, gaming, or overclocking * Familiarity with performance tools (Windows Performance Toolkit, ETW, BIOS tuning) or scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, SQL) * Experience with data visualization or analysis tools (Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL) * Familiarity with measurement equipment (power analyzers, multimeters, thermal cameras) or AI\-assisted productivity tools **Compensation** Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is $112,200 \- $145,200\.

jobs.title: Lead AI and Data Science Engineer II
jobs.description: Do you have a strong background in machine learning and deep learning? Are you interested in utilizing your data science skills and leading a small team in a fast\-paced environment to achieve strategic mission goals? If so, Deloitte has an exciting opportunity for you! As a member of our GPS GSi group, you will play a crucial role in the development and maintenance of our data science and business intelligence solutions. This role will specialize in leading machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI initiatives that will be utilized by Enterprise Solutions professionals to enhance and expedite decision\-making. You will provide expertise within and across business teams, demonstrate the ability to manage ambiguity, and apply problem\-solving skills to anticipate and resolve complex issues. **Work you'll do** * Lead the development of data science products that meet the needs of our clients, with an emphasis on the ability to transform client needs into quantifiable data science solutions and track their outcomes. * Independently manage workstreams, using critical thinking and problem\-solving skills to devise effective solutions for unique challenges and proactively identify critical business problems. * Design, train, and deploy machine learning and deep learning models to various platforms (AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.). * Lead the design of, and advise on, Large Language Model (LLM) solutions for enterprise\-wide documentation (e.g., Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Continued Pre\-training (CPT), Supervised Fine\-tuning (SFT), etc.) * Utilize Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) pipelines, including knowledge of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD for training and deploying models. * Develop cleanly written code that is sufficiently commented and easily understood by others, and ensure the team's code meets the same standard for sharing and collaboration. * Maintain structured documentation of project development stages, including the utilization of GitHub for version control and project management, and track team progress against project scope and timeline. * Build clear narratives and translate analytics into business\-relevant insights, breaking down complex analytical solutions to explain to clients and internal stakeholders. * Remain current with latest industry trends and developments in data science and/or related fields, applying them to build leading practices and respectfully challenging existing approaches, with the ability to learn new skills and knowledge and coach team members to advance the skillset of our Data Science team. * Apply thorough attention to detail, and oversee the review of the team's data science solutions for accuracy and quality. * Coach and mentor team members, and contribute to Coach and project management responsibilities. * Proactively identify risks and dependencies, and escalate appropriately. **The Team** **Government Solutions and Innovation** builds and maintains AI\-powered platforms for the GPS Practice \- acting as the connective tissue between business stakeholders, end users, and the development team, and using data to continuously improve the product experience and drive realized value. **Qualifications** **Required:** * Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or other analytical field * 8\+ years of experience with data science \- including having a deep knowledge \& mastery of Python, machine learning \& deep learning, and associated data science packages (e.g., sklearn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) \- and demonstrated experience leading data science projects and teams from inception to deployment. * Strong knowledge of LLMs and RAG. * Working knowledge of AWS, Databricks, and/or Snowflake platforms. * Strong knowledge of MLOps, including familiarity with containerization (e.g., Docker). * Excellent troubleshooting skills and the ability to manage ambiguity and work independently. * Strong organizational skills, including clear documentation of projects and ability to write clean code. * Experience leading projects using agile project methodology and/or project development lifecycle. * Experience with GitHub for version control. * Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex data science concepts to non\-technical audiences and build narratives that influence internal and client stakeholders. * Ability to complete work in an acceptable timeframe and manage a variety of workstreams, team priorities, and responsibilities simultaneously and with accuracy to meet deadlines, goals, and objectives and satisfy internal and external customer needs related to the job. * Demonstrated experience coaching or mentoring other data scientists. * Ability to travel 15%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. **Preferred:** * Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or other analytical field, OR comparable direct work experience. * Significant experience with MLOps and associated serving frameworks (i.e., FastAPI, etc.) and orchestration pipelines (e.g., SageMaker Pipelines, Step Functions, etc.). * Significant experience working with open source LLMs (e.g., serving via TGI / vLLM, performing CPT and/or SFT, etc.). * Experience using various AWS Services (e.g., Eventbridge, EC2, Lambda, Textract, etc.). * Knowledge of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $118,700 to $197,800\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Lead AI and Data Science Engineer II- Marketing Measurement
jobs.description: Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in data and technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced **Lead** **AI and Data Science Engineer II** **\- Marketing Measurement,** you will have the opportunity to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model tailored specifically for long\-term, onsite client service delivery. **Work you'll do/Responsibilities** As a Lead AI and Data Science Engineer, you will provide technical and analytical leadership for marketing measurement initiatives. You will guide teams in designing rigorous measurement approaches, turning findings into investment recommendations, and improving the quality and consistency of analytics delivery. * Lead the design and evaluation of experimental and quasi\-experimental analyses to measure marketing effectiveness and incremental impact. * Set measurement approaches for geo\-based test\-and\-control studies, paid media, and platform ecosystems such as Google and YouTube. * Guide the application of causal inference, incrementality measurement, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), and A/B testing. * Translate measurement results into clear recommendations on marketing strategy and investment allocation. * Establish and promote standards for data validation, analytical quality, documentation, and communicating assumptions and limitations. * Review analytical work and provide technical direction, coaching, and feedback to team members. * Lead client workstreams, coordinate across business and technical teams, and manage priorities and delivery risks. * Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders in clear, business\-friendly language; escalate material issues to engagement management. * Identify opportunities to improve measurement processes, workflows, and outcomes. * Communicate regularly with Engagement Managers (Directors), project team members, and representatives from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require additional attention and consideration from engagement management * Independently and collaboratively lead client engagement workstreams focused on improvement, optimization, and transformation of processes including implementing leading practice workflows, addressing deficits in quality, and driving operational outcomes A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The Team** AI \& Engineering leverages cutting\-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated solutions across software, data, AI, networks, and cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission\-critical operations. AI \& Data teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms while delivering scalable, high\-value outcomes tailored to their business needs. **Qualifications** **Required** * 10\+ years of relevant experience in data science, marketing analytics, marketing measurement, or a related field. * Advanced SQL proficiency and substantial hands\-on experience using Python or R for analysis. * Demonstrated experience leading marketing measurement or analytics initiatives. * Strong experience with MMM, causal inference, incrementality measurement, geo\-based test\-and\-control design, experiment design, and A/B testing. * Ability to assess data quality and analytical methods, and to explain limitations and assumptions. * Proven ability to guide teams and communicate recommendations to senior business and technical stakeholders. * Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve Preferred * Experience with campaign effectiveness management. * Experience with customer segmentation. * Experience measuring promotions management and effectiveness. * Additional experience in marketing analytics. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $122,000 to $240,500\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. **Recruiting tips** From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters. **Our people and culture** Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. **Our purpose** Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. Learn more. **Professional development** From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there's always room to learn. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through mentorship. From on\-the\-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. jobs.title: SAP AI Engineer III
jobs.description: **Role Overview:** As an Applied AI Engineer III , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands\-on approach to building and enhancing high\-visibility, SAP full\-stack products that serve the business and its users. Your expertise will be pivotal in delighting customers and users, while driving tangible value across Deloitte's product and AI investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across full\-stack software engineering and modern frameworks\-together with applied AI fluency that lets you build GenAI and agentic capabilities directly into the products you deliver\-consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high\-quality, outcome\-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to design, build, and ship products end to end, from concept through production. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Outcome\-Driven Accountability:** Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes\-and for the cost of achieving them. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high\-quality, lean designs and implementations, and owning the inference, token, and cloud cost of what you build. * **Technical Leadership and Advocacy:** Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, testing, integrations, and support. * **Engineering Craftsmanship:** Maintain accountability for code\-design integrity, implementation fidelity to architecture and tech stack, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Be hands\-on, self\-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high\-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. * **Customer\-Centric Engineering:** Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time. * **Incremental and Iterative Delivery:** Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning\-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration and Integration:** Work collaboratively with empowered, cross\-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well\-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. * **Advanced Technical Proficiency:** Possess expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from discovery to production to operations with all quality checks through SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. * **Domain Expertise:** Quickly acquire domain\-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. * **Effective Communication and Influence:** Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well\-structured arguments and trade\-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. * **Engagement and Collaborative Co\-Creation:** Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co\-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. **The team:** US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost\-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom\-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting\-edge internal and go\-to\-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. **The successful candidate will possess:** * Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. **Required Qualifications:** * A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. * 5\+ years of experience with most of the following: ABAP Cloud, RAP , CDS, S/4 HANA extensibility, Clean core, FIORI, ODATA, BTP, CPI , DEVOPS, Joule Studio, RAG, Python, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, as well as unit testing frameworks. * 3\+ years of experience building AI/ML and agentic applications, with hands\-on GenAI experience across LLM integration (using SAP's Business AI capabilities, generative AI hub, Joule, and Joule Studio), parameter mapping, Document grounding, Joule environment management, Prompt injection, data leakage, authorization boundaries, Responsible AI and AI agent orchestration. * 3\+ years of experience with building SAP\-connected applications and extensions using modern cloud engineering patterns, such as containers, Kubernetes, microservices, APIs, events, CI/CD, and managed cloud services, while running on infrastructure from Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI\-augmented spec\-driven development. * Prior experience using methodologies \& tools such as XP, Lean, SAP Activate \+ Agile product delivery \+ Fit\-to\-Standard \+ Clean Core \+ DevSecOps/CI\-CD \+ automated testing. etc. to deliver high\-quality products rapidly. **Other:** * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. high\-quality work products * Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment * Must be sensitive to public attitudes and concerns while effectively carrying out the jobs.title: Manufacturing Process Engineer - Machine Shop
jobs.description: **Your role** ------------- The Manufacturing Process Engineer will be responsible for installation, monitoring, maintaining, troubleshooting, preventative maintenance, and improvement implementation of the equipment assembly line and machining department. This individual will serve as an expert resource to the Operations team, understanding the specifications and requirements for our production equipment. This role is suited to someone who enjoys both hands on tasks as well as time spent evaluating data and developing improvements. This position works closely with multiple internal departments at our New Hudson facility and interfaces with our U.K. team to ensure consistency and common methodology across the organization. **Your day\-to\-day** --------------------- * On site resource to solve manufacturing process problems. * Provide technical assistance on troubleshooting equipment mechanically. * Identify opportunities for improvement in productivity, waste reduction, safety/ergonomics, etc. * Champion the development of tools and fixtures to support lean manufacturing. * Research new manufacturing methods to improve process efficiency. * Analyze and plan workflow, equipment placement and space requirements to improve manufacturing efficiency. * Investigation and resolution of process and product deviations. * Interface with manufacturing personnel to develop processes and procedures. * Prepare technical documents to support improvements, processes, and changes. * Support process transformations to accommodate new products and improvements to existing products. **Your skills and experience** ------------------------------ * B.S. in Manufacturing, Mechanical or Industrial Engineering preferred. Equivalent experience of 5\+ years in process improvement may be considered. * 2\+ years hands\-on experience in engineering in a manufacturing or machine shop environment * 2\+ years’ experience leading projects * Good communication, organization, and interpersonal skills. * Effective problem\-solving skills. * Adaptable and willingness to learn and develop. * Ability to share knowledge and teach proper methods and procedures. * Experience with CNC machine programing preferred. * Ability to travel locally as needed * Must be able to legally work in the U.S. Visa sponsorship is not available at this time. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role. **Your compensation and benefits** ---------------------------------- At Atlas Copco Group, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation. Compensation is determined based on the position and its responsibilities, without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. Our compensation offering is designed to be locally relevant, competitive, and aligned with the expectations of current and future talent. Beyond compensation, we believe that a rewarding career is about having opportunities to learn, grow, contribute, and develop in an environment built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. At Atlas Copco Group, we support our people in building long\-term careers while making a meaningful impact through their work. **Your location and working hours** ----------------------------------- This role requires you to work on\-site at our office in New Hudson, United States (US). You will be part of a dynamic team and enjoy the benefits of face\-to\-face collaboration. **Why it is great to work with us** ----------------------------------- Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‑term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you. **Application process** ----------------------- Our selection process includes interviews and, for some roles, skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us. If you have questions during the process or need support, please contact us: Talent Acquisition: Samantha Harrington

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sutton** Sutton is an AI native operating system for growing companies. Manufacturers, distributors and other operations heavy businesses run inventory, production, sales orders, purchasing and warehousing on Sutton, and many also run custom apps we build with them in days, not months. Those apps are the reason customers love us. Sutton Studio is where anyone can build on top of the platform. You describe an app, dashboard or workflow in plain English, and it is built on live operational data, with Sutton's security and permissions underneath. We have raised $6\.3M from leading venture investors, and our customers run real operations on Sutton at scale, from national cookie chains to a public real estate company with more than 18,000 apartments, a top US research university and precision machine shops. The work you ship here has an impact you can see. We are a small team with big ownership, and we move fast: the distance between a customer's problem and something live in their hands is measured in days. **The role** We are hiring a full stack engineer who can build and run almost anything. You will work directly with our Founding Engineer and our founders. There are no separate front end, back end or lead roles here. We are a flat group of strong generalists, and everyone owns what they build, from the first line of code to production. The work spans our core product, the apps we build with customers, and the platform that keeps all of it fast and safe. **What you will do** You will pick up whatever matters most that week, and the mix will change. Our stack is Node.js, GraphQL and Postgres with a React front end, and we use Claude Code and Cursor every day. Typical work: * Ship features end to end across a Node.js and GraphQL API, Postgres and a React front end, with AI assisted coding as a daily habit * Build the platform behind Studio and customer built apps: scoped per customer tokens, a permissions model where each app declares what it touches, server side validation and audit logging tagged by app * Own reliability for a multi tenant production system: monitoring, alerting, backups and restores, incident response and safe rollbacks * Build resilient integrations with accounting and commerce systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite and Shopify, with retries, idempotency and an alert when a sync stops * Extend our API and MCP server so AI assistants and apps can safely read and write operational data like inventory, production and orders * Work on real world features: barcode scanning, label printing and streams of machine sensor data * Turn customer feedback into product improvements, shipped in days instead of months **Who we are looking for** We are looking for driven builders who understand the business problem behind the code. You think in systems, move quickly, and use AI to multiply your own output. You do not need to be an expert in every layer or fit a single profile. What matters is that you are strong across the stack and committed to creating a customer outcome, with an open mind about how to get there. * You can design a GraphQL schema, fix a slow Postgres query and debug a React state issue in the same afternoon * You have built multi tenant SaaS and care about tenant isolation, safe migrations and per customer configuration * You have run production systems largely on your own, and you know how to monitor, back up, roll back and recover them * You have solid security fundamentals: authentication and authorization, scoped tokens, secrets handling and audit trails * You are comfortable reading vendor API docs and building integrations that hold up: OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries and idempotency * You work AI native every day with Claude jobs.title: Software Engineer I

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer
jobs.description: Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world's most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production\-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies. Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built. **Purpose** ----------- This Design Engineer role involves bridging design and production, creating and optimizing innovative product designs for manufacturability, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and ensuring compliance with internal and industry standards. This role works in collaboration with other integrated project team (IPT) members to produce, review and mature high quality technical documentation, including CAD models, drawings, PMI's, DFMEA's, bills of material, and engineering specifications. The role's expertise in CAD, GD\&T, and PLM systems ensures that engineering design intent is implemented in a manner that is accurate, functional, and manufacturable, meeting customer expectations and Divergent's standards for quality and consistency. **The Role** ------------ * Challenge existing design requirements and define new design standards for product functions and features, based on regulations, DFM/DFAM, and product attributes. * Act as SME for PLM, GD\&T, CAD\-design best practices and lesson learned. * Ensure all designs meet required engineering, manufacturability, and industry standards, addressing issues during the release phase. * Accountable and responsible for protecting the quality of the final engineering products (released designs, CAD, Drawings, \& PMI), ensuring the production team receives data that meets quality and usability standards. * Check technical documentation (incl. drawings, PMI, BOM's, DFMEA, specs, etc.) before being released into PLM, enforcing compliance to internal SOP and guidelines. * Analyze drawings, models, and documentation for GD\&T accuracy, completeness, manufacturability, assemble\-ability and inspectability. * Support active programs by creating and managing design engineering data, as requested by the IPT. * Manage ongoing production NCR's and dispositions, collaborating with ME's and RE's. * Support the implementation of ECR/ECO's for production parts, as required or needed. * Work cross\-functionally to implement cost reduction, methods and product improvements, and support prototype and production build activities. * Identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and process improvement in GD\&T and PMI practices. * Support the training of new personnel for the area of competence. * Maintain and organize design documentation and reference material, ensuring all revisions and updates are properly documented, stored, and disseminated to the broader team. **Basic Qualifications** ------------------------ * Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls. * BS in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. * Aerospace or automotive design background. * 2\+ years of CAD experience creating detailed models. * 2\+ years of PLM/PDM experience. * Solid understanding of common manufacturing and assembly methods, GD\&T, and tolerance/stack\-up analysis. * Experience with PMI, DFMEA, control plans, PPAP and APQP. * Experience with ASME Y14\.100, Y14\.5, Y14\.41\. * Self\-motivated with strong multi\-tasking, organizational, communication and documentation skills. * Ability to work well in an integrated team including daily interactions with technicians, engineers, and managers. * Attention to detail and record keeping. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * MS in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. * 2\+ years of Siemens NX experience. * 2\+ years of Teamcenter experience. * Experience interfacing with engineering, manufacturing and quality teams to understand system designs and the associated constraints. * Experience in CMM programming in a CNC machine shop (Mills, Lathes \& EDM). * Experience with fast iteration prototyping programs. * Demonstrated development and configuration management experience on technically complex hardware products. * Expertise in design for manufacturability and design for assembly including experience taking products from prototype design to production. * Solid understanding of common manufacturing materials and processes, including mills, lathes, welding, sheet\-metal bending, lifting/rigging, assembly, inspection, etc. Additive manufacturing is a plus. * Working knowledge of all chassis systems and vehicle dynamics fundamentals. * Proficiency in Atlassian tools (Confluence, JIRA). **Work Environment** -------------------- * Work is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards. **Compensation** ---------------- At Divergent, our pay range is based on the level of the job. For this role, we will consider candidates at levels E03 \- E05 as evaluated through our interview process. * E03 / Engineer I: $105,980 \- $145,730 * E04 / Engineer II: $122,430 \- $168,340 * E05 / Senior Engineer: $141,380 \- $194,390 **What We Offer Our Regular, Full\-Time Employees:** * **Holistic Compensation Package:** Enjoy a world\-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results\-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions. * **Wellness and Time Off:** Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year\-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time. * **Comprehensive Health and Wellness:** Prioritize your well\-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company\-sponsored life insurance and short and long\-term disability coverage for peace of mind. * **Investment in Growth:** We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance. * **Collaborative and High\-Performing Environment:** Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high\-performing team within a fast\-paced, mission\-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint. ***Equal Employment Opportunity*** *Divergent is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected characteristic. Divergent provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with Disabilities and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act.* *EEO Poster* *In order to adjust to changes in our business, it may become necessary to add, remove or modify certain duties and responsibilities, or to reassign you to another job position. From time to time you may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected.* ***E\-Verify: Right to Work*** *Our company participates in* *E\-Verify**. E\-Verify is a program that electronically confirms a candidate's eligibility to work in the United States after completing the Employment Eligibility Verification (Form I\-9\). The information provided on the Form I\-9 is compared to the records contained in the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) databases. jobs.title: Senior AV Support Services Engineer
jobs.description: **About Diversified:** Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology. **What to Expect:** At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it. **How You’ll Contribute:** The primary focus of the Senior Support Services Engineer is to help support enterprise AV/UC initiatives, with primary responsibility for video conferencing enablement, conference\-room AV/VC refresh projects, AV hardware firmware lifecycle management, and bi\-annual preventive maintenance and remediation. The engineer will work alongside the existing client AV Engineering team to deploy, configure, test, commission, upgrade, and maintain enterprise collaboration technologies including Microsoft Teams Rooms, Cisco collaboration systems, Q\-SYS, Crestron, and related AV technologies. Candidates should have strong hands\-on enterprise AV engineering experience and be capable of independently executing assigned project and lifecycle workstreams while collaborating with engineers, AV integrators, manufacturers, and other technology teams. This is a hands\-on AV engineering and project delivery role; it is not an AV support, meeting support, or event technician position. The Support Services Engineer will be required to be on site Monday\-Friday for eight (8\) hours per day. Typical daily schedule will be 8am – 5pm. These hours may be adjusted based on client needs. **What You’ll Do:** 1\. Video Conferencing Enablement * Execute video conferencing enablement projects across client locations. * Configure, deploy, test, and commission enterprise AV/VC systems. * Support Microsoft Teams Rooms, Cisco collaboration devices, Zoom, and associated room technologies. * Validate room readiness, device configuration, audio/video performance, content sharing, control functionality, and connectivity. * Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), document results, and track issues through resolution. * Troubleshoot technical and integration issues identified during deployments. * Coordinate with AV integrators, vendors, and internal teams through successful implementation and operational handoff. 2\. AV/VC Refresh Projects * Execute conference room AV/VC refresh and lifecycle replacement projects. * Assess existing room technology and identify equipment requiring replacement or upgrade. * Coordinate installation, configuration, testing, and commissioning with AV integrators. * Validate refreshed systems against established AV Engineering standards. * Perform AV signal\-flow, functional, and end\-to\-end room testing. * Troubleshoot technical issues encountered during installation and commissioning. * Track punch\-list items through remediation and closure. * Validate completed installations before operational handoff and maintain required project documentation. 3\. AV Firmware \& Software Lifecycle Management * Coordinate firmware and software updates across enterprise AV/VC hardware. * Review and test updates prior to production deployment and coordinate maintenance windows. * Execute upgrades, perform post\-update validation, and troubleshoot resulting issues. * Maintain firmware versions, deployment records, and exceptions. 4\. Bi\-Annual Preventive Maintenance, Audit \& Remediation * Coordinate and execute bi\-annual preventive maintenance across AV/VC environments. * Audit maintenance results to identify equipment failures, recurring issues, and repair or replacement needs. * Track and coordinate remediation with AV vendors, integrators, and internal teams. * Validate completed remediation and identify lifecycle or future refresh requirements. 5\. Automation and Platform Improvement * Use platform telemetry and analytics to identify recurring issues, improve room reliability, and support proactive or automated diagnostics. * Participate in technology evaluations, proofs of concept, platform upgrades, release testing, documentation, and the transition of emerging capabilities into supported services. * Contribute to consistent engineering standards and repeatable solutions that can be applied across the client’s broader workplace technology environment. 6\. AV Engineering \& Project Support * Work alongside AV Engineering team members on projects and technical workstreams. * Support implementation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and technology evaluations. * Maintain technical, configuration, testing, and deployment documentation. * Collaborate with AV integrators, manufacturers, infrastructure teams, and onsite resources. **What You’ll Bring:****Education \& Certifications:** * High School Diploma/ GED * Bachelor’s degree preferred **Required Skills/Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of enterprise AV/UC engineering, integration, or deployment experience. * Strong hands\-on experience with video conferencing deployments and conference\-room AV/VC refresh projects. * Experience with Microsoft Teams Rooms and/or Cisco collaboration environments. * Strong knowledge of AV signal flow, room systems, commissioning, and troubleshooting. * Experience with Q\-SYS, Biamp, Crestron, or comparable DSP/control platforms. * Experience performing or coordinating AV firmware/software upgrades. * Experience with AV testing, commissioning, and UAT. * Experience working with AV integrators and technology manufacturers. * Ability to independently execute assigned technical work while collaborating with an AV Engineering team. * Strong technical documentation, communication, organization, and follow\-through skills. * Must present well as client facing and working with high level executives within high pressure meeting situations * Proactive personality when it comes to finding issues, staying busy, and supporting the onsite clients * If taking public transit, you will still be responsible for arriving at work at your designated start time. Ensure you have reliable backup transportation if necessary. * Must be able to stand, kneel and/or crouch for long periods of time * Must be able to work in high places, as well as small, cramped places * Must be able to work in hot humid places, as well as cold places * Must be able to properly use hand/power tools, ladders, and subsequent safety equipment * Must be able to lift/maneuver up to 75 lbs, use hand tools, ladder, and have the physical ability to frequently: bend, kneel, stand, and walk for extended periods of time * Must pass a background screen and drug test. **Desired Skills/Qualifications:** * AVIXA CTS, CTS\-I, or CTS\-D * Q\-SYS, or Crestron training/certification * Microsoft Teams Rooms experience * Cisco RoomOS / Control Hub experience * Experience with large enterprise or multi\-site AV/VC deployment and refresh programs * Experience supporting digital signage or enterprise video solutions **What We Offer:** We believe great people deserve great benefits. In addition to competitive compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and work\-life balance: * Multiple medical plan options to fit you and your family’s needs * HSA \& HRA company contributions * Dental coverage, including orthodontic benefits, and vision plans Company\-paid benefits * Basic Life, AD\&D * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability insurance * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Generous paid time off — 3 weeks PTO plus company holidays and floating holidays * 401k with company match * Paid maternity leave * Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * A wide range of voluntary benefits including Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident Insurance, Pet Insurance, Homeowners and Auto Insurance, Supplemental Life and AD\&D coverage, and Legal Services * Commuter benefits * And much more

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **What’s Under the Hood** DriveTime Family of Brands is the largest privately owned used car sales finance \& servicing company in the nation. The DriveTime Family of Brands spans across DriveTime, Bridgecrest and SilverRock. You can find us at the intersection of technology and innovation as we use our proprietary tools and over two decades of industry knowledge to redefine the process of purchasing, financing, and protecting your vehicle. **That’s Nice, But What’s the Job?** ***This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas or who need sponsorship now or in the future are not eligible for hire at this time.*** **In short,** as a Principal Software Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for driving complex, business\-critical initiatives across the organization. You will partner closely with product, architecture, and business stakeholders to design scalable solutions, lead engineering strategy, and solve challenging technical problems using modern cloud\-native technologies. This role requires a hands\-on engineer who can influence technical direction, champion best practices, and help shape the future of our software platforms while delivering measurable business impact. **In Long, as the Principal Software Engineer, you will be responsible for:** * Leading the design, development, and delivery of enterprise\-scale software solutions and strategic technology initiatives. * Architecting and building modern applications using object\-oriented programming languages such as C\#, Java, or Python. * Designing, developing, and optimizing APIs using RESTful services, GraphQL, and serverless architectures. * Driving application integration efforts across internal systems and external third\-party platforms. * Collaborating with product, architecture, and business teams to align technical solutions with organizational objectives. * Providing technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams through architecture reviews, code reviews, and best practice development. * Designing and implementing scalable data solutions leveraging both relational and non\-relational databases. * Developing secure applications utilizing modern authentication and authorization frameworks and identity providers. * Contributing to front\-end application development using modern frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue. * Building and deploying cloud\-native applications within Azure and other cloud environments as needed. * Partnering with marketing and customer technology teams to integrate Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and Customer Engagement Platforms (CEPs). * Evaluating emerging tools, technologies, and engineering practices to improve software quality, scalability, and operational efficiency. * Influencing technical strategy and communicating architectural decisions to senior leadership and key stakeholders. * Balancing technical excellence, delivery timelines, and business priorities to achieve successful outcomes. **So What Kind of Folks Are We Looking For?** --------------------------------------------- * Ability to establish strong cross\-functional partnerships across product, engineering, architecture, and business teams. * Strong engineering fundamentals with the ability to identify enduring solutions beyond technology trends. * Proven ability to navigate and influence product and engineering tradeoffs. * Demonstrated leadership through influence, collaboration, and technical expertise. * Results\-oriented mindset with a focus on delivering high\-impact business outcomes. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non\-technical audiences. * Data\-driven approach to decision\-making and problem\-solving. * Strong analytical thinking and the ability to solve complex challenges regardless of technology stack. * Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and mentoring fellow engineers. **The Specifics.** ------------------ * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * Extensive experience with object\-oriented programming languages such as C\#, Java, or Python. * Expertise in API design and development using RESTful services, GraphQL, and serverless architectures. * Experience working with relational and non\-relational databases including Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or similar technologies. * Experience integrating enterprise applications and third\-party systems. * Exposure to authentication and authorization platforms such as Okta, Auth0, Cognito, Firebase, or similar solutions. * Experience with modern front\-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue. * Experience building solutions in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure. * Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), preferably Segment, or similar technologies. * Experience with Customer Engagement Platforms (CEPs), preferably Braze, or similar technologies. **Nice to Haves** ----------------- * Experience with low\-code or workflow automation platforms such as Pega, Segment, Decisions, or similar technologies. * Experience working within highly regulated or enterprise\-scale environments. * Prior experience leading large\-scale modernization, digital transformation, or cloud migration initiatives. * Background implementing event\-driven or microservices\-based architectures. * Experience mentoring senior engineers and helping establish engineering standards across multiple teams. **So What About the Perks? Perks matter** * **Work From Home.** Feel free to rock the casual wear while still being camera ready. You will be working from your home office (in an approved city \& state) and make sure you have a conducive and quiet workspace with no distractions and reliable and secure internet. * **Medical, dental, and vision, oh my!** DriveTime Family of Brands covers a sizable amount of insurance premiums to ensure our employees receive top\-tier healthcare coverage. * **But Wait, There’s More.** 401(K), Company paid life insurance policy, short and long\-term disability coverage to name a few. * **Growth Opportunities.** You grow, I grow, we all grow! But seriously, DriveTime Family of Brands is committed to providing its employees with every opportunity to grow professionally with roughly over 1,000 employees promoted year over year. * **Tuition Reimbursement.** We’re as passionate about your professional development as you are. With that, we’ll put our money where our mouth is. * **Wellness Program.** Health is wealth! This program includes self\-guided coaching and journeys, cash incentives and discounts on your medical premiums through engaging in fun activities! * **Gratitude is Green.** We offer competitive pay across the organization, because, well… money matters! * **Paid Time Off.** Not just lip service: we work hard, to play hard! Paid time off includes (for all full\-time roles) wellness days, holidays, and good ole' fashioned YOU time! For our Part\-timers, don't fear you get some time too...vacation time is available \- the more you work, the more you earn! **Anything Else? Absolutely.** DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. We could spend a lot of time having you read about ALL our awards, but we’ll save time (and practice some humility) just naming a few others; Comparably Awards: Best Company for Diversity, Best Company Culture and Best Company Leadership, oh and don’t forget Phoenix Business Journal Healthiest Employers (okay, we’ll stop there)! Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of our background and drug screening process. DriveTime is a drug\-free, tobacco\-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high\-energy environment!

technologies. * Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis. * Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments. * Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency. * Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates. ### **Proactive Client Improvement** * Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues. * Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work. * Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements. * Partners with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and ESAs to turn findings into clear, cost\-effective recommendations for each client's technology roadmap. * Tracks hardware and firmware end\-of\-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation. * Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business outcomes, not technology features. ### **Leadership** * Hires, onboards, coaches, and develops Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers, including technical mentoring and certification planning. * Sets clear expectations, holds regular 1\-on\-1s, conducts performance reviews, and holds the team accountable using EOS tools (Rocks, Scorecards, Issues, To\-Dos) in Strety. * Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross\-functional or cross\-company work. * Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans. * Manages the team's 24/7 on\-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after\-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards. * Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value. ### **Operations and Compliance** * Defines, tr  (required) * 2\+ years leading engineers as a manager, team lead, or technical lead, with direct responsibility for work assignment and mentoring * MSP or multi\-client environment experience strongly preferred ### **Specialized Knowledge and Skills** * Expert enterprise networking fundamentals, including complex switching and routing, high availability system design, advanced network security design, Internet services and protocols, and advanced network diagnostics. * Demonstrated expert proficiency in at least three of the following, with advanced skills in the balance: core routing, core switching, network security, network diagnostics, and application load balancing. * Top expert level analysis and design skills: gathering data on systems issues, defining alternative approaches, assessing business impact, and recommending, developing, and implementing cost\-effective solutions. * A track record of proactively finding and fixing problems in environments you support, with examples you can walk us through. * Proven ability to lead, coach, and hold engineers accountable while staying hands\-on. * Excellent oral and written communication, including explaining technical risk and recommendations to non\-technical customers and executives. * Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, incidents, and people concurrently. * Advanced knowledge of current technologies, tools, applications, and vendors. ### **Certifications (preferred)** * CCNP Enterprise or Security, or equivalent experience; CCIE a strong plus * Fortinet NSE, Meraki (CMNA/ECMS), or other vendor learn additional network platforms as needed * VMware virtualization platforms (Platform9 a plus) * Windows Servers and Services (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP) * Auvik Monitoring * Autotask PSA and IT Glue (or similar PSA and documentation platforms) * MS Office, Visio, and collaboration tools **Why Join EO?** At EO, our employees are what makes us special. We are a highly collaborative company with a very involved senior leadership team that invests in their staff. We strive to be a company where every employee has a voice, everyone takes pride in their work and gets satisfaction from helping people, and where every employee is constantly learning and driving improvements. Create intuitive interfaces for complex workflows (prompting, iterating, reviewing AI outputs) * **Onboarding \& Activation:** Craft the first\-time user experience that takes someone from "what is this?" to "I can't work without this." * **Design System:** Build and maintain our design system from scratch. * **Visual Identity:** Shape Endex's brand through our product, marketing site, and collateral. Create a visual language that feels sophisticated, trustworthy, and cutting\-edge * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Engineering and Product to ship designs. Balance user needs with technical constraints, especially within Excel's add\-in environment * **Growth \& Conversion:** Design signup flows, pricing pages, and upgrade prompts that drive conversion **What We're Looking For** * **Product Designer:** You have a strong portfolio demonstrating end\-to\-end product design, from research and wireframes to high\-fidelity mockups and shipped features * **User\-Obsessed:** You deeply understand user workflows and pain points. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. **THE ROLE** Pure1 is the unifying manageability and intelligence layer on top of all Everpure products and services \- FlashArray, FlashBlade, CBS, Portworx and more. It is the nexus of our promise of a simple customer experience, providing insights and tools to help make our customers' lives better. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Working on end\-to\-end lifecycle application development across the full stack (roughly 30% frontend and 70% backend, vary quarter by quarter). You are expected to generate over 90% of your code using AI tools. * AI tooling leadership: you are expected to be a leader in not only AI tools usage, but to also create new skills and techniques by experimenting with AI and new technologies and architectural patterns. You keep up with real\-world AI developments and present those new developments to the team. * Designing, developing and maintaining customer\-facing and internal\-facing web applications, leveraging AI design tools and using technologies such as backend micro\-services in Java, Python, and in collaboration with our UX team for frontend work in Angular and Typescript * Leading fellow engineers and stake\-holders to identify requirements and take solutions from initial design to production * Leading/driving a project's implementation, including coordinating other engineers' work * Take charge and drive the team's design, development, unit testing, code reviews, documentation, continuous integration, and continuous deployment * Continuously explore and develop use of AI in all above areas to help accelerate the development life cycle and reduce traditional software development and maintenance pain points **WHAT YOU BRING** * 10\+ years of professional experience designing, implementing and testing various product components * 4\+ year(s) of experience in a leadership role (such as tech lead) driving multiple projects from requirements to release, including directing other engineers and being the first point of contact for cross functional teams * Strong experience using AI to generate production quality code, and a drive to experiment with new AI developments to increase productivity, quality, reliability, and security of our services * 10\+ years combined professional experience in Java, Javascript, Python, or equivalent. Nice to have: Typescript, C/C\+\+ * Ability to thrive in a highly collaborative and team\-oriented environment, and able to deal with ambiguity in project requirements and other specifications * Ability to lead, monitor, and support multiple concurrent projects with fast context switching * Knowledge of AWS, Kubernetes, networking infrastructure. Angular, NoSQL are a plus We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara or Bellevue office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave. \#LI\-REMOTE, \#LI\-ONSITE **WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:** * **Innovation**: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers. * **Growth**: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®! * **Team**: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good. And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information. **ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:** Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you're invited to an interview. **OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:** We're forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn't just accepted but embraced. That's why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership. Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire. **Join us and bring your best.** **Bring your bold.** **Pure and simple.**
