jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Your Future Evolves Here** Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones. Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business. Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture. **What You’ll Be Doing:** **Position Summary:** The Software Engineer designs, develops, tests, and maintains software applications using modern programming languages and frameworks. Working in an Agile, globally distributed team, this role partners with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into technical specifications and deliver clean, maintainable, and reliable code. This individual works with minimal supervision on assigned features, actively learning and adopting the development methods, frameworks, and patterns defined for the role and by the team, and contributes to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems. The role is expected to use approved AI\-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every delivered result. **AI\-Assisted Engineering Expectations:** Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI\-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design, evaluating alternatives, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards. **Key Responsibilities:** **Design and Development** * Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications for assigned features using modern programming languages and frameworks. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications. * Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, following the team’s established best practices, patterns, and coding standards. * Write unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability. * Contribute to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems. **Quality and Continuous Improvement** * Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, functionality, and maintainability, and seek feedback to continuously improve skills. * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues and bugs in a timely manner. * Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and reliability. * Follow and help reinforce the team’s development processes and standards, helping peers understand the benefits and risks of exceptions. * Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and methodologies, and stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends. **AI\-Enabled Delivery** * Utilize approved AI\-assisted engineering tools to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities. * Apply AI\-assisted development techniques throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, coding, testing, debugging, and documentation. * Evaluate and validate AI\-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness before use. * Learn and adopt the prompts, skills, agents, and AI\-assisted development patterns defined by the team, and share improvements that benefit the team. * Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality through AI\-enabled workflows and automation. **Governance and Compliance** * Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices. * Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling. * Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI\-assisted solutions. **Required Qualifications:** * 2\+ years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex, scalable applications. * Proficiency in C\# or Python and familiarity with their ecosystems. * Working knowledge of relational database development, preferably using SQL Server. * Strong understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures. * Familiarity with Git\-based version control (e.g., GitHub, Azure Git) and collaborative coding workflows, including pull requests. * Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). * Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a globally distributed team. * Strong communication skills, openness to feedback, and the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience related to HL7 FHIR. Understanding resource\-first FHIR patterns. Comfortable reading FHIR implementation guides. * Experience in healthcare data domains such as providers, members, prior authorizations, and claims. * Exposure to AI\-assisted development platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools. * Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI\-assisted testing, and AI\-enabled software delivery practices. * Experience with additional back\-end technologies (e.g., Node.js, Django, Spring). * Familiarity with microservices architecture. * Experience working with NoSQL data stores (e.g., Elasticsearch). * Healthcare domain experience. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in\-person I\-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration. **Technical Requirements:** We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router. **Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.** **If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact** **recruitingteam@evolent.com** **for further assistance.** The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $109,000\-$123,000\. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

jobs.title: Software System Engineer
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced **Senior Software System Engineer** to support the certification activities of the flight software for the Nyx program. You will work in a dedicated team focused on verification \& validation (V\&V), software certification, requirements tracing, test planning and system engineering interfacing. In this role, you will collaborate closely with software development teams, system engineering, certification bodies, and safety authorities. You will work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment where cross\-functional integration is essential. **Key Responsibilities** * Contribute to V\&V and IV\&V activities to ensure that flight software meets functional, performance, and safety requirements * Support requirements management and tracing, ensuring full traceability from system\-level requirements to software implementation, test and verification artifacts * Prepare and review documentation required for software certification and NASA Safety Reviews * Interpret, tailor, and apply formal standards * Interface with internal Product Assurance * Collaborate daily with system engineers and software development teams to resolve technical issues and clarify requirements * Develop and maintain software functional design baseline * Plan software testing of the integrated mission * Use your understanding of C\+\+ and Python to meaningfully engage in software design and test discussions **What we would love to see from you** * Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, or another related field. * 3\-5 years of experience in systems design, analysis, and testing of aerospace or space\-related systems, with a focus on integration of complex spacecraft and/or testing activities. * Experience working on safety\-critical or highly regulated software systems (preferably in aerospace) * Solid understanding of requirements management, V\&V, test and certification processes * Strong technical background in software engineering, with practical experience in flight software frameworks and modern C\+\+ * Experience with real\-time systems, embedded development, or spacecraft software * Familiarity with software testing methodologies and simulation tools * Excellent cross\-disciplinary communication and collaboration skills * Focus on detail, quality, and testing * Familiarity with agile and modern development practices **Nice to have** * Familiarity with standards such as SSP 50808, NASA\-NPR\-7150\.2, NASA\-STD\-8739\.8B, RCC319, ECSS\-Q\-ST\-80C * Prior work on human\-rated spaceflight programs * Experience with model\-based system engineering and castle programming * Experience with CI/CD systems and build systems **Why you should join us!** What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: * We’re Agile \- we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind * We’re Open and Collaborative \- we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them * We have a lot of Fun \- we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. *The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.* *All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third\-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.* *If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.*

jobs.title: Full Stack Senior Software Engineer (Remote in CA)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Join a team that puts its People First! As a member of the First American family of companies, First American Trust is a federal savings bank that has provided banking, wealth management, and trust solutions on a national, full\-service basis for more than five decades. Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people\-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ\+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.**What We Do** ============== We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Senior Software Engineer to design and implement secure, scalable, cloud\-native software solutions that power next\-generation financial applications. In this role, you will contribute hands\-on development while supporting architecture and design decisions across modern web applications, APIs, and distributed services. If you are passionate about exploring new technologies and have a demonstrated track record of delivering innovative features and products, we would like to hear from you. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Product, Architecture, UX, DevOps, and Security, to design, develop, and integrate AI\-enabled capabilities such as intelligent automation, LLM\-powered services, RAG\-based solutions, and API\-driven AI integrations. You will help translate emerging ideas into reliable, production\-ready systems that deliver measurable business value. This position offers the opportunity to work with a talented team while operating autonomously with minimal supervision. A strong background in modern software development, cloud platforms, and agile methodologies is essential. Experience building, integrating, or operating AI\-powered applications, and using AI\-assisted development tools to improve delivery, is highly valued.**What You'll Do:** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable applications in an Azure cloud environment. * Build full\-stack solutions using Python, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs, and microservice architectures. * Modify and enhance existing applications; contribute to product delivery through coding and pull request reviews. * Design, develop, and integrate AI\-powered capabilities, including LLM integrations, RAG, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation, using platforms such as Azure OpenAI. * Implement and maintain AI orchestration and inference pipelines, ensuring performance, cost efficiency, observability, and responsible usage. * Apply software engineering best practices (testing, monitoring, CI/CD, observability, secure SDLC) to production systems, including AI\-driven applications. * Evaluate and prototype emerging AI tools and frameworks; leverage AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate design, coding, testing, and code review. * Ensure data privacy, security, governance, and compliance when building and deploying AI\-enabled functionality. * Independently define and prioritize goals and tasks in a fast\-paced agile product environment with small, focused teams. * Collaborate with Solution Architects and stakeholders to align on design plans, troubleshoot production issues, and drive durable solutions. * Mentor engineers on software engineering best practices, cloud\-native architecture, and AI integration patterns. * Propose solutions to complex problems, build consensus among the team, and influence technical direction. **What You'll Bring:** * 5\+ years of software development experience using Python and building cloud\-native applications in Azure (AWS experience also considered). * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent combination of education and experience. * Experience developing modern web applications with React and JavaScript/TypeScript. * Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming, software design patterns, and application architecture. * Experience designing and consuming REST APIs. * Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL). * Experience conducting code reviews and mentoring other engineers. * Experience working in Agile development environments. * Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, and modern software development best practices. * Experience integrating AI capabilities into applications, including Azure OpenAI, LLMs, RAG, or vector databases. * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes preferred. * Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and business teams. * Familiar with Ruby on Rails or willing to learn it. * Experience with event\-driven architecture and messaging platforms. * Experience with application observability leveraging OpenTelemetry. **TECHNOLOGY:** Python, Azure (App Services, Functions, Azure OpenAI, AI Services), React, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST API, Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server), NoSQL Databases (MongoDB, Cosmos DB), LLMs, RAG, AI APIs. **DEVELOPMENT TOOLS:** Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Windows, Azure, Git, GitLab, GitHub, Azure DevOps, NPM Package Management, CI/CD Pipelines. jobs.title: AI & ML Ops Engineer
jobs.description: Responsibilities/Job Description: The **AI \& ML Operations Engineer** designs, builds, and maintains the engineering processes and platform capabilities needed to deploy, monitor, govern, and maintain deployed AI/ML solutions at scale. The role converts validated analytical work into reliable production solutions and manages the operational lifecycle of models and related services while meeting enterprise privacy, security, and support standards. The engineer partners with data scientists, data engineers, central cloud and infrastructure teams, API and Interoperability teams, Cybersecurity, service owners, and relevant engineering teams to deliver maintainable solutions. The role remains hands\-on in engineering, testing, deployment, and troubleshooting while using enterprise\-managed capabilities for production data movement, integration, and infrastructure. Scientific method validation remains with the Data Scientist and designated reviewers; this position implements the operational controls for deployed solutions. This role is part of a new AI \& Automation engineering team and will directly design, build, deploy, and support production AI applications and services. Work may include agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, orchestration, APIs and integrations, automated evaluation and testing frameworks, observability, monitoring, release and rollback processes, and model/application lifecycle management. **Responsibilities** **Model deployment and orchestration.** Deploy batch and real\-time models and related AI services using approved CI/CD, containers, APIs, and workflow patterns. Build and maintain assigned model deployment and runtime components and coordinate dependencies with enterprise platform owners. **Release management.** Automate packaging, versioning, testing, promotion, rollback, and recovery for models and services. Implement retraining or recalibration workflows using criteria defined with data scientists and the required validation and release approvals. **ML platform capabilities.** Implement, integrate, configure, and operate approved feature stores, model registries, experiment tracking, and related ML lifecycle capabilities with enterprise platform owners. Partner with Cloud \& AI Deployment Engineering and central cloud teams on compute, storage, networking, and deployment. **Deployed\-model governance.** Implement approved lifecycle controls, access restrictions, lineage, audit trails, change records, and release approvals for deployed models. Maintain traceability across data, code, model, and configuration versions. **Monitoring and reliability.** Implement logging, alerts, and monitoring for model performance, drift, data quality, latency, availability, and errors. Work with data scientists, service owners, and relevant engineering teams on measures, thresholds, incident response, and service objectives. **Data and API integration.** Work with central data\-engineering teams on managed data pipelines and with enterprise API and Interoperability teams on real\-time and application integrations, including MuleSoft or other approved API capabilities. Coordinate monitoring, recovery checkpoints, restart procedures, security, and support ownership. **Enterprise support and maintainability.** Ensure production solutions have documented dependencies, operational procedures, escalation paths, and ongoing ownership before release. Arrange support with the responsible enterprise teams, including 24/7 coverage where required for critical services, rather than relying on an individual project owner. **AI application operations.** Operate assigned LLM, retrieval\-based, and agent applications using automated quality checks, model/tool tracing, prompt and configuration versioning, and usage/cost monitoring within the common production lifecycle. **Security and engineering standards.** Apply enterprise privacy, security, encryption, role\-based access, and sensitive\-data controls. Follow common infrastructure\-as\-code, pull\-request, and deployment practices with the responsible teams; bring needed tooling or design exceptions through established review processes. **Collaboration and improvement.** Help scientists and partner teams move prototypes into supported production solutions. Review code, tests, and documentation, resolve incidents across dependencies, provide constructive technical feedback, and improve reliability, reproducibility, performance, and efficiency. **Required Qualifications*** B.S./B.A. in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * At least three years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, or MLOps, including work with production systems. * Proficiency in Python or another modern programming language, such as Java or Go, sufficient to build, test, troubleshoot, and maintain production components. * Hands\-on experience deploying and operating batch and/or real\-time machine\-learning models in production. * Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps; source control, code review, automated testing, and controlled releases. * Hands\-on experience with containerization and orchestration technologies using enterprise\-approved platforms and tools. * Experience in cloud and/or hybrid environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Working knowledge of SQL and experience with large datasets and data\-workflow orchestration; ability to integrate model services with enterprise\-managed pipelines and APIs. * Experience implementing logging, metrics, monitoring, alerts, and operational diagnostics and investigating failures across model, application, data, and infrastructure dependencies. * Understanding of security best practices, role\-based access control, secrets management, and handling sensitive data. * Ability to independently deliver assigned engineering work, communicate technical tradeoffs, and collaborate with data scientists, clinicians, data/API teams, cloud/DevOps, security, and support functions. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience in healthcare, health technology, or another regulated industry handling PHI/PII. * Familiarity with EHR/EMR integration and healthcare data standards such as HL7/FHIR, ICD, CPT, LOINC, or SNOMED. * Experience with ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or Azure ML, including model registries, feature stores, and experiment tracking. * Experience with ETL/ELT, data warehouse or lakehouse platforms, enterprise API platforms, infrastructure as code, and formal production\-support practices. * Experience monitoring model drift, fairness, and explainability and implementing healthcare AI governance controls. * Experience operating LLM, retrieval\-based, or agent applications, including quality evaluation, tracing, prompt/configuration management, and cost monitoring. Qualifications: $109,449\.60\- $154,523\.20 Annual

jobs.title: Cloud & AI Deployment Engineer

The role combines hands\-on cloud engineering with collaboration across DevOps, Security, and AI/ML teams to deliver reliable, secure environments that can be supported and maintained long term. The engineer follows enterprise infrastructure\-as\-code, pull\-request, deployment, and cloud\-governance practices, including FinOps tagging. The role identifies gaps and helps establish AI\-specific cloud guardrails, reusable patterns, and implementation guidelines with the responsible enterprise teams. The position supports cloud and infrastructure delivery; MLOps retains deployed\-model operations, and data scientists and designated reviewers retain scientific method validation. This role will serve as the AI \& Automation team’s dedicated cloud engineering resource, enabling AI engineers through secure, repeatable Azure environments and deployment patterns while working alongside existing enterprise and contracted cloud resources. The role may also support AWS and hybrid\-cloud needs where applicable. **Responsibilities** **Azure cloud implementation.** Design, implement, configure, and maintain assigned Azure infrastructure supporting AI/ML solutions in partnership with central Cloud Engineering and infrastructure teams. Coordinate compute, storage, networking, access, and dependencies using approved cloud capabilities. **Infrastructure as code and deployment.** Build and maintain version\-controlled infrastructure and deployment configurations. Use pull requests, peer review, testing, and enterprise CI/CD processes for repeatable deployment, promotion, rollback, and recovery. Align GitHub and DevOps practices with designated enterprise owners. **AI cloud guardrails and standards.** Identify implementation gaps and help develop and apply approved AI cloud guidelines, reusable patterns, and guardrails with central Cloud Engineering, Architecture, and Security. Ensure deployments follow shared standards rather than isolated, project\-specific practices. **Cloud governance and FinOps.** Apply enterprise\-required resource tagging and cloud\-governance practices to support ownership, cost visibility, and efficient resource use. Work with the responsible enterprise teams to address tagging and governance gaps and maintain standards across cloud implementations. **Security and access.** Implement approved encryption, access\-control, and sensitive\-data protections for cloud resources. Coordinate security requirements with security and infrastructure owners and bring needed tooling or design exceptions through established review processes. **Production readiness and support.** Document configurations, dependencies, monitoring, logging, operational procedures, recovery steps, and escalation paths with responsible service owners before production use. Coordinate ongoing support, including the coverage required for critical services, rather than relying on an individual project owner. **Reliability and troubleshooting.** Monitor and troubleshoot assigned cloud infrastructure and deployment processes. Work with MLOps and enterprise service owners to investigate failures, resolve infrastructure dependencies, and maintain availability and performance. **Cross\-team delivery and ownership.** Partner with central cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, data/API, and AI/ML teams to deliver supported environments and deployment capabilities. Clarify implementation and support responsibilities and contribute to updating responsibility assignments as enterprise platform ownership evolves. **Documentation and continuous improvement.** Maintain technical documentation, reusable deployment patterns, and support information. Provide constructive technical feedback, share implementation guidance, and improve reproducibility, efficiency, and long\-term support and maintainability across AI cloud deployments. **Required Qualifications*** B.S./B.A. in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field; or * A combination of education and experience equivalent to a bachelor’s degree. * Three years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or related work, including demonstrated hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience with Azure cloud engineering and deployment in an enterprise environment. * Experience implementing and maintaining infrastructure as code and reusable deployment configurations. * Experience with source control, pull requests, CI/CD, and controlled deployment processes using GitHub, Azure DevOps, or comparable enterprise\-managed tools. * Ability to implement and troubleshoot cloud compute, storage, networking, and access configurations in partnership with infrastructure teams. * Experience applying cloud governance, resource tagging, and enterprise deployment and support standards. * Understanding of security best practices, role\-based access control, encryption, and sensitive\-data handling in cloud environments. * Experience with monitoring, logging, operational troubleshooting, and documented production support for cloud\-hosted services. * Ability to identify gaps and develop clear technical guidelines, guardrails, and reusable implementation patterns with enterprise owners. * Ability to independently deliver assigned work, communicate technical tradeoffs, and collaborate with central cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, data/API, Security, and AI/ML teams. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience supporting AI/ML deployments or AI applications in Azure. * Experience in healthcare, health technology, or another regulated industry handling sensitive data. * Experience with containers and deployment patterns for cloud\-hosted applications and services. * Experience with AWS or hybrid\-cloud environments and applying common standards across cloud platforms. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Balance and Ledger - Core
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.**Overview** ------------ Fanatics Betting \& Gaming (FBG) is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics Holdings, Inc. As a **Staff Engineer** on the **Balance and Ledger** team, you will be the technical owner of the ledger and balance services that hold customer funds across Fanatics. Balance and Ledger will be a shared ledger and a customer\-level balance that can be used across Sportsbook and Casino, Markets, and other LOBs. You will design the systems that make this possible: a ledger that is correct and auditable, a balance model that enforces which funds can be used where, and a migration path that moves existing wallets onto the shared platform without disrupting customers. This role combines deep backend expertise with architectural leadership. You will set the technical direction for the balance platform, work closely with Payments, Fraud, Responsible Gaming, Finance, Legal, and Compliance partners, and guide engineers across several teams as new businesses adopt the shared ledger. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Own the architecture** of the ledger and balance services, including the data model, consistency guarantees, and the interfaces other businesses use to read balances and authorize spend. * **Design and build** distributed services in Java and Spring Boot that handle high transaction volume with strict correctness, idempotency, and auditability requirements. * **Model funds by type and eligibility**, so that each portion of a customer's balance is usable only where client, product, customer location, and transaction type allow, and so that a regulator\-driven restriction can be applied quickly and safely. * **Lead the migration** of existing business wallets onto the shared ledger in phases, including dual\-running, reconciliation, cutover, and rollback plans that avoid customer\-visible downtime. * **Architect event\-driven integration** using java and architectural patterns so that balance changes are published reliably and downstream consumers can depend on ordering and delivery. * **Carry responsible gaming protections with the balance**, working with the Responsible Gaming and Fraud teams so that limits, self\-exclusion, and other customer protections remain enforced as funds are used across businesses. * **Work with Finance, Legal, and Compliance** on how funds are attributed between businesses, how settlement and chargebacks are handled, and what data may be shared across Fanatics entities. * **Build for reconciliation and audit**, including complete transaction histories, financial reporting feeds, and tooling that lets Operations and Finance verify balances independently. * **Lead technical initiatives** that span multiple teams, and run architectural reviews, design sessions, and incident postmortems. * **Mentor engineers** and raise the standard for security, observability, reliability, and testing across the platform. * **Partner with product, frontend, and mobile teams** so that balance behavior is clear and consistent in every customer\-facing experience. * Be open to occasional travel to Fanatics offices or industry events for planning, collaboration, and team development. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot. * Experience designing and operating a ledger, wallet, balance service, or another financial system of record where correctness and auditability are requirements. * Strong command of transactional consistency, idempotency, concurrency control, and relational data modeling in systems that cannot lose or double\-count a transaction. * Experience building event\-driven systems and working with message streaming platforms such as Kafka. * Demonstrated success setting technical direction and driving alignment across multiple teams. * Experience migrating live, high\-traffic systems with minimal customer impact. * Ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs clearly to engineering, product, finance, and leadership audiences. * Comfort working in a fast\-paced, regulated environment with changing priorities. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience in online gaming, sports betting, fintech, banking, or payments. * Experience with a shared platform used by several business units, including managing adoption, versioning, and ownership boundaries. * Experience with financial reconciliation, settlement, or accounting\-oriented data models. * Familiarity with data privacy and consent requirements when customer data moves between legal entities. * Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and observability tooling such as Datadog, Grafana, or CloudWatch. * Interest in developer experience, clean API design, and systems that remain maintainable as more teams depend on them. Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in\-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi\-day cultural immersion in New York City for full\-time, non\-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/ \#LI\-VG1 By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. *Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Stablecoin Payments
jobs.description: Flex is building **AI\-native financial services for business owners**. We’re re\-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. **Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.** Since launching publicly in **September 2023**, Flex has scaled from **zero to nine\-figure annualized revenue**, with a clear path to **profitability by late 2026**. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are **affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)**—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a **\~$1T\+ revenue market** hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a **$100B\+ company** by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M\+ in equity and $300M\+ in debt. * **Mission\-critical problems**: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. * **High bar, low ego**: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. * **Speed over comfort**: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. * **Enduring impact**: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. **Team \& Locations** We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. **Flex Fuels Ambition.** ### **About the Role** Flex is building stablecoin products for business owners, and we need engineers who can ship them. The team is small and moving fast, and you’ll be one of the first engineers to join. You’ll build the services that move customer money on\-chain and connect them to the banking systems Flex already runs. That means real ownership, direct access to the engineering lead and product, and work that customers use. Crypto experience helps, but it isn’t required. Much of the work is strong fintech engineering: payments, onboarding, compliance, and reliability. If you’ve built that kind of system and want to learn the crypto side, we want to talk. ### **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and run backend services for stablecoin payments, including deposits, withdrawals, and on and off ramps * Integrate with partners for wallets, virtual accounts, and stablecoin orchestration * Build business onboarding (KYB) and compliance flows that stand up to banking audits * Connect new stablecoin products to Flex’s existing banking, ledger, and payments systems * Own your work from design through launch and production support * Work closely with product, design, compliance, and business development * Help set technical direction of the team’s roadmap * Onboard and mentor new teammates ### **Requirements** * 5\+ years of backend software engineering experience * Experience building and running production services in fintech, payments, or banking * Experience with compliance\-driven systems such as KYB, KYC, AML, or audit requirements, and comfort working with compliance stakeholders * Strong system design skills, especially for money movement: accuracy, reliability, and handling failures safely * Proficiency in a modern backend language * Comfortable owning problems end to end in a small, fast\-moving team * Clear communicator with technical and non\-technical partners ### **Nice to Haves** * Hands\-on crypto experience: stablecoins, wallets, custody, on\-chain transactions, etc. * Experience with on and off ramps, virtual accounts, or stablecoin orchestration * Smart contract development or auditing experience * Prior experience at a startup or high\-growth company Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. Flexbase Technologies Inc.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI Agents)
jobs.description: Fluent is building the next generation advertising network: Partner Monetize and Advertiser Acquisition. Our vision is to build an ML/AI first network of advertisers and publishers working toward a common objective, elevating relevancy in e\-commerce for everyday shoppers. Fluent is hiring its first dedicated AI Engineer. Over the past year, AI at Fluent has moved from pilots to production: a service desk agent that closes tickets without a human touch, a pipeline that cut modeled audience delivery from days to hours, and an agent that audits cross\-system attribution and identifies revenue reconciliation opportunities. All of it was built by people doing it alongside their day jobs. Your job is to make it your day job. You will sit in Core Engineering and work every day with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Solution Architecture. You will build the agents and automated workflows our business teams have asked for, and you will build them on the Databricks lakehouse that is Fluent's data hub, because the hard part of most of these workflows is not the model. It is getting trusted data and reliable actions in front of it. You are a builder who ships. You are strong in Python and SQL, you have put at least one LLM\-powered application in front of real users, and you know the difference between a demo and a production system: evaluation, monitoring, cost, and a clear owner. You have worked in Databricks or a comparable lakehouse, or you have the data engineering depth to get productive there quickly. You are comfortable sitting with a support lead or an account manager, understanding how they actually work, and turning that into something that runs every day. This role is fully remote in the United States, with occasional travel to our New York headquarters. ### **What you'll do** * Ship production agents and automated workflows from a prioritized, business\-validated backlog. Own each one from scoping with the business owner through build, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and handoff. * Build the data foundation those workflows depend on in Databricks: Unity Catalog tables and views, Lakeflow pipelines, Lakeflow Connect ingestion from systems like HubSpot, and Genie spaces that let business teams ask questions in plain language. Bring data from our ad\-serving and partner platforms, CRM, support desk, and finance systems into one place people can trust. * Work with Data Science to make agent quality measurable: evaluation sets, accuracy and drift tracking, cost and latency instrumentation, and the audit fields and failure alerts every production workflow carries. * Integrate with Fluent's systems through APIs, webhooks, MCP servers, and orchestration (Databricks Workflows, n8n, GitHub Actions), and replace brittle point\-to\-point automations with maintained, observable ones. * Partner with Core Engineering to expose platform data and actions as APIs, so agents and business teams can use them directly instead of routing requests through engineers. * Build reusable pieces, not one\-offs: Claude skills, MCP connectors, prompt and evaluation libraries, and playbooks that other builders across Fluent can pick up. * Handle consumer data in line with Fluent's privacy and compliance standards, use only approved AI tools, and work with IT \& Security on credentials and access. * Demo weekly, write things down in Confluence, and share what you learn in brown bags and tech talks. * Use AI\-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot review) as a normal part of how you work. ### **What success looks like** In your first 90 days you will have shipped one workflow end to end, with a named business owner and numbers Finance can validate. By six months you will have several in production, at least one reusable component another builder has picked up, and a clear view of what next quarter's backlog should be. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, with strong Python and SQL. * You have built and shipped at least one LLM\-powered application or agent that real users depend on, using tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs, and evaluation. * Hands\-on experience with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows) or a comparable lakehouse, or deep enough data engineering experience to ramp quickly. * Experience integrating SaaS and internal systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and OAuth. * You test your work, instrument it, and care about cost. You know when a workflow is ready to be owned by someone else. * You communicate clearly with people who do not write code, and you are comfortable running a working session with a business team. * Experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as part of a modern engineering workflow. * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Nice to have** * Databricks Mosaic AI (Agent Framework, Model Serving, Vector Search), Genie, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakebase, or Databricks Apps. * Building MCP servers, or working with the Claude Developer Platform or Agent SDK. * Workflow orchestration tools such as n8n. * Integrations with HubSpot, Zendesk, NetSuite, or Jira. * Experience in ad tech, performance marketing, or another environment that handles regulated consumer data. **Benefits** At Fluent, we like what we do, and we like who we do it with. Our team is a tight\-knit crew of go\-getters; we love to celebrate our successes! In addition, we offer a fully stocked kitchen, catered breakfast and lunch, and our office manager keeps the calendar stocked with activity\-filled events. When we are not eating, working out, or planning parties, Fluent folks can be found participating in recreational sports leagues, networking with She Runs It, and bonding with across teams during quarterly outings to baseball games, fancy dinners, and pizza\-making classes. And we have all the practical benefits, too… * Competitive compensation * Ample career and professional growth opportunities * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Pre\-tax savings plans and transit/parking programs * 401K with competitive employer match * Volunteer and philanthropic activities throughout the year * Educational and social events * The amazing opportunity to work for a high\-flying performance marketing company! Salary Range: $130,000 to $155,000 plus competitive bonus \- The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Fluent salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. Candidates may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors seeking personal information. Fluent recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with an @fluentco.com domain. Any outreach by Fluent via other sources (e.g. text, other domains etc) should be ignored. Fluent participates in the E\-Verify Program. As a participating employer, Fluent, LLC will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), with information from each new employee’s Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. Each works from its own schedule and its own spreadsheets. When a project slips, the people who could fix it usually find out last. We connect schedules, field progress and execution data across every party, forecast where delivery is heading, and help teams act before a delay becomes a missed date. On one 15\-project portfolio, Foresight found a project 245 days behind, cut reporting overhead by 90%, and helped prevent more than $100M in lost revenue. We raised a $25M Series A led by Macquarie Capital and are headquartered in New York. **The role** We're looking for an **Applied AI Engineer** to help build the core ML engine of the Foresight platform. You will build the systems that enhance the ability for efficient delivery of large scale construction projects. You will architect, train and deploy the models that perform Foresight's risk predictions and AI recommendations, to be used in interfaces that make 100k\-activity projects understandable at a glance. This is a hands\-on role on a new team, for someone who owns models and backend features from training to deployment and monitoring to build systems that are accurate, scalable and observable. At Foresight, machine learning is an integral part of the platform. You will be using complex, multimodal high stakes data to make predictions that will be used by teams to deliver major projects on time. This could translate to work on: * Risk prediction: Build, train and deploy models that predict if a project will be at risk and by how much. * Criticality prediction: Build models that use project plans to identify which of the tasks are the most critical to complete the project on time before the project even starts. * Project planning: Build models that accept blueprints and 3D Replit models to create project timelines and scaffolding as the starting point for human planners to make project planning a breeze. * Progress trackers: Build models that take in multi\-model data from static cameras or videos from humans/drones on\-site, voice notes, etc about a task to predict what percent of the task is complete. * Risk mitigation: Build, train and deploy models that can predict the best path forward for risk mitigation or timeline amelioration for major projects. * Continuous improvement: Evaluate models repeatedly and prototype methods and new models to improve the accuracy of current features, inspired by latest research publications. **What you'll do** * Own features from technical design through release and beyond: measure adoption, learn and keep improving. * Work alongside Full Stack engineers to help them turn new models into production features customers rely on. * Partner with product, design and customers to find the problems most worth solving. * Tune performance across the modelling stack, from accuracy to latency and reliability. * Raise the bar on architecture, testing, observability and how the team ships. * Help shape the product and technical roadmap. **Requirements** **You might be a fit if you** * Have 3\+ years of experience building and shipping Machine Learning models in production, with real ownership of the backend. * Have 1\+ years of experience building and shipping VLM/LLM based features to production. * Are strong in Python on the backend (FastAPI, Django or similar). * Are solid at relational data modelling in Postgres: schema design, indexes, query plans, migrations, and an ORM such as SQLAlchemy. * Have shipped agentic workflows, RAG systems and high\-volume data pipelines. * Have experience with async work: queues, background jobs, retries, idempotency, and what happens when a worker dies halfway. * Are hands\-on with AWS (S3, RDS, a managed queue or event service, containers or serverless). * Write tests and debug production issues from logs, metrics and traces, not guesses. * Are clear in written communication and comfortable making pragmatic trade\-offs in a small team that moves fast. **Bonus points** * Experience with workflow orchestration for multi\-step jobs (Temporal, Step Functions, Airflow or similar). * You've worked on a legacy\-to\-modern migration, or on products for regulated enterprise or public\-sector customers (SOC 2, data residency). * Early\-stage or founding\-team experience. None of these are required. If the core of this role excites you, apply. **Benefits** **Why join now** * **Real stakes, real customers**. Real stakes, real customers. You won't be building for a hypothetical buyer. Owners and contractors are building now, on deadlines measured in revenue per day. * **Blank canvas, solid ground**. You get first\-engineer level scope on a product that already has paying customers, real data and proven outcomes to tell. * **Defining a category**.Agentic software for physical infrastructure is a new category. What you build will become the standard. * **Small, senior team**. Flat, direct, low on process. We debate openly, decide quickly and ship. **Compensation and location** * **Total Comp**: $180,000\-230,000, based on experience, level, and location. * **Benefits**: Health, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO . * **Location**: New York, San Francisco, and Montreal are preferred. Occasional travel to may be required. Foresight is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on any protected basis.

jobs.title: Water Systems Manager
jobs.description: The Senior Water Systems Engineer is Forest Lawn’s senior technical authority for water resource planning, distribution and treatment system design, hydraulic modeling, asset management, capital improvement planning, and regulatory compliance. The role provides technical leadership for reliable design and development of sustainable water infrastructure; supports system operations and maintenance; and helps to manage water use across the parks. Typical projects include wells, pipelines, pump stations, pressure zones, controls, reservoirs, treatment, storage, and SCADA controls and instrumentation. The position also supervises staff and oversees consultants, contracts, and project delivery. **What You'll Be Doing** * Under direction, leads long\-range master planning for potable water, recycled water, groundwater, and new supplies. Develops solutions for current and future storage, treatment, distribution, renewal, and expansion needs. Plays a key role in the development of a long\-term water system Capital Improvement Program and renewal strategies. Prioritizes projects and prepares supporting justifications, engineering estimates, budgets, and schedules. * Conducts water resource planning in collaboration with internal departments, consultants, regulatory agencies, water utilities, and other utility providers. Prepares and reviews technical reports, represents Forest Lawn’s interests in public forums, and advocates for reliable, diversified, and sustainable water supplies. * Champions stewardship, customer service, reliability, resiliency, sustainability, innovation, and efficiency in the planning, design, operation, and renewal of Forest Lawn’s water systems. * Develops and maintains hydraulic models used to analyze water demands, system pressures, flow capacity, storage requirements, pumping strategies, emergency supply scenarios, and water quality considerations. Uses modeling results to evaluate operational scenarios, inform operational decisions, optimize system performance and support infrastructure planning and capital improvement recommendations. * Collaborates with utility operators to evaluate distribution system performance using SCADA data, field observations, hydraulic modeling results, and engineering analysis. * Will establish a GIS\-based water system asset inventory to support the development of an asset management program, including standards, procedures, and performance metrics. Uses ArcGIS Pro and related tools to support asset mapping, condition assessments, maintenance scheduling, risk\-based prioritization, and master planning. * Collaborates with utility operators to assess and document infrastructure conditions, remaining useful life, replacement value, and operational criticality. Evaluates vulnerabilities and operational risks and recommends maintenance, emergency response, repair, rehabilitation, replacement, and capital improvement priorities. * Works with Construction Management, Operations, Landscape Maintenance, utility operators, consultants, and contractors to deliver projects safely and effectively. Monitors budgets, schedules, risks, and performance; coordinates startup, testing, commissioning, operational acceptance, and closeout. * Develops scopes of work, requests for proposals, and contract documents; evaluates consultant proposals, supplier quotations, and contractor qualifications; and procures and administers professional services agreements, supplier agreements, and construction contracts in accordance with company procedures. * Ensures design quality and constructability; develops, supervises, reviews, and, when required, stamps technical drawings, specifications, and plans. Reviews and acts on requests for information, submittals, cost proposals, schedules, test results, and change orders. Leads the technical design of water production, distribution, storage, pumping, and SCADA projects; conducts field inspections; and documents construction observations. * Identifies water infrastructure maintenance needs. Researches methods and materials. * Coordinates with electrical engineers on pump equipment, controls, and electrical demand loads for water system projects. * Represents Forest Lawn before public agencies, municipalities, counties, cities, and water purveyors. Coordinates utility and regulatory activities and obtains plan\-check approvals, encroachment permits, and other required authorizations for water system projects; supports applicable grant funding activities. * Coordinates and supervises compliance, water production, permitting and other reporting and payment obligations. * Collaborates in the collection and analysis of water\-use records for all cemeteries, CIMIS evapotranspiration data and other information used in the development of water budgets, distributes monitoring reports to park leadership and senior management, and trains Operations personnel on water conservation practices. * Bachelor’s Degree in Civil or Mechanical Engineering. * Minimum fifteen (15\) years of progressively responsible experience in water systems engineering. * Demonstrated leadership in project and program management, staff supervision, consultant oversight, contract administration, or construction management. * Experience with municipal water utilities, special districts, public agencies, engineering consulting firms, or comparable organizations is highly desirable. Knowledge of water distribution system operations, capital improvement planning, hydraulic modeling, and infrastructure asset management preferred. * Valid California Driver’s License, including state required levels of active auto insurance. * California Civil or Mechanical Professional Engineer (PE) license in good standing. * SWRCB Water Distribution Operator Grade D3 or higher preferred. * Preferred Project Management Professional (PMP). * Preferred GIS\-related certifications. * Preferred Asset management certification. * Preferred SCADA, controls, or instrumentation\-related certifications. * * AutoCAD experience required, particularly with schematic and diagrammatic drawings, scaled plan drawings, scaled mechanical and civil engineering details, use of dimensioning, and creation and manipulation of highly formatted drawings. * Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams, internal staff, and external consultants or vendors. * Proficiency in reading and reviewing technical drawings, construction documents, and project specifications. * Strong knowledge of permitting processes with municipalities and public agencies. * Ability to simultaneously work on multiple projects and produce quality results within deadlines. * Excellent oral and written communication skills. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team. * Ability to work in a hybrid setting and travel to multiple locations around Southern California. **Competitive Benefits** Forest Lawn takes pride in offering an excellent benefits package to our employees, which taken as a whole, leads our industry and is competitive with the benefits in just about any other industry. Click here to learn more about our benefit offerings. **Drug Testing Policy** Prior to beginning employment, all job applicants who receive a job offer will be required to voluntarily submit to a drug screening test conducted by a laboratory designated by Forest Lawn. The drug screening method is a hair collection test that will detect the use of illegal drugs within the past 90 days. A positive drug test may result in the withdrawal of the job offer. **E\-Verify Statement** Forest Lawn has registered to participate in the federal government's E\-Verify program. With E\-Verify we are able to confirm the employment authorization of all newly hired employees through an electronic database maintained by the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security. With respect to new hires, the E\-Verify process is completed in conjunction with a new hire's completion of the Form I\-9, Employment Eligibility Verification upon commencement of employment. E\-Verify is not used as a tool to pre\-screen candidates. For up\-to\-date information on E\-Verify, go to https://www.e\-verify.gov/employees/e\-verify\-overview. **Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance** Forest Lawn will consider for employment all qualified Applicants, including those with Criminal Histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. Forest Lawn has always attracted unique and exceptional individuals; those who aren’t satisfied with simply building a career, but want to go home at the end of the day knowing they’ve made a profound and positive difference in people’s lives.

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description: **Job: Commissioning Engineer** **Location: Remote/Field** **Build Your Future with GBA** ------------------------------ At GBA, we bring vision to life through collaboration, craftsmanship, and commitment. Our teams are driven by a shared passion for delivering high\-quality, safe, and efficient projects that make an impact in the communities we serve. We’re looking for a highly motivated, detail\-oriented Commissioning Engineer to lead and support commissioning activities across mission\-critical facilities, including data centers, central plants, and complex MEP systems. You’ll help ensure systems are designed, installed, tested, and operated in accordance with project requirements and owner expectations. This role combines strong mechanical and/or electrical expertise with hands\-on field experience to manage commissioning from design review through final turnover. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Review design documents, specifications, and submittals for commissionability and compliance, and provide constructability and operability feedback to design teams. * Develop commissioning plans, procedures, and schedules, and define scope aligned with the Owner’s Project Requirements (OPR) and Basis of Design (BOD). * Participate in design meetings, risk reviews, and constructability assessments. * Conduct site inspections to verify installations against design documents and specifications. * Develop and manage pre\-functional checklists (PFCs), and coordinate readiness with contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders. * Track commissioning issues in logs and ensure resolution. * Witness factory acceptance tests (FATs) and site acceptance tests (SATs). * Develop and execute functional performance test (FPT) scripts and lead integrated systems testing (IST) for mission\-critical systems. * Validate sequences of operation for HVAC systems, including CRAHs, AHUs, chillers, and cooling towers; electrical systems, including UPS, generators, ATS, and switchgear; and building automation and supervisory control systems (BAS/SCADA). * Troubleshoot system deficiencies, coordinate corrective actions, and verify system redundancy, failover, and alarm responses. * Compile commissioning documentation and turnover packages and verify completion of all commissioning activities. * Support operations staff training and deliver final commissioning reports and system manuals. **What You Bring** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 3–10\+ years of commissioning, construction, or MEP engineering experience. * Strong understanding of HVAC systems and controls, electrical distribution systems, and BAS/SCADA systems. * Experience reading and interpreting engineering drawings and specifications, developing and executing test scripts, and preparing commissioning documentation. * Strong troubleshooting, problem\-solving, communication, and coordination skills. * Technical leadership in field environments, attention to detail, and accurate documentation. * Ability to manage multiple projects, coordinate effectively with teams, and adapt to fast\-paced construction environments. * Experience in data centers or other mission\-critical facilities, including integrated systems testing (IST). * Familiarity with ASHRAE commissioning guidelines, NFPA standards, and Uptime Institute Tier requirements. * OSHA 10\- or 30\-hour training. * Certifications such as Certified Commissioning Professional (CCP) or LEED Commissioning (CxA), preferred but not required. * Knowledge of control systems such as Siemens, Schneider Electric, or Johnson Controls. **Work Environment** -------------------- * This position combines office and field\-based work, with frequent site visits to construction and operational facilities. **Travel** ---------- * This position may require travel up to 90%. **Why You’ll Love Working Here** -------------------------------- At GBA, you’ll work on cutting\-edge mission\-critical infrastructure in a collaborative, growth\-focused environment, with opportunities to lead complex, high\-impact projects. We offer: * Competitive salary based on experience and performance bonuses * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and holidays * Professional development and certification support **Join Our Team** ----------------- If you’re a motivated commissioning professional who takes pride in delivering reliable, high\-quality systems, we’d love to hear from you. **Apply today and build your future with GBA.** *At GBA, we are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer promoting diversity in our workforce by including all individuals regardless of age, race, religion, color, sex, national origin, marital status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, pregnancy status, or any other status protected by law.*

jobs.description: **Job Description** The Senior Robotics Software Engineer – AI\-Enabled Manipulation \& Industrial Automation designs, develops, integrates, validates, and deploys AI\-enabled robotic applications for industrial and factory automation. The role spans robotic manipulation, perception, motion planning, computer vision, simulation, controls, and AI—including vision\-language\-action (VLA) models and learned manipulation policies. The engineer develops end\-to\-end, closed\-loop solutions that combine classical robotics and modern AI for tasks such as perception\-guided manipulation, multimodal task understanding, sensor\-driven feedback, and autonomous execution. This role bridges robotics software, artificial intelligence, and manufacturing automation, with a focus on turning advanced prototypes into robust, scalable, production\-relevant systems. **Key responsibilities** * Design and deploy robotic applications for industrial automation, including pick\-and\-place, material handling, part transfer, machine tending, inspection support, and vision\-guided manipulation. * Build collision\-aware, dynamically feasible manipulation pipelines integrating object detection and pose estimation, grasp generation, inverse kinematics, motion and trajectory planning, collision avoidance, reliable execution, and gripper control using frameworks such as MoveIt, Lula, RMPflow, OMPL, or related technologies. * Develop computer\-vision and AI perception systems for detection, semantic and instance segmentation, 6D pose estimation, RGB\-D and point\-cloud processing, scene understanding, and grasp\-point generation. * Integrate AI/ML models into real\-time or near\-real\-time robotic workflows to improve perception, generalization, manipulation, task\-level decision\-making, and runtime reliability. * Develop closed\-loop robotic systems that use sensor feedback to monitor task execution, detect failures, update robot actions, and improve runtime reliability. * Develop and evaluate VLA models and learned policies for multimodal task understanding, natural\-language instruction following, action generation, imitation learning, and autonomous manipulation. * Use NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Omniverse, Replicator, and related tools to build digital environments, generate synthetic data, validate behavior, and develop simulation\-to\-real workflows before physical deployment. * Own robotic software architecture across perception, planning, control, simulation, AI inference, data flow, system interfaces, hardware integration, and deployment; develop modular, maintainable software using Python, C\+\+, ROS 2, Linux, Git, Docker, and reproducible development environments. * Integrate and calibrate manipulators, grippers, RGB/RGB\-D and depth cameras, force/torque sensors, and other automation hardware, including camera intrinsics/extrinsics, hand\-eye calibration, and robot\-to\-cell registration; make calibration robust and repeatable in the field. * Implement force and compliant control—such as impedance, admittance, and guarded moves—for contact\-rich tasks including insertion and assembly. * Build data\-collection workflows for learned policies, including teleoperation, demonstration capture, dataset curation, and experiment tracking. * Debug and validate systems across software, AI models, perception, simulation, motion planning, controls, networking, and hardware. Define measures such as task success, perception accuracy, cycle time, trajectory quality, repeatability, and reliability. * Collaborate with robotics, perception, ML, controls, manufacturing, and plant\-facing teams to troubleshoot issues, document solutions, and transition prototypes from simulation through hardware integration, validation, and deployment. * Provide technical ownership of robotic applications from early prototyping and simulation through hardware integration, validation, and deployment. * **Optional:** Integrate robotic cells with industrial systems and safety infrastructure, including PLCs (OPC UA, Ethernet/IP, Modbus), safety I/O, and robot safety configurations in accordance with ISO 10218 and ISO/TS 15066\. **Required qualifications** * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field. * 2\+ years of experience developing robotic software or applications involving manipulation, perception, motion planning, simulation, industrial automation, or related systems. * Strong Python, C\+\+, and ROS 2 development skills, with experience building modular robotics software. * Familiarity with AI/ML workflows for robotic perception, learned manipulation, multimodal robotics, and autonomous systems. * Strong understanding of robotic manipulation, perception, motion planning, controls, coordinate frames and transformations, simulation, and automation software. * Experience with inverse kinematics, trajectory generation and execution, collision louds, 6D pose estimation, registration, and geometric computer vision. * Experience deploying AI models with PyTorch, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, or comparable GPU\-accelerated inference frameworks. * Experience optimizing control\-loop timing, perception and inference latency, trajectory execution, and end\-to\-end task cycle time. jobs.title: Staff ML Engineer - Embodied AI Scaling Foundations
jobs.description: **Job Description** At General Motors, we're turning today's impossible into tomorrow's standard. Our vehicles already move millions of people every day, and we're building the autonomy that will drive them \- L2 through L4, on real roads, at real scale. Making self\-driving safe at that scale is one of the hardest AI problems there is. The Data Scaling team owns the data flywheel for AV foundation model pre\-training and SFT. We determine what data the AV needs in order to learn driving behaviors at scale, and we define what data quality means across the loop. The team delivers ML models that move the product up the data scaling curves, turning better data composition into measurably better driving behavior. We work with the very large datasets GM already has and we define the next generation of highest\-value datasets GM collects. With each major release we aim to 10x the *effective* data behind our models: more scale, more diversity, and more value extracted from every example. **Why Join Us?** * Train on driving data almost nobody else has \- real\-world miles from GM's fleets, plus synthetic sim data \- scaling into billions of examples. Then decide which ones are worth it: ten thousand near\-identical highway miles teach the model less than one unprotected left turn in the rain. Mixture design, curation, mining, and evaluation are how you find out which is which, working alongside other MLEs and research scientists. * Work on questions with no textbook answers yet. Scaling laws for language are well mapped by now; for embodied driving data \- heavy\-tailed, safety\-constrained, closed\-loop \- they aren't. You'd be helping write them, and we support publishing what you find. See your results in the world rather than on a leaderboard. The models this team ships change how the vehicle behaves on real roads, and that behavior comes back as the evidence for your next iteration. * As a Staff AI/ML Engineer in the Embodied AI Data Foundations organization, you will be an individual contributor developing data\-centric AI solutions that directly improve autonomous driving performance. You will design and run the data curation and model training recipes that produce models capable of safe, reliable behavior across diverse real\-world scenarios, drawing on both real and synthetic data. **What You'll Do** * Design and run experiments that connect data composition to model behavior: dataset mixtures, sampling strategies, curricula, and scaling\-law studies that tell us where to invest next. * Apply methods such as self\-supervised pre\-training, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and foundation\-model fine\-tuning to driving behavior, trajectory generation, and perception tasks. * Develop data curation and mining methods \- auto\-labeling, deduplication, difficulty and uncertainty estimation, long\-tail and out\-of\-distribution scenario discovery \- to raise the value of every training example. * Define offline metrics and evaluations that actually predict on\-road behavior, and use them to make model and data decisions from evidence rather than intuition. * Trace model failures back to their root cause in the data, then close the loop by specifying the data needed to fix them. * Train models at scale across large multi\-GPU/multi\-node datasets, partnering with platform teams on the pipelines and tooling this requires. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to bring models into onboard driving systems, and document learnings and best practices along the way. Follow relevant literature and bring promising advances into our recipes and evaluations. * **Your Skills \& Abilities** Required: * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning. * Strong ML fundamentals: you can design a clean experiment, pick the right baseline, read an ablation, and tell signal from noise. * Proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with experience training models on large datasets. * Hands\-on experience with data\-centric ML: curation, sampling, labeling, or evaluation of large training sets. * Working knowledge of large\-scale foundation models and how they are pre\-trained, fine\-tuned, and aligned. * Solid data analysis skills (NumPy, Pandas; SQL or Spark for large datasets). * Demonstrated ability to deliver applied ML results under real\-world constraints and timelines. * Clear communication: you can explain a result and its limits to both engineers and non\-experts. Preferred: * PhD, publications, or open\-source contributions in representation learning, multimodal or vision\-language models, generative models, RL, or data\-centric ML. * Experience with robotics, autonomous driving, or other embodied AI systems. * Experience with synthetic and simulation data, including sim\-to\-real transfer. * Familiarity with production ML deployment workflows. \&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **About GM** Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all. **Why Join Us** We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture.
