jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: GiveCampus is the world's leading fundraising platform for non\-profit educational institutions. Trusted by millions of donors and 1,300\+ colleges, universities, and K\-12 schools, our mission is to help advance the quality, the affordability, and the accessibility of education. At our current pace, we will facilitate $100 billion in charitable giving over the next decade–enough money to send more than 1 million students to college, tuition\-free. GiveCampus is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, but we're also practitioners of Sustainable Growth: we've made the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest\-growing private companies each of the last five years and we've been profitable nine of the last 10\. In 2025, we celebrated a $140 million growth investment that included a major liquidity event for GiveCampus employees–the second in less than three years. Our purpose\-driven team of 130\+ is located in 30\+ states across the US: team members work from anywhere they choose. We have a beautiful 12,000sf office in Washington, DC that is available for people to use whenever they want, and we regularly organize team meet\-ups, visit partner institutions, and host retreats in various locations. While we operate at meaningful scale, we're still small relative to the commercial and social good opportunities in front of us. Every GiveCampus employee plays a meaningful role in shaping what comes next, and we're growing the team in support of our ambitious plans–including a $100 million investment in AI product development. If you believe in the transformative power of education and want to join a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company, you'll fit right in. **Location:** This is a remote\-first role based in the U.S. While we embrace flexible, distributed work, we also value in\-person connection. Team members are expected to attend multiple company\-wide and team\-specific onsites throughout the year. **The role** ------------ GiveCampus has spent the last 18 months getting good at using AI. People use it every day, and we've shipped agents and apps that changed how work gets done: a codebase agent that answers questions no doc can, an RFP agent, a support knowledge bot, a feature request agent, and a data integrations assistant for our Partners. Now, we are ready to take it to the next level. You'll design, build, and operate the next generation of AI Infrastructure at GiveCampus, including sources of company and Partner context, a clear model for who and what can access which data, a registry of what's already been built, memory that carries across agents, and the guardrails that let us move fast without losing track of what our agents are doing. This is a platform role. You'll work alongside a product partner and co\-builder (the AI Transformation Lead) who owns prioritization, stakeholder management, and adoption, so you can spend your time on architecture and engineering. **What we're driving** ---------------------- The AI Transformation team exists to change how GiveCampus operates, so that every team runs on connected workflows and agents by default, and output grows without headcount growing alongside it. Over the next year, that means: * Field teams spend most of their time with customers instead of on meeting prep, research, CRM updates, and follow ups * Every customer interaction is backed by context (school data, usage, relationship history, and peer benchmarks) delivered before the conversation starts * Managers act on AI generated briefings and alerts instead of assembling reports by hand * Finance, People, and Ops teams manage agents that run their recurring processes, stepping in only on exceptions and approvals * The enablement infrastructure and operating model that make the change last: standard toolkits, a governed agent lifecycle, and measurement of impact by department You'll contribute directly to every one of these outcomes by owning the platform that makes them possible. The agents doing this work are only as good as the context, access, and controls underneath them, and that's what you'll build. **What you'll own** ------------------- You'll start by building the foundation that makes the outcomes above possible. After that, the role grows with the company and with AI itself, so treat the later stages as direction, not a fixed scope. ### **First 6 months: build the foundation** * **Shared context and memory**: one source of company and Partner knowledge that every agent reads from, so a change is made once and reaches every tool * **Identity and access**: auditable permissions for agents, one view of credentials and MCP connections, and a registry of what's already built * **Governance**: an evaluation gate before production, an audit trail, monitoring, and protection against prompt injection and data leaks, with build versus buy calls made alongside Infrastructure * **A paved road for builders**: templates and guardrails for Taskforce builders, plus measurement of impact by de ring** ------------------ ### **Must have** * Six or more years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time owning platform, infrastructure, or backend systems in production * Hands on experience shipping LLM systems with real users: retrieval, tool use, evaluations, and MCP or similar integration patterns * Strong Python, plus experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), authentication, and observability * A security mindset: you think about access, data boundaries, and failure modes before something ships * A record of building internal platforms or shared services that other people adopted * Experience growing a system from an early version into something a whole company depends on * Appetite to grow into the technical lead for AI across the company * Real excitement about AI and a drive to keep learning: you follow what's new, try things early, and stay current. You don't need to know everything yet, but AI moves fast enough that this role only works if you're engaged with it * You judge your work by business results (hours given back to teams, faster cycle times, tools people use every day), not by what shipped * Comfort working from requirements set with a product partner, and the judgment to push back when the technical answer is different * Clear written communication with technical and non technical teammates ### **Nice to have** * Experience with agent orchestration, multi agent systems, or agent governance tooling * Familiarity with Snowflake, dbt, or a semantic layer * Experience with Salesforce data and APIs * Time at a startup or small team where you were the first person to own a system **How we work** --------------- You'll report to the AI Transformation Lead. Together you form a small pod: they act as product lead and build for adoption, and you own the platform. You'll partner closely with Engineering and Product through AI Plumbers, our cross team working group for AI architecture, agent orchestration, data access, and governance. You'll also work with our AI Taskforce, the builders in each department who will use what you build. GiveCampus has a strong written culture built on Notion, Slack, and async work. We move quickly, document what we do, and give people real autonomy and direct access to leadership. We're remote first, and this role can be based anywhere in the US. **Why this role** ----------------- * **The groundwork is done.** People already use AI every day and we have working agents in production. You're building the layer that makes them work together. * **Clear ownership.** You own the platform, with a product partner who owns prioritization and adoption. * **Room to grow.** You'll start with the foundation and grow into the technical lead for AI at GiveCampus as the work and the field change. * **Leadership investment.** AI is a company priority, with executive sponsorship behind this work. * **A mission that matters.** GiveCampus helps schools raise money to advance education. **Ready to apply?** ------------------- Be sure to keep an eye on your spam and promotions boxes in case our emails end up there! *At GiveCampus, we value diversity and we pledge to foster an environment of support, inclusivity, and learning, both on the job and throughout the application process. In this spirit, we encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.* *GiveCampus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants and employees are not discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.* *If you feel like you don't meet all of the requirements for this role, please apply anyways. We know confidence gaps and imposter syndrome often get in the way of connecting with incredible people, and we don't want them to prevent us from meeting you.*

jobs.description: **Who We Are** For over 70 years, Glatfelter Insurance Group has believed in doing the right thing for our clients, agents, communities and associates. This founding principle has enabled Glatfelter to grow from the kitchen\-table, one\-man\-operation as it began, to one of the largest managing general agencies in the U.S. with nearly 500 associates across the country, a distribution network of over 4,500 independent brokers and more than 30,000 clients. It is what drives us to innovate—the desire to deliver the best for our clients. Founded as The Glatfelter Agency, which is still in operation, the program basis of Glatfelter Insurance Group, Volunteer Firemen’s Insurance Services (VFIS), was founded in 1969\. Throughout the years, Glatfelter has expanded to include specialized program business inclusive of public entities, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and religious organizations. Glatfelter provides their insureds with comprehensive insurance solutions including property, casualty, life insurance, and more. In 2018, Glatfelter joined American International Group (AIG) and is now part of the AIG family. **About the Position** Glatfelter Insurance Group is seeking a **Sr. Programmer/Analyst** who will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high\-performance applications utilizing web development frameworks and best practices. In addition, the role involves mentoring team members, leading code reviews and technical sessions, and collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure quality and timely delivery of software solutions. This position is required to be onsite in our York, PA office. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, and implement software components and enhancements in accordance with approved project plans and ensuring high\-quality, reliable code. * Collaborate with back\-end developers to transform wireframes into polished, responsive interfaces * Participate in the full software development lifecycle for new features and system enhancements. * Ensure cross browser and device compatibility, optimizing for speed and scalability * Integrate with internal and external systems, APIs, or web services. * Maintain confidentiality and professionalism * Pursue professional growth and continued education **What We’re Looking For** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience * Industry Experience: A minimum of 6 years in software development * Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC). * Proficiency in core Java development – specifically Spring * Hands\-on experience developing Java\-based web applications. * Experience with developing REST API * Experience and knowledge working with various data formats such as XML, JSON * Advanced experience in writing SQL queries on MS SQL Server * Deep knowledge of software architecture principles, microservices, and design principles for building large\-scale, robust platforms * Ability to share technical knowledge through formal mentoring, code reviews, design document reviews, and technical presentations * Excellent communication, problem\-solving, ownership, and leadership skills * Experience with Angular development is preferred but not required * Experience in cloud integrations is a plus * Experience in containerization and distributed development a plus **Why Choose Glatfelter?** Glatfelter is honored to have been named a Best Place to Work in PA since 2005\. We provide equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories. jobs.title: Security Platform Engineer – AWS/Kubernetes
jobs.description: The Security Platform Engineer supports the sustainment, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting of AWS cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes environments hosting enterprise Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) capabilities supporting Department of Defense Defensive Cyber Operations. The engineer focuses primarily on the application\-specific infrastructure supporting SIEM/SOAR platforms, ensuring availability, reliability, performance, security, and operational continuity. The position requires strong hands\-on AWS and Kubernetes experience, along with a working understanding of SIEM/SOAR applications, their architecture, and supporting infrastructure dependencies. Required Qualifications * Hands\-on experience administering and troubleshooting AWS cloud infrastructure and services. * Hands\-on experience supporting Kubernetes environments, including workloads, deployments, pods, services, and application connectivity. * Working knowledge of Linux operating systems and system administration. * Understanding of SIEM/SOAR platforms, their operational functions, and supporting infrastructure dependencies. * Experience troubleshooting distributed applications, network connectivity, system performance, and resource utilization. * Understanding of cloud networking, IAM permissions, storage, and infrastructure security concepts. * Experience supporting production enterprise applications and coordinating with infrastructure and application support teams. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting Elastic SIEM, Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, or comparable security platforms. * Experience with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS). * Experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls. * Familiarity with AWS SQS, SNS, Lambda, and Python scripting. * Experience with Docker, Helm, Kubernetes troubleshooting, and containerized application deployments. * Familiarity with AWS CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and other infrastructure monitoring services. * Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, or infrastructure as code. * Experience supporting DoD cybersecurity environments, DISA STIG requirements, and RMF processes. Specialized Integration Engineering Capability At least one engineer may require additional proficiency with AWS SQS, SNS, Lambda, and Python to support application\-specific integrations, message processing, and automation. This specialization supplements the core AWS/Kubernetes platform engineering responsibilities and is not necessarily required for every position. Team Integration The Platform Engineer works closely with the Cloud Engineering team responsible for deploying and maintaining general AWS/Kubernetes infrastructure. Platform Engineering focuses on sustaining the application\-specific infrastructure and workloads supporting SIEM/SOAR capabilities, coordinating with Cloud Engineering and vendor support personnel on shared infrastructure dependencies and application\-related issues.

jobs.title: Data Warehouse Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview: Hamilton Company is a worldwide leader in the design and manufacture of manual, semi\-automated and robotic products for precision fluid measuring. We specialize in the development, manufacturing and customization of precision measurement devices, automated liquid handling stations, and sample management systems. For more than 60 years, Hamilton has been satisfying customer needs by combining quality materials with skilled workmanship, ensuring the highest level of performance of every precision fluid measuring device we manufacture. Responsibilities: Hamilton Company is seeking a motivated, hands\-on builder to help develop the data pipelines, integrations, and business systems that connect information and support better business decisions. This role combines data engineering, analytics, and technical business analysis, with opportunities to turn business requirements into working solutions. Using a variety of skills and methods including SQL, Python, and Machine Learning you will build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines, connect existing databases and applications, and contribute to new systems that capture, organize, and analyze business information. This position is suited to someone with strong SQL and Python skills who enjoys solving practical problems, learning new techniques, and building tools that people use. Responsibilities: * Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that extract, transform, and integrate data from existing databases, business applications, and newly developed systems. * Contribute to data warehouse development by implementing and maintaining tables, data models, and analytical datasets with architectural guidance. * Work with business stakeholders and the technical manager to understand workflows, clarify requirements, and translate needs into defined technical tasks. * Develop integrations, automation, and business system components that improve how information is captured, connected, and used. * Help implement record\-linkage and entity\-resolution solutions using rules\-based, probabilistic, and machine learning approaches; investigate uncertain matches and validate results. * Prepare datasets and help develop, test, and evaluate forecasting and classification models. * Integrate approved model outputs into data pipelines, business systems, dashboards, and reporting workflows. * Implement data validation and reconciliation checks; investigate discrepancies and troubleshoot pipeline and integration issues. * Collaborate with the technical manager and DevOps engineer to test, deploy, and monitor solutions using established engineering practices. * Document data flows, business rules, integration logic, and changes so solutions are understandable and maintainable. * Take ownership of assigned deliverables, communicate progress and blockers, and incorporate feedback from technical reviews. This position is located onsite in Reno, Nevada. Qualifications: * Strong SQL skills for querying, transforming, validating, and troubleshooting relational data. * Strong Python skills for data processing, analysis, and automation. * Foundational understanding of data warehousing, relational data modeling, and ETL/ELT concepts. * Foundational understanding of machine learning concepts and an interest in applying them to record linkage, forecasting, and classification. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance when needed. * Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and business colleagues. Education/Experience: * Bachelor’s degree. * 2 \+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, data warehousing, business intelligence, analytics, or technical business analysis. **Preferred Skills** * Experience with Power BI, DAX. * Exposure to record matching, deduplication, forecasting, or classification through work, coursework, or personal projects. * Experience connecting applications or databases through APIs. * Familiarity with version control, automated testing, and deployment workflows. About Hamilton: * Diverse portfolio of exciting and innovative design projects. * Tremendous opportunities for professional growth. * Commitment to sustainable design. * Competitive compensation. * Excellent benefit package includes medical, dental, vision insurance, paid vacation time, paid sick time, disability insurance, 401k, tuition reimbursement and more. * Solid stable company. * Must pass drug and background screens. * May be required to wear Personal Protective Equipment (provided by employer). EEO \- It is the policy of this organization to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age 40 and over, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, citizenship status, religious preference, or veteran status in all phases of the employment process and in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space \- ready to join us? **What’s the position?** We’re looking for a Staff Mobile Engineer to own technical direction for mobile experiences within the Promos domain, working within our shared React Native platform and contributing to related web and back office experiences where needed. You will solve complex client engineering problems and raise the engineering bar across teams while remaining close to the code. Working across Product, Design, QA, Backend, Platform, Security, Compliance, and Operations, you will turn ambiguous needs into durable strategies and guide critical initiatives from discovery through production. Staff level impact means creating clarity beyond one team, developing other engineers, and being accountable for organizational outcomes, not only implementation. **Your responsibilities will include:** **Technical strategy and architecture** * Own the mobile technical direction for the assigned product domain, such as Promos, while aligning with the shared React Native platform and supporting related web and back office experiences where needed. * Partner with Principal and Staff Engineers and the teams that own shared capabilities such as geolocation, identity, security, compliance, and platform services, integrating those capabilities into Promos while maintaining clear ownership boundaries. * Guide architecture evolution and modernization, balancing product delivery, technical debt, and platform investment through pragmatic decisions, clear tradeoffs, and measurable outcomes. * Lead major restructuring work through planned iterative delivery: establish the target end state before execution, decompose the initiative into sequenced tickets, surface dependencies and risks, and provide credible delivery dates that are updated as evidence changes. **Promotional and client capabilities** * Build responsive and reliable promotional experiences across mobile and web, including offer discovery, eligibility, activation, state changes, and rewards, with clear recovery and correctness. * Partner with Product, Data, Backend, and Operations to define promotion lifecycle, client contracts, experimentation, success measures, and operational controls across mobile, web, and back office experiences. * Set standards for deeplinks, attribution, analytics, CRM, and push across platforms such as AppsFlyer, Segment, Amplitude, Braze, and Firebase, with reliable identity and consent handling. **Execution, quality, and operations** * Remain hands on with the hardest problems, turning ambiguity into iterative delivery while delegating effectively and correcting work that is off course or not producing value. * Model and raise a high bar for code review, using reviews to improve correctness, maintainability, shared understanding, and engineer growth; advance standards for testing, CI/CD, accessibility, security, observability, App Store and Google Play delivery, controlled rollout, privacy, and incident readiness, and treat performance as a measurable product requirement. * Lead diagnosis across client, API, and platform boundaries using Sentry and correlated logs, traces, and metrics, turning incidents into systemic improvements. **AI enabled engineering** * Drive responsible adoption of AI assisted development across discovery, implementation, testing, documentation, debugging, and review, measuring improvements to quality, speed, learning, and developer experience. * Identify valuable product and operational uses for AI, assess feasibility and model risk, and establish guardrails for evaluation, confidential data, human accountability, and production safety. **Organizational impact and culture** * Act proactively as a trusted technical advisor to Product and Engineering teams, identifying risks and opportunities early and using customer, operational, and market insight to make clear recommendations and drive decisions to closure. * Mentor Senior and Staff Engineers through architectural guidance, reviews, pairing, and reusable knowledge; contribute technical perspective to senior hiring, capability planning, and career development. * Resolve systemic risks, ownership gaps, and missing capabilities by bringing the right people together; lead change with calm ownership, constructive conflict, clear commitments, and learning without blame. **What are we looking for?** * Typically 7\+ years of software engineering experience, including 5\+ years building production React Native applications, plus a degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent demonstrated experience. * Deep expertise in React Native architecture, React, and TypeScript, including strict type safety practices, with a record of evolving frontend platforms, shared libraries, or design systems and establishing patterns adopted by multiple teams. * Strong iOS and Android knowledge across native APIs, debugging, performance, security, deployment, and store delivery, including the ability to design or guide native module bridges and safe JavaScript/native data flow. * Expertise in real time client systems and modern state management, including REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, resilience, caching, offline behavior, graceful degradation, and clear client/server state boundaries; MobX and TanStack React Query, or comparable technologies, are strongly valued. * Experience architecting a shared mobile platform across multiple applications, brands, regions, environments, and delivery teams, with product configuration, jurisdiction specific behavior, and feature flag driven rollout using LaunchDarkly or a comparable platform. * Experience with relevant client integrations such as authentication, deeplinks, attribution, analytics, CRM, push notifications, privacy, or consent. * Strong engineering judgment across testing, observability, CI/CD, feature management, performance, accessibility, privacy, and secure development for systems where reliability, compliance, security, or financial correctness are business critical. * Hands on fluency with AI assisted software development and a practical understanding of prompt/context design, evaluation, hallucination risk, privacy, security, and responsible human review. * A record of shaping technical and product strategy, delivering ambiguous multi team initiatives, and connecting investments to measurable customer and business outcomes without relying on formal authority. * Excellent communication and proactive, low ego leadership, including clear proposals, executive communication, productive conflict, sound decisions amid uncertainty, and effective mentoring. **Preferred experience:** * Client experience in sportsbook, casino, online gaming, fintech, or another regulated digital industry. * Experience with internal operational or back office applications, including GraphQL, MSAL or comparable SSO, role based access, audit trails, and workflow heavy interfaces. * Experience scaling client engineering through monorepos, shared tooling, design systems, developer platforms, or production AI practices. **What’s in it for you?** We offer our employees more than competitive compensation. Our team benefits include: * Competitive pay and benefits * Flexible vacation allowance * Flexible work from home or office hours * Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand * Opportunity to build products enjoyed by millions as part of a passionate team * A roster of uniques **Roster of Uniques** We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and we trust and empower our team to own and improve that experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where, regardless of background or beliefs, you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you. Hard Rock Digital is an equal opportunity employer.

maintain scalable data pipelines integrating CRM, billing, product analytics, and other business\-critical systems. * Connect product usage, account activity, sales pipeline, contracts, and revenue data to create a consistent view of B2B customers. * Build reliable, well\-documented data models supporting pipeline analytics, revenue reporting, customer segmentation, retention, and expansion. * Partner with Sales, RevOps, and Finance to support forecasting, territory planning, account prioritization, sales performance, and revenue attribution. * Establish visibility into how enterprise customers adopt and use Higgsfield's products, enabling insights into conversion, engagement, and expansion opportunities. * Implement automated validation, monitoring, documentation, and governance to ensure data accuracy and consistency across systems. * Identify opportunities to improve pipeline performance, automation, and infrastructure as the business grows. **Requirements:** * 6\-8\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or a closely related technical role. * Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience building production\-grade ETL/ELT pipelines. * Experience working with modern data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift. * Hands\-on experience with data transformation and orchestration tools such as dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or similar technologies. * Experience integrating data from business systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe, or other CRM and billing platforms. * Strong understanding of data modeling, data architecture, and data quality best practices. * Familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics, including ARR, pipeline, conversion, retention, churn, and expansion. * Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Strong communication skills and experience partnering directly with nontechnical stakeholders. **Compensation \& Benefits** * We offer a competitive and thoughtfully structured compensation package designed to align with impact, experience, and long\-term growth. * **Base Salary:** The anticipated salary range for this role is **$200,000 \- $260,000**, depending on experience, skills, scope, and location. * **Bonus:** This role is Bonus eligible and may participate in the Company's discretionary annual bonus program. * **Equity:** In addition to cash compensation, employees are eligible to participate in the company’s stock option program and share in Higgsfield’s long\-term growth. * **Benefits:** We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and additional benefits and perks. * The opportunity to work on ambitious AI products alongside a highly experienced, fast\-moving, and international team. * Significant ownership, direct impact, and opportunities for professional growth as the company scales. This is a **hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area**. Team members are expected to work from our San Francisco office **three full days per week**, with the remaining days worked remotely and are expected to be available during agreed working hours and to maintain sufficient overlap with the relevant team’s time zone. We value in\-person collaboration, active communication, responsiveness, and close partnership across teams. *Higgsfield AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $260K

jobs.title: Advanced Systems Engineer - Aircraft Data Networks
jobs.description: **Advanced Systems Engineer – Aircraft Data Networks** **Join the Team Behind Honeywell Aerospace Anthem** Honeywell Aerospace Anthem is an industry\-leading, cloud\-connected Integrated Flight Deck designed to bring greater connectivity, flexibility, and simplicity to modern aviation. Built on a scalable software platform with cloud\-native communications, navigation, and surveillance capabilities, Anthem supports a wide range of aircraft, from business aviation and commercial transport to defense platforms, general aviation, and emerging Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) vehicles. Anthem is introducing a new level of cockpit personalization, allowing pilots to configure their flight deck based on mission needs and phase of flight while maintaining the reliability and precision the aerospace industry demands. By combining advanced connectivity, intuitive user experiences, and highly integrated avionics systems, Anthem is helping redefine how pilots interact with aircraft. As an Advanced Systems Engineer \- Next\-Generation Aircraft Data Network, you'll play a key role in developing the network architecture that enables communication across the Anthem ecosystem. You'll work alongside a multidisciplinary team of systems, software, and avionics engineers to deliver resilient, high\-performance solutions for one of the industry's most advanced flight deck platforms. You will report to the Senior Software Engineering Manager and is based at our Deer Valley facility in Phoenix, Arizona. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Drive the design, development, systems integration and verification of the Aircraft Data Network. * Perform systems engineering activities including requirements analysis, system architecture development, integration testing, and validation of avionics systems operating within the Data Network * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define, develop, and ensure seamless integration of Avionics software solutions that meet system requirements and performance specifications. * Stay current with industry trends and technological advancements in the Avionics space

jobs.title: Principal Artificial Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description: The **Principal Artificial Intelligence Engineer** will provide expert\-level technical leadership in the design, development, and application of AI technologies, algorithms, and intelligent systems to solve complex engineering and product challenges. You will be responsible for acting as the subject matter expert for technical AI projects and provide direction on exploring and implementing methodologies and best practices. You will report directly to our Director of Advanced Projects and you’ll work out of our Plymouth, MN location on a Hybrid work schedule. As a Principal Artificial Intelligence Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader within Honeywell's Advanced Projects organization, applying cutting\-edge AI technologies to create innovative product capabilities and solve complex engineering challenges. You will help establish the tools, frameworks, and best practices that enable rapid experimentation and agentic AI development while partnering with cross\-functional teams to mature concepts from research and prototype through product deployment. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of intelligent aerospace systems by translating emerging AI technologies into differentiated products, capabilities, and business value.

SQL * 3\+ years of experience in deploying data \& feature pipelines, model training, and inferencing within the Databricks stack * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with: + Databricks + PostgreSQL + tight timelines * Experience with: * Delta Lake / Lakehouse architecture * Orchestration tools (Airflow, Azure Data Factory) * Streaming (Kafka, Event Hubs) * Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD pipelines The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $117,600 \- $161,700 per year This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. jobs.title: Director, Applied AI Engineering
jobs.description: Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible. Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P\&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here! **PURPOSE OF THE JOB** The Director of Applied AI Engineering is a senior leader responsible for the delivery and operation of generative and agentic AI solutions across the enterprise. This role leads a team of engineers who design, build, deploy, and support generative and agentic AI capabilities that address business needs in underwriting, claims, distribution, finance, and corporate operations. The Director owns AI Platforms, the shared enterprise capability through which these solutions reach and remain in production, comprising managed foundation model services, agent runtime and orchestration, and machine learning operations. The Director sets engineering standards for generative and agentic AI development and establishes the operating model by which this work is delivered and supported. The Director collaborates closely with data services, cloud and infrastructure engineering, product management, and enterprise risk and governance functions to ensure solutions are well\-founded, responsibly deployed, and sustainable in production. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Leads the design, development, and production delivery of generative and agentic AI solutions across the enterprise, including generative AI applications, intelligent document processing, conversational interfaces, and agentic and multi\-agent workflows. * Owns AI Platforms, including managed foundation model services (Amazon Bedrock), agent runtime and orchestration (Bedrock AgentCore), and machine learning operations — model registry, feature engineering, deployment pipelines, model serving, versioning, evaluation, and production monitoring. * Operates AI Platforms as a shared enterprise capability, onboarding and supporting engineering, analytics, and data science teams as platform tenants and defining the standards and guardrails under which they build. * Establishes and maintains engineering standards for generative and agentic AI development, including prompt and context management, evaluation frameworks, testing practices, documentation, and release management. * Directs the delivery model for generative and agentic AI work, including team structure, capacity planning, and management of commitments to business stakeholders. * Partners with data and AI product management, who own intake and prioritization, to convert the prioritized portfolio into achievable delivery commitments. * Oversees production support for generative and agentic AI solutions, ensuring reliability, performance, and issue resolution within established service levels. * Maintains capacity for applied research and evaluation of emerging generative and agentic AI capabilities, balancing exploratory work against production delivery commitments. * Evaluates emerging generative and agentic AI technologies, foundation models, platforms, and vendors; makes build\-versus\-buy recommendations and recommends adoption when appropriate. * Partners with enterprise risk and governance functions to ensure generative, agentic, and machine learning solutions complete required review and approval prior to production deployment. * Collaborates with data services teams to define and secure the data products, semantic models, and pipelines required to support generative and agentic AI solutions. * Partners with cloud and infrastructure engineering teams, who own on\-premise and cloud hosting, to define the compute, hosting, security, and scaling requirements on which AI Platforms depends. * Partners with financial operations on cost transparency and unit economics for AI Platforms consumption, including token, inference, agent execution, and model cost management. * Translates complex, cross\-functional business and integration needs into actionable development requirements, designs, and plans for engineering teams. * Directs the team utilizing KPIs and data to inform decision making. * Monitors and evaluates the performance of generati services environment with model governance requirements preferred. * Master's degree in a technical or quantitative discipline preferred. **LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS** * Cloud and machine learning certifications including but not limited to AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified Azure AI Engineer, or other relevant certifications preferred. * Agile certifications including but not limited to Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Certified SAFe practitioner, PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI\-ACP), or other relevant certifications preferred. **KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS** * Strong working knowledge of generative and agentic AI architectures, foundation model selection, model lifecycle management, and evaluation methods. * Working knowledge of managed foundation model and agent runtime services, including Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore or comparable platforms, and of the data engineering practices that support retrieval and grounding. * Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage complex engineering initiatives with multiple teams, stakeholders, and dependencies. * Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop engineering team members, with a focus on improving team dynamics and performance. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present technical information to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to operate effectively where critical dependencies are owned by other teams, working through published commitments and shared prioritization. * Proven ability to manage cross\-functional teams and drive change in complex environments. * Strong analytical skills to assess business and technical requirements and develop effective solutions. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The employee may need to sit in front of a computer for a period of time. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally need to reach, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may need to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment. *This description is a general statement of essential job functions and responsibilities. It does not exclude other duties as assigned.* The current range for this position is $160,745\.90 \- $287,738\.43 This range is exclusive of fringe benefits and potential bonuses. It's our people who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. **Job Type:** Full time **Req ID:** JR101722

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling
jobs.description: Experienced Technology Chicago The Development Platform organization at IMC Trading is focused on accelerating tech team workflows by providing self\-service tools, services, documentation, and support. The Development Platform team operates the infrastructure that makes this possible: the environments where AI agents run, the integrations that connect them to our systems, and the safety and security controls that keep them reliable and auditable. Your work will span agent harnesses, developer workspaces, context delivery, and tooling that connects AI agents to internal services. This is a highly collaborative role with substantial ownership. You will engage directly with engineers to understand their needs, connect those needs to the team’s broader priorities, and turn open\-ended problems into practical solutions. You will help define what we build and carry it through design, implementation, delivery, and ongoing improvement. You will bring strong software engineering fundamentals and an eagerness to learn. jobs.description: **About IPS Group. Populus.ai and Elevate IPS** IPS Group, Inc. is a San Diego\-based parking technology company, Level 1 PCl DSS and SOC 2 Type II compliant, whose smart meters, software and mobile products serve cities across North America, the UK and Ireland. IPS Group offers one mobility data platform under two brands: Populus.ai, a stand\-alone product for the micromobility market, and Elevate, the same application branded for IPS Group customers. It gives cities one place to manage parking, the curb and shared mobility: parking revenue, occupancy, enforcement, parking sessions, pricing and geographies. The platform runs on Google Cloud and is built in Python on PostgreSQWPostGIS. **Job Description:** The Principal Engineer is the technical owner of the platform behind Populus.ai and Elevate, combining two roles in one: the platform's architect and its lead hands\-on developer. You will set the architecture, write production code every week, and lead a small distributed team of offshore engineers and external development partners. Expect roughly 60—70% hands\-on development and 30—400/0 architecture and technical leadership. This is a senior individual contributor role, not a people\-management role: you lead through design, code review and example. As the team grows, this role is expected to evolve into engineering leadership for the Populus.ai and Elevate platform. This is a "do it all" position. On any given day you might build a new ETL pipeline and the product around it, design an API for a data product, trace why a metric looks wrong, fix a broken integration, or update infrastructure as code as the GCP environment evolves. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** **Architecture** Own the end\-to\-end architecture of the platform, across both the Populus.ai and Elevate brands: FastAPl services, the PostgreSQL/PostGlS data model, Airflow data pipelines and GCP infrastructure. Make and document key technical decisions. Set engineering standards for code quality, code review, testing, security' and data quality. Own the design and enforcement of secure, region\-scoped data access so customers only ever see their own data. Review and approve work from external development partners at defined checkpoints, including AI and LLM features built into the platform. Partner with Product Management on feasibility, scoping, estimates and metric definitions for the roadmap. Own GCP reliability, security posture and cloud cost. Hands\-on development Build new data products end to end: ETL pipelines, backend APIs and supporting front\-end changes. Investigate and resolve data questions ("why does this number look like this?") by tracing metrics through SQL, pipelines and code. Build new third\-party data integrations and troubleshoot breakages in existing ones. Maintain infrastructure as code and keep Python dependencies and libraries current. Strong PostgreSQL and analytical SQL; working experience with PostGlS and geospatial data. Production front\-end experience with TypeScript and React, including map\-based interfaces (Mapbox GL JS or similar). Production experience on Google Cloud Platform: Cloud SQL, IAM and service accounts, Secret Manager, Cloud Storage, monitoring and logging. Infrastructure as code with Terraform. Building and operating ETL pipelines with Apache Airflow Or a similar orchestrator. Docker and CVCD with GitHub. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co\-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand\-first. We partner with companies like Crate \& Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com, H\-E\-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world\-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. In the U.S., co\-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades\-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world\-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you. **About the Role** ------------------ As Lead Product Manager for Agentic Commerce, you'll define what agentic payments and rewards look like at Imprint, then go build it. This is a zero\-to\-one role: you'll run a small skunkworks team that ships in tight increments, puts new products in front of real users fast, and lets the market tell us what works. We're looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply fluent in payments, and genuinely obsessed with AI agents. You don't just follow the space; you use agents every day and build with them yourself. Agentic Commerce is a small, high\-autonomy team inside Imprint's payments organization. It operates like a startup within the company: few dependencies, short cycles, and a bias toward shipping something real over polishing a plan. You'll report to the product leader for Payments, Risk and Customer Operations, and partner day to day with engineers on our payments and messaging platform. You'll also work closely with partnerships, risk, compliance and our brand partners to turn experiments into products that can run at scale. **The Opportunity** ------------------- * Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for agentic commerce at Imprint, from how agents initiate and authorize payments to how cardholders use agents to earn and redeem rewards. * Run a fast build\-measure\-learn loop: frame a bet, ship the smallest version that tests it, read the signal, and decide whether to scale, pivot or kill it. * Prototype hands\-on with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor and similar) to get from idea to something users can touch in days, not quarters. * Get close to the power users who already use agents to optimize their spending and rewards, and turn what you learn into products they'd pay attention to. * Track the agentic payments ecosystem (network and wallet agent programs, agent payment protocols, tokenization) and decide where Imprint should build, partner or wait. * Work with risk, compliance and our bank partners to design agent\-initiated payment flows that are safe and auditable from day one. * Make the case for what's working to leadership and brand partners, and help jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Mission** --------------- As the world’s number 1 job site\*, our mission is to help people get jobs. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and accessible workplace where all people feel comfortable being themselves. We're looking to grow our teams with more people who share our enthusiasm for innovation and creating the best experience for job seekers. (\*Comscore, Total Visits, March 2026\)**Day to Day** -------------- As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer in our Staffing Technology Marketplace group, you'll own the source data, the models and the business impact behind Indeed's AI\-first staffing platform, which agencies, employers and the MSPs that coordinate them use every day to take orders, book workers and manage shifts. Through Indeed and our own Indeed Flex agency, we see labor\-market activity at a scale no single agency can: workers looking for work, employers creating demand, shifts being worked. You'll set the technical direction for turning that into models that predict whether a booked worker will turn up, whether and how fully an order will fill, and which orders are at risk early enough for someone to act. You'll then turn those predictions into decisions customers act on and increasingly trust the platform to make for them: how many backups to book, which agencies an MSP should release an order to and in what sequence within contracted volume splits, and what pay rate will achieve the fill and quality a client asked for without overspending. On a typical day you'll work with customers and our business, product and engineering teams to define, build and evaluate production models per market in the US and UK. You'll keep them healthy and catch a model degrading for a single customer before they notice. You'll design ranking and reliability scoring that balances today's fill against the long\-term health of the worker pool, so the same few workers aren't overused while everyone else drifts away. You'll make models work from day one for a new agency with no history, and hold up on the thin data most agencies have. Every recommendation needs to be explainable to the person acting on it and configurable to each agency's risk appetite. You'll use what the models show to shape the roadmap with product, engineering and design, and work with legal and engineering partners on foundational questions, such as what can be learned across agencies and what must stay separate.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Partner with cross\-functional teams to enhance and optimize search algorithms for improved accuracy, relevance, and overall user experience. * Experiment with Proof of Concept Machine Learning model improvements, scale them to production, and run iterative A/B experiments to improve our matching technology while partnering with other teams * Define and clarify project priorities, deliverables, and success criteria in partnership with cross\-functional teams. * Act as a bridge between technical and non\-technical collaborators, facilitating effective communication and comprehension of project goals and outcomes. * Mentor and grow other software engineers and Machine Learning Engineers across teams * Break down larger Machine Learning initiatives into pieces that deliver incremental business value and guide the team through implementing them * Represent Indeed at major Machine Learning conferences, such as Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), and the International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR). **Skills/Competencies** ----------------------- * Requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field and a minimum of 8 years of related experience; or a Master’s degree with a minimum of 6 years of experience; or a PhD with 3 years experience * Proven experience building ML for two\-sided marketplaces, staffing, on\-demand labor or similar operational businesses, including experiment design where marketplace interference rules out clean A/B tests. * Proven experience solving cold\-start and sparse\-data problems in production, in multi\-tenant B2B settings where each customer's data and configuration differ: models that work from day one for a new customer with no history and hold up on thin data, built on well\-calibrated probabilistic predictions (classification, forecasting) under uncertainty. * Prior success in deploying impactful Machine Learning solutions to large\-scale production systems, while partnering across teams * Solid knowledge of data structures and algorithms * Sense of ownership and accountability as a key contributor in the technical and product domains * Knowledge and practical experience working on Deep Learning Libraries (like Torch, Tensorflow, etc.) * Excellent written and verbal communication in English, effective with technical and business audiences **Salary Range Transparency** ----------------------------- Tier 1 \- United States of America 163  at https://www.indeed.com/careers/benefits!**Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement** ---------------------------------------------------- Indeed is deeply committed to building a workplace and global community where inclusion is not only valued, but prioritized. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, family status, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, neuro\-diversity, disability, age, or veteran status, or any other non\-merit based or legally protected grounds. Indeed provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in the employment application process. To request an accommodation, please visit https://www.indeed.com/careers/accommodations. If you are requesting accommodation for an interview, please reach out at least one week in advance of your interview. For more information about our commitment to equal opportunity/affirmative action, please visit our Careers page (https://www.indeed.com/careers). **Inclusion \& Belonging** Inclusion and belonging are fundamental to our hiring practices and company culture, forming an integral part of our vision for a better world of work. At Indeed, we’re committed to the wellbeing of our employees and on a mission to make this the best place to work and thrive. We believe that fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where every employee feels respected and accepted benefits everyone, fueling innovation and creativity. We value diverse experiences, including those who have had prior contact with the criminal legal system. We are committed to providing individuals with criminal records, including formerly incarcerated individuals, a fair chance at employment. Those with military experience are encouraged to apply. Equivalent expertise demonstrated through a combination of work experience, training, military experience, or education is welcome.**Indeed’s Employee Recruiting Privacy Policy** ----------------------------------------------- Like other employers Indeed uses our own technologies to help us find and attract top talent from around the world. In addition to our site’s user and privacy policy found at https://www.indeed.com/legal, we also want to make you aware of our recruitment specific privacy policy found at https://www.indeed.com/legal/indeed\-jobs. **Agency Disclaimer** Indeed does not pay placement fees for unsolicited resumes or referrals from non\-candidates, including search firms, staffing agencies, professional recruiters, fee\-based referral services, and recruiting agencies (each individually, an "Agency"), subject to local laws. An Agency seeking a placement fee must obtain advance written approval from Indeed's internal Talent Acquisition team and execute a fee agreement with Indeed for each job opening before making a referral or submitting a resume for that opening. **AI Notice** Indeed is committed to ensuring fairness and transparency throughout our hiring process. jobs.description: Posted Date 7/19/2026 Description **We are:** Accenture’s Global Responsible AI team within the Global Data \& AI Practice. AI is becoming more pervasive, more powerful and more accessible. With these new opportunities come increased risks. We work with leading organizations to ensure AI is designed, built and deployed in a manner that engenders trust and adheres to laws, regulations and ethical norms. Our Responsible AI strategy will enable us to embed responsibility into all of Accenture’s data and AI activities. We’re developing and deploying differentiated IP and Responsible AI solutions with our ecosystem partners. We’ll be engaging regulators to help shape the policy agenda, conducting pioneering research with academia and offer training and resources to our clients through the Responsible AI Academy. The risks of AI are real and well\- known. Let’s help our clients turn those risks into opportunities. **You are:** We’re looking to grow our Responsible AI team and if you’re an experienced RAI Engineer with a Responsible AI background, we’d love to hear from you. As a Responsible AI Engineer, you’ll be experienced in building state of the art models to solve difficult business challenges. But you’ll also have at least a year’s experience looking at responsible aspects such as AI model Fairness, Transparency, Explainability, Robustness, Soundness and Privacy – preferably gained in a client\-facing environment. You’ll be a problem solver who is passionate about all things data. You’ll be excited by difficult modelling challenges, and you’ll enjoy working with like\-minded people who thrive on pushing the boundaries of the possible. Some of the areas you’ll be working in include: * Developing and implementing AI models and solutions, focusing on ethical and responsible practices. * Detecting, evaluating, and applying relevant RAI dimensions (bias, fairness, robustness explainability etc.) in AI systems; work on mitigating the identified risks. Supporting client sales conversations and proposal preparation * Optimizing and maintaining existing AI systems for enhanced performance and adherence to ethical standards. * Participating in the full AI development lifecycle, including data preparation, design, coding, testing, deployment, and support. * Contributing to the development of internal guidelines, best practices for responsible AI development and technical training. * Staying updated with current AI trends, ethical considerations, and technological advancements. * Assisting in the identification and correction of biases in datasets and AI models. * Documenting AI development processes and maintaining a transparent record of decisions and methodologies used. Travel may be required for this role. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience) * Minimum of 5 years of experience in developing and evaluating machine learning models and AI solutions. At least 2 from the following: + Statistics and Probability Theory, Regression Modelling, Clustering Methods, Time Series Forecasting, Tree Ensembles + Deep Learning, Neural Networks, Generative AI + Natural Language Processing, Text Mining, Computer Vision, Image Recognition + Machine Learning Visualization Tools * Minimum of 5 years of experience in the following: + Proficiency in programming languages like Python, R, or Java. + Familiarity with AI and machine learning frameworks (e.g., Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch). + Rapid API development with standard frameworks and tools (E.g. Django, Flask, or FastAPI) + Fundamental version control practices and proficiency in version control platforms (e.g. GitHub, Bitbucket, etc) + Experience with database management and data processing. + Understanding and working knowledge of cloud services and platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) related to AI. + Demonstrated ability to work with complex datasets and perform data preprocessing and analysis. **Professional Skills Requirement** * Strong problem\ tion process. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative, more competitive, and more creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities. For details, view a copy of the Accenture Equal Opportunity Statement Accenture is an EEO and Affirmative Action Employer of Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities. Accenture is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women. **Other Employment Statements** Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States. Candidates who are currently employed by a client of Accenture or an affiliated Accenture business may not be eligible for consideration. jobs.title: Senior Director, AI Engineering -Agentic AI Platform(Remote Eligible)
jobs.description: Posted Date 11/05/2026 Description Senior Director, AI Engineering \-Agentic AI Platform(Remote Eligible) At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Make high judgment build\-vs\-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state\-of\-the\-art in AI. * Define and drive enterprise\-wide AI strategy, aligning product, research, risk, and data organizations around shared technical and ethical principles * Establish a multi\-year roadmap for scalable, reliable, and compliant AI systems that serve as shared infrastructure across the enterprise * Champion Responsible\-AI, ensuring ethical, transparent and explainable model practices are embedded in all lines of business * Oversee the scaling of AI operations \- including model lifecycle management, observability, and cost efficiency \- across hundreds of production use cases **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good * Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands\-on when necessary and lead by example * You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven * You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss * You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown Capital One is open to hiring a Remote or Hybrid Employee for this opportunity. If the role is designated as Hybrid, you are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on\-site presence at your designated office location. If the role is designated as Remote, you are expected to adhere to Capital On e leadership on AI investment strategy, organizational design, and risk management priorities * Experience establishing external partnerships or thought leadership presence in AI industry, academia, or open\-source communities * Experience right\-sizing models, instance counts, and hardware types given requirements (e.g., context length, token inputs, token outputs) ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. Remote (Regardless of Location): $286,200 \- $326,700 for Sr. Director, AI Engineer Cambridge, MA: $314,800 \- $359,300 for Sr. Director, AI Engineer McLean, VA: $314,800 \- $359,300 for Sr. Director, AI Engineer New York, NY: $343,400 \- $392,000 for Sr. Director, AI Engineer San Francisco, CA: $343,400 \- $392,000 for Sr. Director, AI Engineer San Jose, CA: $343,400 \- $392,000 for Sr. Director, AI Engineer Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter. This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan. Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well\-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part\-time status, exempt or non\-exempt status, and management level. jobs.description: About Us: **Intermountain Electric (IME)** brings decades of experience as a trusted leader in electrical contracting. Founded in 1946, we began as a small company in Denver, CO, and have since grown to be part of the largest specialty contractor in North America. Today, we work with owners and contractors nationwide, delivering complex construction solutions across various industries, including aviation, mission critical, entertainment, and healthcare. At IME, our people are our most valuable asset. We are committed to fostering a culture that prioritizes safety, quality, and professional growth. Joining IME is more than just finding a job—it's about building a career with opportunities to advance and make an organizational impact. Power your future with IME and be a part of a team that drives success in every project. About this Role: Intermountain Electric, Inc. (IME) is celebrating 80 years of powering progress across Colorado. Our office teams help deliver safe, smart, and reliable electrical solutions through our people and partnerships, the IME Way. Through strategic planning, collaboration, and technical excellence, and guided by our values of Integrity, Safety, Ingenuity, Relationships, Craftsmanship, and Spark, we empower our professionals to innovate, support our field teams, and strengthen the partnerships that move our work forward. Join a team where your expertise fuels the systems that keep communities running! The Project Engineer provides technical and engineering support for electrical construction projects from project initiation through completion. This role is responsible for coordinating technical activities, supporting project planning and execution, maintaining quality standards, and promoting safe work practices to help ensure project accuracy, compliance, and successful outcomes. What You'll Do: **Project Planning \& Engineering Support** * Analyze and interpret construction drawings to ensure a thorough understanding of project requirements. * Assist with reviewing plans, specifications, and contract documents to identify key project requirements and areas requiring ongoing attention. * Support the preparation and maintenance of project checklists related to contractual obligations and deliverables. * Collaborate with project teams by providing input on cost estimates, project schedules, and overall planning activities. **Project Documentation \& Execution** * Prepare statements of work, submittals, and change management documentation to support project execution and communication. * Conduct inspections of equipment, materials, workmanship, and completed construction to verify compliance with project specifications and quality standards. * Maintain accurate project records to track progress, document changes, and support compliance requirements. * Assist in monitoring project activities to ensure alignment with approved plans and specifications. **Safety Management \& Compliance** * Promote a culture of safety by supporting compliance with applicable safety regulations, standards, and best practices. * Monitor ongoing construction activities to verify adherence to established safety procedures. * Ensure materials, equipment, and work methods comply with project and safety requirements. * Support continuous awareness and accountability regarding safety performance across project activities. **Industry Representation \& Relationship Building** * Serve as a company ambassador by representing organizational values and expertise within the electrical contracting industry. * Maintain professional, ethical, and respectful relationships with internal and external stakeholders. * Build and strengthen relationships with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and industry contacts. * Support the company’s reputation as a trusted and reliable partner in the electrical contracting sector. *Additional duties as assigned.* What You'll Bring: **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** * Strong ability to perform due diligence and conduct project risk assessments. * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills. * Effective interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across project teams and stakeholders. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical information to audiences with varying levels of expertise. * Demonstrated commitment to integrity, ethics, and professional conduct. * Ability and willingness to travel frequently to construction project sites. **Demonstrated Accomplishments** * Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, Procore, BlueBeam, and Accubid. * Proven ability to read and interpret blueprints, drawings, and technical construction documents. * Understanding of electrical construction within large\-scale commercial environments. * Experience developing and maintaining relationships with clients, subcontractors, and suppliers while remaining aware of industry and market trends. * Thorough knowledge and application of safety standards within electrical construction. * Ability to support project quality, documentation, and technical compliance throughout the project lifecycle. **Education \& Experience** * Working knowledge of supporting or managing industrial and/or commerical electrical construction projects. * General construction experience preferred. * Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education, skills, and training preferred. * Equivalent combinations of relevant education, training, and applied experience will be considered. What You'll Get: **Working Conditions**: The majority of the time you will work on construction job sites. When on construction job sites you will encounter typical construction conditions including extreme temperatures, noise, dust, mud debris, welding, leading edge, trenching, and shoring, sometimes in a confined space. You may be required to visit multiple locations during any one day. **Benefits Overview:** IME provides an industry\-leading comprehensive benefits package.
