jobs.title: Senior software engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Join the Data Capabilities team as a Senior Software Engineer on Intuit's Data Platform. We're using data in groundbreaking ways to uncover customer insights, personalize customer experiences through AI/ML, and provide a unified customer view across all Intuit products. As a Senior engineer, you'll operate as a technical leader — setting the direction for how we build event\-driven, real\-time data services at scale, mentoring engineers across teams, and partnering with data architects and senior leadership to shape our technology roadmap. You'll be hands\-on with core technologies like Kubernetes, Kafka, DynamoDB, and S3, while driving engineering excellence across testing, CI/CD, performance, and reliability practices. **Responsibilities** Develop web services that make big data available in real\-time for in\-product applications. Work with data architects to ensure that Event Driven solutions are aligned with company\-wide technology directions. Lead fast moving development teams using agile methodologies. Lead by example, demonstrating best practices for unit testing, CI/CD, performance testing, capacity planning, documentation, monitoring, alerting, and incident response. Communicate progress across organizations and levels from individual contributor to senior executive. Identify and clarify the critical few issues that need action and drive appropriate decisions and actions. Communicate results clearly and in actionable form. Serve as technical “go to” person for our core technologies – Kubernetes, Kafka, DynamoDB, S3, and springboot. Demonstrate strong implementation aptitude to translate objectives into a scalable solution to meet the needs of the end customer while meeting deadlines. Demonstrate commitment to your professional development by attending conferences, taking classes, giving technical presentations, and participating in developer communities inside and outside of Intuit. **Qualifications** BS in Computer Science. MS Preferred. Strong CS fundamentals including data structures, algorithms and distributed systems. Strong database fundamentals including SQL, performance and schema design. 5\+ years of strong Object Oriented Programming (Java, Scala, or Python) 5\+ years of hands\-on Software Engineering experience. 5\+ years of experience integrating technical processes and business outcomes – specifically: data and process analysis, data quality metrics/monitoring, data architecture, developing policies/standards \& supporting processes. Strong project leadership experience, including being a technical lead for multiple complex software development projects using agile methodologies. Experience with Kafka, Spark, Kafka, DynamoDB and AWS is a plus. 3\+ years working with Cloud Technologies. Experience with various offerings from AWS, including S3, EMR, Dynamo, Networking is a plus. History of contributing to open source projects is a plus. 5\+ years DevOps experience including configuration, optimization, backup, high reliability, monitoring and systems version control. Track record working with data from multiple sources – willingness to dig\-in and understand the data and to leverage creative thinking and problem\-solving. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including business writing and presentations. Ability to communicate objectives, plans, status and results clearly, focusing on critical few key points. Demonstrated ability to work in a matrix environment, ability to influence at all levels, and build strong relationships. Knowledge of enacting service level agreements and the appropriate escalation and communication plans to maintain them. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $171,000 \- $231,500

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer - Platform Software
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Engineering * JOB218860 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** Our team designs and builds the embedded platform software infrastructure that supports critical performance, safety and user\-facing features of the da Vinci™ Surgical System, Intuitive’s flagship product. We’re looking for a high energy, experienced embedded software engineer to take technical ownership across our embedded platform software stack. In this role, you will lead board bring\-up initiatives, drive architectural decision for our next\-generation platforms, and serve as a technical anchor for the team – mentoring junior engineers and collaborating cross\-functionally with hardware, system software, and FPGA teams. You will own critical subsystems supporting video networking, UI display, and machine learning capabilities of Da Vinci 5 while driving improvements in robustness, reliability, manufacturability, and serviceability. **Essential Job Duties** * Lead board bring\-up activities for next generation\-based platforms including bootloader configuration, BSP customization, peripheral driver integration and system validation – taking end\-to\-end ownership from initial power\-on through production readiness. * Own development and drive the technical direction of embedded software for video networking, UI display, and machine learning applications on Linux\-based systems – including architectural decisions, code review and performance optimization. * Design and own comprehensive test strategies to validate board functionality, peripheral interfaces, and system performance metrics – including defining acceptance criteria and driving resolution of complex hardware\-software integration issues. * Partner with and technically guide hardware engineers to identify, root\-cause and resolve board\-level issues during early development phases – serving as the primary software interface for cross\-functional hardware bring\-up * Architect and lead the development of automated test frameworks for board validation and regression testing – establishing scalable infrastructure usable across multiple platform variants. * Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and hands\-on debugging support – actively contributing to the growth of the team. * Author and maintain technical documentation including design specifications, bring\-up procedures, and failure analysis reports in compliance with FDA\-regulated development processes. ### **Qualifications** **Required Education, Skills \& Experience** * Minimum of 8 years of related experience and a Bachelor's degree; Iterable Nova is our intelligence layer. It helps customer experience teams adapt in real time and improve every interaction. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on Nova, you'll lead context retrieval and search. The goal is agent responses that are grounded in evidence, aware of the customer's context, and based on what a query means rather than its literal words. You will build the retrieval stack and the search subagents that run on top of it. You will have real autonomy: from research and experimentation through to systems running reliably in production, you'll own this work and help shape the direction of AI at Iterable. One of our core values is a growth mindset, and Iterable is a company where everyone can grow. If this role excites you, please apply — we value applicants for the skills they bring beyond a job description. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build retrieval across structured data (tables, SQL, dashboards, code) and unstructured content (docs, tickets, chat, media), using each source's own signals. * Build semantic query understanding for agents: query rewriting, decomposition, intent classification, and entity resolution for multi\-turn workflows. * Build pipelines that extract entities, embeddings, summaries, and metadata from customer data, and keep them fresh. * Build search subagents that decide what to retrieve, run multi\-hop searches, check whether results are good enough, and flag when retrieval fails. * Measure quality with ranking metrics (nDCG, MRR, Recall@K), LLM judges, human labels, and online tests. Track how retrieval affects final responses, and use the results to improve both retrieval and the harness. * Mentor engineers on the team and help set the technical direction for Nova. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of hands\-on MLE experience putting complex models into production at scale, including search, information retrieval, or recommendation systems. * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field. * You keep up with the latest research and focus on applying it: shipping reliable changes that measurably improve the product experience for customers. * Deep IR expertise: lexical (BM25\), dense (embeddings, ANN indexes), and hybrid retrieval, plus learning\-to\-rank. * Production experience with search engines such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Vespa, including relevance tuning and reranking. * Hands\-on experience with RAG, query rewriting, reranking, and grounding techniques that reduce hallucination. * Experience building agents on top of retrieval, such as multi\-hop search or sufficiency checks. * Strong evaluation practice: offline benchmarks, regression detection, A/B testing, and labeling pipelines. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Experience with LLM APIs from multiple providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google), including tool calling and prompt caching. * Experience indexing and ranking structured and unstructured data in the same system. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Recruitment Disclaimer:** Please be aware that Iterable, Inc. In addition, 5\+ years of experience leading technologists to manage, anticipate and solve complex technical items within your domain of expertise * 10\+ years demonstrated experience leading engineering teams and owning technical roadmaps for platform capabilities used by multiple product teams. * Hands\-on Databricks expertise (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Spark, SQL Warehouses) and ability to set secure, scalable patterns. * Strong LLM application architecture skills (RAG, tools, agents, orchestration) with a focus on safety and reliability. * Experience building and running production AI systems with strong testing, observability, and resiliency practices. * Strong knowledge of data governance and access controls (e.g., Immuta or similar) with audit\-ready practices. * Ability to translate technical decisions into business value, trade\-offs, risks, and investment needs for senior leaders * Hands\-on experience using enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and validate AI\-generated outputs. * Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to influence leaders on safe scaling patterns and reuse. **Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills** * Experience building Model Context Protocol servers or secure agent tool layers. * Familiar with star schema and Medallion architecture to validate AI\-generated outputs. * Delivered AI in regulated environments with strong governance and auditability. * Familiar with Sigma Computing or similar Databricks\-based analytics tools. * Built reusable agent patterns and platform accelerators that scale across teams. **ABOUT US** JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management. Those in eligible roles may receive commission\-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. jobs.description: **JOB DESCRIPTION** Join the Process Intelligence team at JPMorgan Chase to investigate how people, processes, and technology shape work. jobs.title: Senior AI Product Engineer
jobs.description: Just Right Reader is a forward\-thinking curriculum provider committed to advancing literacy for students from Birth through 12th Grade. Our comprehensive resources are designed to support all learners, including upper\-grade students requiring additional intervention to develop foundational skills. Grounded in the Science of Reading, our high\-quality materials and tools equip educators with the support they need to accelerate achievement and foster lifelong readers. **Position Overview:** Just Right Reader works with school districts and state education agencies to get kids books at the right reading level. Our platform is TypeScript, Next.js and Postgres, and it connects to the CRM, ERP and internal systems that run the business. We're adding AI to the product. We have a list of projects we want to build and we haven't started on any of them, so we're hiring an engineer to do that work. **Key Responsibilities:** **The projects are already scoped, so you wouldn't be coming in to figure out what we should build. You'd be building it, and making the technical decisions along the way: how we call models, what happens when the output comes back wrong, what we do about cost and latency, and how we test any of it.** **That last part matters more than it might sound. Right now we'd have no way to tell whether a change to a prompt or a model made things worse, and we'd want that in place early rather than after something goes out badly.** **Because we work with K\-12 students, privacy and data handling come up in every design conversation instead of at the end of one. Recommendations also have to be defensible, and one that's wrong but sounds confident causes us more trouble than not making one.** **You'd also do regular product work. We're a small team, so there's Next.js, schema design and integration work alongside the AI projects.** **Qualifications:** You've built an AI product from scratch and shipped it to real users. We're specifically after someone who made the architecture decisions rather than building features on top of a system another team maintained, since that's the situation here. If every AI project you've worked on already had a gateway, an eval setup and a cost dashboard in place when you arrived, this will be a harder jump than it looks. We'd want to hear about at least one thing you built that people depended on, and we'll ask a lot of questions about it. Engineering * Senior\-level experience as a full\-stack or product engineer on systems that were genuinely in production, with real users and real consequences when something broke. * Strong TypeScript. Nearly everything you'd write here is TypeScript, across both the application and the services around it. * Next.js in production rather than familiarity with it. You should be comfortable with the App Router, server components, API routes, and the places where Next.js makes things harder than they need to be. * Strong backend skills: API design, server\-side business logic, and the kind of debugging where the bug turns out to be three systems away from where the error showed up. * Strong PostgreSQL. Query design and optimization, schema and data modeling, and enough experience to know when the ORM is helping and when you should write the SQL yourself. A fair amount of the work here is SQL\-heavy. * Third\-party API integration where the interesting part was the failure cases. Retries, idempotency, rate limits, partial failures, and vendors behaving differently in production than their docs suggested. * AWS at the application level \- S3, SQS, Secrets Manager, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB. We care more about whether you've debugged something running on them than whether you can list the services. AI specifically * You know the ways LLMs fail in production: malformed structured output, schema drift, latency spikes, cost surprises, refusals, and answers that are wrong but sound certain. More to the point, you know what to build so that users don't have to deal with any of it. * You've had to evaluate quality somehow. Golden sets, scored runs, human review, regression checks before a deploy \- whatever form it took, you've answered the question of whether a change made things better or worse with something other than a feeling. * Judgment about when a model is the wrong tool. A fair amount of what looks like an AI problem turns out to be a rules or SQL problem with a better interface, and we'd rather ship the boring version when that's the right answer. * Some sense of what running this costs and what to do about it. Working here * We're small, so you'd be talking directly with the people in operations, customer success and fulfillment who use what we build. Being able to have those conversations well matters about as much as the code does. * Comfort treating internal tooling as a normal part of the job rather than a distraction from the interesting work. Useful but not required: * Retrieval systems in production, eval tooling you've built or used seriously, Prisma, Terraform or general infrastructure literacy, Python, previous K\-12 or FERPA work, and experience with systems like NetSuite, HubSpot, Shopify or Slack. We're not doing model training, fine\-tuning or research, so this isn't the right role if that's what you're after. **Why Join Us:** At Just Right Reader, we're transforming how children learn to read. You'll be part of a passionate, growing team committed to educational equity, literacy innovation, and joyful learning. * Mission\-driven company focused on improving literacy and education outcomes. * Collaborative and innovative work environment with opportunities for growth and development. * Competitive salary and benefits package.

jobs.description: **An exciting career awaits you** ================================= At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment. **Position Summary** The Value Chain Optimization (VCO) team has an opening for a Cross\-Regional Planning \& Optimization Advisor/Engineer. The Cross\-Regional Planning \& Optimization Advisor/Engineer plays a critical role in enabling enterprise\-wide value optimization by aligning commercial strategy, operational constraints, and market dynamics across multiple regions. Reporting to the Cross Regional Optimization Director, this role operates at the intersection of planning, logistics, and commercial teams to drive consistent, economically optimized decision\-making across the value chain. This individual serves as a highly collaborative and energetic integrator, partnering closely with logistics and commercial stakeholders. They facilitate cross\-regional alignment, communicate complex concepts in a clear and actionable way, and influence outcomes across diverse stakeholder groups without direct authority. Leveraging strong analytical skills and hands\-on experience with linear programming models, including PIMS, the Cross\-Regional Planning \& Optimization Engineer evaluates scenarios, validates plans, and identifies opportunities to improve value capture across the system. They translate optimization outputs into actionable insights while ensuring consistency in how models are applied and embedded into planning and execution processes. **Key Responsibilities** * Leads development of optimized regional and cross\-regional production plans using LP models, balancing operational constraints, market conditions, and value chain opportunities across multiple refineries. * Serves as a subject matter expert in refinery planning and optimization, applying broad knowledge of refinery operations, economics, and market dynamics across multiple refineries and value chain functions. * Provides technical leadership for LP model development and optimization, challenging assumptions, refining and regional constraints, and ensuring models accurately reflect business and operational realities. * Drives development of regional and cross\-regional optimization strategies, aligning stakeholders to address constraints, capture value opportunities, and maximize value chain performance. * Guides complex scenario and sensitivity analyses to support critical planning decisions, evaluate risks, and optimize performance. * Leads advanced performance assessments, backcast analyses, and scenario evaluations to identify systemic gaps and drive continuous improvement initiatives. * Leads collaboration across Operations, Commercial, Logistics, and Planning organizations to align assumptions, operating strategies, and optimization recommendations. * Leads complex planning and optimization initiatives, mentors' other advisors, and advances planning and optimization capabilities across the organization. **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering required. A Bachelor's degree in another field may be considered with five (5\) years of experience in refinery planning, optimization, value chain, operations, commercial, logistics or related technical experience required. * Four (4\) years of refinery planning, optimization, value chain analysis, operations, commercial, logistics, or related experience required. * Aspen PIMS linear programming user background preferred. **Skills** * **Analytical Thinking**: Strong problem\-solving skills to identify architectural challenges, analyze requirements, evaluate options, and propose effective solutions * **Building Partnerships**: Developing and leveraging relationships within and across work groups to achieve results. * **Business Acumen**: Applies knowledge of MPC’s business, industry and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals. Makes decisions and recommendations clearly linked to MPC’s strategy. * **Business Domain Knowledge**: Understanding of business processes, industry trends, and market dynamics to provide relevant and actionable insights for strategic decision\-making. * **Commodity Market Analysis**: Applies knowledge of commodity markets, price dynamics, and supply\-demand fundamentals to inform planning, optimization, and commercial decision\-making. * **Continuous Improvement Mindset**: Identifies and leads opportunities for continuous improvement and value creation, both incremental and largescale. * **Data Analysis**: Data Analysis is the process of identifying, evaluating, interpreting and organizing data so that it can be used for business decisions. It includes sorting through data to identify patterns and establish relationships. * **Decision Support Analytics**: Leverages analytics, reporting, and decision frameworks to generate insights, evaluate alternatives, and support informed, data\-driven decision\-making. * **Influencing Others**: The ability to garner support for initiatives by gaining the respect of others and inspiring trust and confidence. * **Integrated Planning \& Optimization**: Designs and manages integrated planning processes that align supply, demand, and operational constraints to optimize value across the enterprise value chain. * **Metrics Management**: The process of monitoring performance indicators that demonstrate how effectively a unit/ business/ function/ company is achieving key objectives. * **Optimization Modeling**: Applies optimization models and quantitative techniques to evaluate scenarios, improve system performance, and support complex operational and commercial decisions * **Scenario Planning**: Design and evaluate alternative future states to stress\-test strategies and inform resilient decision\-making. * **Stakeholder Engagement**: Build alignment across internal and external stakeholders to support shared objectives. * **Systems Thinking**: The ability to analyze complex systems and understand their interdependencies, considering both technical and business aspects, to develop comprehensive and scalable architectures. jobs.title: VDC AI Engineer
jobs.description: #### **POSITION SUMMARY** Metcon, Inc., one of the nation's leading Native American\-owned commercial general contractors, is seeking an innovative and technically skilled VDC AI Engineer – Agentic Modeling and Coordination to help advance our Virtual Design and Construction capabilities through the integration of artificial intelligence, automation, and constructible building information modeling. This is a unique opportunity for a construction professional who understands how buildings are actually constructed and possesses the technical expertise to develop intelligent workflows that improve project coordination, model accuracy, and field execution. The ideal candidate will combine hands\-on trade knowledge, advanced BIM/VDC capabilities, and practical experience developing AI\-assisted automation solutions. This individual will work directly with project teams, trade partners, and construction leadership to identify coordination challenges, develop solutions, and implement AI\-driven processes that improve efficiency while maintaining the highest standards of constructability and quality. This is a construction\-first position. We are not seeking a traditional software developer with limited construction exposure or someone whose AI experience is limited to writing prompts. We are looking for a professional who can recognize complex trade coordination challenges, develop controlled technical solutions, and validate that the resulting models and recommendations are accurate, practical, and field\-ready. #### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES** Virtual Design and Construction / BIM Coordination * Develop, manage, and coordinate accurate, constructible, tradespecific 3D models for complex commercial construction projects. * Utilize Autodesk Revit, Navisworks Manage, and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) to facilitate multidisciplinary coordination. * Perform detailed clash detection, issue tracking, and model quality assurance to identify conflicts before construction. * Evaluate mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, structural, and architectural systems for spatial coordination and constructability. * Lead or support BIM/VDC coordination meetings with project teams, designers, engineers, and specialty subcontractors. * Translate model coordination findings into practical solutions that support fabrication, installation, and field execution. * Support construction sequencing, prefabrication planning, and installation logistics through coordinated digital models. * Maintain model accuracy and alignment with project specifications, design intent, and approved construction documentation. Artificial Intelligence and Agentic Workflow Development * Design, develop, and implement AIassisted workflows using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and approved AI platforms. * Develop intelligent automation solutions for model QA/QC, clash analysis, document review, issue prioritization, and coordination reporting. * Build agentic workflows capable of interacting with BIM software, structured project data, and construction documentation through approved integrations. * Utilize Model Context Protocol (MCP), application programming interfaces (APIs), and automation tools to connect AI capabilities with existing construction technology platforms. * Develop repeatable workflows that improve coordination efficiency, reduce manual processing, and enhance the quality of project information. * Automate repetitive VDC activities such as issue classification, coordination summaries, model checks, and document comparisons. * Collaborate with internal technology and operations teams to evaluate emerging AI applications and identify practical construction use cases. * Document workflows, establish repeatable procedures, and support adoption across Metcon project teams. Model Validation, Quality Control and Risk Management * Independently validate AIgenerated recommendations, model modifications, and coordination outputs before implementation. * Maintain appropriate human review and approval requirements for all production model changes. * Establish quality control procedures to identify inaccurate, incomplete, or potentially unsafe AIgenerated results. * Ensure automated processes do not compromise design intent, contractual requirements, constructability, or project quality. * Coordinate with design professionals and project leadership regarding changes requiring formal design review or approval. * Maintain traceability of AIassisted model reviews, coordination decisions, and approved modifications. * Protect confidential project information and ensure AI workflows comply with companyapproved data security practices. Project Team and Trade Partner Collaboration * Work closely with Project Executives, Project Managers, Superintendents, Preconstruction teams, and trade partners to support project delivery. * Engage directly with specialty subcontractors to understand installation requirements, fabrication constraints, a assisted workflows involving construction software, structured data, project documentation, or automated processes. * Working knowledge of Python, Dynamo, C\#, or comparable automation and scripting technologies. * Understanding of construction documents, specifications, installation sequencing, and field coordination. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problemsolving abilities. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with construction professionals across multiple disciplines. * Ability to independently evaluate technical outputs and verify constructability before implementation. Important: The five\-year minimum experience requirement applies to construction and trade experience, not years of experience using artificial intelligence tools. #### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience working with Revit APIs, Navisworks APIs, Autodesk Platform Services, or Autodesk Construction Cloud integrations. * Experience configuring MCP integrations, Claude Code, reusable AI skills, or OpenAI API workflows. * Advanced experience developing automated BIM quality control or clash management solutions. * Experience with fabricationlevel modeling, prefabrication, modular construction, and installation sequencing. * Experience integrating AI with project management platforms, document management systems, or construction databases. * Familiarity with Procore and other construction management technologies. * Experience coordinating largescale commercial construction projects in healthcare, education, aviation, entertainment, hospitality, or industrial markets. * Demonstrated improvements in coordination turnaround time, model accuracy, issue resolution, or reduction of field rework. * Experience developing standardized VDC processes, training materials, or technology implementation programs. * Degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Computer Science, or a related discipline is preferred; equivalent handson construction and technical experience will be considered. #### **KEY COMPETENCIES** Construction and Trade Expertise: Understands how building systems are fabricated, installed, coordinated, and constructed in the field. Advanced BIM/VDC Capabilities: Possesses hands\-on modeling, clash detection, and multidisciplinary coordination experience. Applied AI and Automation: Can develop functional, repeatable AI\-assisted workflows that solve real construction challenges. Technical Judgment: Understands the limitations of AI\-generated information and maintains appropriate human oversight. Problem Solving and Innovation: Identifies opportunities to improve construction processes through technology without compromising quality or constructability. Collaboration and Communication: Works effectively with designers, engineers, project teams, specialty contractors, and executive leadership. Accountability and Integrity: Maintains high standards for accuracy, data protection, documentation, and approved production changes. #### **About METCON INC** Metcon is a Native American\-owned business (Lumbee) founded in 1999 in Pembroke, North Carolina. Metcon, which stands for (Metal and Construction), was conceived as a General Contractor specializing in panelized metal studs and truss. As a young company, Metcon worked primarily on housing and related panelized projects throughout North Carolina. The firm quickly transitioned into a full\-service commercial general contracting operation still incorporating metal\-framed systems whenever possible. The UNC system higher education bonds of the 2000’s was a catalyst to Metcon’s growth as a primary contractor for the UNC\-Pembroke campus. Expanding their focus in Education, the company quickly became a leader, in not only University construction, but also K\-12 facilities across the Carolinas. Metcon remains headquartered in Pembroke, North Carolina, with offices in Raleigh, Charlotte, Fayetteville, North Carolina and Columbia, \& Myrtle Beach South Carolina.

The engineer will contribute across the complete memory\-development lifecycle, including architecture definition, transistor\-level circuit build, composing detailed circuit diagrams, layout interface, SPICE verification, timing and power characterization, compiler enablement, and pre\- and post\-silicon validation. The role requires strong hands\-on knowledge of SRAM and register\-file design, memory arrays and bitcells, read/write datapaths, sense amplifiers, address decoding, control logic, assist techniques, and PPA tradeoffs. The candidate will work closely with teams handling layout development, CAD tools, manufacturing processes, testchip, product, silicon\-test, and foundry. They will develop **reliable**, production\-ready memory solutions and correlate models with measured silicon behavior. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * **Design and optimize** custom SRAM, register\-file, and embedded\-memory circuits from architecture through schematic, layout support, characterization, and release. * **Develop and verify** memory\-array subsystems including bitcell arrays, precharge and equalization, sense amplifiers, write drivers, address decoders, wordline drivers, control logic, clocking, redundancy hooks, and read/write datapaths. * **Evaluate bitcell and peripheral\-circuit stability**, performance, leakage, dynamic power, and area across process, voltage, temperature, mismatch, and aging conditions. * **Own transistor\-level simulation and signoff** using HSPICE, Spectre, FineSim, or comparable tools, including PVT corners, Monte Carlo analysis, parasitic\-aware post\-layout simulatio and waveform/debug reviews. * **Drive SRAM PPA optimization** through circuit sizing, architecture selection, banking and muxing decisions, assist techniques, bias strategies, retention modes, and critical\-path analysis. * **Define Achieving this vision starts with understanding the work itself, directly from the people doing it. Every professional domain has its own workflows, terminology, constraints, business rules, and standards for what constitutes a good outcome, much of which remains buried in long\-tail domain knowledge. You will work closely with customers, users, and domain experts to discover how work happens in practice, identify high\-value opportunities for AI, and rapidly validate ideas against real customer needs. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Internal Platforms
jobs.description: Mosaic Pediatric Therapy provides clinic\-based and home\-based ABA therapy for children with autism across North Carolina and Virginia. We are growing quickly, and we build and run a growing portfolio of internal software: custom web applications, AI\-assisted operational tools, agentic workflows, and integrations with a modern Azure\-based Lakehouse. These systems support clinical operations, billing, credentialing, and analytics. Our software handles protected health information (PHI) and sits in workflows where accuracy and compliance are non\-negotiable. We need a senior software engineer to turn that energy into well\-designed, secure, maintainable applications. ### **About the Role** This is a senior, hands\-on software engineering role. You will design, build, ship, and maintain the internal applications and services that Mosaic runs on, and set the engineering standards for how software gets built here. About 70% of the role is software development such as application architecture, building features end to end, APIs and integrations, testing, code review, and production support. The other 30% covers the data and platform work those applications depend on, such as data pipelines into our Azure Fabric Lakehouse, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and monitoring. We are a Microsoft shop (Azure, Fabric, SQL Server, Microsoft 365\). We care more about strong engineering fundamentals than any specific language or framework, and we want to put your expertise to work. The role is highly cross\-functional. You will work directly with the VP of Data Science, the Director of IT, and operational leaders across the business. You will also mentor internal builders who use AI\-assisted development tools, helping them produce software that is safe, tested, and maintainable. ### **What You'll Do** **Design and build internal applications.** Own internal software end to end, from requirements and architecture through implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Build web applications, services, APIs, and integrations with third\-party systems such as our EHR, billing, and HR platforms. **Set and raise the engineering bar.** Establish standards for source control, branching, code review, testing, modular design, documentation, and secure coding. Lead by example through high\-quality code and thoughtful pull request reviews. **Ship AI\-enabled software.** Build and maintain applications and agentic workflows that use LLMs and AI services. Help internal builders using Claude Code and similar tools turn prototypes into production\-grade software. **Own production reliability.** Put deployment pipelines, environment management, monitoring, alerting, and incident response in place across internal systems. Debug production issues and run blameless post\-incident reviews. **Support the data and platform layer.** Build and maintain the pipelines that move application data into and out of our Azure Fabric Lakehouse. Contribute to cloud infrastructure, infrastructure\-as\-code, and data models that serve both applications and reporting. **Partner with the business.** Work directly with clinical, billing, credentialing, and operations leaders to turn workflow problems into well\-scoped software solutions. ### **What We're Looking For** ### **Required** * 4\+ years of professional software development, building and shipping production applications * High proficiency in at least one modern programming language, and comfort picking up others * Strong software engineering fundamentals: object\-oriented or functional design, modular architecture, testing (unit, integration, end to end), debugging, and Git\-based workflows * Experience designing and building APIs, services, and web applications * Track record of owning software end to end, from design through production support * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows * Experience building on a major cloud platform (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP considered) * Solid SQL and relational database design skills * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar * Understanding of secure coding practices and of handling sensitive or regulated data * Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with non\-technical stakeholders * Experience mentoring other developers or leading code review ### **Nice to Have** * Experience in the Microsoft ecosystem: Azure, .NET, SQL Server, Microsoft Fabric, Entra ID, or Power Platform * Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines or working in Lakehouse or data warehouse environments * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience (Bicep, Terraform, or ARM) * Experience building applications on top of LLMs or agentic frameworks * Experience in healthcare, ABA, EHR/EMR, claims, or other regulated environments * Exposure to HIPAA, HITECH, HITRUST, SOC 2, or related compliance frameworks ### **Why This Role Matters** This role is foundational to how Mosaic builds software over the next several years. You will shape the architecture, standards, and engineering culture behind the next generation of internal applications and AI\-enabled systems. Instead of owning one narrow slice, you will set the direction for how software gets built and maintained across the company. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * Competitive salary based on experience * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) * PTO and paid holidays * Remote\-first flexibility * Equipment and tooling support We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: **OVERVIEW** *A thriving, mission\-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award\-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. We are seeking a player\-coach style who understands the complexities of building adaptive and conscientious AI coding teams, and can help us apply rigor and standards to our infrastructure decisions and rollouts. In this role, you will supervise the mid\-level engineering staff, provide mentorship and support to NPR's larger engineering teams and own the evaluation and deployment of the team's AI tools and vendors. This role suits someone who can weigh build\-versus\-buy decisions honestly, explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical colleagues, and hold both vendors and our own work to NPR's standards for privacy, security, and accuracy. This is a chance to shape a new team and have a tangible effect on how NPR uses AI responsibly in service of its mission, on a team built on respect, trust, and work\-life balance. ### **Responsibilities** * **People Leadership:** Manage and mentor a team of entry and mid\-level AI engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and supporting each person's professional growth. * **Delivery:** Lead technical planning, scoping, and sprint execution for AI Labs engineering work, such as NPR's AI\-powered metadata service, in partnership with AI Labs leadership and editorial and business stakeholders. * **Engineering Standards:** Work with AI Labs leadership to develop AI coding frameworks, practices, and expectations for the team. * **Code Quality and Architecture:** Review designs and code, and contribute hands\-on where it helps the team, keeping systems maintainable, secure, and consistent with NPR's technical standards. * **Testing and Evaluation:** Build and maintain automated testing and model evaluation practices, including regression tests and evaluation checks before release, aligned with quality bars set by the product team. * **Production Support:** Coordinate the team's response to production bugs and infrastructure incidents, and lead follow\-up reviews to prevent repeat problems. * **Vendor Evaluation:** Lead technical evaluations of AI vendors, models, and tools, covering architecture, data handling, security, and cost, and recommend whether NPR should build, buy, or partner. * **NPR\-wide AI Tool Review:** Participate in AI Labs' review of AI tools requested by teams across NPR, working with IT Security through the vendor risk and security intake processes. AI Labs assesses, and IT and the Office of General Counsel approve. * **Vendor Relationships:** Take over day\-to\-day management of selected AI vendors and tools, from onboarding and seat provisioning through renewal and offboarding. * **Responsible Scaling:** Track vendor usage, spend, and renewal dates against budget, and ensure AI systems scale securely and cost\-effectively while maintaining strong data privacy protections. **The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.** ### **Minimum Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience building and shipping production AI or machine learning systems, with deep hands\-on knowledge of large language models and the systems built around them. * 2\+ years of experience managing or mentoring engineers. * Experience setting engineering practices for a team, such as code review, testing, or deployment standards. * Experience working with technology vendors and managing software tools, including security and data privacy reviews. * Experience building automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs. * Hands\-on experience building in a major cloud environment (Azure, AWS, or GCP). * Experience setting up automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs. * Experience working across technical and non\-technical teams, including expla working with product managers to gather requirements from stakeholders. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a media organization, newsroom, or public service institution. * Experience onboarding staff into a new or growing team. * Experience working with procurement, legal, or vendor risk teams on technology reviews. ### **Required Skills/Competencies** * Strong Python skills and working knowledge of retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search. * Proficiency in design and architecture of AI systems and systems of AI evaluation * Proficiency in SQL and cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake. * Familiarity with model evaluation methods, prompt engineering, and API integration, including NPR's approved model families such as Claude, Gemini, Gemma, and Llama. * Ability to assess vendor security documentation, data processing terms, and seat\-based and usage\-based pricing. * Commitment to data privacy, AI ethics, and identifying and reducing bias. ### **Education a hybrid permitted role. The employee must also reside in an NPR\-supported location based on the number of onsite days they choose. ### **Job Type** * This is a full\-time, exempt position. ### **Compensation** **Salary Range**: The U.S.\-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $180,000 \- 206,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations. **NPR Benefits**: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Data Curation - Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.description: We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer for our Autonomous Vehicles Data Curation team. The role involves applying state\-of\-the\-art techniques to search, curate, and evaluate high\-quality datasets and ground truth for autonomous vehicles, a critical aspect of our next\-generation products. You will have the opportunity to work with top researchers and engineers in the field of deep learning and computer vision to deliver impact to our customers around the world. Intelligent machines powered by Artificial Intelligence computers that can learn, reason and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Today, a self\-driving car powered by AI can meander through a country road at night and find its way. An AI\-powered robot can learn motor skills through trial and error. The era of AI has begun. NVIDIA's GPUs run Deep Learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and act as the brain of computers, robots and self\-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Just as human imagination and intelligence are linked, computer graphics and AI come together in our architecture. NVIDIA GPUs are used broadly for Deep Learning, and NVIDIA is increasingly known as “the AI company”. Make your choice to join us today. We are training Deep Neural Networks and developing data search and curation capabilities for NVIDIA's Autonomous Vehicles effort, with the goal to enable autonomous driving. We are seeking Deep Learning/Machine Learning engineers who are passionate about building the datasets and tools that support perception, prediction, planning and control for self\-driving cars to achieve full autonomy. jobs.description: **OVERVIEW** *A thriving, mission\-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award\-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.* *Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR**.* *This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.* ### **Intro to Position** NPR's AI Labs team is looking for a Manager of AI Engineering and Vendor Operations. This person will serve on the AI Labs leadership team and help inform NPR's AI technical strategy. We are seeking a player\-coach style who understands the complexities of building adaptive and conscientious AI coding teams, and can help us apply rigor and standards to our infrastructure decisions and rollouts. In this role, you will supervise the mid\-level engineering staff, provide mentorship and support to NPR's larger engineering teams and own the evaluation and deployment of the team's AI tools and vendors. This role suits someone who can weigh build\-versus\-buy decisions honestly, explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical colleagues, and hold both vendors and our own work to NPR's standards for privacy, security, and accuracy. This is a chance to shape a new team and have a tangible effect on how NPR uses AI responsibly in service of its mission, on a team built on respect, trust, and work\-life balance. ### **Responsibilities** * **People Leadership:** Manage and mentor a team of entry and mid\-level AI engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and supporting each person's professional growth. * **Delivery:** Lead technical planning, scoping, and sprint execution for AI Labs engineering work, such as NPR's AI\-powered metadata service, in partnership with AI Labs leadership and editorial and business stakeholders. * **Engineering Standards:** Work with AI Labs leadership to develop AI coding frameworks, practices, and expectations for the team. * **Code Quality and Architecture:** Review designs and code, and contribute hands\-on where it helps the team, keeping systems maintainable, secure, and consistent with NPR's technical standards. * **Testing and Evaluation:** Build and maintain automated testing and model evaluation practices, including regression tests and evaluation checks before release, aligned with quality bars set by the product team. * **Production Support:** Coordinate the team's response to production bugs and infrastructure incidents, and lead follow\-up reviews to prevent repeat problems. * **Vendor Evaluation:** Lead technical evaluations of AI vendors, models, and tools, covering architecture, data handling, security, and cost, and recommend whether NPR should build, buy, or partner. * **NPR\-wide AI Tool Review:** Participate in AI Labs' review of AI tools requested by teams across NPR, working with IT Security through the vendor risk and security intake processes. AI Labs assesses, and IT and the Office of General Counsel approve. * **Vendor Relationships:** Take over day\-to\-day management of selected AI vendors and tools, from onboarding and seat provisioning through renewal and offboarding. * **Responsible Scaling:** Track vendor usage, spend, and renewal dates against budget, and ensure AI systems scale securely and cost\-effectively while maintaining strong data privacy protections. **The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.** ### **Minimum Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience building and shipping production AI or machine learning systems, with deep hands\-on knowledge of large language models and the systems built around them. * 2\+ years of experience managing or mentoring engineers. * Experience setting engineering practices for a team, such as code review, testing, or deployment standards. * Experience working with technology vendors and managing software tools, including security and data privacy reviews. * Experience building automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs. * Hands\-on experience building in a major cloud environment (Azure, AWS, or GCP). * Experience setting up automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs. * Experience working across technical and non\-technical teams, including explaining technical and cost trade\-offs to people without a technical background and working with product managers to gather requirements from stakeholders. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a media organization, newsroom, or public service institution. * Experience onboarding staff into a new or growing team. * Experience working with procurement, legal, or vendor risk teams on technology reviews. ### **Required Skills/Competencies** * Strong Python skills and working knowledge of retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search. * Proficiency in design and architecture of AI systems and systems of AI evaluation * Proficiency in SQL and cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake. * Familiarity with model evaluation methods, prompt engineering, and API integration, including NPR's approved model families such as Claude, Gemini, Gemma, and Llama. * Ability to assess vendor security documentation, data processing terms, and seat\-based and usage\-based pricing. * Commitment to data privacy, AI ethics, and identifying and reducing bias. ### **Education Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Work Location \& Requirements** * Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role include duties that are better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office, preferably at the Washington, DC location, at least 2 days a week. The employee must also reside in an NPR\-supported location based on the number of onsite days they choose. ### **Job Type** * This is a full\-time, exempt position. ### **Compensation** **Salary Range**: The U.S.\-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $180,000 \- 206,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations. **NPR Benefits**: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full\-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well\-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long\-term disability, short\-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees. **Does this sound like you? jobs.title: Software Engineer - Front-End Web Applications
jobs.description: **Position Description:** Position Summary The National Radio Astronomy Observatory (NRAO) is a prestigious research and development organization that plays a vital role in the study of the universe. Associated Universities, Inc. (AUI) is a nonprofit organization that manages and operates the NRAO under a cooperative agreement with the National Science Foundation. The Observatory is a hub for technological and scientific collaboration, operating state\-of\-the\-art radio telescope facilities for use by the international scientific community. The Observatory has been instrumental in the study of black holes, galaxies, and the early universe. The NRAO develops and maintains software used by the astronomy community for proposing, planning, scheduling, and analyzing observations made with these telescopes. We are seeking a mid\-level Software Engineer with strong front\-end web development skills to join the Archive Team, part of the Science User Applications Group (SUA). The Archive Team develops and maintains the NRAO Science Archive, one of the Observatory’s most visible user\-facing applications. You will help shape the interfaces that astronomers around the world use every day. You will have the opportunity to contribute to the next generation of tools critical to the Observatory, for both current telescopes and the next generation Very Large Array (ngVLA). This position will be based in Albuquerque, NM; Socorro, NM; Charlottesville, VA; or Green Bank, WV. For well\-qualified candidates, a remote work arrangement may be considered. **What You Will be Doing:** Your initial focus will be on the NRAO Science Archive web application. There are many opportunities for improvement, including: * Modernizing and streamlining the user interface for a better user experience * Building new front\-end features and components that help scientists find and work with radio astronomy data * Improving front\-end performance, accessibility, and test coverage * Collaborating with backend developers to design and consume APIs and to improve overall system performance You will design and deliver key components of the system, working closely with teammates and with scientific users to understand their needs. Team members also maintain and upgrade existing software and develop new tools that support the Observatory’s evolving observing methods, helping keep the Observatory at the forefront of science and technology. Work Environment You will join a team of professionals engaged in research and development in science, engineering, software development, and education. Work is typically performed in a research or development environment. **Who You Are:****You have:** * A bachelor's degree in computer science or related field; highly relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a bachelor's degree. An advanced degree is not required but is welcome. * A minimum of one year experience in the development of software applications. * At least three years of professional experience developing web applications is preferred, with a significant portion focused on the front end. * Familiarity with standard software engineering concepts, practices and procedures through academic training or internship experience(s). Competencies * Professional experience building front\-end web applications with Angular and TypeScript * Solid command of HTML, CSS/Sass, and JavaScript, and experience with Bootstrap or similar frameworks * Experience with build and bundling tools such as webpack * Experience consuming and designing RESTful APIs and an understanding of HTTP * Experience with version control, front\-end testing methodologies (unit and end\-to\-end), and CI/CD * Experience debugging and profiling web applications, including browser performance * Understanding of object\-oriented design and the ability to build maintainable, well\-structured software * Demonstrated ability to learn and apply new languages and frameworks * Strong interpersonal and communication skills – both verbally and in writing * The ability and interest to work as part of a team in a Scrum environment. **While not required, you may have:** * Experience with Python or Java and with backend development, sufficient to work effectively across the stack * Familiarity with relational databases and object\-relational mapping (for example, SQLAlchemy) * Familiarity with messaging systems such as RabbitMQ * Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker, Docker Compose, Docker Swarm, or Kubernetes * Experience with accessibility standards and responsive design * Familiarity with basic astronomical principles and data reduction Additional Requirement Observatory employees must be authorized to work in the United States. The Observatory presently cannot sponsor new H\-1B Visas for this position. **Total Rewards:** Compensation The starting salary of this position is between $96,588 and $120,000\. Factors which may affect starting pay may include; education, experience, skills, competencies, other qualifications of the successful candidate, as well as internal equity and labor market conditions. **Benefits:** Associated Universities, Inc (AUI) offers a comprehensive benefits package addressing the needs of employees and their families with most benefits beginning on the first day of employment, subject to eligibility requirements. AUI provides: * Excellent paid time off (13 holidays, annual accrual of up to 24 vacation days) * Medical, dental and vision plans are effective on the first day of employment. * AUI’s retirement benefit contributes an amount equal to 10 percent of a qualified participant’s base pay with no required employee contribution. * Click Total Rewards for more information. **Application Instructions:** For consideration, select the “Apply” button above. Please be prepared upload a cover letter describing your interest in this position along with a current resume. We reserve the right to close this posting prior to the listed expiration date above based on the volume and/or quality of the applicant pool. **Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:** AUI is an equal opportunity employer. To view our complete statement, please visit https://public.nrao.edu/careers/. If you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, you may submit your request by sending an email to resumes@nrao.edu. PM20

Associated Universities, Inc. (AUI) is a nonprofit organization that manages and operates the NRAO under a cooperative agreement with the National Science Foundation. The Observatory has been instrumental in the study of black holes, galaxies, and the early universe. At NRAO, we are recruiting an experienced Software Engineer to join the Online (ONL) group. The Online group develops and maintains the telescope operations software that turns an astronomer's observing plan into telescope observations, directing the telescope through its observing sequence and producing some of the intermediate data products that go to the archive and to scientists and array operators. You will help support the VLA and VLBA today and contribute to the design and implementation of the online systems for the next generation Very Large Array (ngVLA). This position can be based in Socorro, NM, Albuquerque, NM, Charlottesville, VA or Green Bank, WV. You will work with senior software engineers, scientific staff, and operations staff to understand how astronomers want to observe, refine requirements, and deliver reliable software. Activities may include (but are not limited to): * Developing and maintaining software that sequences and executes observations, including observing modes, calibration strategies, and scheduling logic * Working with astronomers and operations staff to translate scientific requirements into software designs, and validating the results against scientific needs * Working with the Monitor \& Control group on the interfaces between observation execution and hardware control * Supporting data acquisition and the flow of data and metadata to downstream processing and the archive * Prototyping and evaluating architectures and technologies for the ngVLA online systems * Supporting operations, including diagnosing problems that arise during observing Additional duties include the maintenance and necessary upgrades of existing software to support operations, and the development of new capabilities to meet the demands of new observing modes and instrumentation. jobs.title: Engineer, Software Engineer
jobs.description: If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care. **This role will work a hybrid schedule coming into the Des Moines, Iowa office.** This entry level position contributes to the development, maintenance, and support of Commercial Agribusiness applications and services. The associate will deliver defined software work with guidance from experienced team members, following established requirements, design direction, coding practices, security controls, and delivery processes. The team is a full\-stack build\-and\-run team supporting applications and APIs used by members, agency partners, and internal associates. **Key responsibilities** * Implement, configure, test, debug, document, and maintain application code, APIs, and interfaces for assigned work. Break down defined tasks, raise questions when requirements or impacts are unclear, and communicate progress or risks to the team. * Learn the supported application landscape, data flows, and business processes. Develop working knowledge of the teams applications. * Contribute to application maintenance and modernization using technologies including Java, Spring Boot/Spring MVC, Angular, REST APIs, relational databases, CI/CD, and container platforms. **Desired background** A foundation in computer science, information systems, software development, or a related area is appropriate for the role. Relevant programming coursework or experience, basic understanding of the software development lifecycle, and willingness to learn team tools. Previous internship experience is valued. \#LI\-AC1 **Job Description Summary** If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry\-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you! As a Software Engineer, you will focus primarily on providing high\-quality, efficient technology solutions to business partners by crafting new software applications or modifying and/or supporting existing packaged or custom\-built applications. In this capacity, you’ll code, configure, test, debug, document, and maintain applications. **Job Description** **Key Responsibilities:** * Develop, test, debug, document, and deploy software according to engineering standards and best practices. * Apply secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities. * Use DevSecOps practices, tooling, and techniques. * Demonstrate continuous improvement and learning. * Review and process project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables proactively. May perform other responsibilities as assigned. **Reporting Relationships:** Reports to a Technology Manager/Director. **Typical Skills and Experiences:** **Education**: Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems or other related degrees are preferred. Technology experience or non\-traditional technology certificates can be substituted for an undergraduate degree. **Experience**: Early career opportunity with one or more years of technology experience. **Knowledge, Abilities and Skills**: Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, C\+\+, Python, JavaScript. Knowledge of software development lifecycle. Good problem\-solving skills. Ability to thrive in a team environment. Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus. Other criteria, such as competencies and experiences, may take precedence. Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the Director and HR Officer. **Values**: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values. **Job Conditions:** **Overtime Eligibility:** Not Eligible (Exempt) **Working Conditions**: Hybrid to normal office environment. Associates may have on\-call responsibility after normal working hours and/or on weekends. **ADA**: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties. **Benefits** We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision, life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro\-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company\-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. Nationwide is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where everyone feels challenged, appreciated, respected and engaged. Nationwide prohibits discrimination and harassment and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to any characteristic (or classification) protected by applicable law. Smoke\-Free Iowa Statement: Nationwide Mutual Insurance Company, its affiliates and subsidiaries comply with the Iowa Smokefree Air Act. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Niantic Spatial** AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99\.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI\-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. **About the Role** You’ll join a small infrastructure team with broad, shared ownership — the engineers who keep Niantic Spatial running. The team covers the cloud platform, the developer tooling every engineer depends on, and the edge services our customers’ requests pass through. You’ll work across SRE, infrastructure, and developer platform alongside teammates who know the stack well, and you’ll grow into owning parts of it yourself. Because every engineer here builds on what this team provides, your work will also shape how the whole engineering org builds, ships, and operates. **What You'll Do** * **Cloud and SRE:** Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code, and help improve reliability through monitoring, alerting, and service\-level objectives. * **Developer Platform:** Help run our source control, CI/CD pipelines, and build infrastructure so engineers can ship quickly and safely. * **Production Operations:** Share on\-call, take part in incident response and follow\-up, and automate away repetitive operational work. * **Edge and Delivery:** Help run the edge API gateway, CDN, and authentication and authorization systems with the rest of the team. * **Compute and GPU Management:** Help provision and monitor compute and GPU capacity across teams. * **AI\-Assisted Operations:** Use AI tools to help build, automate, and maintain our infrastructure, and help shape how the team uses them. **What You'll Bring** * **Years of Experience:** 3\+ years in infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering. * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Experience managing infrastructure as code with tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or similar. * **Cloud:** Hands\-on experience with GCP, AWS, or another major cloud provider in production. * **CI/CD:** Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, GitHub Actions, or similar. * **Containers:** Production experience with containers and container orchestration, such as Kubernetes. * **Core Technical Skills:** Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, or C\+\+, plus shell scripting and Linux systems. * **AI in Your Workflow:** Comfort using AI\-assisted tools in your engineering work, or a strong interest in building that habit. We’ll help you ramp up on how we use AI here. **Nice to Have** * Familiarity with API gateways, load balancers, or CDNs. * Familiarity with modern authentication and authorization, such as OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, or cloud IAM. * Experience with GPU workloads or ML infrastructure. * Experience with message queuing systems. **Location \& Work Model** This role is based in our San Francisco or Sunnyvale, CA office, or in Bellevue, WA. We work in a high\-collaboration environment and ask team members to be on\-site a minimum of 3 days per week. **Compensation \& Benefits** The base salary range for this position is $171,000 \- $230,000 for Bay Area candidates and $162,500 \- $218,500 for Seattle/Bellevue candidates. Actual salary is based on assessed skills, experience, and location. This role is also eligible for equity, bonus, and benefits. Your recruiter can answer questions about total compensation during the hiring process. **Inclusive Application** We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed — you may be exactly who we're looking for. **Equal Opportunity** Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws.
