jobs.title: Quality Manager
jobs.description: ***Maximize your potential. Minimize your footprint.*** Nortek Data Center Cooling builds the systems that keep modern data centers running — from liquid cooling to large‑scale air solutions. Our work supports some of the world’s most demanding AI and hyperscale environments, and we solve those challenges with engineering depth and practical execution. We keep things simple here. We communicate early, stay close to the details, and follow through. When issues come up, we address them directly, not with layers of process. Customers count on us because we do what we say and we keep projects moving. Our culture is hands‑on and collaborative. People take ownership, move quickly, and help each other. If you like working with teammates who are straightforward and accountable, you’ll feel at home. With the backing of Madison Air, we have the scale, stability, and manufacturing footprint to support complex, high‑growth programs. **Job Summary** The Quality Manager is responsible for leading quality strategy, culture, and execution for Nortek Data Center Cooling's Dyersburg manufacturing facility. This role serves as a key business partner to Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Quality, ensuring products consistently meet customer expectations while driving operational excellence throughout the organization. The Quality Manager will champion a proactive quality culture focused on prevention, process capability, and continuous improvement. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, sound business judgment, and the ability to influence cross\-functional teams to solve problems, improve performance, and eliminate recurring quality issues. This leader will balance customer requirements, manufacturing realities, and business objectives while developing sustainable systems that support growth, improve product quality, and strengthen customer confidence. **Key Outcomes** Within the first 12\-24 months, the Quality Manager will: * Build and sustain a "Right First Time" culture where quality ownership exists throughout the organization. * Improve first\-pass yield and reduce defects, rework, scrap, and cost of poor quality. * Strengthen process capability through effective controls, standard work, and preventive quality practices. * Improve responsiveness and effectiveness of containment, root\-cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Reduce customer defects, warranty issues, and quality escapes. * Improve supplier performance and incoming material quality. * Develop a high\-performing quality organization capable of supporting ongoing business growth and manufacturing scale. * Increase visibility to quality risks, trends, and performance metrics that enable faster and more effective business decisions. Responsibilities Quality Management System \& Compliance * Lead implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the facility Quality Management System in alignment with company requirements and the intent of ISO 9001:2015\. * Ensure required procedures, work instructions, forms, records, and document controls are current, accessible, and followed. * Plan and support internal, customer, and third\-party audits; document findings, assign actions, and verify sustainable closure. * Monitor compliance obligations applicable to the products and processes manufactured at the site and escalate gaps or risks promptly. * Promote disciplined change control so engineering, process, material, and supplier changes are reviewed and implemented with appropriate quality controls. Manufacturing Quality \& Process Control * Provide visible floor leadership for incoming, in\-process, final inspection, end\-of\-line testing, packaging, and shipment release activities. * Ensure inspection and test plans, acceptance criteria, check sheets, control plans, and workmanship standards are defined and consistently applied. * Partner with Operations and Engineering to identify process weaknesses, implement preventive controls, and reduce defects, rework, scrap, and disruption. * Establish appropriate hold, quarantine, disposition, and release controls for nonconforming material and product. * Confirm measuring and test equipment is suitable, controlled, calibrated, and used correctly. * Assess manufacturing, shipping, packaging, installation, and service feedback and provide actionable recommendations to the responsible functions. Corrective Action, Problem Solving \& Improvement * Lead or facilitate containment, root\-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and effectiveness verification using structured problem\-solving methods. * Maintain strong governance of nonconformance, MRB, CAPA, deviation, and quality\-improvement actions through closure. * Analyze recurring defects and process trends; prioritize improvement work based on customer impact, risk, and business performance. * Capture and communicate lessons learned and ensure applicable improvements are incorporat cess improvement, implementing quality management systems, and delivering measurable improvements in product quality, process capability, customer satisfaction, and operational performance. * Demonstrated success leading teams and driving measurable improvements in product quality, process capability, customer satisfaction, and operational performance. * Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems. * Experience leading root\-cause analysis, CAPA programs, nonconformance management, audit readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, bills of material, test procedures, and manufacturing documentation. * Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Demonstrated ability to think independently, challenge assumptions constructively, and make fact\-based business decisions. Preferred Qualifications * Experience in HVAC, data\-center cooling, air\-handling, refrigeration, electrical\-mechanical equipment, or other complex configured\-to\-order manufacturing. * Formal auditor training or certification; ASQ certifications such as Certified Quality Engineer or Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence are beneficial. * Experience with Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, 8D, 5\-Why, fishbone analysis, PFMEA, control plans, statistical process control, and layered process audits. * Experience supporting customer factory witness testing, commissioning, installation, warranty, or field\-service quality activities. * Experience using Autodesk Construction Cloud/BIM 360 or similar platforms for project documentation and issue tracking. * Prior experience working in a regulated or customer\-controlled project\-delivery environment. Leadership Competencies * Independent thinker who exercises sound judgment and applies practical decision\-making in complex situations. * Courage to challenge assumptions and escalate risks when product quality, customer satisfaction, or compliance is at stake. * Strong business acumen with the ability to balance quality, cost, delivery, and customer requirements. * Data\-driven problem solver with expertise in root\-cause analysis and continuous improvement. * High degree of accountability with a demonstrated bias toward action and execution. * Collaborative leader who builds trust and credibility across all levels of the organization. * Continuous improvement mindset focused on prevention, process capability, and sustainable results. * Effective coach and developer of people who creates strong teams and future leaders. Work Environment \& Position Requirements * Primarily based at the Dyersburg manufacturing facility with regular presence on the production floor. * Ability to work safely in an active manufacturing environment and use required personal protective equipment. * Ability to inspect equipment and work areas, which may require standing, walking, bending, reaching, or accessing production and test locations. * Occasional travel may be required for customer, supplier, field, audit, training, or other company needs. * Work schedule flexibility may be required to support production priorities, customer events, containment activity, or critical quality issues. **Why Join Nortek Data Center Cooling?** * Help shape and scale quality systems within a rapidly growing business serving the expanding AI, cloud computing, and hyperscale data center markets. * Lead quality initiatives that directly impact customer success, operational performance, and business growth. * Work alongside experienced leaders in engineering, operations, and manufacturing who value accountability, ownership, and practical problem solving. * Help shape the future of quality within a growing organization backed by Madison Air and supported by significant manufacturing scale and resources. * Influence products that power mission\-critical infrastructure relied upon by some of the world's largest technology companies.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer, Cloud AI Infrastructure, Sr
jobs.description: Summary The Senior Platform Engineer, Cloud \& AI Infrastructure designs, builds, automates, and operates the secure cloud platforms that enable OnPoint’s AI, data, analytics, and automation capabilities in Azure and M365\. This is a senior, hands\-on engineering role responsible for translating complex requirements into reliable, reusable, and production\-ready platform services. The position provides technical leadership for assigned Azure and AI infrastructure capabilities, including architecture, infrastructure automation, identity and networking integration, observability, resiliency, and cost optimization. It establishes engineering patterns that help teams move from experimentation to production without compromising security, supportability, or enterprise standards. Working with Technology Operations, Architecture, Information Security, Data, Solution Engineering, and the Innovation Center of Excellence, this role resolves complex platform challenges, mentors engineers, and enables approved self\-service capabilities. The position leads through technical expertise and cross\-team influence rather than people management. Primary outcomes, first 12 months * Establish reusable, automated deployment patterns for priority cloud, AI, and data workloads. * Reduce provisioning lead time and manual configuration through infrastructure as code and standardized platform services. * Act as the Microsoft ecosystem (365, Azure, etc.) evangelist of new and existing capabilities – the first to be informed, the first to use, the first to teach others to use, and always with energy and commitment to ensuring this platform’s return on investment. * Implement production\-readiness standards covering security, monitoring, support ownership, recovery, and cost. * Improve reliability and operational visibility through service health measures, actionable alerts, and tested recovery procedures. * Establish platform cost and capacity baselines and deliver prioritized optimization improvements. * Enable safe experimentation and repeatable promotion into production through approved environments and controls. Key responsibilities Cloud architecture and platform engineering * Independently lead the design and implementation of complex Azure infrastructure spanning compute, storage, networking, identity, security, and shared platform services. * Develop and maintain reference architectures, reusable deployment patterns, and documented technical decisions aligned with enterprise architecture standards. * Translate business and workload requirements into designs that balance reliability, security, performance, cost, and operational complexity. * Identify platform dependencies and constraints, recommend improvements, and contribute to platform roadmaps and lifecycle planning. Infrastructure automation and delivery * Engineer version\-controlled infrastructure using Terraform and/or Bicep, supported by PowerShell, Azure CLI, or Python. * Utilize Microsoft 365 and other platforms to automate corporate functions for IT Operations and advise on how other teams can do the same. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated validation, controlled promotion, secure configuration, and recovery or rollback procedures. * Establish reusable modules and approved self\-service provisioning patterns that reduce manual work and configuration drift. * Apply code review, testing, documentation, and change\-management practices to infrastructure engineering. AI and data platform enablement * Engineer the infrastructure foundations for AI services, agent workloads, Databricks, and related enterprise data and automation platforms. * Implement secure connectivity, workload identities, secrets management, environment separation, capacity controls, and platform telemetry. * Partner with application, AI, and data engineers to establish scalable deployment and operational patterns for inference, retrieval, and agent workloads. * Support infrastructure dependencies and integrations for Microsoft 365, Copilot, and Power Platform in partnership with their platform owners. * Clearly define infrastructure ownership, application responsibilities, and support boundaries before production release. Security, governance, and operational resilience * Implement approved identity, access, networking, encryption, policy, and monitoring controls in partnership with Information Security. * Define and monitor service\-level indicators and objectives for assigned platform services. * Maintain operational runbooks, configuration evidence, recovery\-test results, and technical documentation supporting audit and operational readiness. Technical leadership and collaboration * Lead technical delivery for complex platform initiatives and coordinate dependencies across teams. * Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing. * Explain technical options, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Evaluate emerging capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, security, maintainability, and total cost – particularly but not limited to the Microsoft ecosystem. Required qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Seven or more years of progressively responsible infrastructure, systems, cloud, or platform engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on Azure engineering experience. * Demonstrated ability to independently design, implement, and operate complex production cloud solutions. * Advanced knowledge of Azure networking, private connectivity, DNS, identity, role\-based access, managed identities, secrets management, and cloud governance. * Demonstrated experience building reusable infrastructure as code and automated deployment pipelines using Git\-based engineering practices. * Strong scripting and automation capability using PowerShell, Python, and/or Azure CLI. * Experience implementing observability, performance tuning, capacity management, high availability, and tested disaster recovery. * Hands\-on experience supporting production AI or data platform infrastructure, with the ability to explain its security, connectivity, scaling, and operational requirements. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex, cross\-platform issues and lead corrective action. * Experience leading technical implementations, mentoring engineers, and communicating architectural trade\-offs. Certifications Required * An active Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification, or the ability to obtain it within 12 months of hire, supported by demonstrated equivalent architecture and engineering experience. Preferred * Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, particularly for candidates with strong infrastructure automation and delivery\-pipeline responsibilities. Preferred qualifications * Experience with Azure\-hosted AI services, agent infrastructure, retrieval architectures, and secure model\-service connectivity. * Experience with Databricks infrastructure, workspace deployment, private networking, identity integration, and platform monitoring. * Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Policy, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Key Vault, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud. * Experience supporting Microsoft 365, Copilot, or Power Platform integrations and environment governance. * Experience in financial services or another regulated enterprise environment. * Experience developing shared platform services, self\-service engineering capabilities, and cloud cost\-management practices. At OnPoint, we believe a workplace that reflects the richness of the world fosters a welcoming and empowering environment for everyone. We're committed to equity and inclusion, and consider all qualified applicants embracing every race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and your unique background. We encourage you to apply if you're passionate about this opportunity and have the core qualifications. Your unique experiences and skills are what make you a strong candidate. Don’t let imposter syndrome hold you back! Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible to all. If you need any accommodations during the application or interview stage, please let us know. We're dedicated to providing what's necessary to ensure a fair and inclusive experience.

jobs.title: Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under guidance. Applies basic scalability requirements, conducts performance/load testing, and configures resiliency features (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts) to handle network variability. Builds telemetry, alerts, and runbook\-driven procedures; delivers scoped features and fault\-injection tests; and helps implement basic data replication and synchronization. Assists with on\-call rotations, uses automation/IaC scripts to troubleshoot, and follows change, security, and compliance procedures (encryption, access controls, remediation plans) while escalating complex issues to senior engineers. **Key Responsibilities** **System Design \& Architecture \- System Scalability:** Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. Optimizes code and/or systems for large\-scale data processing in large\-scale systems. Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large\-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. Implements performance and load testing. **System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Design:** Collaborates with team to build fault\-tolerant components capable of withstanding in\-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. **System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Performance:** Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures. Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures. Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. **System Design \& Architecture \- Correctness / Availability:** Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault\-injection, brown\-out) to evaluate system correctness. Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. **Operational Troubleshooting \& Incident Management:** Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. **Compliance \& Security:** Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi\-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security. Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up\-to\-date **Automation \& Change Management:** Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure. Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. **Responsibilities** As a Core Infrastructure Software Engineer, you will: * Design, develop, and operate highly available, scalable, and fault\-tolerant microservices across control plane, connectivity, distributed\-systems data plane, and Linux daemon technologies. * Contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from conceptualization and product definition through design, development, launch, and operational maturity. * Identify opportunities to automate engineering workflows across development, testing, troubleshooting, operations, and documentation, leveraging AI\-assisted and agentic approaches where appropriate. * Measure and improve reliability, delivery velocity, operational efficiency, customer outcomes, and engineering productivity, while sharing effective practices across the team. * You should be a hands\-on, adaptable, and self\-motivated engineer who learns quickly, applies new tools thoughtfully, and enjoys solving challenging high\-availability and scalability problems. **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience with systems or application development. * 3\+ years of experience with distributed systems or backend development. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related engineering field. * Proficiency with data structures, algorithms, and operating systems. * Experience with distributed systems, including familiarity with CAP theorem, consensus, messaging, and high availability. * Demonstrated willingness to learn and responsibly apply AI/LLM tools, skills, and automation to improve engineering workflows.

jobs.title: AI Ops Engineer (GTM)
jobs.description: Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work. Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades\-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo\-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual. Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate. **A bit about us:** We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on. Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250\+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose\-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal\-grade precision. We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date. We're trusted by 5,000\+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M\&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster. Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one. **The Role** We're rebuilding Orbital's go\-to\-market around AI. Not by adding another tool to the stack, but by rethinking how we find, win and grow customers from first principles. As an AI Ops Engineer (GTM) on our Revenue team, you'll sit with the people doing the work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product and Finance. You'll question how we work today, reimagine it from first principles with AI, and build what replaces it. You're essentially an internal forward deployed engineer. Over time, you'll help join up the whole business so every team works off the same data and foundations. The technology is changing every month. We want someone who finds new and unusual ways of doing things, and builds them so they keep working as the tools change. You'll report to the VP of RevOps. This role is for someone early in their career with exceptional raw ability: we care far more about how fast you learn and what you've built than about years of experience or job titles. **What you'll do** * Embed with revenue teams to understand how they work, and spot where AI and automation could change the outcome * Build AI agents, workflows and integrations that remove manual work and help teams make better decisions * Connect our systems (CRM, marketing, CS, product and finance data) so teams work from one trusted picture of the customer * Try new approaches, test them quickly with real users, and keep what works * Ship in short cycles and prove impact. Build the measures that show pipeline created, conversion lift and time saved * Build things to last: documented, maintainable and easy to adapt as models and tools change * Share what you learn and help colleagues get more out of AI **What you'll bring** * A strong academic background in a quantitative or technical subject (for example computer science, engineering, maths, physics or economics), or equivalent evidence of exceptional ability * Clear evidence that you build: side projects, tools, automations, a GitHub, a startup, hackathons, or things you've shipped at work * Hands\-on experience building with AI, such as LLM APIs, agents or AI coding tools * Some coding ability (for example Python, JavaScript or SQL) and comfort working with APIs * Exceptional problem\-solving: you break messy problems down, learn new things quickly and explain your thinking simply * Commercial instincts. You understand how pipeline is created, speak the language of AEs and marketers, and prioritise what moves revenue * Comfort with ambiguity and a strong sense of ownership in a lean, fast\-moving team **Nice to have** * Time in a customer\-facing, sales or consulting role * Experience with a CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce) or automation tools such as n8n, Zapier or Make * Experience at an early\-stage or fast\-growing startup **Salary:** $100,000 – $120,000 \+ equity \+ benefits (New York) **Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital.** We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on. **At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.** We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you. **This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting**. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements. *Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Help Build a New AI\-Native Operating Model** At Pfizer, we're investing in the future of AI\-enabled drug discovery. This role is about more than using AI to improve existing ways of working. We are building a new operating model in which small, highly capable teams combine human expertise with AI to achieve outcomes and move at a pace that previously required much larger organizations. We are looking for people who want to help invent and champion that model: individuals willing to rethink how work is organized, how problems are decomposed, what can be delegated to intelligent systems, and how humans and AI work together most effectively. Successful candidates will use AI not simply as a productivity tool, but as a means to fundamentally transform how scientific and technical work gets done—and will help others across R\&D adopt these new ways of working. **Why This Role Is Different** **Own Meaningful Problems** You'll own critical AI capabilities from architecture through production deployment. Rather than contributing to isolated components, you'll lead the design and delivery of end\-to\-end systems that directly enable scientific discovery. **Work Where AI Meets Real\-World Impact** The systems you build will support researchers tackling some of the toughest challenges in medicine, helping accelerate insights across discovery, development, and translational science. **Operate at the Frontier of AI** You will work across technologies and domains including: * Large Language Models (LLMs) * Agentic AI Systems * Multimodal Learning * Scientific Machine Learning * Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) * Knowledge Graphs * Distributed Training and Inference * AI Platforms and MLOps * AI Evaluation and Benchmarking **Accelerate Your Growth** You'll work alongside experts in AI, engineering, computational biology, and drug discovery while taking on increasing technical ownership and influence. **Build, Ship, Learn, Repeat** We value engineers who can move from ambiguity to execution, convert ideas into working systems, measure outcomes, and continuously improve based on real\-world feedback. **The Opportunity** As a Senior AI Research Engineer, you will build the machine learning systems that transform innovative models into secure, reliable, and scalable capabilities for scientists across Pfizer. You will: * Own an end\-to\-end subsystem, platform capability, or workflow * Make sound architecture and design tradeoff decisions * Deliver production\-quality software and AI solutions * Drive technical execution for complex projects * Influence engineering standards and best practices * Help less\-experienced engineers grow through collaboration, code reviews, and technical coaching Success in this role requires strong engineering fundamentals, demonstrated experience delivering production systems, and the ability to operate effectively in an environment where science, technology, and business impact intersect. **What You'll Do** **Build the AI Systems Behind Tomorrow's Scientific Breakthroughs** * Design, develop, and deploy production\-grade AI systems supporting multimodal biomedical models and intelligent agents * Engineer data pipelines, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, knowledge systems, inference services, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows * Create scalable software that enables AI capabilities to move beyond experimentation and into everyday scientific use **Own End\-to\-End Technical Delivery** * Translate scientific and business needs into technical solutions * Lead architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement for your area of ownership * Drive projects from concept through production and operational support **Turn Research Into Impact** * Partner closely with AI scientists, computational biologists, data engineers, and platform teams * Transform promising prototypes into reusable, reliable, and maintainable systems * Develop solutions with clear interfaces, measurable performance, and long\-term sustainability **Make Thoughtful Engineering Tradeoffs** * Balance performance, scalability, cost, reliability, security, privacy, maintainability, and speed of delivery * Apply sound engineering judgment when evaluating technical approaches and system architecture decisions **Build Trusted and Responsible AI** * Strengthen model evaluation, observability, reproducibility, lineage, security, and operational resilience * Implement practices that support responsible and trustworthy AI deployment within scientific environments **Raise the Engineering Bar** * Contribute to architecture reviews, code reviews, engineering standards, and reusable technical patterns * Troubleshoot complex problems and improve engineering quality across the organization * Provide guidance and support to less\-experienced engineers through collaboration and mentorship **Deliver Measurable Outcomes** * Define success metrics and operational indicators * Continuously improve pe fizer location and work on\-site an average of 2\.5 days per week. The annual base salary for this position ranges from $106,000\.00 to $176,600\.00\. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 15\.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. jobs.title: Facilities Technician
jobs.description: Quality Agents, LLC offers validation and quality expertise to the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. Our facilities technicians operate and maintain the clean and plant utility systems, HVAC and building infrastructure that keep GMP manufacturing, laboratory and storage spaces running at client sites, around the clock where the site requires it. Technicians work to the client's SOPs, cGMP and Good Documentation Practices, and to current regulations and industry practice. Our mission is to provide cost\-effective solutions by providing intelligent, driven resources to our clients, with superior quality and integrity. **The Role** The Facilities Technician operates, monitors and maintains the utility and facility systems of a GMP biopharmaceutical manufacturing facility that runs 24\-7\. The Technician works within a shift team under a Lead Facilities Technician, resolves alarms and routine issues independently, and documents all work to GMP standards. The role carries no supervisory responsibility. **Responsibilities** ***Operate and maintain the utilities*** * Operate and monitor purified water and WFI generation, storage and distribution systems (RO/EDI, distillation, storage tanks, hot loops, ozone and UV sanitization), and clean steam generators including steam quality parameters. * Maintain compressed air and process gas systems (nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide), including dryers, filters, manifolds and point\-of\-use assemblies. * Monitor and maintain cleanroom HVAC: air handling units, HEPA filtration, differential pressure, temperature and humidity control. * Operate the building management and environmental monitoring systems: respond to alarms, review data and record the actions taken. * Maintain the chillers, boilers, plant steam, heating hot water, glycol and other plant utilities that supply the clean systems, and support the UPS, normal and emergency power systems. * Perform rounds of mechanical rooms, utility spaces, cleanrooms, rooftops and cold storage to identify abnormal conditions before they become alarms. * Perform routine sanitization, passivation support and filter changes per approved procedures. * Respond to alarms and excursions, troubleshoot mechanical, electrical and controls faults, restore service and initiate deviations as required. ***Keep the records and stay compliant*** * Complete work orders, logbooks and preventive maintenance records in the site CMMS accurately and at the time of the work, following cGMP, SOPs and Good Documentation Practices. * Support requalification, calibration and periodic review of utility systems, and the commissioning of utility changes. * Take part in deviation investigations, root cause analysis and CAPA implementation. * Draft and revise SOPs, preventive maintenance tasks and work instructions, and support change controls for utility modifications. * Coordinate contractor work in GMP areas with proper gowning, permitting and oversight. * Follow EHS policies including lockout/tagout, confined space, hot work, permit\-to\-work and chemical handling, and keep a clean, organized and safe work area. * Comply with all applicable Quality Agents and client policies on health, safety and the environment. **What Good Looks Like** * Utility systems run within their limits; alarms are answered quickly, resolved and recorded. * Work orders, logbooks and PM records are complete, accurate and right first time. * Procedures are followed, and anything outside them is raised as a deviation, not worked around. * Dependable on shift, on weekends and holidays, and on call. * Works well with the shift team, the client's engineering staff and contractors. **Skills** * Hands\-on experience with GMP mechanical, electrical and HVAC systems. Experience with clean utilities (purified water, WFI, clean steam, compressed air, process gases) is strongly desired. * Ability to read P\&IDs, electrical schematics and equipment manuals. * Working knowledge of CMMS and building management or environmental monitoring platforms. * Troubleshooting across mechanical, electrical and controls systems. * Familiarity with cGMP (21 CFR Parts 210 and 211\), Good Documentation Practices and USP \<1231\> water quality requirements, or the ability to learn them quickly. * Clear written and verbal communication, including complete and legible records. **Minimum Requirements** * High school diploma or GED. * Able to work a rotating shift schedule including nights, weekends and holidays, and to take part in scheduled on\-call rotations. * Current driver's license and auto insurance, or other dependable means of transportation that allows you to reach the site within about two hours when on call. * Able to stand and walk for long periods, climb ladders and stairs, lift up to 50 pounds, and work in varying temperatures and noise levels while wearing PPE, including cleanroom gowning. **Preferred** * Technical trade school, military training or an associate degree in mechanical, electrical, HVAC or a related field. * Maryland Stationary Engineer license, boiler operator license, EPA Section 608 certification, Maryland journeyman electrician or HVAC license, or OSHA 10 or 30\. * Experience with deviations, change control or regulated investigations. **Typical Experience** Typically, 2 to 7 years of hands\-on facilities or utilities maintenance, with time in a GMP pharmaceutical, biotechnology or other regulated manufacturing site preferred. Experience ranges are a guide, not a requirement. Pay placement reflects experience and demonstrated performance. **Employment** Full\-time, hourly, non\-exempt, W\-2\. On site at a client biopharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Gaithersburg, MD. The facility operates 24\-7: the role works a rotating shift schedule that includes nights, weekends and holidays, and takes part in scheduled on\-call rotations. Overtime is paid for hours worked over 40 in a week. **Compensation and Benefits** Pay range: $34 to $42 per hour (about $70,700 to $87,400 per year at 2,080 hours), plus overtime. Placement within the range reflects experience and demonstrated skills. Full\-time employees are eligible for benefits including: * Health, dental and vision insurance * Life, AD\&D and disability insurance * Health savings account for participants in our health plan * 401k retirement plan * Paid time off * Paid holidays Incentive bonuses may be awarded depending on company profitability and individual contribution. Benefits are subject to plan documents and eligibility requirements. Quality Agents accepts applications on an on\-going basis in order to build a talent pool of potential candidates. These applications remain open for consideration, as positions become available, for one (1\) year from the date of application. After that time, or if your application information changes, please submit your application again. **Equal Opportunity \& Accessibility Statement** Quality Agents, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities throughout the application and hiring process. If you require assistance or accommodation, please contact us.

experience level, including: * Strong analytical, organizational, and technical problem\-solving skills. * Ability to interpret topographic information, engineering drawings, design files, and technical expertise. * Ability to identify technical challenges, communicate concerns, and seek appropriate guidance when necessary. * Ability to assist, guide, and mentor less\-experienced staff, as Candidates at the Assistant level should demonstrate the ability to learn and apply appropriate engineering software, while candidates at the Associate and Principal levels should demonstrate increasing proficiency in independently performing, evaluating, and reviewing technical analyses. **Rick Engineering Company (RICK) is an Equal Opportunity** Rick's employees are protected by laws designed to protect employees from discrimination on the bases of race, religion, color, sex, pregnancy, gender identity, sexual orientation, parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or any other non\-merit based factor. correspondence. ***Document Control, Submittals, and RFIs*** * Prepare, review, distribute, and track submittals in accordance with project requirements and established workflows. * Perform an initial velop working knowledge of project management, field operations, scheduling, cost control, contract administration, quality, safety, and closeout processes. **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor’s workflows. * Demonstrated attention to detail, reliability, initiative, and follow\-through. * Ability to work collaboratively with project management, field leadership, subcontractors, design partners, and internal teams. * Ability to work primarily from assigned project sites and travel to project locations as required. * Valid driver’s license required. **Core Competencies** ***RNGD Values Alignment*** * Exemplifies RNGD’s core values: * Renegade Mentality * Sweep Floors * Build Together * Honor Promises ***Project Coordination and Execution*** * Maintains awareness of project priorities, schedules, documentation, and assigned action items. * Coordinates information and follow\-up across project management, field operations, subcontractors, and design partners. * Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities and follows through to completion. ***Organization and Planning*** * Takes a systematic and organized approach to project tasks, records, deadlines, and communication. * Accurately estimates the time and level of effort required to complete assignments. * Anticipates upcoming needs and supports project leadership in maintaining schedule, budget, and workflow alignment. ***Technical Aptitude and Constructability Awareness*** * Reads and interprets construction drawings, specifications, submittals, schedules, and technical information. * Connects jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Location: San Antonio, Texas (on\-site)** **About Ranchflow** Ranchflow builds AI\-powered livestock monitoring and virtual fencing for ranchers. Solar\-powered GPS smart collars track location, monitor animal health, and use audio cues to keep cattle within virtual boundaries drawn in the Ranchflow app. There are no posts, wires, or fence maintenance. Alongside the collars, the Ranchflow Ranch Management Platform gives producers one place for records, grazing plans, and day\-to\-day operations. Founded by ranchers and technologists, Ranchflow turns years of field observation into AI insights that help producers catch illness early, run rotational grazing easily, and raise healthier herds. Ranchflow is headquartered in San Antonio, Texas with offices in Canada. Learn more at www.ranchflow.ai. Ranchflow is part of the Soilworks Natural Capital portfolio. **The Role** We’re looking for a hands\-on Software Engineer to take ownership of our software platform: our mobile and web applications, backend services, and cloud infrastructure. You’ll work closely with our founder and our hardware and firmware teams to turn product requirements into reliable, easy\-to\-use features, and help take the product from prototype through commercial deployment. This is an AI\-first seat: we expect you to use LLMs every day and to build lightweight tools and workflows that let a small team produce the output of a much larger one **What you’ll do** * Build and improve Ranchflow’s mobile app, web dashboard, backend services, and APIs. * Build features for livestock tracking, virtual fence management, paddock planning, grazing history, alerts, and device management. * Design reliable data flows between collars, gateways, cloud services, and user applications. * Work with the firmware team to define device communication interfaces, boundary updates, acknowledgements, and synchronization when connectivity is intermittent. * Develop map\-based tools for drawing and editing paddocks, viewing animal locations, and reviewing historical activity. * Improve onboarding, farm setup, collar pairing, and the overall farmer experience. * Own database design, cloud deployment, monitoring, security, and platform performance. * Establish practical standards for code reviews, automated testing, documentation, and release management. * Break product requirements into technical tasks and help coordinate delivery as the team grows. **Requirements** **What you’ll bring** * Two or more years of professional software development experience delivering production software used by real customers. * Strong full\-stack skills, including backend services, APIs, databases, and modern web or mobile applications. * Experience taking ownership of software architecture decisions. * Experience deploying and operating applications on a major cloud platform. * A strong understanding of authentication, access control, data security, and reliable system design. * Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, Git, and collaborative code reviews. * The ability to troubleshoot problems across applications, backend services, and connected systems. * Strong communication skills and comfort working in a small team where priorities evolve through field testing and customer feedback. **Nice to have** * Experience with IoT platforms, connected devices, or hardware\-integrated products. * Experience with mapping, geospatial databases, GPS data, or location\-based applications. * Experience with offline functionality, intermittent connectivity, and data synchronization. * Familiarity with device messaging protocols such as MQTT. * Experience with mobile app releases, device onboarding, Bluetooth, or NFC. * Exposure to agriculture, livestock management, or other field\-deployed technology. **Benefits** * Premier Health Insurance plan with $0 deductible and $0 co\-pay * Dental and vision insurance plans * Flexible spending account options * Open Paid Time Off Policy plus nine paid public holidays * Participation in our 401(k) savings plan * Company\-paid Life and AD\&D coverage * Educational materials and expenses to support related development **About Soilworks Natural Capital:** Ranchflow AI is proud to be a portfolio company of Soilworks Natural Capital, a private equity fund that invests in, incubates, and acquires companies to help accelerate the Regenerative Agriculture movement. Soilworks is on a mission to prove regenerative grazing is the most profitable way to ranch. Based in San Antonio, TX, Soilworks portfolio companies include Range Ward, Powerflex Supply, Cream Co., Grazing Lands, and Grassroots Carbon. *\*No visa sponsorship is available for this position\**

jobs.title: Mobile Engineer - Android (Early Career)
jobs.description: **Overview** **Mobile at RealDefense** RealDefense is bringing its protection to mobile. We're building privacy and security apps for iOS and Android that protect people on the device they use most and connect them with the RealDefense products and services they rely on across phone and computer. The apps run on one shared platform that powers several consumer brands. Features are built once and shared, while each app's navigation and experience are built natively, so it feels at home on iOS and on Android. It's an early\-stage team, so you'll help shape both the apps and the platform. **The role** We build consumer privacy and security apps for Android and iOS. Most of the code is shared Kotlin Multiplatform, with native code where each platform needs it. You'll take features from idea to Google Play: plan, build, test, ship and support them in production. You'll join a small, hands\-on team where engineers own features across both platforms. You'll work directly with our head of mobile, who sets the architecture, still writes code and mentors the team. You'll have a real say in technical decisions, grow your skills across Android, iOS and Kotlin Multiplatform, and take on more ownership as the platform grows. **What you'll do** Build Android privacy and security features that go deep into the platform, such as on\-device scanning and network filtering. Build subscriptions and accounts with Google Play Billing. Build shared Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform code that ships on both Android and iOS, and review both iOS and Android code. Own your features in production: Play Console releases, policy reviews, crash and log triage, performance and battery tuning with the Android Studio profilers, fixes. Work with AI coding agents every day: plan the work, keep each step small and tested, review what the agent writes. Write a short plan before you build and keep it current as the work changes. **What you bring (required)** A CS degree or equivalent practical experience, and 1\+ year of full\-time professional experience building Android apps in Kotlin. At least one app you helped ship to Google Play, from work or your own project, that you can walk us through end to end. Solid Kotlin, coroutines and Jetpack Compose fundamentals: you can write, test and debug a feature on your own, with unit and UI tests as part of how you ship. AI\-native development: you build with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agent mode or similar) every day, and can show how you plan, direct, review and test what they write. You can explain every line you ship, and you keep plans and docs current, so teammates and agents work from the same context. Willingness to learn Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform, and to work in Xcode and Swift when shared code runs on iOS. Based in the Los Angeles area and able to work from our office 3 days a week. **Nice to have (not required)** Personal apps, open source or hackathon projects you can show us. Android system features such as VpnService, background work, or sensitive permissions. Any Kotlin Multiplatform or Compose Multiplatform experience. Profiling memory, battery and startup time with the Android Studio profilers. Interest in privacy and security. **About RealDefense – Join a Team That's Making an Impact** Headquartered in Los Angeles, CA, RealDefense LLC is an award\-winning software development company known for its flagship product brands, including iolo System Mechanic® and SUPERAntiSpyware®. With a commitment to innovation, RealDefense has consistently earned top ratings from PC Magazine™ and protects over 3 million customers. The RealDefense portfolio also features renowned privacy and security software brands, including MyCleanID, MyCleanPC, USTechSupport, ioloVPN, GetMyDrivers, WarrantyStar, and Support.com. RealDefense partners with leading consumer brands in the cybersecurity and PC manufacturing sectors to deliver telemetry\-enabled monetization solutions. For more information, please visit **www.realdefen.se**. **How We Work – Our Core Values** * We Get It Done. * We Ask Questions. * We Like Our Job. * We Over\-Communicate. * We Prove Ourselves Every Day. **Equal Opportunity Employer** RealDefense is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, reproductive health decision\-making, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need an accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please contact us at hr@realdefen.se. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90045

Job Summary: The Manager, Technical Systems Infrastructure oversees and implements enterprise\-wide effectiveness and efficiency of the data center technology infrastructure including Compute, Storage, Backup \& Recovery, SAN fabric, and End\-User computing platforms. This role manages multiple teams of engineers and administrators within their department. Minimum Education: Bachelor’s degree required. Licensure, Registration and/or Certification: VMware, Microsoft, or similar certification, preferred. Work Experience: Minimum 5 years of related IT experience. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Working knowledge and proficiency with enterprise infrastructure technologies, including server platforms, virtualization and cloud infrastructure, storage area networks, enterprise storage systems, data protection and recovery solutions, end\-user computing (EUC) delivery technologies, and associated hardware and software. Working knowledge of network concepts and dependencies necessary to support enterprise infrastructure solutions. Knowledge of infrastructure architecture, capacity planning, performance management, high availability, disaster recovery, lifecycle management, system monitoring, and infrastructure security principles. Knowledge of information technology change, configuration, incident, and problem management practices. Ability to evaluate emerging technologies, assess technical risk, and develop infrastructure standards and technology roadmaps. Excellent technical and non\-technical oral and written communication skills. Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with attention to detail. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment while managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines. Ability to lead complex technical initiatives, coordinate effectively across technical teams and vendors, and communicate complex technology concepts, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non\-technical audiences. Essential Functions and Responsibilities: Develops and executes a comprehensive IT infrastructure strategy aligned with the company's objectives, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. Assesses current infrastructure and identifies areas for improvement, growth, and cost optimization. Manages day\-to\-day IT operations of the data\-center infrastructure environments. Ensure all proposed changes to IT systems are thoroughly reviewed, approved, implemented, and documented in accordance with established change control procedures. jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Edge AI
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** The Samsara AI team builds end\-to\-end AI solutions for our customers as well as core ML infrastructure for Samsara. As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will be working with petabyte\-scale sensor, diagnostic, video, and text data to solve critical problems for Physical Operations customers, globally. You will work closely with ML Engineers and Scientists, as well as full\-stack and firmware engineers to deliver core product features, services, and optimizations. **This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States. This position requires travel up to 5% of the time. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.** **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real\-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are a life\-long learner:** We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go. * **You believe customers are more than a number:** Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes. * **You are a team player:** Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win—together. #### **In this role, you will:** * Lead design and implementation of critical AI product initiatives on Edge devices. * Develop both tactical AI solutions as well as more strategic and longer term research. * Work with petabyte\-scale data from customer operations including text, transactions, diagnostics, sensor, camera, and location data. * Partner across business units to explore and prototype new AI experiences and optimize the ML model performance on edge devices. * Stay connected to industry and academic research and adopt novel technology that suits Samsara's needs. * Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices **Minimum requirements for the role:** * 8\+ years experience as a Machine Learning Engineer. * Profound experience in optimizing ML models and systems for Edge compute constraints. * Coding in python or similar. * Coding in C\+\+ or Rust. * Strong functional knowledge of the iterative machine learning product development process. * Experienced in developing and shipping production code at large scale. * Ability to distill informal or ambiguous customer and business requirements into crisp problem definitions. * Proven ability to communicate verbally and in writing to technical peers and leadership teams with various levels of technical knowledge. * Experience coaching and mentoring ML Engineers. **An ideal candidate also has:** * Proficiency in self\-serving with data for experiments and model training at scale. * An established record of successful high impact deliveries in AI. * Deep knowledge in state of the art Computer Vision and multi\-model models. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Developer
jobs.description: We’re currently looking for a Full Stack Software Developer to join our growing team of engineering and ergonomics professionals at Sandalwood Engineering \& Ergonomics. This role will support the design, development, integration, and deployment of secure web applications and backend services. Working with a collaborative technical team, this position will deliver reliable, maintainable software that supports business operations and provides a clear, accessible user experience. When you join the Sandalwood team, you’ll join an engaging and inclusive group with a mission to help our customers identify, assess, and reduce work\-related risks to quality, productivity, and employee health. In your day to day activities, you’ll work with multiple customers, as a consultant and trusted partner in Sandalwood’s areas of expertise of Injury Prevention, Systems Engineering \& Systems Integration. You’ll help customers innovate, solve their current struggles and guide them with the power of Sandalwood’s deeply ingrained subject matter expertise. You will have opportunities to help lead your own individual development with programs designed to guide you. Feeling you haven’t been recognized lately? You will have the chance to consistently appreciate your coworkers and be appreciated by your coworkers for continued distinction using our peer to peer appreciation and feedback software. You will be encouraged to participate in Sandalwood’s multitude of extra\-curricular activities including: * An innovative health, safety and wellness program * An internal innovation forum to guide and develop innovation initiatives * The all\-team meeting and staff day planning committee, dedicated to fostering team dynamics, collaboration and cross\-functional interactions * Participating in on\-campus and virtual recruiting * The social committee plans various get\-togethers for the team outside of work * Our cross\-line of business marketing committee assists with marketing planning, ideas and collaboration * The mentorship program provides a forum for mentors/mentees to connect and provide feedback, make connections and offer encouragement * Community involvement opportunities driven by our team’s background, our companies’ core values and community need Attributes to be successful * A dynamic professional with an engaging presence, a friendly demeanor, and strong interpersonal and organizational skills, capable of representing our brand with confidence in customer interactions. * Proven experience in business communication, including delivering presentations and producing professional documents. * Skilled at setting priorities, taking ownership of assignments, and thriving both independently and as part of a collaborative team. What you'll do Responsibilities * Designing and implementing web applications, backend services, and REST APIs * Developing responsive, accessible user interfaces that clearly communicate application data and system status * Implementing authentication, role\-based access, and secure data handling * Developing database transactions, audit trails, and integrations with external systems * Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to clarify requirements and deliver software solutions * Participating in Agile ceremonies and maintaining backlog items * Ensuring code quality through reviews, automated testing, and documentation * Supporting application deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and release readiness * Providing regular updates on completed work and deliverables * Preparing technical documentation and user guides **Requirements** * Proficiency in a backend programming language such as Java, C\#, Python, or a comparable language * Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern frontend framework * Experience developing REST APIs and working with relational databases, SQL, and transactional data processing * Working knowledge of application security, including token\-based authentication and authorization * Familiarity with automated testing, Git, and continuous integration and delivery pipelines * Strong understanding of software design principles, the software development lifecycle, and Agile methodologies * Candidates for this position must be legally authorized to work in the United States at time of application. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire and verified through E\-Verify. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with cloud\-based platforms, containerized applications, and infrastructure as code * Knowledge of enterprise identity providers and secure system integrations * Familiarity with event\-driven systems, concurrency controls, caching, and error recovery * Experience with accessibility standards, performance testing, and application monitoring * Experience in manufacturing, industrial, or other operational environments Candidates for this role with Sandalwood Engineering \& Ergonomics must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application, without sponsorship. Verification of employment eligibility will be conducted by E\-Verify at the time of hire. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status. If you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please call 734\-744\-9705\. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k) * Profit Sharing * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation \& Sick) * Public Holidays * Short Term \& Long Term Disability * Training \& Development * Support to grow in multiple areas

jobs.title: Software & Business Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Brief** ------------- Design, build, and support data\-driven applications, integrations, and reporting tools that strengthen operations across all divisions. Pay range: **$150k to $175k base plus incentive opportunity** Software \& Business Intelligence Engineer Onsite initially during orientation, then hybrid remote $150k to $175k annual base plus incentive bonus **Overview** ------------ Santa Monica Seafood is seeking a seasoned Software and Business Intelligence Engineer with a strong blend of software development/engineering, report writing, and business analysis expertise. The ideal candidate will also have hands\-on experience in accounting, the food industry, and business operations relevant to food production and distribution. This cross\-functional role will be instrumental in designing and implementing data\-driven solutions, streamlining operational workflows, and building custom software/reporting tools that empower strategic decision\-making across the organization. The successful candidate will be a member of a small team chartered to deliver and maintain multiple applications (sales, purchasing, finance, production, HR) focused on the internal business teams. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working closely with business teams and management to deploy solutions to all divisions of the company. This is a growth position with an expanding company and an opportunity to work with our business team to transform our business. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Software/Integration Developer** * Leverages strong understanding of business to develop high quality code to meet product/platform requirements. * Develop and maintain complex SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures. * Build scalable, secure enterprise applications. * Integrate emerging technologies including AI/ML. * Build integration solutions utilizing APIs. * Define and uphold best practices for coding, software architecture, and system integrations, conducting code check\-ins and code reviews to maintain high development standards. * Collaborate cross\-functionally on solutions and systems integration. * Adopt best practices and innovative software design methodologies. * Use tools such as SQL Profiler to trace transaction activity, identify affected tables, and troubleshoot system locks and/or performance issues. * Monitor cloud and on\-prem BSA assets (AWS, Azure, custom apps). ### **Report Writing Duties** * Analyze business requirements and convert them into functional specifications. * Create and maintain Power BI dashboards and ERP reports. * Ensure data consistency across platforms (e.g., ERP, CRM, databases). This includes data normalization and standardization. * Monitor KPIs and deliver actionable insights. * Utilize tools such as SQL profiler to translate end user transactions to affected tables for effective report writing. * Setup and maintain data exchange gateways such as Power BI Gateways. * Train users on Power BI and troubleshoot data/reporting issues. ### **Business Analyst** * Conduct gap analysis, process modeling, and document workflows. * Support M\&A, company expansions, and new business startups. * Compose internal and external SOPs, user guides, videos, and documentation. * Participate in development and execution of effective training programs. * Promote automation to replace manual processes and implement changes to improve processes and workflows. * Consult with VP of Enterprise Solutions and other department leadership regarding ongoing process improvements or changes, potential impact of those changes. * Provide helpdesk support to business operation. * Demonstrate ability to manage conflicting priorities and challenging situations. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Proven experience in software development, reporting, and business analysis. * Strong in SQL (Transact\-SQL), Python, Power BI, cloud platforms, C, C\+\+, C\#, .NET. * Experience with Microsoft BI Stack: SSRS, SSIS, SSAS. * Expertise in data modeling, data warehousing, ETL processes. * Background in accounting or financial reporting. * Proven experience in fast\-paced environments with tight deadlines. * Familiarity with integrations. * Hands\-on with cloud databases (Azure SQL DB, MS SQL DB). * Solid experience in automated testing and QA. * AI/ML experience * BS degree in computer science, software engineering, or information technology. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Full Stack Development skills. * Hands\-on accounting experience. * Experience in perishables or food industry operations * MCP integration Join Santa Monica Seafood and build your career with a company that has earned its reputation through decades of steady growth and doing things the right way**.** We offer competitive pay, strong benefits, and a workplace where people stay because they’re respected and given room to succeed. If you’re ready to be part of a team that values hard work and reliability, we’d like to meet you.

The role centers on project management leadership: planning, governance, risk management, and keeping stakeholders aligned. Familiarity with modern data and analytics platforms such as Databricks or Snowflake is a strong advantage, since many of our initiatives involve data platform implementations and migrations. The ideal candidate takes projects from concept through execution and keeps cross\-functional teams aligned. They are technical enough to work credibly with engineers and architects without needing to be one. **Key Responsibilities** *Project Leadership* * Lead end\-to\-end delivery of technical projects, including platform implementations, migrations, and modernization efforts * Define scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables, and manage changes through a defined change control process * Build
