jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Seamless** Seamless is building the future of AI\-powered revenue generation. Sales professionals use our platform to identify prospective buyers, improve contact and company data, and create pipeline more efficiently. By combining proprietary data, artificial intelligence, and modern go\-to\-market technology, Seamless helps organizations connect with the right people and accelerate revenue growth. We are continuing to invest in our platform, our AI capabilities, and the team required to define the next generation of sales technology. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Seamless is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Visa sponsorship is not included in our hiring package. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. **Why Seamless** ---------------- Seamless is building the future of AI\-powered sales and revenue technology. Our platform brings together real\-time B2B data, artificial intelligence, sales engagement, enrichment, automation, buyer signals, AI agents, APIs, integrations, and workflow capabilities to help revenue teams find the right buyers, improve contact and company data, personalize outreach, create pipeline, and convert more opportunities into revenue. As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer at Seamless, you will have the opportunity to: * Own meaningful features from concept through production, with a direct impact on the experience of our users. * Build scalable, high\-performing applications and services that support our data search engine and social profiling platform. * Work across our web application, Chrome extension, and connected services rather than being limited to one part of the stack. * Shape technical solutions with autonomy, collaborating closely with product managers and a lean remote engineering team. * Ship quality code iteratively, solve customer problems, and help evolve a platform that handles large volumes of data and concurrent requests. At Seamless, you’ll work with a team that values simple solutions, thoughtful engineering, strong ownership, and the ability to deliver meaningful results. **The Opportunity** You’ll join Seamless’s Technology organization as part of a lean, full stack engineering team. Your work will help advance our data search engine and social profiling platform, supporting the tools customers use to find and connect with the right buyers. You’ll take ownership of features from early requirements through deployment and post\-launch improvement. Our architecture includes a customer\-facing web application, a Chrome extension, and connected services, giving you the opportunity to contribute across the product and its underlying systems. You’ll build responsive interfaces with React and modern JavaScript while designing scalable backend services that handle large datasets and concurrent requests. You’ll collaborate with product and engineering partners, make sound technical decisions, and ship practical solutions without unnecessary complexity. **What You’ll Own** * Own full stack projects and deliverables from concept through production. * Build scalable, performant user interfaces using React, ES6/7 JavaScript, Webpack, HTML, CSS, and related modern tools. * Design, develop, and implement microservices that handle large volumes of concurrent requests and data. * Create JSON schemas and user experience workflows that support business processes involving hundreds of millions of records. * Translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions that address user needs. * Ship high\-quality, finished code frequently through iterative development and MVP delivery. * Develop complete features with substantial autonomy while communicating clearly with remote teammates. * Drive end\-to\-end development from initial brief through post\-launch analysis in partnership with product managers and technical stakeholders. * Support and improve experiences across web applications, browser extensions, and mobile platforms. **What You’ll Bring** Required Qualifications: * Ideally 5\+ years of experience building high\-quality, cloud\-based web applications. * 5\+ years of expertise in modern frontend technologies, including React, ES6/7 JavaScript, Webpack, HTML, and CSS. * 2\+ years of experience with backend technologies including Node.js, Express, Postgres, and AWS. * Experience working with large datasets using S3, Athena, OpenSearch, or similar services. * Strong SQL skills and an analytical approach to problem\-solving. * Experience working with internal APIs and integrating third\-party APIs. * Experience with React Hooks and other modern React features. * Ability to create clear documentation for new and existing features and functionality. * Experience developing software using AI\-assisted tools such as Claude and Cursor. Preferred Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree. * UI/UX design specialization. * Experience developing Chrome extensions. * Experience with web scraping. **Benefits** At Seamless, we invest in our employees by offering a comprehensive benefits package designed to support health, financial well\-being, work\-life balance, and professional growth. Eligible employees have access to benefits that currently include: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options * 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions * Company\-paid life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment, and short\-term disability coverage * Voluntary supplemental insurance options * Employee Assistance Program * Annual wellness reimbursement * Paid time off, company holidays, and paid parental leave for birthing and non\-birthing parents * Remote\-first work environment * Employee discount and perks program * Professional development, ongoing learning, coaching, and career\-growth opportunities Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable plan documents and may be modified by Seamless at any time.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II (Full Stack)
jobs.description: At Shutterfly, we make life's experiences unforgettable. We believe there is extraordinary power in the self\-expression. That's why our family of brands helps customers create products and capture moments that reflect who they uniquely are. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) with a strong passion for building high\-quality, scalable user experiences backed by reliable backend services. While this role spans the full stack, the primary focus is on designing, implementing, testing, and evolving complex frontend systems that power rich, interactive applications \- with meaningful contributions to the backend services that support them. Ideal split for the role will be 80% frontend and 20% backend. The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of modern UI architecture alongside solid backend experience, strong engineering fundamentals, and a firm computer science foundation \- including data structures, algorithms, and performance considerations relevant to large\-scale client and server applications. You will work on sophisticated single\-page applications that require careful state management, rendering performance, and seamless integration with the backend services you help build and maintain. You are expected to work independently, take ownership of features end\-to\-end across the stack, and contribute to technical design decisions. You should have excellent problem\-solving and organizational skills, along with hands\-on experience with Test\-Driven Development (TDD) and Agile development practices. What You'll Do: * Develop and maintain scalable, high\-performance web applications across the full stack using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, GraphQL, Java, Spring Boot, and Python. * Build rich, interactive user experiences, including canvas\-based rendering and custom UI workflows for personalized product creation (e.g., photo books, SVG layouts). * Own frontend features end\-to\-end \- from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch support. * Design, develop, and maintain backend services, domain services, and RESTful/GraphQL APIs that support frontend capabilities. * Optimize frontend performance across rendering, memory usage, network efficiency, and bundle size. * Contribute to architecture decisions spanning state management, data\-fetching strategies, SSR/CSR tradeoffs, and API design. * Apply Test\-Driven Development (TDD) practices using Jest and modern component/integration testing frameworks. * Ensure applications meet accessibility (WCAG), security, and privacy compliance standards. * Collaborate closely with designers, backend engineers, and product stakeholders to deliver cohesive user experiences. * Participate actively in code reviews, raising quality, consistency, and maintainability across the codebase. * Deploy and operate services in AWS\-based environments, working with CI/CD pipelines. * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools where appropriate to improve developer productivity and software quality. Required Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience with a primary focus on frontend development and meaningful backend experience. * Expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, CSS3, and GraphQL. * Working knowledge in Java, Spring Boot, Python or similar technologies for backend development. * Comprehensive understanding of frontend architecture, single\-page application (SPA) design, and modern rendering patterns. * Hands\-on experience with canvas rendering, custom UI engines, or performance\-critical frontend components. * Strong computer science foundation, including data structures, algorithms, and performance analysis. * Experience designing and integrating with RESTful and GraphQL APIs. * Proven track record in Test\-Driven Development and automated testing using tools like Jest. * Familiarity with cloud\-based deployments, especially AWS. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision. * Demonstrated success in building maintainable, scalable, and cost\-effective solutions across the stack. * Adaptable to evolving product requirements and technical constraints while balancing user experience, engineering excellence, and long\-term maintainability. * A mindset of continuous improvement \- bringing forward ideas that promote modern engineering standards, tooling, and best practices. Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar. * Experience working with LLMs (Large Language Models) and generative AI applications, including prompt engineering and fine\-tuning strategies. * Experience building frontend build, deployment, and CI/CD workflows. * Experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ. * Experience with workflow engines. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform. Supporting a diverse and inclusive workforce is important to Shutterfly not only because it directly reflects our value of Embracing our Differences, but also because it's the right thing to do for our business and for our people. We welcome all applicants and evaluate them based on their qualifications. Learn more about our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion on our Career Site. This position will accept applications on an ongoing basis until filled. The compensation package for this role is based on multiple factors, such as job level, responsibilities, location, and candidate experience. The base pay ranges included below are specific to the locations listed, and may not be applicable to other locations. California : \[$117,750\-166,000] Connecticut and New York: \[$117,750\-152,000] Colorado, Illinois, Minnesota and Washington: \[$117,750\-140,750] Nevada: \[$110,500\-152,000] Maryland and New Jersey: \[127,250\-152,000] Hawaii : \[$110,500\-132,250] This position may be eligible for a bonus incentive, health benefits, a 401K program, and other employee perks. More details about our company benefits can be found at https://shutterflyinc.com/benefits/. This opportunity can be remote, but candidates must reside in a state in which Shutterfly is registered to do business. This includes all US states except District of Columbia, North Dakota, Mississippi, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Wyoming. This position will accept applications on an ongoing basis until filled. \#SFLYTechnology

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer AI (Contractor)
jobs.description: **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we're part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. *Agentic \& AI Engineering* * + Design, build, and operate production\-quality agentic applications using agentic SDKs/harnesses — including multi\-agent orchestration, subagent delegation, tool integration, and lifecycle hooks. + Design Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool and resource interfaces that give coding agents/harnesses safe, reliable access to backend systems and enterprise data. + Engineer prompts for reliable structured output (JSON schemas, few\-shot examples, validation/retry loops) and build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve output quality. + Manage context effectively across long documents, multi\-turn conversations, and multi\-agent handoffs; design escalation and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns for production reliability. *Developer Productivity* * + Configure and extend Codex/Claude Code for team\-wide use: AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md hierarchies, custom slash commands, Agent Skills, path\-specific rules, and plan mode. + Integrate agentic development into CI/CD pipelines for automated code review, test generation, and PR feedback, tuned to minimize false positives and duplicate findings. + Build and maintain MCP server integrations (project\- and user\-scoped) that extend agent\-native development capabilities across engineering workflows. + Identify high\-value opportunities for AI\-assisted development and design reusable capabilities that multiple teams can adopt, not just one\-off solutions. *Discovery, Prototyping \& Production Delivery* * + Partner directly with engineering teams to understand workflows, pain points, and opportunities through hands\-on discovery. + Rapidly prototype and validate new AI capabilities with real users, then take successful prototypes into secure, observable, maintainable production systems. + Own the full lifecycle: implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. *Technical Leadership* * + Provide hands\-on technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, and troubleshooting of agentic systems. + Mentor engineers on agentic design patterns, prompt engineering, and agent\-native development practices. + Communicate tradeoffs, risks, and results clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. + Contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, and documentation that help other teams build effectively with agentic development tools. Requirements * + 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands\-on work building and operating AI/LLM\-powered or agentic applications. + Strong programming skills (Java, Python, Go, Rust, or C\+\+) and solid engineering fundamentals — API design, testing, debugging, code review, maintainable code. + Practical, production\-grade experience with agentic SDKs/harnesses, MCP, and LLMs — tool use, orchestration, RAG, context management, structured output, and evaluation. + Experience designing MCP tool/resource interfaces and reasoning about tool selection, error handling, and reliability in multi\-agent systems. + Demonstrated experience integrating AI into CI/CD and developer workflows. + Ability to work in ambiguous problem spaces, evaluate tradeoffs, and make pragmatic engineering decisions. + Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience mentoring and leading through influence. + Build and maintain an engineering knowledge base for agentic workflows, including content ingestion, organization, updates, and retrieval. Connect it to agents through RAG and MCP so they can use trusted, current information with source citations. jobs.title: AI Implementation Engineer & Project Coordinator
jobs.description: **Allocation:** 50% project coordination and client delivery; 50% on\-premises Document AI solution implementation **Reporting:** Project/Account Lead for client delivery; AI Architect/Technical Lead for solution implementation **Location:** Albuquerque, NM , with periodic client site visits (10% Travel) **Role purpose** This role has two parts. The first is coordinating client document\-processing projects: workload scheduling, client communication, production reporting and delivery reconciliation. The second is turning business and document\-processing requirements into clear specifications, then validating the on\-premises Document AI solution and supporting its integration, deployment and operational readiness. The role works closely with the AI Architect, who owns technology selection and architecture, and with the offshore development team, which owns Python application development. **Project coordination and client delivery (50%)** 1\. Planning and workload management * Work with client managers to schedule work based on delivery priorities, available capacity and agreed deadlines. * Keep a delivery tracker covering intake, owners, due dates, dependencies, risks and open issues. * Coordinate internal resources and production teams so delivery commitments are met. * Find schedule risks early and propose ways to reduce them. 2\. Client communication and governance * Report project status, delivery progress, delays and any decisions the client needs to make. * Prepare and send weekly production and delivery reports. * Hold status meetings and keep meeting notes, action items and decision logs. * Visit client sites periodically to review each department’s scope, document types, extraction requirements, naming conventions, folder structures and acceptance criteria. 3\. Delivery reconciliation and quality * Reconcile opening backlog and new intake against work that is completed, delivered, rejected, on hold or outstanding. * Check delivery counts and identifiers, look into missing, duplicate or inconsistent records, and report any discrepancies. * Keep audit\-ready records of what was delivered, when it was accepted and how issues were resolved. 4\. Scope and change management * Keep a register of requirements and change requests. * Get written agreement from the designated owners before scope or delivery changes take effect. * Turn approved client requirements into implementation tasks with testable acceptance criteria. **Document AI solution implementation (50%)** 1\. Requirements and functional specifications * Gather and document requirements for document intake, classification, extraction, validation, reconciliation, search and reporting. * Define document types, metadata fields, extraction rules, naming conventions, folder structures and expected outputs. * Prepare source\-to\-target mappings, sample input and output datasets, workflow descriptions and acceptance criteria. * Turn approved requirements into development tasks, answer the development team’s questions, and keep requirements traceable to what gets built. 2\. SQL, data validation and reconciliation * Write SQL queries and approved database routines for validation, reconciliation, exception analysis and reporting. * Define validation rules for completeness, format, lookups, duplicates and consistency across documents. * Check processing results against source documents and expected outputs. * Prepare exception reports with supporting evidence and track each issue until it is resolved. 3\. Integration testing and solution quality * Test the document\-processing workflows, APIs, database outputs and integrations the development team delivers. * Build representative test datasets that cover document variations, poor OCR quality, missing information, duplicates and conflicting values. * Score extraction and retrieval results against agreed reference answers, and confirm that outputs keep source\-document and page references. * Test retries, reprocessing, interrupted jobs and human\-review workflows. * Log defects so they can be reproduced, coordinate the fixes, and confirm the corrected behavior. 4\. On\-premises deployment and operational support * Support environment setup and deployment, following the architecture and procedures the AI Architect has approved. * Coordinate installation prerequisites, configuration, database connectivity, internal endpoints and access requirements. * Run deployment checklists, check service health and confirm processing works end to end, including offline operation where required. * Monitor processing, review logs, investigate failures and escalate issues as needed. * Maintain configuration records, operating procedures, troubleshooting guides and release checklists. 5\. Development coordination and user acceptance * Manage the implementation backlog, priorities and dependencies with the offshore development team, and report progress against milestones. * Run solution demonstrations and user acceptance testing (UAT). * Record user feedback and separate defects from new requirements. * Prepare release\-readiness evidence for sign\-off, and provide user training and operational handover. Qualifications (suggested) * Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. * 4\+ years of combined experience in project coordination and technical implementation, preferably in document management, ECM or data processing. * Strong SQL skills and experience with data validation and reconciliation. * Familiarity with OCR, document classification, data extraction and AI/ML\-based document processing. * Experience working with offshore development teams and running UAT. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience in client\-facing roles. * PMP, CAPM or Agile certification is a plus. Pay: $20\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Expected hours: 30\.0 – 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Agentic Infrastructure, liftlab - Stanford Law School
jobs.description: **Stanford Law School Salary Budgeted Range: $117,536 \- $165,000** **Job Description** **Research Engineer, Agentic Infrastructure** **Legal Innovation through Frontier Technology Lab (liftlab), Stanford Law School** Stanford Law School’s Legal Innovation through Frontier Technology Lab (liftlab) is seeking a Research Engineer to design and implement the software systems that make the lab’s research possible. Working at the intersection of software engineering, computational research, and agentic AI, the engineer will build infrastructure for coordinating research agents, rapidly provisioning research environments, and running large\-scale empirical experiments. The Research Engineer reports to the lab Directors, Prof. Julian Nyarko and Dr. Megan Ma. The Directors collaboratively design the research agenda, study designs, and methodological requirements. The engineer develops the technical response to that design: assessing feasibility, contributing architectural and implementation ideas, translating research specifications into working systems, and iterating with the scientist as findings and requirements evolve. The successful candidate will combine strong programming and systems architecture skills with an understanding of research methods and reproducibility. They will build modular, configurable infrastructure that allows researchers to vary models, datasets, agent strategies, and experimental conditions without rebuilding workflows from scratch. Their responsibilities will span the software development lifecycle, from technical design and prototyping through testing, deployment, maintenance, and performance optimization. Developing classifiers and baseline models will be part of a broader responsibility to turn collaboratively developed research ideas into reliable, adaptable computational capabilities. **Your Duties Will Include:** * **Research Collaboration and Technical Design:** Translate research designed with the Directors and other research scientists into technical specifications, implementation plans, and deliverable milestones. Assess feasibility, identify computational constraints, explain technical tradeoffs, and contribute design feedback that informs continued research development. * **Agentic Infrastructure and Software Development:** Design and implement modular systems for deploying and coordinating research agents, integrating models and tools, managing data, and executing experiments. Develop reusable interfaces and configuration\-driven workflows that accommodate changes in research questions, methods, and experimental conditions. * **Research Environments and Scalable Experimentation:** Rapidly provision reproducible computing environments with appropriate software, dependencies, and data access. Build parallel or distributed experiment pipelines that support comparisons across datasets, models, prompts, and agent strategies, with appropriate logging, checkpointing, and recovery mechanisms. * **Computational Methods and Validation:** Implement classifiers, baseline models, analytical tools, and evaluation harnesses as research needs require. Read research papers and associated source code, test implementations against reference results, and collaborate with the research scientists and fellows to investigate discrepancies and validate computational behavior. * **Software Quality and Reproducibility:** Lead code review, automated testing, debugging, change control, and technical documentation. Establish practices for tracking code, data, model, configuration, and environment versions so that experiments can be reproduced and results traced to their computational inputs. * **Operations and Performance:** Maintain, troubleshoot, and upgrade research applications and infrastructure. Diagnose complex failures, evaluate libraries and platform changes, and optimize runtime, data access, scheduling, and resource use while preserving experimental conditions and reproducibility. * **Technical Leadership and Collaboration:** Lead engineering delivery, exercising independent technical judgment within agreed research requirements and priorities. Mentor research staff as needed; develop clear implementation guides; and collaborate with computing and data professionals on development standards, deployment practices, and infrastructure planning. **Preferred Education** * A Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, computational methods, or a related field, strongly preferred. PhD in computer science, software engineering, data science, computational methods, or a related field, would be ideal. **Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Strong programming skills in Python and the ability to select, adapt, and quickly learn appropriate scientific programming tools and libraries. * Demonstrated ability to design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain complex software systems. * Strong understanding of modular software architecture, API integrations, data architecture, and data modeling. * Ability to rapidly configure reproducible research environments and resolve complex software dependency and installation issues. * Experience with scalable data processing, parallel or distributed execution, and performance optimization. * Working knowledge of research design, statistics, and machine learning sufficient to implement and test computational methods in collaboration with researchers. * Strong code review, debugging, quality control, and documentation skills, with attention to computational accuracy and reproducibility. * Ability to translate evolving research specifications into reusable technical capabilities and communicate feasibility constraints and design tradeoffs clearly. * Ability to plan engineering work, deliver against agreed milestones, and collaborate effectively with researchers and technical colleagues. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience designing, implementing, or evaluating LLM\-based or agentic AI systems, including tool integrations, workflow orchestration, and evaluation frameworks. * Experience building reusable infrastructure for large\-scale empirical experiments, including configurable pipelines, containerized environments, and reliable execution across computing platforms. * Experience with advanced statistical or machine learning methods, or demonstrated ability to learn and implement such methods quickly. * Experience reading research papers and associated code to support replication, computational validation, and evaluation. * Experience with R or other scientific programming languages in addition to Python. Experience mentoring developers or research staff and establishing shared practices for software quality, documentation, and reproducible research **Core Duties** : * Conceptualize design, implement, and develop solutions for complex systems/programs. * Work with a variety of users to gain information, and develop intra\-system tradeoffs between different users, as necessary; interact with a diverse client base and outside vendor contacts. * Document system builds and application configurations; maintain and update documentation as needed. * Provide technical analysis, design, development, conversion, and implementation work. * Work as a project leader, as needed, for projects of moderate complexity. * Serve as a technical resource for applications. * Compare, evaluate, and implement new features and technologies, and integrate them into the computing environment. * Follow team software development methodology. * Mentor junior software developers. **Minimum Education and Experience:** Bachelor's degree and five years of relevant experience, or a combination of education and relevant experience. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** : * Expertise in designing, developing, testing, and deploying applications. * Proficiency with application design and data modeling. * Ability to define and solve logical problems for highly technical applications. * Effective communication skills with both technical and non\-technical clients. * Ability to lead activities on structured team development projects. * Ability to select, adapt, and effectively use a variety of programming methods. * Knowledge of application domain.

jobs.title: Data Analytics and Systems Engineer (Systems Engineer II) - 61167545
jobs.description: **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ ***The mission of the South Carolina Department of Education is to serve students, support teachers, empower parents, and engage the community so that every student graduates prepared to reach their full potential.*** **About the Role** You’ll turn complex education data and business needs into reports, dashboards, and working data systems that people can use. The work spans data analysis and systems development. You’ll query and transform data, investigate discrepancies, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and build tools that replace manual spreadsheets and email workflows. Applications may include data validation tools, searchable registries, workflow interfaces, and self\-service reporting tools. AI\-assisted development is a core part of the role. You’ll use approved AI coding tools to accelerate development while taking responsibility for understanding, reviewing, testing, debugging, and improving the resulting code. We are not looking for someone who simply generates code and assumes it works. We want someone who can determine whether a solution is accurate, secure, maintainable, and ready for others to use. **What You’ll Do** * **Build dashboards, reports, and interactive analytical data products.** Develop practical tools that support data analysis, validation, reporting, and agency workflows. * **Use AI tools responsibly throughout development.** Translate requirements into clear development tasks, guide AI\-generated implementations, inspect the code, and refine solutions through testing and user feedback. * **Read, test, and debug code.** Understand how code components interact, identify defects, verify calculations and business rules, and test normal use, edge cases, and failure conditions. * **Work with enterprise data.** Write and maintain SQL queries against data warehouses and source systems. Use scripts and APIs to retrieve, transform, validate, and connect data. * **Investigate data quality issues.** Trace discrepancies across systems, determine appropriate sources, document root causes, and coordinate resolution. * **Replace manual processes with maintainable solutions.** Turn recurring spreadsheet, email, and data\-processing tasks into reusable scripts, automated workflows, or applications. * **Translate business needs into technical requirements.** Work with SCDE staff, districts, and technical partners to clarify the problem, define expected behavior, and validate the finished solution. * **Maintain and support what you build.** Use version control, document dependencies and business rules, and coordinate deployment and changes with appropriate technical teams. * **Protect sensitive information.** Apply appropriate access controls and follow agency security, privacy, and data\-handling requirements, including requirements governing approved AI tools. * Communicate findings clearly, track assigned deliverables, and perform other duties as assigned. This position is located in the Office of Information Technology. **Minimum and Additional Requirements** --------------------------------------- A bachelor's degree in computer science or related field and experience in computer system development and modification in either an on\-premises, cloud\-based, or hybrid environment. Relevant experience may substitute for the bachelor's degree on a year\-for\-year basis. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Working knowledge of SQL and experience analyzing or transforming data. * Familiarity with Python, JavaScript, JSON, . * Enough software development knowledge to read and explain code, test its behavior, identify problems, and debug AI\-generated implementations. * Understanding of basic application concepts, including user interfaces, databases, APIs, authentication, authorization, and error handling. * Ability to build a working solution from a business need and validate it against defined requirements. * Strong analytical judgment, clear communication, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems independently. * Experience may be demonstrated through professional work, academic projects, or substantive personal projects. * Experience with Snowflake, SQL Server, or similar database platforms. * Experience with Power BI, Preset/Apache Superset, or comparable visualization tools. * Experience building usable data products with AI\-assisted coding tools. * Experience integrating applications with APIs and managing configuration and credentials securely. * Experience documenting data definitions, mappings, business rules, and analytical methods. * Familiarity with K–12 education data, PowerSchool, Ed\-Fi, or education reporting. * Familiarity with React, Streamlit, or comparable frameworks. * Familiarity with Git, automated testing, application deployment, and ongoing maintenance. You do not need to know every tool listed. We are looking for strong fundamentals, sound judgment, and the ability to build and support solutions people will actually use. **Additional Comments** ----------------------- **How We Work** We value practical solutions over unnecessary complexity. AI can accelerate development, but it does not replace understanding the problem, checking the data, reviewing the code, or testing the result. The goal is not simply to produce a prototype. It is to deliver a useful, tested, documented solution that can be maintained after its initial release. **Application Prompt** Describe an application, analytical tool, or automation you built. Explain the problem it solved, your contribution, how you tested it, and how you used AI tools, if applicable. A sanitized example or project description is welcome; do not submit confidential data or proprietary code. As a part of a generous compensation package, we offer comprehensive benefits that include generous paid time off, preeminent health care benefits, professional development opportunities, pension, a 401(k), and a hybrid work schedule with opportunity for remote work. The South Carolina Department of Education offers an exceptional benefits package that includes: * Health, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance for Employee, Spouse, and Children. * 15 days annual (vacation) leave per year. * 15 days sick leave per year. * 13 paid holidays. * State Retirement Plan and Deferred Compensation Programs. ONLY THOSE APPLICANTS CHOSEN FOR AN INTERVIEW WILL BE NOTIFIED BY LETTER THAT THE POSITION HAS BEEN FILLED. http://www.ed.sc.gov/jobs/human\-resources/title\-ix\-nondiscrimination/

Platform Developer II or Platform App Builder a plus. * Proficiency in full\-stack web development with React and TypeScript on the frontend and C\# or Python on the backend. * Experience designing, building, and troubleshooting APIs and system integrations. * Experience building and deploying applications on Microsoft Azure (App Service, Azure Functions, Container Apps, Azure SQL, Entra ID), ideally using infrastructure\-as\-code (Bicep). * Relational database design and SQL development experience in Azure SQL or SQL Server. * Proficiency with source control and CI/CD tooling (GitLab, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), including source\-driven Salesforce deployment (Salesforce DX). * Familiarity with Agile delivery, code review discipline, and automated testing. * Familiarity with accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG) for public\-facing web applications. * Experience in state government, K–12 education, or a similarly regulated environment, including student data privacy requirements (FERPA). * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Additional Comments** ----------------------- **WORKING CONDITIONS** * Primary location: Columbia, SC. * On\-call availability may be required for mission\-critical system incidents. * Background check required. *The South Carolina Department of Education is an Equal Opportunity Employer.* As a part of a generous compensation package, we offer comprehensive benefits that include generous paid time off, preeminent health care benefits, professional development opportunities, pension, and a 401(k). jobs.title: Manager, AI/ML Engineering
jobs.description: **Role Summary:** The Manager of AI/ML Engineering \- North America leads a team of AI/ML engineers and delivers alongside them. This is a deliberate player\-coach role: you manage, coach, and grow the team *and* stay hands\-on \- personally designing, building, and shipping complete production AI/ML solutions, including the user touchpoints and applications on top of them. You are the delivery anchor for this team: you own the team's commitments and their production health, take the hardest solutions yourself, set the technical bar, and raise the craft of the engineers around you. The role is engineering\-first \- you lead by building \- and balances a team rooted in data science and ML with strong software and solution\-delivery depth. The team operates in a global environment and there is functional interaction across regions. **How We Operate:** Our products are owned end\-to\-end by engineering \- from design through production and into maintain\-and\-optimize. Direction, requirements, and priorities come through our program and product\-management partners. This is a deliberate operating model: the role succeeds through strong delivery inside that partnership \- shaping requirements, pushing back with evidence, and building trust \- not through sole control of product direction. Leaders here own products and stay close to the work; this is not a pass\-through people\-management position \- you are expected to contribute code and solutions directly. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Team leadership \& growth** * Lead and manage an AI/ML engineering team of engineers \- day\-to\-day direction, coaching, performance, and career development. Some of these engineers may functionally work on programs outside your direct remit, and you will manage engineers that contribute to your programs from other regions. * Contribute to hiring: interview, raise the bar on engineering craft, and help grow the team through the active pipeline. * Develop engineers toward the full\-stack AI/ML profile (data, modeling, services, application layers); mentor through code review and pairing. * **Hands\-on delivery (player\-coach)** * Personally own and ship hard solutions end\-to\-end \- data pipelines, model/inference services, agentic/LLM components, APIs, and the user touchpoints (apps, dashboards) on top. * Spend a substantial share of your time building and reviewing code \- you stay in the work, not just over it. * Design and implement ML models on structured, time\-series, and unstructured data; own validation, evaluation, and error analysis on the team's deliverables. * **Solution \& product delivery** \- * Own the team's delivery of production AI/ML solutions and their production health end\-to\-end. * Set and enforce engineering standards \- architecture, code review, testing, CI/CD. * Work closely with the dedicated MLOps team and hand off for production release and operation * Build to their readiness standards and gates and route production\-driven code changes back through your team. * **Cross\-functional leadership** * Partner with program and product\-management teams on scope, priorities, and delivery commitments; communicate progress with evidence. * Operate within a global organization * Coordinate with functional leads and globally dispersed project teams * Build products with global platforms and standards. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related field, or related field. * A minimum of 10 years in software engineering, including substantial hands\-on solution development \- services, APIs, and user\-facing touchpoints/apps (front\-end/full\-stack) \- and experience leading or coordinating a team of engineers. * A track record of shipping and operating production software \- you have owned systems in production, not just delivered projects \- and you remain hands\-on today. * Practical experience delivering ML/AI\-powered products. * Strong Python and common ML libraries; ability to work across data, modeling, and software concerns. * Cloud (AWS preferred) and modern data/ML platforms (e.g. Databricks/Spark). **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience building agentic/LLM\-based systems and adopting AI\-assisted development tooling across a team. * Automotive, industrial, IoT, or other regulated/embedded\-adjacent domain experience; time\-series or vehicle data a plus. * Familiarity with MLOps concepts (CI/CD for ML, model registry, monitoring, retraining). * Front\-end/full\-stack delivery experience (dashboards, internal tools, product UIs). * A track record as a player\-coach \- leading a team while still contributing code. **Our Benefits \- Designed with You in Mind** **Comprehensive Health \& Well\-being Coverage** From your very first day, you'll have access to medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage \- ensuring you and your family stay healthy and protected. **Generous Paid Time Off** We believe in work\-life balance. That's why we offer: 17\+ paid holidays, including shut\-down from December 24th through New Years Day every year. Vacation, float \& wellbeing days, sick time and fully paid parental leave when your family needs you most. **Competitive Retirement Savings Plans** We help you plan for the future with: * An employer match on contributions to your 401k, Roth, and Catch\-Up plans * An employer contribution, even if you don't contribute **Income Protection \& Insurance Options** Benefit from included and optional disability, life, and other insurance programs \- because your peace of mind matters. **Company Vehicle Lease Program** Eligible employees and their immediate families can enjoy company vehicle lease options with included insurance, maintenance, and unlimited mileage. Plus, take advantage of exclusive discounts on Stellantis products. **Family Building Benefit** We proudly support all paths to parenthood\- including fertility and infertility treatments, adoption services, and gestational surrogacy. **Support for Your Growth and Giving Back** We believe in investing in your future and your passions: * Tuition reimbursement * Student loan refinancing programs * 18 paid volunteer hours each year to make a difference in your community **And so much more!** When you join us, you're not just building a career \- you're joining a company that supports you, inside and outside of work.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: At TDS Telecom, connecting people is at the heart of everything we do. We are forward thinkers who leverage cutting\-edge fiber internet technology to strengthen communities. We are dedicated to excellence, which drives us to succeed together, creating a better world through meaningful connections. Ready to make an impact? The **Lead Software Engineer** works independently or leads teams of 5 or more people responsible for application design, development, testing, and problem resolution work teams with significant autonomy and independence. The scope of work typically includes major system projects that support company\-wide business operations. As an experienced developer and an experienced technical leader, the position receives periodic mentoring, feedback, and supervision by management. Applications may include custom developed software, commercial packaged software, or open\-source software. Software may consist of on\-premise applications, cloud\-based software and services, hybrid configurations, integration tools, or business workflow tools. The Lead Software Engineer leads the team's use of AI coding tools. They will set the standard for reviewing and accepting AI\-generated code, define where the tools should not be used, and share reusable prompts and automation. *This position has the ability to work remotely in any of the 40\+ States in which TDS Telecom operates. Final candidates may be invited onsite for final interviews in Madison, WI.* Responsibilities: * Leads teams of 5 or more people that develop, test, and fix defects in application software. * Leads the preparation and review of application software designs at the system level. The scope of design will frequently include multiple systems supporting company\-wide business processes. * Leads cross\-functional work teams in preparing work estimates and project schedules for all technical work on projects. Mentors team members in the development of work plans. * Leads work teams in resolving complex problems which are frequently unique, require creative problem solving and advanced technical skills, and frequently span multiple systems and may cross team boundaries. * Maintains authoritative knowledge of all systems within the scope of the team's responsibility. Provides a consultative role to business process owners in the use and modification of system software. Maintains expert\-level knowledge of software development best practices, tools, and methodologies that are recognized within the company. * Leads teams focused on quality and continuous improvement initiatives across business units within the company. * Maintains expert knowledge of the technologies and practices of the company's chosen markets. Maintains awareness of trends in technologies and vendor product offerings. * Actively participates in preparing and conducting technical interviews of job candidates on behalf of the group manager. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications*** Bachelors degree (or higher) \-OR\- 4\+ years professional work experience. * 5\+ years experience in software development or testing. **Other Qualifications*** Knowledge of AI\-assisted software engineering * Knowledge of software development methodologies, practices, and tools. * Knowledge of project management methodologies, practices, and tools. * Knowledge of one more programming language used by the team. * Knowledge of software testing practices and tools. * Knowledge of problem\-solving techniques and tools. * Ability to travel as needed for company business and professional development. * Ability to work nights and weekends as needed for system implementations and resolving system problems. * Knowledge of business analysis practices and business process modeling. * Knowledge of quality management and quality improvement practices. * Knowledge of team leadership skills, practices, and behaviors. * Knowledge of techniques, tools, and applicable laws to conduct effective and legal interviews. * Knowledge of techniques for writing and presenting business proposals to management. * Knowledge of effective writing and public speaking skills. Ability to convey complex information to general audiences. * Knowledge of C\# / .NET or a comparable primary stack. * Knowledge of relational databases (Oracle or SQL Server) \- data modeling and query performance. * Knowledge of event\-driven or streaming integration (e.g. Kafka), including ordering, duplicate delivery, and replay. Do you meet the Required Qualifications but are unsure if your experience aligns with the Other Qualifications? We encourage you to apply! Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications, even when they possess the skills and experience needed to succeed in the role. Experience and skills come in many forms, and they may not always match exactly what’s listed on paper, but they can still lead to success. If you meet the Required Qualifications and believe you have the potential to thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply today! **Benefits** Associates scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week have access to medical, dental, vision, life insurance, a 401(k) plan, education assistance, and paid time off benefits such as vacation (15 days accrued per year for full\-time; pro\-rated for associates working between 20\-39 hours), sick leave (10 days accrued per year for full\-time and pro\-rated for all other associates), seven paid national holidays and one floating holiday, paid parental leave (6 weeks after 12 months of employment), among others. Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability coverage is also available for associates working 30 or more hours per week. Associates scheduled to work under twenty hours per week or for a limited term (i.e. interns) are eligible for medical coverage, the 401(k) plan (if 18 or older), as well as sick leave (10 days accrued per year for full\-time and pro\-rated for all other associates). Click here for more specific information regarding our comprehensive well\-being program. **Who is TDS Telecom?** TDS Telecom provides high\-speed internet, TV entertainment, and phone services to a diverse range of communities, including small to mid\-sized urban, suburban, and rural areas across the U.S. With over 50 years of experience, TDS is committed to building and expanding fiber optic networks that bring cutting\-edge connectivity to neighborhoods nationwide. Serving over 1 million connections, our mission is to create a better world by delivering innovative communication solutions that enhance the way people live, work, and connect. Visit tdstelecom.com to learn more! At TDS, we are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and value the difference of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives in our workforce. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by law. **Pay Transparency** The listed pay range reflects the minimum and maximum base salary. Actual offers will be based on factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, location, and role\-specific competencies. Some positions may also offer additional compensation, such as bonuses or equity awards. Pay Range (Hr./Yr.): $81,000\.00/Yr. \- $131,600\.00/Yr.

Target Tech builds and operates the intelligence powered architecture that fuels these outcomes. Our teams design scalable platforms, modern data ecosystems, and resilient infrastructure that allow thousands of engineers to deliver secure, high performing systems at enterprise scale. **About the Core Platform Services Team** ========================================= Target’s Infrastructure strategy is built around one idea: make the right thing the easy thing. The Target Application Platform (TAP) is where that happens. Builders tell TAP what they need, and the platform, more and more with help from AI agents, gets it done safely. In an agentic world, many more people create software. Builders at Target include engineers, product managers, UX designers, data scientists, and analysts. Core Platform Services builds the common services that connect Target’s platforms, so builders get a delightful experience that feels like one connected platform. We work closely with our Product Manager to find where builders lose the most time and decide what to build next. Our first major capability is Action Center, along with the tools that help builders act on it: * **Action Center.** A shared service and API that platform teams use to publish the work they need from builders, such as instrumenting with OpenTelemetry or upgrading a runtime. It tracks that work across the more than 5,000 applications on TAP and gives each one a single prioritized list, in place of requests scattered across tickets, chat, and email. * **Remediation guides.** A shared framework that lets a platform team write the fix for a common problem once and make it available to every application. * **Agentic remediation.** AI agents that follow a guide, make the code change, and open a pull request for the builder to review, either in the background on TAP or inside the builder’s own coding agent. A person approves every change. Action Center is a starting point. Over time, the team will build the features and integrations that remove friction across the full builder experience, from starting a new project to running it in production. We track adoption, time to complete, and manual work removed, and use that data to decide what comes next. We serve two groups: the builders who create software on TAP, and the platform teams who support them. We earn adoption by building services people want to use, and we measure success in builder time returned. The platform has already given back more than 500,000 hours, and this team’s work is a big part of growing that number. We operate business\-critical services in 24x7 production environments. jobs.title: Data and AI Engineer - July 2027
jobs.description: The Brattle Group, a privately held, global economics consulting firm, is looking for a **Data and AI Engineer** to join our **San Francisco, CA** office to start in **July 2027**. The Data \& AI Engineer is an early\-career role within Brattle’s Data \& AI Engineering team, focused on hands\-on technical work across client delivery, applied R\&D, and internal capability\-building. This role is designed for candidates who are strong builders, fast learners, and clear communicators, and who want to develop technical judgment in a setting where problems are varied, ambiguous, and often time\-sensitive. This is not a narrowly defined pipeline role or a heads\-down engineering track. Data \& AI Engineers work across data engineering, applied analytics, machine learning, and AI\-enabled workflows, staying close to implementation while learning how technical choices affect real client work. Candidates are not expected to arrive as experts across data engineering, solution architecture, and applied AI research. They are expected to be hands\-on, curious, coachable, and comfortable learning quickly. **Where This Role Sits at Brattle:** The Data \& AI Engineering team is a specialized technical group embedded within Brattle’s consulting staff. The team supports client work while also serving as an applied R\&D function for the firm: researching emerging technologies, prototyping new analytical and AI\-enabled workflows, and translating useful methods into reusable capabilities. The team partners with economists, consultants, industry experts, and internal stakeholders to improve how the firm works with data, analytics, machine learning, and AI through project delivery, reusable tools, documentation, training, and knowledge\-sharing. Data \& AI Engineers work under the guidance of more experienced technical leads, including Senior Data \& AI Engineers, Solutions Architects, and Research Engineers. As experience grows, the role can develop toward deeper execution ownership, increased responsibility for solution design, more advanced AI and research work, or some combination of those paths. **Nature of the Work:** Data \& AI Engineers work on problems where the technical path is often unclear, the data is imperfect, and the constraints are real. Source materials may be incomplete, inconsistent, degraded through prior systems, or difficult to interpret. Some matters also involve restricted or confidential workflows that shape how data can be accessed, handled, or shared. The role requires practical judgment. There may be multiple valid approaches, each with trade\-offs, and limited ability to go back to the source for clarification. Data \& AI Engineers are expected to reason carefully from imperfect inputs, document assumptions, surface limitations, and help build solutions that are defensible, reproducible, timely, and fit for purpose. Project timelines may shift quickly based on external events, negotiations, litigation deadlines, or client needs. Some work is recurring and operational; some is one\-off or exploratory. The right candidate is a resourceful, practical builder: someone who can stay organized, adapt to changing constraints, and make progress without losing rigor or composure. The team environment is academic, collegial, grounded, and highly collaborative. We value curiosity, humility, initiative, clear communication, and practical intelligence. The work can be technically advanced, but the culture is not ego\-driven. We are looking for people who are resourceful, friendly, proactive, flexible, and able to work well with others in a global, connected consulting environment. **Some of the day\-to\-day responsibilities of this role include:** * Prepare, inspect, clean, reconstruct, and validate data from a wide range of sources, including structured datasets, documents, reports, exports, PDFs, workflows where they are useful to the problem * Contribute to workflows involving text extraction, classification, summarization, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation, model evaluation, automation, visualization, or rapid prototyping * Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate learning and execution while maintaining responsibility for accuracy, confidentiality, defensibility, and quality * Support applied R\&D by helping prototype, test, and evaluate new tools, methods, and workflows before they are adopted more broadly * Communicate progress, technical findings, assumptions, limitations, and trade\-offs clearly to consultants, economists, technical peers, and other stakeholders * Participate in code review, collaborativ r a related field * Equivalent hands\-on technical experience, internships, research work, or project\-based experience may also be considered * 0\-3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics, applied AI, machine learning, software development, research, or related technical work * Must be available to begin full\-time employment in July 2027 * Hands\-on experience building at least one working AI\-enabled application, tool, or automated workflow through coursework, research, an internship, a capstone, or an independent project. * Ability to explain the problem addressed, your individual contribution, the technologies used, and how you evaluated the solution’s performance and limitations. * Comfort working in ambiguous problem spaces where the task may need to be clarified, decomposed, and revised as new information emerges * Strong foundation in Python for data analysis, scripting, automation, or prototyping, with exposure to libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, or comparable tools * Working knowledge of SQL and relational data concepts, including joins, aggregation, filtering, and practical data exploration * Foundational understanding of statistics, data analysis, machine learning, or experimental evaluation, with interest in strengthening applied judgment over time * Exposure to generative AI workflows, such as prompt design, embeddings, vector search, The anticipated base gross salary range for this position in San Francisco, CA is $100,000 \- $126,000 annually. jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: At Truckstop, we have transformed the entire freight\-moving lifecycle with our SaaS solutions. From freight matching to payments and everything in between, we are the trusted partner for carriers, brokers, and shippers alike. We lead this industry forward with our One Team mindset committing to principles such as assume positive intent, have each other's back, and be your authentic self. Our drive for greatness produces high expectations, yet our regard for humans is even higher. Join a team of brilliant minds and generous hearts who care deeply about other's success. **Position Summary:** --------------------- Manage the chapters of Software Engineers whose role is to efficiently design and implement software solutions for the transportation industry. Work closely with Product and Technology stakeholders to take an active leadership role in driving iterative improvements in the software development methodologies that contribute to successful product value delivery. **Essential Job Functions:** ---------------------------- The successful candidate will receive direction from the executive team and be involved with aligning development teams to achieve goals of the company. * Balance partner focus and skill sets across multiple projects and various locations to ensure on\-time and high\-quality delivery of projects. * Be an agile champion by guiding an iterative approach through investable stories. * Work closely with Product partners, as well as other cross functional partners to plan sprints, releases, and development activities. * Track and report progress of the projects against key milestones. * Keep stakeholders updated throughout the development cycle and act as a liaison with relevant parties, including the project management office, quality assurance, other development teams, production support, infrastructure support, etc. to facilitate the release process. * Provide coaching, mentoring, and support to direct reports for both technical and non\-technical issues to ensure growth and productivity among team members. * Manage partner availability, knowledge transfer, training, and allocations among development teams; review and approve billing and time\-off requests where applicable. * Lead root\-cause analysis efforts, communicate options for resolution, and provide recommendations to customer\-facing technology problems in a timely manner. * Manage remote teams; build "one team in multiple locations" culture. * Establish and communicate knowledge of application development best practices. * Maintain knowledge of new technologies and industry best practices; engage team resources to utilize best practices. * Be a champion of engineering and operational excellence: establish and maintain growth and improvement goals for the team and individual team members. * Show strong business and technical judgment that will accelerate time to market of releases while incrementally moving our products and services toward our long\-term vision. * Other duties as assigned. **Position Requirements:** -------------------------- * BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related discipline with minimum of 8 years of related experience * A minimum of 3 years of experience managing software engineers. * Passionate about building a strong software engineering team with the skills necessary to rapidly produce high quality applications. * Experience balancing priorities among a team responsible for production support and new development; sense of priority and urgency. * Demonstrated Agile experience * Demonstrated ability to influence and motivate team members working in multiple locations. * Demonstrated expertise in building, debugging, and maintaining mission critical applications that drive the business. * Expert level knowledge and practice using at least 3 of the following technologies: Event Driven design, Enterprise Message Bus framework (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, Azure Event Hub), Kubernetes, Angular, GIT/GitLab, .NET Core, Serverless frameworks (AWS Lamba, Azure Functions) Salesforce, Mobile development (Swift/Kotlin/Flutter), SQL or NoSQL database. jobs.title: Geospatial and Digital Innovation Development Leader
jobs.description: Matrix New World Engineering, a part of True Environmental and its partner firms, have united their strengths to establish the nation's premier environmental and engineering services consulting firm. This powerhouse organization offers an extensive range of services aimed at revolutionizing the built environment and preserving the natural one. Its diverse expertise encompasses environmental remediation, urban planning, engineering iconic coastal and marine structures, developing sustainable energy sources, and pioneering resource extraction methods. Explore further at www.MWNE.com and True\-Environmental.com to discover the full scope of our capabilities. True Environmental is seeking a hands\-on technical leader to drive geospatial, digital, and AI innovation into everything we do. Working directly with engineers, scientists, GIS staff, and project managers across our six practice groups (Natural Resources and Regulatory Services, Mining, Environmental, Engineering, Water Resources, and Federal) you will learn how each team delivers its work and build the tools, platforms, and workflows that make that work faster, more accurate, and more valuable to clients in the Transportation and Infrastructure, Water, Energy, Power and Utilities, Mining, Industrial, Environmental, and Natural Resources markets. You will be the firm’s U.S.\-based technical authority for enterprise GIS, geomatics, and digital solutions across all practices, and the person who turns emerging technology into everyday practice. You will design the geodatabases, write the scripts, build the applications, integrate the data feeds, and apply AI in a manner that improves how we compile data, detect change, and deliver results. Just as importantly, you will train project teams to use what you create, so innovation reaches every project. Alongside our technical leadership, you will represent the firm in front of clients and present at industry conferences, and you will coordinate with digital technology leaders in Canada to identify, develop, and leverage tools across True. The position reports to the Chief Operating Officer and works in a matrixed relationship with practice leads across the firm. ### **What You Will Do** **Cross\-Practice Technical Leadership** * Act as the U.S. technical lead for geospatial and digital solutions, supporting all six practice groups: Natural Resources and Regulatory Services, Mining, Environmental, Engineering, Water Resources, and Federal. * Partner with each practice to map current workflows, identify where spatial data and automation can remove manual effort or improve decision quality, and prioritize a development backlog. * Establish firm\-wide standards for geodatabase design, metadata, data governance, QA/QC, and deliverable formats so geospatial output is consistent regardless of practice or office. * Coordinate with digital technology leaders in Canada to identify, develop, and leverage tools across True, aligning platforms and avoiding duplicated development. * Serve as technical reviewer for geospatial deliverables and provide expert input on proposals when practices need a defined digital scope. **Product and Platform Development** * Design and build enterprise geodatabases, web\-mapping applications, custom dashboards, and digital\-twin platforms that integrate 2D/3D mapping, asset inventories, document repositories, point clouds, BIM/Revit models, and inspection and monitoring records. * Develop repeatable analytical tools and workflows for recurring project needs, for example: cut/fill and dredging analysis, discharge and runout modeling, routing and constraint analysis, contaminant plume and exceedance visualization, impervious surface and flood\-exposure analysis, and automated regulatory reporting (figures, tables, EDDs). * Build and maintain field data collection applications (Survey123, Field Maps, Fulcrum, or custom) and the pipelines that move field data into enterprise databases and client deliverables. * Integrate real\-time and external data sources (IoT sensors, AIS, weather and environmental feeds, bathymetric and LiDAR scans) into living data products. * Automate with Python, SQL, JavaScript, ModelBuilder, and FME; convert legacy CAD/MicroStation, Access, Excel, and PDF data into spatially enabled databases. **Innovation and Technology Evaluation** * Evaluate and pilot emerging capabilities, including GeoAI and LLM\-assisted data compilation and metadata generation, automated defect and change detection from imagery and point clouds, open\-source geospatial stacks, cloud deployment, and immersive/XR visualization, and establish practical, governed paths to adoption. * Direct reality\-capture programs in coordination with field teams: terrestrial and bathymetric LiDAR, sonar, UAS photogrammetry and inspection. * Identify project\-built tools that can be hardened into reusable firm assets or client\-facing products. **Client Representation, Enablement, and Training** * Together with tech you build. * Mentor GIS analysts and developers across practices on development practices, database design, and scripting; you will influence and guide, not line\-manage, these staff. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Geography, Geospatial Science, Environmental Science/Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * Authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship. * 20\+ years of progressive geospatial and application\-development experience, with substantial time as technical lead on multidisciplinary projects in an environmental, engineering, AEC, or public\-sector setting. * GISP certification (or ability to obtain within 12 months). * Deep expertise in the Esri platform: ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise/Server, ArcGIS Online, Experience Builder, Survey123, Field Maps, 3D/Spatial Analyst. * Proven development skills: Python, SQL (PostgreSQL/PostGIS, SQL Server), JavaScript (Esri JS API, Leaflet, Node.js), and relational database design. * Demonstrated track record of building web applications, dashboards, and enterprise GIS infrastructure that measurably improved delivery efficiency or client decision\-making. * Experience integrating field data collection platforms with enterprise geodatabases and downstream modeling or reporting tools. * Ability to work across disciplines: elicit requirements from non\-GIS staff, explain technical trade\-offs clearly, and deliver tools people actually adopt. * Comfortable presenting to clients, agencies, and industry audiences. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing digital\-twin or asset\-management platforms integrating point clouds, BIM, and inspection data (ports, utilities, transportation, or facilities). * Hands\-on reality\-capture experience: LiDAR, bathymetric/sonar survey, UAS operations (FAA Part 107\), photogrammetry, 3D modeling. * Open\-source geospatial and cloud experience (QGIS, MapServer, GeoServer, PostGIS; Azure or AWS). * Experience applying AI/ML or LLM\-assisted tooling to geospatial data compilation, defect detection, or metadata generation. * Integration experience with EAM/BIM platforms (e.g., Maximo, Autodesk Forma) and CAD/MicroStation conversion via FME. * Experience with 3D visualization, immersive/XR, or interactive training content for stakeholder engagement. * Experience working across distributed, multi\-office, or cross\-border teams. ### **Why True Environmental** * Experience developing digital\-twin or asset\-management platforms integrating point clouds, BIM, and inspection data (ports, utilities, transportation, or facilities). * Hands\-on reality\-capture experience: LiDAR, bathymetric/sonar survey, UAS operations (FAA Part 107\), photogrammetry, 3D modeling. * Open\-source geospatial and cloud experience (QGIS, MapServer, GeoServer, PostGIS; Azure or AWS). * Experience applying AI/ML or LLM\-assisted tooling to geospatial data compilation, defect detection, or metadata generation. * Integration experience with EAM/BIM platforms (e.g., Maximo, Autodesk Forma) and CAD/MicroStation conversion via FME. * Experience with 3D visualization, immersive/XR, or interactive training content for stakeholder engagement. * Experience working across distributed, multi\-office, or cross\-border teams. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
