jobs.title: AI & Process Automation Developer
jobs.description: Truliant’s mission is to improve lives by putting our members first, providing great service and straightforward financial solutions. Our core values of Member Focus, Service, Guidance, Relationships, and Community define how we interact with members to fulfill our mission of improving lives and providing a foundation on which we conduct ourselves. Our Promise to Our Teammates: Truliant strives to provide all teammates with an enjoyable place to work where they feel valued, empowered and rewarded for all that they do. * **This position is remote within our NC, SC, VA footprint. Although this position is primarily remote, there are occasional events and meetings that may require you to work on\-site at one of our Truliant locations.** **Why this role matters** ========================= At Truliant Federal Credit Union, better technology helps our teams work more efficiently and creates a smoother experience for our members. As an AI \& Process Automation Developer, you’ll help turn business needs into secure, reliable automation and AI solutions that reduce manual effort and improve how work gets done. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving real business problems, building practical technology, and learning alongside experienced developers, architects, and business partners. **What you’ll do** ================== In this role, you’ll help design, build, test, deploy, and support enterprise automation and AI solutions. Your work may include robotic process automation, workflow automation, system integrations, intelligent document processing, and conversational AI. **Day to day, you’ll:** * Build and maintain reusable automation workflows, attended and unattended automations, and conversational AI capabilities using established development standards. * Connect solutions with enterprise applications through REST APIs, SOAP services, SQL databases, message queues, and enterprise connectors. * Test, document, deploy, troubleshoot, and support solutions across development, testing, and production environments. You’ll also partner with developers, architects, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, assess automation opportunities, and deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, and maintainable. **What you bring** ================== We’re looking for a hands\-on developer who combines solid programming and integration experience with a practical understanding of AI and automation. You can move an idea from requirements through testing and support while asking thoughtful questions and working well with both technical and business partners. **This role is a great fit if you have:** **Required Experience:** * 2\+ years of foundational experience with AI or automation technologies such as RPA, workflow automation, conversational AI, intelligent document processing, or an equivalent platform. * 3\+ years of experience using source control, CI/CD processes, and modern software development tools. * 1\+ years of automation development, systems integration, or related experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting technical solutions. * 2\+ years of experience with REST APIs, SQL, JSON, XML, and system integration concepts. * 3\+ years of experience with Python, Java, React JavaScript, Node.js, or similar programming languages. **Required Skills:** * Develop, test, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain automation solutions using reusable components and established development practices. * Build and support integrations using APIs, databases, services, and enterprise connectors. * Use source control and CI/CD practices to manage reliable software changes across environments. * Translate business requirements into technical designs, workflow diagrams, specifications, deployment instructions, and support documentation. * Apply unit, integration, and regression testing practices and support User Acceptance Testing. **Education/Certifications required within one year:** * UiPath Advanced Developer Professional Certification. * Kore.AI Automation AI / XO Platform, Kore.AI Agent AI, \& Kore.AI Agent Platform Builder advanced training or developer certification. You should also be comfortable working within Agile delivery, SDLC, DevSecOps, secure coding, change management, and enterprise governance standards, while collaborating closely with senior developers and cross\-functional partners. **What sets you apart** ======================= **You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive in this role:** * A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * 2\+ years of experience working within Agile development teams. * 2\+ years of exposure to cloud\-based platforms, services, and development environments. * 2\+ years of experience in financial services, healthcare, government, or another regulated industry. * Curiosity about emerging technologies such as Generative AI, Retrieval Augmented Generation, prompt engineering, and Agentic AI. **What you’ll get** =================== We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. **In this role, you can expect:** * Meaningful work that improves operational efficiency and supports a better member experience at Truliant Federal Credit Union. * Hands\-on opportunities to build across automation, integrations, conversational AI, and emerging AI technologies rather than being limited to one type of solution. * Collaboration with experienced developers, architects, and business partners who can help you strengthen both your technical skills and business understanding. * A team environment that values secure, maintainable solutions, thoughtful problem\-solving, continuous learning, and high\-quality service. **Ready to Apply?** =================== If you have a passion for member service and would like to invest in a meaningful career with opportunity for growth, we encourage you to apply to Truliant! As a member of the Truliant family, you will enjoy the following full time benefits: * No\-cost employee Medical, dental, vision coverage * Prescription benefits (including mail order) * Paid holidays and Paid Time Off (PTO) * 401(k) plan with contribution matching * Paid community involvement volunteers hours * Paid group life Insurance * Teammate loan discounts * Tuition reimbursement * Short and long\-term disability * Health \& Wellness program * Teledoc (physician video conferencing) * Onsite fitness facilities or health club reimbursement * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Medical flexible spending account * Dependent care flexible spending account

jobs.title: Senior Bazel Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About us** Tweag is a software consultancy that helps engineering organizations overcome technical bottlenecks that stand in the way of success. Our work in scalable build systems, primarily through Bazel, helps our clients grow their tech organization without the maintenance burden. ### **About you** Tweag works with organizations at all experience levels, from trying out Bazel for the first time, to refactoring and scaling Bazel workspaces with hundreds of thousands of potential targets. In every situation, we are the experts, helping them achieve their goals and delighting them with improvements they never expected. We are looking for someone who can handle: * Integration with as\-yet\-unsupported languages. * Development of specialized Bazel toolchains. * Improving open\-source Bazel rules to unblock our clients. * Using Gazelle to standardize and clean up code. * Refactoring Bazel code, and teaching others how to do so. * Debugging the internals of Bazel. ### **In addition, we'd appreciate** * Ties to the Bazel community. * Active maintenance of Bazel open\-source tools. * Expertise in Bazel performance optimization, both within rules and in evaluating the build graph. * Knowledge of other reproducible build systems, such as Nix, Buck2, or Pants. ### **You'll love Tweag if you love** * A fully remote workplace with strong respect for work\-life balance. * Working on complex engineering problems, often with no right answer. * A research\-informed culture, with plenty of nerding out about computer science and mathematics. * Giving back to the community by contributing to open\-source software, contributing to our blog, participating in working groups, and stewarding conferences.

jobs.description: Description: **Description** Tyndall Federal Credit Union is an established Credit Union based in Panama City, Florida with branches across the Florida Panhandle and South Alabama. We offer our employees a family\-orientated work environment with numerous exciting benefits and career growth. We are looking for the next member of our \#TeamTyndall family! **Our Mission:** Tyndall Federal Credit Union is committed to making a meaningful difference in the lives of our members. As an MLE, the reward for working within these requirements is significant \- offline performance gains in our ranking models are strongly correlated with topline impact for the entire Eats business. **What You’ll Do** * Own and develop on all parts of the ML lifecycle \- both offline (training, model architecture, etc.) and online (serving efficiency, GPU provisioning \+ utilization, etc.). * Bring SOTA ML techniques from DLRM and LLM literature (Scaling Laws, Kernel Fusion, Latent Attention, Agentic Auto\-Research, RL\-based post\-ranking, etc.) into our modeling stack. * Collaborate closely with backend engineers to ensure high\-quality and reliability in end\-to\-end integration. * Coordinate with Science and Product partners to maximize the business impact of ML improvements. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field, with 3\+ years of full\-time experience working on production ML systems. * Strong proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, or Java. * Strong proficiency with common Deep\-Learning frameworks (PyTorch, Tensorflow/Keras, Jax, etc.). * Experience with distributed data processing and ETL frameworks (Spark, Ray Data, etc.). * Strong technical communication and ability to manage multiple cross functional stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field, with publications in the ML/AI space (papers, conference presentations, company technical blogs, etc.). * Industry experience working on Deep Learning Recommendation Systems and/or LLM model development at scale in a production/user\-facing environment. * Experience optimizing Deep Learning model architectures \+ serving stack to improve GPU MFU across different hardware types. * Desire to grow into technical leadership and become a force multiplier for junior engineers. Our team designs, develops and maintains massively scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architectures, data analytics, and digital solutions. **Job Overview and Responsibilities** Enterprise Network Infrastructure Security \& Engineering is leading a bold transformation for United Airlines, infusing AI\-driven automation, modern network infrastructure security, and next\-generation engineering and IoT into every layer of our global network. This role owns that transformation, architecting and securing the enterprise software\-defined network across our campuses, airports, remote workforce, and public cloud, while engineering an intelligent, self\-healing network that predicts and prevents issues before they affect the airline. This leader will guide our technology, vendor, and people strategy as networking converges with AI/ML, cybersecurity, and cloud\-native engineering. Enterprise Network Infrastructure Security \& Engineering is part of our Digital Technology organization, focused on enabling the entirety of United Airlines and all of its divisions with advanced, secure, and intelligent infrastructure. * Lead the organization's AI\-driven network transformation, engineering AI/ML, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation into the network's design to build self\-healing capabilities, eliminate manual configuration, and detect and prevent issues before they impact the airline * Own network infrastructure security strategy and execution, advancing zero\-trust architecture, secure access, and end\-to\-end network segmentation in partnership with cybersecurity leadership to protect United's critical infrastructure, data, and airline operations. * Lead network engineering and architecture for a modern, software\-defined network, advancing SD\-WAN, cloud connectivity, application services, and network automation and orchestration as networking converges with the public cloud and SaaS. * Architect and engineer secure, resilient connectivity across all airports, campus and remote offices, contact centers, cloud, and third\-party network connections, embedding network security controls, threat protection, and compliance requirements into network designs and holding vendors to United's engineering and security standards. * Lead and develop a large team of world\-class network engineering and network security engineering talent focused on networking at true enterprise scale with an emphasis on secure connectivity, network access, segmentation, and infrastructure resiliency. * Operate as a thought leader internally and externally on AI\-enabled, secure, next\-generation networking. jobs.title: AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Who We Are** United Imaging is a leading global medical device developer and supplier with a diversified portfolio of advanced medical products, digital healthcare solutions, and intelligent solutions that cover the entire process of imaging diagnosis and treatment. Join our innovative team with the mission of developing and supplying advanced technologies and improving patient care worldwide. As part of our global team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with talented and dedicated colleagues while developing and expanding your career. **Company Page:** http://www.united\-imaging.com/en/home/ **Benefits \& Compensation** When joining our team, we offer the following benefits: medical, dental, vision, short\- \& long\-term disability insurance, employee assistance program, company paid basic life insurance, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off, sick leave, and (12\) paid holidays. Compensation decisions are based upon the candidate level of skill, qualifications, geographical location and experience, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the posted pay range. Additionally, the position may also be eligible to earn performance\-based incentive compensation (such as cash bonus(es)). **Job Description** The AI Software Engineer designs, develops, and maintains AI\-powered software that supports United Imaging’s business operations, combining strong software engineering skills with hands\-on experience applying large language models. The engineer works with business users across quality, manufacturing, finance, HR, and R\&D to translate operational needs into reliable software solutions, ensuring stability, security, and maintainability. Responsibilities include gathering requirements, defining system functionality, developing algorithms, and writing production code, primarily in Python and TypeScript. In this role, you will focus on applied AI for Speed, United Imaging’s in\-house AI workspace platform. Speed gives employees an AI assistant and AI agents that work across company files, collaboration tools such as Lark and Microsoft Outlook, and business systems: answering questions, analyzing documents and spreadsheets, running Python analyses in a secure sandbox, automating approval and reporting workflows, and supporting quality reviews of manufacturing records. You will design, build, evaluate, and ship the large language model (LLM) capabilities behind these features, working end to end from use\-case discovery with business users to production deployment and measurement of impact. **Key Responsibilities:** * Understanding of the business operational process and providing software solutions. * Develop flowcharts, layouts and documentation to identify requirements and solutions. * Produce specifications and determine operational feasibility, integrate software components into a fully functional software system, develop software verification plans and quality assurance procedures * Document and maintain software functionality, comply with project plans and process requirements, deploy programs, evaluate feedback and upgrade software. * Design and build LLM\-powered features for Speed, including tool\-calling AI agents, multi\-step workflow automation, and conversational assistants grounded in company documents and business systems. * Develop retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge\-base capabilities: document parsing (PDF, Word, Excel, scanned forms), chunking, embeddings, vector search, and answers that cite their sources. * Apply AI to document review in regulated workflows, such as AI\-assisted review of medical device manufacturing and quality records (e.g., Device History Records), with human\-in\-the\-loop sign\-off and full traceability. * Build evaluation pipelines for AI features (labeled datasets, offline replay of real runs, precision/recall and task\-success metrics, regression checks for prompt and model changes) and use them to drive measurable quality improvements. * Integrate and operate commercial LLM APIs and self\-hosted open\-weight models, balancing quality, latency, and token cost through model routing, context management, and prompt caching, while meeting enterprise data\-privacy and security requirements. * Partner with business users in quality, manufacturing, finance, HR, and R\&D to identify high\-value AI use cases, prototype quickly, ship to production, and measure adoption and impact. Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields * Proficient in Python and TypeScript, with experience using source code management tools such as Git. * Hands\-on experience building and shipping applications on large language models (e.g., OpenAI GPT, or open\-weight models such as Qwen or Llama), including prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, and streaming. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG): embeddings, vector search (e.g., pgvector or a dedicated vector database), and evaluating retrieval quality. * Strong Python skills, including building backend services and REST APIs (e.g., FastAPI, asynchronous programming). * Experience designing quantitative evaluations for AI/ML systems (test sets, metrics, error analysis) and using the results to guide improvements. * Complex problem\-solving skills and Critical thinking, strong interest in technology and strong IT skills * Communications skills and professional proficiency in written and spoken English **Preferred Skills \& Experience:** * Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field. * Experience building AI agents (multi\-step planning, tool use, sub\-agents, memory) or with the Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience serving open\-weight models on premises (e.g., vLLM, GPU inference, quantization). * Experience with document AI: OCR, layout and table extraction, and vision\-language models for PDFs, spreadsheets, and scanned forms. * Full\-stack experience with TypeScript, React/Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Redis. * Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as Lark or Microsoft 365 (Graph API) through OAuth and REST APIs. * Experience with Medical Imaging related projects * Passion for solving complex technical challenges with innovative ideas **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion** United Imaging is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity, equity, and inclusion matter. United Imaging provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. **Working Conditions:** *Magnetic Environment Exposure:* This position requires working in an environment where strong magnetic fields may be present. Employees may be exposed to powerful magnets, electromagnetic equipment, or other devices that generate magnetic fields. *Risk to Ferrous Metals in the Body:* Due to the nature of the magnetic environment, employees must **not** wear or carry ferrous metals on their person while in the designated work area. This includes, but is not limited to, metal objects such as steel, iron, and other ferrous materials. Additionally, employees with implants, medical devices, or foreign objects containing ferrous metals within their body (e.g., certain surgical implants, pacemakers, or metal pins) may be at risk and must disclose any such conditions to their supervisor prior to starting work. **Are You Looking for Something Different?**To learn more about United Imaging, visit our company page (https://www.united\-imaging.com/en) and check us out on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/united\-imaging\-healthcare/)

jobs.description: We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world. **How we LEAD:** Universal Music Group is building an Applied AI and Machine Learning function to help our teams discover and develop artists, connect with fans, make stronger commercial decisions, and protect the integrity of the music ecosystem. We are looking for a Lead Machine Learning Engineer to build, ship, and operate reliable machine learning and AI systems that create durable value across UMG. This is a senior individual\-contributor role for an engineer who combines strong software and systems expertise with practical knowledge of the AI and ML lifecycle. You will turn models, data products, and AI workflows into maintainable production capabilities across revenue forecasting, artist, catalog intelligence and talent scouting, release marketing, and rights and ecosystem integrity. signals before they become incidents. **Ship Agentic AI \& ML\-Powered Tools** * Build GenAI\-powered engineering assistants that automate deployment orchestration, release governance, and environment jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: We need your talent! Waters Corporation is currently seeking a DevOps Principal Engineer to join our Global Software Engineering team. Our team understands the value of their work in the real world. As a DevOps Principal Engineer in Milford, MA you'll be working with technology used for quality testing and the development of nearly every drug taken in around the globe. These are processes that we want to optimize. Consider this, today’s lab instruments can only be viewed from the lab – our mission here is to be able to enable scientists to see their lab results from Starbucks, home, anywhere you can access the internet. We are just getting started with building our next generation best in class platform with a goal of being the “best in the industry” to support our customers across life, materials, food, and environmental sciences. We are looking for a passionate Principal DevOps Engineer to lead our CI/CD platform initiatives in a hybrid cloud and physical instrument environment. This role combines hands\-on technical expertise with strategic leadership to drive horizontal alignment across multiple development value streams and establish enterprise\-scale automation practices. This role is onsite 3x/week in Milford, MA: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday Our organization is built on the principles of strong collaboration, cross\-functional teamwork, and a relentless drive to solve problems that matter. If this is the type of culture you excel in, then we look forward to speaking with you. Responsibilities: ### **Internal Platform Development \& Architecture** * Design, develop, and evolve internal build platforms (primarily in Python) serving 65\+ active software projects. * Build and scale platform services that reliably handle 10,000\+ jobs, with clear SLIs/SLOs, observability, and failure modes teams can understand. * Own platform APIs, CLIs, and self\-service workflows so teams can onboard, build, test, and release without tickets. * Treat internal developers as customers: gather feedback, prioritize pain points, and iterate on developer experience. ### **CI/CD Excellence \& Process Optimization** * Implement and improve pipeline primitives, reusable templates, and release automation that raise quality and cadence across teams. * Reduce manual toil by encoding policy and workflow into the platform—creating guardrails as code and eliminating tribal knowledge. * Support horizontal integration across diverse value streams via shared contracts, plugins, and extension points. ### **Infrastructure \& Technical Leadership** * Solve hybrid\-cloud and on\-premises constraints through durable platform abstractions, and eliminate ticket\-driven firefighting. * Support physical instrument and hardware\-constrained workflows with purpose\-built platform capabilities where needed. * Stay hands\-on designing and shipping production\-quality code; use ops experience to inform architecture. ### **Leadership \& Collaboration** * Serve as a technical leader and mentor, elevating the capabilities of engineers across the organization. * Drive cross\-functional collaboration, ensuring smooth integration across systems, teams, and business functions. * Establish and champion best practices, standards, and patterns for DevOps and platform engineering. * Communicate technical strategies and trade\-offs clearly with engineers, leadership, and stakeholders at all levels. Qualifications: **Abilities that will help you be successful:*** **Education \& Experience:** Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science (or a related field) with 10\+ years of DevOps/platform engineering experience, including operating at scale. * **Programming Expertise:** Strong proficiency in Python, with a deep understanding of object\-oriented design and maintainable software architecture. * **Git at Scale:** Expert Git; multi\-repo/monorepo strategies; branching and governance that platforms enforce. * **Systems Proficiency:** Advanced shell scripting (Bash, PowerShell) with fluency in diverse Linux and Windows operating environments. * **CI/CD Leadership:** Extensive experience designing, implementing, and scaling CI/CD pipelines; proven success driving release reliability and velocity across multiple teams. * **Scale \& Reliability:** Track record managing large\-scale systems with high availability and performance requirements. * **Hybrid Cloud Expertise:** Hands\-on experience with AWS, Azure, and on\-premises environments. * **Automation:** Bias toward eliminating manual workflows with durable, tested automation. * **Technical Leadership:** Proven ability to mentor engineers, influence architectural direction, and set standards across teams. * **Hands\-On Development:** Strong programming background with the ability to design and deliver production\-quality code and raise the bar for platform quality. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * **Complex System Integration:** Experience supporting or integrating with physical instruments or hardware\-constrained systems. * **Proven Leadership:** Demonstrated technical leadership experience within software organizations, influencing direction and elevating team performance. * **Polyglot Engineering:** Knowledge of multiple programming languages and build systems, with the ability to choose the right tool for the problem. * **Scale Experience:** Hands\-on experience scaling platforms to reliably manage very high volumes and concurrency. * **Enterprise Context:** Background operating within enterprise software development environments, balancing agility with governance. * **Configuration Management Expertise:** Experience with modern configuration management frameworks such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef. * **Cloud\-Native Practices:** Champion of containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Lambda, and ECS. * **Advanced Python Expertise:** Experience developing large\-scale, maintainable Python services and frameworks used across the organization. Company Description: Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high\-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high\-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of \~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide. *Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. It benefits our employees, our products, our customers and our community. Waters complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to sex, race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, marital status (including civil unions), military service, veteran status, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, legally recognized disability, domestic violence victim status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Waters is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.*

jobs.description: At West, we’re a dedicated team that is connected by a purpose to improve patient lives that has been at the center of our Company for more than a century. Our story began when Herman O. West solved the problem of supplying penicillin in mass quantities to the US Government during World War 2\. Through our work to deliver thousands of lifesavings and life\-enhancing injectable medicines to millions of patients daily, West’s indelible mark on the healthcare industry has just begun. A name started our story. How will you help write our future? There’s no better place to join an inclusive community of professionals with opportunities for lifelong learning, growth and development. Supported by benefit programs, we empower the physical, mental, emotional and financial health of our team members and their families. We believe in giving back to help those in need in the communities where we live and work. And are equally committed to creating a healthier environment and planet through our sustainability efforts. **This position is a fixed\-term contract projected to last 9 months. The position offers benefits, training, and full\-time hours. A $1,000 bonus will be offered for 12 \& 24 weeks for those that complete these milestone dates.** **Job Summary** This role will focus on the development and deployment of an automation or digital strategy that encompasses the selection and use of the most appropriate digital or automation solution that brings the greatest benefit to our business. The role will involve capturing the best digital or automation solution helping to scope out the most prudent digital solution to meet customer needs, managing programs, and working with outside vendors where appropriate to deliver on time and within budget. It will be expected that you build a strong collaborative mindset with stakeholders and manage expectations realistically and effectively. You will also be required to foster positive synergistic external relationships with other manufacturers, vendors, research bodies, industry groups, and public bodies. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Provide engineering assistance to assure plant, machinery and processes are at an optimum level. * Provide assistance and make recommendations to Division Engineering on a timely basis. * Administrator of the maintenance management software. * Ensure plant is in compliance with OSHA and local, state and federal environmental regulations. * Routinely evaluate and review employee performance. * Write validation, user requirements, equipment specification and other documents as needed. * Promote and support a Lean Manufacturing environment within the facility. * Improve processes and procedures to manufacture a quality product at a minimum cost. * Quotes new automation lines, engineering services, etc. for new and existing customers. Develops suppliers and maintain audit. Develops design concepts for new Automation. * Provide leadership to engineers. Provide and schedule tools and supplies for departments. Assume responsibility for various engineering projects as assigned. * Facilitate meetings with the customer both on and off site to determine the needs, requirements, and customer specifications. Establishes relationships with customer and automation suppliers in pursuit of win‐win results and ongoing business. * Provide and schedule training for the department. Purchases tooling related equipment in accordance with the company policy. * Responsible for project cost accounting and delivering projects on schedule and at budget. * Provides a “Customer Service” attitude when interacting with internal and external customers while accomplishing work, production, and achieving quality standards. * Maintain machine and plant equipment drawings. * Manage and oversee the functioning of the site engineering groups. * Develop initial project scope, timeline, savings and cost estimations. * Write PER (Project Expenditure Request) and project justification documents. * Develop equipment requirements. * Research new technologies and methodologies to use in the plant. * Present justification to management and/or customer to attain approvals. * Lead project teams and team meetings as required. * Performs other duties as assigned based on business needs. * Conforms with and abides by all regulations, policies, work procedures, instruction, and all safety rules. * Exhibits regular, reliable, punctual and predictable attendance. * Other duties as assigned. **Education** * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science and/or Information Systems, Manufacturing Automation and Technology required **Work Experience** * Minimum 8 years of experience in manufacturing, engineering, automation and/or information technology in an automated production manufacturing operations environment required and * Experience with complex manufacturing OT IT systems integration required and * Proven success implementing complex manufacturing OT IT systems integration. requ ery and containment manufacturing required and * Multistakeholder complex program management. You have solid working experience as a Senior Project or Senior Program Manager in complex global projects required and * Experience in Azure Dev Ops required and * Some validation experience – computer systems, equipment and process required and **Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Deep knowledge of manufacturing processes, and relevant technologies. * Developed understanding of OT technologies * Strong people leadership and influencing capability * Strong organizational skills, the ability to perform under pressure and management of multiple priorities with competing demands for resources * Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem\-solving skills * Some knowledge of Artificial Intelligence and its application in manufacturing * Able to comply with the company’s safety and quality policies at all times **License and Certifications** * Manufacturing\\Lean Six Sigma Certification\-IASSC or Agile preferred * Program and Project Management\\Certified Project Management Professional (PMP)\-PMI Knowledge of Agile and Waterfall methodologies preferred **Travel Requirements**20%: Up to 52 business days per year **Physical Requirements** Sedentary\-Exerting up to 10lbs/4kgs of force occasionally, and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body. jobs.title: Principal Engineer I - AI Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Principal Engineer I \- AI Engineering**Location:** Block 23**What you'll do:** As a Principal Engineer I, you'll provide SME expertise in GitHub Copilot, agentic engineering, and adjacent technology domains to ensure enterprise solutions are secure, compliant, reliable, and supportable. You'll serve as a technical owner and strategic engineering lead for enterprise GitHub Copilot and the organization's agentic software engineering capabilities, providing technical direction for their architecture, configuration, integration, governance, lifecycle, and evolution. This role is responsible for defining and evolving the technical vision, architecture, engineering patterns, governance, and capabilities of the enterprise Agentic SDLC Harness, including reusable agents, skills, instructions, rules, plugins, MCP integrations and other AI\-assisted engineering capabilities. As a Principal Engineer I, you will partner with Development, Architecture, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Security, Cloud and Governance teams to establish a scalable and secure ecosystem that accelerates software delivery while maintaining engineering standards and controls. You'll partner with project sponsors, engineering teams, platform owners, and technology leaders to refine requirements, evaluate technical approaches, and drive solutions from concept through enterprise adoption. You'll provide technical leadership across organizational boundaries, influence engineering standards and architectural decisions, communicate complex technical concepts to both engineering and leadership audiences, and mentor engineers in GitHub Copilot, agentic engineering, DevOps, and related software engineering practices. This role requires deep technical expertise in GitHub Copilot, agentic software engineering, modern software development, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, DevOps and platform engineering, CI/CD, APIs and integrations, development frameworks, identity and access, and secure software delivery. Strong strategic and critical thinking, technical leadership, communication, and collaboration skills are required to influence engineering practices and establish trusted relationships across development teams, business partners, technology leadership, and governance functions.* Serve as an enterprise technical owner and SME for GitHub Copilot and AI\-assisted software engineering. * Define the technical strategy, architecture, standards, configuration model, and operating model for enterprise GitHub Copilot and agentic software engineering capabilities. * Engineer, configure, and evolve enterprise GitHub Copilot capabilities, including managed settings, enterprise and organizational policies, model availability, custom agents, skills, instructions, rules, plugins, approved MCP servers, and related extensibility capabilities. * Evaluate new and evolving GitHub Copilot and agentic engineering capabilities through controlled testing and experimentation, and determine enterprise readiness, security and governance requirements, adoption strategy, implementation approach, and business value. * Design and evolve the enterprise Agentic SDLC Harness that defines and governs how AI agents and capabilities interact with developers, source repositories, CI/CD platforms, development tools, and enterprise systems, including patterns for orchestration, tool access, context management, permissions, and human oversight. * Design and implement technical guardrails for AI\-assisted engineering, including access controls, approved tools and models, MCP server permissions, agent capabilities, repository interactions, data handling, and other controls required to balance developer productivity with enterprise security, regulatory, compliance, and risk requirements. * Establish and operate lifecycle management practices for Copilot and agentic engineering configurations, including source control, peer review, testing, approval, versioning, staged deployment, promotion of changes across test and enterprise environments, and rollback. * Serve as a technical escalation point for complex GitHub Copilot and agentic engineering issues, including configuration, authentication, IDE integration, policy enforcement, agent/plugin behavior, MCP integrations, and enterprise platform interoperability. * Establish monitoring and operational practices for platform availability, configuration health, integration reliability, usage, and emerging technical risks. * Develop reference implementations, technical standards, engineering patterns, playbooks, reusable examples, quick\-start guides, and enablement materials that accelerate safe adoption across development teams. * Define and monitor enterprise metrics for adoption, usage, developer experience, quality, reliability, engineering effectiveness, and value realization; use these insights to identify opportunities to improve GitHub Copilot, the Agentic SDLC ecosystem, and developer productivity. * Communicate platform roadmap, zure DevOps, including repository governance, identity and access, integrations, policies, CI/CD, and developer tooling. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience with GitHub Copilot and AI\-assisted software engineering, including enterprise configuration, agentic capabilities, customization, integration, governance, and developer enablement. * Experience architecting enterprise developer platforms and developer enablement ecosystems, including reusable frameworks, integrations, automation, engineering patterns, and shared platform capabilities. * Strong understanding of generative AI and agentic architectures, including AI agents, tool calling, agent orchestration, prompt engineering, context engineering, retrieval patterns, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and secure integration with enterprise systems. * Experience designing security and governance controls for AI\-assisted engineering, including identity and access, least\-privilege tool access, secrets and sensitive\-data protection, repository permissions, third\-party integrations, MCP servers, and agent/tool execution boundaries. * Demonstrated software engineering experience and ability to design, build, test, and maintain automation, integrations, developer tooling, APIs, scripts, and reusable engineering components. * Ability to translate emerging technologies into secure, scalable, supportable enterprise solutions. * Ability to work effectively in a team environment. * Advanced knowledge of enterprise architecture, technology governance, security and risk frameworks, with demonstrated ability to integrate new capabilities into existing enterprise platforms and operating models. * Experience working within a regulated financial\-services environment and supporting technology risk assessments, audits, regulatory examinations, and control\-evidence requests is preferred. * Advanced speaking and writing communication skills. * Advanced knowledge of applicable regulatory and legal compliance obligations, rules and regulations, industry standards and practices. * Previous technical leadership experience preferred. **Benefits you’ll love:** We offer all the important things you'd want — like competitive salaries, an ownership stake in the company, medical and dental insurance, time off, a great 401k matching program, tuition assistance program, an employee volunteer program, and a wellness program. In addition, you’ll have the opportunity to bolster your business knowledge, learning the ins and outs of how successful companies operate and manage their finances, giving you invaluable hands\-on experience to help grow your career! **About the company:** Western Alliance Bank, Member FDIC, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Western Alliance Bancorporation. Serving clients nationwide, Western Alliance Bank includes six legacy bank brands — Alliance Association Bank, Alliance Bank of Arizona, Bank of Nevada, Bridge Bank, First Independent Bank and Torrey Pines Bank — that remain part of the company’s heritage, as well as AmeriHome Mortgage, a Western Alliance Bank Company. Western Alliance Bancorporation is committed to equal employment and will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, color, religion, age, nation origin, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or genetic information. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process and/or need an alternative method of applying, please email HR@westernalliancebank.com or call 602\-386\-2488\. jobs.title: Lead, Mobile App Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Whitepages helps millions of people stay connected, stay protected, and make informed decisions, and our mobile apps area big part of that mission. We're looking for an Engineering Lead to own our ReactNative mobile experience end to end — setting technical direction, growing a small high\-trust team, and pushing our product to feel as fast and complete as our web experience. This is a hands\-on leadership role, but “hands\-on” looks different here than it used to: you'll spend your time directing and reviewing the output of coding agents vs. writing code yourself, and you'll be expected to have real judgment about when to delegate to an agent, when to step in by hand, and how to keep quality high either way. You'll make architecture calls, set the technical direction the agents work within, and work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with product, design and marketing to help decide what we build next, not just how. We're rethinking how mobile engineering gets done, and agentic workflows are central to that. This role owns how our team orchestrates coding agents day to day — scoping the work they're trusted with, building the guardrails (tests, review gates, CI checks) that keep their output safe to ship, and continuously tuning the workflow as the tools improve. We want a lead who treats agent management as a core engineering skill, not a side experiment — someone who can get a team of engineers and agents shipping together faster than either could alone, without sacrificing code quality or product judgment. This role starts focused on Mobile, but it isn't meant to stay siloed there. As agentic workflows take over more of the routine implementation work, we expect engineers — especially leads — to spend less time boxed into one stack and more time flexing across our engineering orgs wherever the product needs the most judgment: Mobile today, with Web and Data work entering the mix as our roadmap and agent capabilities evolve. We're looking for someone who's energized by that direction, not just tolerant of it — someone who wants to grow into a generalist engineering leader over time rather than staying a specialist in one surface area. **What You'll Do** * Lead a small team of mobile engineers: set technical direction, review code and architecture decisions, and mentor engineers toward greater ownership and craft. * Own the architecture of our ReactNative applications across iOS and Android, balancing shared code with platform\-specific quality. * Partner directly with Product, Design and Marketing to shape the roadmap — you'll be expected to bring product judgment to the table, not just estimate tickets. * Build, evaluate, and roll out agentic and AI\-assisted engineering workflows (coding agents, automated code review, test generation, CI triage) to raise the team's velocity and code quality. * Champion testability, accessibility, and usability as first\-class concerns in every feature, not an afterthought. * Own and evolve our mobile CI/CD pipeline, including automated UI testing and release processes. * Translate technical tradeoffs into plain language for non\-technical stakeholders, and technical requirements the other direction. * Act as a role model for operational excellence — reduce technical debt, improve documentation, and keep a healthy sense of urgency on the team. Requirements: **What We're Looking For** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3\+ years leading or mentoring other engineers. * 4\+ years of experience with ReactNative, or a strong combination of React web and native/hybrid mobile development. * 5\+ years of experience with JavaScript or TypeScript. * Proven ability to own architecture for a production mobile app used at meaningful scale. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools or agentic workflows in a real engineering workflow (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, custom agent pipelines) \- you can speak to what worked, what didn't, and where you'd draw the line on trusting an agent's output. * Strong product sense: you ask “should we build this” as often as “how should we build this,” and you can back that judgment with user impact, not just opinion. * A track record of working through ambiguity to a shipped, well\-tested solution with real autonomy and ownership. * Excellent communication skills across engineering, product, and non\-technical audiences. * Genuine interest in growing beyond mobile over time — comfortable picking up backend/services or data\-oriented work as the role expands, rather than staying siloed to one stack. **Nice to Have** * Experience building ReactNative libraries with native (iOS/Android) integration, or native development in Swift/Kotlin. * Experience designing or operating agentic systems in production (not just using AI tools, but building the workflows/tooling around them). * Experience with mobile CI/CD, UI automation frameworks, and release engineering. * Familiarity with customer data platforms (CDPs) and interpreting product analytics to inform roadmap decisions. * Experience on hybrid agile teams, and comfort with informal project management (scoping, estimation, status reporting). * Prior exposure to backend services or data engineering/analytics work — you don't need to be an expert, but you've worked outside mobile before and know you can ramp up quickly. Whitepages is a nimble, high\-impact team of \~50 team members, operating with the autonomy and ownership of a small company while reaching millions of users. We’re remote\-first with a thoughtful hybrid model that balances flexibility and connection. **Seattle\-based employees** work from home four days a week and in our centrally located downtown office on Tuesdays, along with one designated in\-office week each quarter. For team members based in **ID, CO, WI, FL, or MD** you will work from home and we bring everyone together in Seattle for one week each quarter to collaborate in person. **This role is only open to current residents of the states outlined above.** Compensation includes a competitive base salary plus participation in both quarterly and annual bonus programs tied to company performance. The base salary range for this role is $175,000–$250,000, plus bonus opportunity. Salary dependent on location **(WA, ID, CO, WI, FL, or MD)** and experience. Whitepages is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We value authenticity and welcome people of all backgrounds to join us in our mission.

Our models rank restaurants and dishes, predict delivery times, price orders, and dispatch couriers for millions of diners across Grubhub and Wonder. Most of those predictions are served to high\-traffic Java services. How well a model works with those services matters as much as how good the model is. We're hiring a Staff Machine Learning Engineer with deep Java backend experience to set the technical direction for how our models and services work together. You'll define how every team calls our models. You'll set the standards for load testing and performance across the services that use them. You'll also lead complex ML work that spans multiple teams and systems. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You'll write code, design models, and take on the hardest production problems yourself. You'll be the main technical link between Model Platform and our software engineering teams, and you'll partner with Applied Scientists, our data and infrastructure platform teams, and senior engineering leadership. Our interview process includes the same Java coding interview our software engineers take. **The Impact You Will Make** * Define the standard architecture for how Java services call ML models, including client libraries, API contracts, latency budgets, and fallbacks. * Set the standards for load testing, performance benchmarking, and capacity planning for every service that calls our models, and build them into the release process. * Drive performance work such as profiling, JVM tuning, caching, request batching, and concurrency for our highest\-traffic model integrations. * Lead the design and delivery of complex ML solutions that span multiple teams or systems, and make the architecture decisions that cross team boundaries. * Build reusable ML architectures, pipelines, and deployment patterns that get Applied Science work into production faster. * Set the standards for ML reliability, scalability, monitoring, and lifecycle management, including model scorecards, reproducible training, safe rollout, and SLOs for tier\-1 models. * Own model architecture and tuning for our most demanding deployments, balancing accuracy against latency, scalability, and cost. * Run design and code reviews across ML and software engineering teams, and push back on technical decisions when the evidence supports it. * Own the platform's technical roadmap with engineering leadership, sequence work across teams, and raise risks early. * Mentor senior and mid\-level engineers, take part in hiring, and build depth on the team so no critical system depends on one person. * Explain technical trade\-offs in business terms to product and executive stakeholders, and write down key decisions and the reasons behind them. **What You Bring to the Table** * BS, MS, or PhD in running high\-traffic backend services in Java * 5\+ years building and running ML systems in production, including 3\+ years at senior scope setting technical direction across teams or systems * Expert Java and object\-oriented design skills, including service frameworks (Spring Boot or similar), REST or gRPC APIs, and JVM performance tuning * A track record of setting load testing and performance standards (Gatling, JMeter, or similar) and planning capacity for services as load changes * Experience designing highly available distributed systems (99\.99% uptime) with automated testing and monitoring built in from the start * Deep expertise in production ML architecture, including training pipelines, batch and real\-time serving, feature pipelines, model versioning, and rollback at scale * Strong Python and hands\-on model development experience with common frameworks (XGBoost/LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow), including choosing and tuning models under real latency and cost limits * Strong data engineering skills in Spark and SQL, including building and debugging streaming or batch pipelines * Deep experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS or GCP (SageMaker, jobs.title: Level 2 Engineer (IT Service Desk Technician)
jobs.description: **Description** We're looking for IT professionals who will thrive working with multiple corporate clients to help them support, manage, and plan their IT infrastructure. Mainly operating in Windows environments, most of our clients are small businesses with little or no IT expertise in\-house. We're not just looking for the best technical talent, we're also looking for folks who interact well with users \- whether they're administrative staff or the business owner! The Level 2 Service Desk Technician provides advanced technical support to end\-users by resolving escalated issues from Level 1 support and performing deeper troubleshooting across hardware, software, and network systems. This role requires strong analytical skills, a solid technical foundation, and the ability to work independently or collaboratively to resolve complex IT problems. **Key Responsibilities** * Respond to and resolve escalated service desk tickets from Level 1 technicians. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to operating systems, business applications, hardware, and network connectivity. * Perform root cause analysis and implement long\-term solutions to recurring problems. * Support user account management, including Active Directory, Exchange, and other enterprise systems. * Assist with system upgrades, patch management, and deployment of new technologies. * Document solutions and contribute to the knowledge base for future reference. * Collaborate with Level 3 support and infrastructure teams when necessary. * Provide mentorship and guidance to Level 1 technicians. * Ensure compliance with IT policies, procedures, and security standards. **Requirements** * Associate or bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field. * 2–4 years of experience in IT support or service desk roles. * Strong knowledge of Windows and Mac operating systems, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals. * Experience with remote support tools and PSA platforms (e.g., ConnectWise). * Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and customer service skills. * Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA Network\+, Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator, ITIL) are a plus. You'll also need: * Excellent communication (written and oral) skills * Excellent documentation and record\-keeping skills * The desire and ability to learn new technology This is a hybrid position. Employees will work both on\-site and remotely. Employees may be required to visit local client sites occasionally. **Benefits** * This is a full\-time salaried position with excellent benefits. * Overtime pay, even though it is a salaried position (Fluctuating Work Week) * Health, Dental, and Vision insurance * Short\- and Long\-Term Disability, plus Basic Life, at no cost to you * 401(k) with corporate match * Wellbeing reimbursement * Up to 4 paid days per year for volunteer activities **Core Values** Our core values define our culture and how we approach working with clients, hiring new teammates, and rewarding each other, and they even allow us to consider when someone is not a good fit. We all use these core values as a filter through which we make decisions. By embodying these values as an organization and as individuals, we will continue to grow and succeed. *Be Curious* We embrace curiosity as a driver of growth and innovation. Being curious means asking questions, seeking new perspectives, and continuously learning. It's about challenging assumptions, exploring possibilities, and staying open to change. *Be A Good Steward* We responsibly manage the resources entrusted to us—time, talent, capital, and relationships—with care and integrity. Being a good steward means acting with long\-term vision, making thoughtful decisions, and leaving things better than we found them. *Put People First* We prioritize people in every decision and interaction. By leading with empathy, respect, and care, we create a culture where individuals feel valued, supported, and empowered to thrive. When people come first, everything else follows. *Be Accountable* We take ownership of our actions and outcomes. Being accountable means following through on commitments, learning from mistakes, and holding ourselves to the highest standards of integrity and performance. We own the results—good or bad—and strive to continuously improve.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Workato** ----------------- Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission\-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com. **Why join us?** ---------------- Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a **flexible, trust\-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles**. We are driven by **innovation** and looking for **team players** who want to actively build our company. But, we also believe in **balancing productivity with self\-care**. That's why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you! Also, feel free to check out why: * Business Insider named us an "enterprise startup to bet your career on" * Forbes' Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world * Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America * Quartz ranked us the \#1 best company for remote workers **Responsibilities** ==================== We're looking for an exceptional Senior Software Engineer to help build the distributed backend that powers our AI agent platform and the developer\-facing products around it — the event\-driven services, real\-time integrations, and APIs that let agents reliably do real work. You'll be building the systems that need to stay correct and available on our path to 1M users over the next year. In this role, you will also be responsible to: * Build event\-driven, horizontally\-scalable backend services that process work reliably and correctly even when parts of the system fail. * Build real\-time surfaces and integrations — streaming connections, gateways, and CLIs — that hold up under load. * Integrate LLMs and agentic harnesses into production systems. * Drive features end\-to\-end — from ideation and architecture through deployment, observability, and iteration. * Raise the engineering bar through clean, well\-tested code, thoughtful reviews, and mentorship. **Requirements** ================ ### **Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills** * 5\+ years shipping and operating production backend systems at scale. * Strong proficiency in Python, and the judgment to write clean, well\-tested, maintainable code under it. * Deep distributed\-systems fundamentals: you know how to keep systems correct and available under partial failure, backpressure, and load — and you design for it by default. * Hands\-on experience with event\-driven, streaming, or real\-time systems (queues, pub/sub, long\-lived connections). * Comfortable operating services in production on Kubernetes in the cloud — and instrumenting them with metrics, tracing, and dashboards so you can debug what you ship. * Solid API and software\-architecture instincts; you make and defend sensible trade\-offs in ambiguity. * LLM/agentic and developer\-facing product experience (MCP, RAG, APIs, SDKs, CLIs) a strong plus. Our stack: Python, FastAPI, Postgres, Kubernetes, AWS. You don't need prior experience with all of it — we care that you can pick it up fast. ### **Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics** * High agency and ownership: You drive work end\-to\-end, from ambiguity to shipped and iterated, without waiting to be told. * A reliability mindset: You design for failure, not just the happy path. * Product\-minded: You care about the users using what you build, not just the system behind it. * AI\-native: You use modern AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code) in your daily workflow and stay at the cutting edge of what it can do. * Excellent written communication: We work async and write things down. **(REQ ID: 3006\)**

jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. jobs.title: IT Support Engineer (Hybrid - Phoenix)
jobs.description: If you’re looking to learn from a winning information technology team and receive outstanding benefits that support your family\- while working for a company that takes a people\-first approach to business, we invite you to explore our IT Support Engineer position. * This is an on\-site position that requires traveling to and working at client locations in Phoenix, AZ, 1\-2 days/week. **Primary Purpose and Function** The overall performance objective of the Support Engineer I is to provide the best possible support and customer service to our clients. jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: We are working together to achieve excellent health. Come join us! The Yukon\-Kuskokwim Health Corporation is a Tribal health care organization, serving nearly 30,000 people living across rural, southwest Alaska in villages with populations from about 10 to more than 1,000\. Bethel, the regional hub and location of the only hospital in the region, has a population of nearly 7,000\. The Yukon\-Kuskokwim Delta is home to thousands of lakes and two primary rivers—the Kuskokwim and Yukon. We offer a broad range of employment opportunities and the chance to make a meaningful impact on the health of people in the region. ### **Position Summary:** **The Network Engineer assists and works alongside of the Network Engineer(s) and Associates in planning, implementation and administering YKHC data networks for Bethel area, Sub\-Regional Clinics, village clinics, and Anchorage YKHC Offices. Ensures the technical integrity, performance, and reliability of all Voice, Data and Video networks. Technical integrity includes installation, scheduled maintenance, and problem resolution of all LAN/WAN and telecommunications equipment and networks within a given geographical area. Assist in maintaining the LAN/WAN services and provide on\-line, real\-time support and first\-line troubleshooting on all YKHC clinical, financial, and micro\-computer hardware and software, telecommunications hardware and software, all peripheral/fax/copier hardware and software, and coordinating maintenance services by outside vendors for all networked components.** · Monitor and Maintain File Servers. · Monitor and Maintain Printer Serves. · Administer SQL Server. · Administer Win2k Servers. · Assist and participate in maintaining all LAN and WAN links that provide major support of the financial, patient care, word processing and data base needs of the YKHC. · Provides system analysis, development, maintenance, trouble shooting and programming for all aspects of Corporate LANs and their links. · Maintains knowledge of various operating systems and local area networks and participate in the evaluation of new hardware and software developments in the field, with special emphasis on networks, communications and integrated computing systems. · Participates in telecommunications planning and management for all YKHC locations. · Maintains daily and weekly backups, as well as archiving mid\-year and year\-end data base information. · Develops and maintains documents used by the help desk in troubleshooting network problems. · Establishes or supervises and maintains server logs of YKHC Network server(s). · Performs other job\-related duties as assigned. **Position Qualifications:** · **Minimum Education** An Associate of Applied Science in Computer Information Technology and Systems Management. Preferred: A Bachelor of Science in Information Technology degree with an emphasis on Networking or Information Management. May substitute for a Microsoft MCSE OR graduation from accredited network management, network wiring, and transport protocol courses in preparation for required position accountabilities. **Minimum Experience** 3\+ years working experience with Cisco switches and routers, 3\+ years working experience in a network environment, 1\+ years working with Windows 2003/2008 server, 1\+ years working with SAN Technology, experience working within a team\-oriented, collaborative environment **License, Certification, Registration** A \+ required, Network \+ required, CCNA required. MSCE preferred **Equipment/Tools** Workstations and Servers. **Specialized Knowledge and Skills** Competent and proficient understanding of how a computer network should be operated in accordance with industry best practices. Strong understanding of how to properly configure the computer network that best serves the corporation’s applications and services. Strong understanding of the corporation’s goals and objectives. Ability to effectively communicate with technology staff and customer to correctly identify problems and collaboratively develop solutions. **Supervisory Responsibilities** None **Benefits Include:** * Generous PTO – starting at 4\.5 weeks per year, accrued over time * Eleven paid holidays * Comprehensive healthcare coverage * Life and Disability Insurance * Flexible Spending Account * Retirement plans * Employee Wellness Center Plus More! * Compensation Pay Range Minimum: 32\.88 Employment Type: Regular Time Type: Full time Hours Per Week: 40 FLSA Exempt: No Yukon Kuskokwim Health Corporation is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified individuals will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status and any other basis protected by law. Individuals with disabilities needing assistance in the recruitment process are encouraged to contact Human Resources directly. Under P.L. 93\-638, preference is given to Alaska Native/American Indian applicants. For more information, please contact the YKHC Recruitment Department at YKHCRecruitment@YKHC.org

causes, and track recurring issues to reduce repeat tickets. + Use SQL to research data and system behavior, and validate fixes. + Write and maintain detailed documentation of findings, resolutions, and best practices, including knowledge base articles for customers and the support team. * Customer\-Centric Communication + Explain complex technical concepts clearly to audiences from Support to drive end\-to\-end issue resolution. + Act as the bridge between customer feedback and the product roadmap, advocating for key enhancements and bug fixes. * Team Collaboration + Share WM expertise with fellow Technical Support Analysts to support their professional growth and skill development. + Set high standards for productivity, accuracy, and customer empathy, and model best practices. + Lead periodic knowledge\-sharing sessions on troubleshooting techniques, WM product insights, and process improvements. **Minimum Requirements** * Four\-year bachelor’s degree (or foreign troubleshooting (SQL) * 3 years of experience supporting or deploying enterprise software * Experience troubleshooting issues between WM software and external systems (such as ERP, transportation, or automation systems) * Thrives in a remote working environment **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with a Tier 1 WMS platform and knowledge of warehouse operations * Experience mentoring or leading junior support or consulting staff * Familiarity with a ticketing system such as Zendesk and an issue tracker such as Jira * Strong written and verbal communication, including with executive and operations stakeholders * Experience building knowledge base content and leading training or knowledge\-sharing sessions **Key Performance Indicators** * Average response and resolution times on escalated tickets, benchmarked against established SLAs * Resolution of advanced L2 and L3 issues, including first\-time fix rate * Reduction in repeat issues through root cause analysis and knowledge base content * Accuracy and completeness of ticket documentation and categorization * Customer satisfaction ratings (if applicable) * Contribution to team knowledge sharing and documentation (team feedback) **Our Core Values*** **Customer Success** – Our customer’s success is our success. This includes a drive for continued learning to master one’s area of expertise and expand skill sets * **Empower Others Succeed** – We are a team\-oriented environment that thrives on collaboration, sharing knowledge, and empowering \& supporting others to succeed in their roles. As a rapidly growing company with many new employees, this is a cornerstone of our culture * **All About Results** – Our team understands that positive outcomes and achieving goals are paramount to our success. We give employees the flexibility to achieve their results along with holding each other accountable to build a positive environment of high performance * **Forward Thinking** – Planning and looking ahead is part of our DNA. This includes thinking about how decisions today set us up for success for the short\-term and long\-term, as well as taking incremental steps to achieve the company’s long\-term vision to be an industry leader **Benefits*** Da Vinci offers a fully remote environment – work where it’s convenient for you and the company has regular in\-person company gatherings to build team relationships * GO \- PTO days to provide an opportunity to recharge and spend time on your other passions * 401k plan with 4% company match to invest in your future * Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance to support the health \& well\-being of you and your family * 7 Paid Company Holidays \+ Paid Sick Days **Compensation** The target salary range for this role is $100,000–$120,000\. 394dWlMOhg
