jobs.description: who we are lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth\-focused environment for our people. about this team The Enterprise Data \& AI organization is a strategic and operational driver of growth for lululemon, owning and building the data and AI platforms and services that enable the enterprise to operate with intelligence at scale. The team leads the design and delivery of a trusted unified data foundation, AI\-driven data analytics and insights, and AI solutions across lululemon’s vertically integrated retail ecosystem, while embedding strong data governance and responsible AI practices from the very beginning. By applying AI to critical business challenges and creating new, transformative AI solutions, the team helps reshape how lululemon operates. Through deep partnership with product, technology, and business teams, Enterprise Data \& AI accelerates product innovation, unlocks measurable value, elevates guest and educator experiences, and drives enterprise efficiency. Our data and AI platform foundation is built on enterprise data lake architecture, standardized ingestion and integration frameworks, and canonical semantic models spanning product, customer, and supply chain domains. The platform advances data insights and AI capabilities while maintaining rigorous data governance, observability, and platform reliability. The team delivers self\-service data capabilities and shared platform services that enable consistent, trustworthy consumption across analytics, AI/ML, and operational use cases at enterprise scale. core responsibilities As a Principal Software Engineer, you will own the system design and implementation of lululemon’s enterprise data \& AI platform and the systems that ensure delivery of data products and services that power high\-impact business data\-driven insights and AI use cases. You will ensure data pipelines and services that enable analytics, AI/ML, are reliable, efficient, and governed, and support operational consumption at scale. You will design and build enterprise\-grade data and AI infrastructure and reusable components that enable multiple product teams and business domains to build, publish and consume data products. You will build a context and semantic layer infrastructure that enables insights and AI use\-cases. You will enable and influence the engineering delivery of data insights and analytics across multiple use\-cases. You will establish the direction and system design for the enterprise data platform, set engineering standards and platform practices adopted across the domain, and serve as the definitive technical authority on the enterprise data platform. You will partner closely with product, business, and technology stakeholders including VP\-level leadership, on technical strategy, platform roadmap, and cross\-functional initiatives. This role may require availability outside of standard business hours, including on\-call support, based on business needs. **select responsibilities include:** * Define vision and approach for enterprise data initiatives and effectively and efficiently deliver the technology solution design * Collaborate closely with architects on enterprise data platform technical architecture and system design, and provide deep technical expertise on implementation approaches, feasibility assessment, and operational implications * Be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption * Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption * Build platform components for ML/AI applications such as point\-in\-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale * Architect robust multi\-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross\-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads * Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers * Write high\-quality production code to solve the complex technical challenges when hands\-on expertise is required * Challenge and improve existing architecture decisions by identifying limitations in current systems and proposing techni \-to\-end, including ingestion frameworks, pipeline orchestration, DataOps disciplines (CI/CD, SLAs, observability), platform reliability, and security, privacy, and access control in partnership with risk and compliance teams * Deep experience analyzing complex system interactions to identify optimal solution approaches; proven ability to make technical trade\-off decisions balancing immediate delivery needs with long\-term scalability and organizational impact * Experience defining implementation plans and execution approaches for complex, cross\-organizational technology programs; familiarity collaborating with architects to translate architectural designs into actionable engineering roadmaps * Recognized depth in engineering implementations, combined with breadth to assess system\-wide implications; proven ability to make rapid, high\-confidence judgements on when to engage directly with engineers versus delegating * Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy and investment decisions through technical insights on feasibility, risk, and business impact * Experience defining enterprise semantic layers and canonical models — including taxonomies, ontologies, and knowledge graphs — used across multiple product teams and business domains * Exposure to AI\-driven systems including optimization, predictions, and Agents; experience working with knowledge representation for LLM\-powered applications * Experience building knowledge bases or data platforms in retail or similarly complex consumer domains must haves * Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life. * Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results. * Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same. * Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure. * Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships. * Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously. additional notes **Please note:** Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visa at this time for this role. compensation and benefits package lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay\-for\-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from $205,600 \- $269,900 annually; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program and equity offerings, subject to program eligibility requirements. At lululemon, investing in our people is a top priority. We believe that when life works, work works. We strive to be the place where inclusive leaders come to develop and enable all to be well. jobs.title: Process Integration and Technology Development Engineer
jobs.description: The Process Integration and Technology Development Engineer defines, develops, and implements silicon process technology for the manufacture of integrated silicon devices. The successful candidate will be responsible for unit/process module development, process flow implementation, design rule definition, device architecture, electrical characterization, and technology qualification. These tasks support new silicon technology developments and transfers of existing technologies in and out of the resident fab. Experience related to semiconductor processing in BCD, Discretes, and hybrid Smart Power technologies is desired. * Responsibilities **Process Integration and Technology Development** * Lead the development of unit processes and process modules for CMOS, BCD, Discretes, and hybrid Smart Power technologies. * Define and assess process module characterization to ensure robustness, manufacturability, and scalability. * Develop and maintain end\-to\-end technology process flows with detailed process specifications. * Define physical design rules and test structures for characterization. * Drive process and device optimization to meet performance, reliability, and cost targets. * Design and analyze statistical experiments using DOE, regression, and AI\-assisted methods to optimize device architecture and process modules. * Support intrinsic reliability studies, including gate oxide integrity, TDDB, HCI, EM, and stress migration, using both physics\-based and data\-driven approaches. **Manufacturing, Yield \& Technology Transfer** * Facilitate process improvements and corrective actions for yield, reliability, and manufacturability issues using root\-cause analysis and data mining and analysis. * Support Process Engineering and Yield Engineering teams to improve process quality and yield for technologies released to manufacturing. * Enable smooth technology transfers into and out of the fab by using data\-driven monitoring, excursion detection, and learning systems. * Qualifications **Required** * MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or related technical field. * Knowledge of semiconductor device physics and construction , including CMOS, DMOS, Bipolar, and Trench FET devices. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly. * Demonstrated problem\-solving ability and strong collaboration skills in cross\-functional teams. **Preferred** * Understanding of semiconductor processes such as CVD, PVD, implant, diffusion, etch and plating. * Hands\-on experience with process and device TCAD jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **About Subsense** ------------------ Subsense is a deep\-tech company developing the world’s first non\-surgical, bidirectional brain\-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. Our mission is to unlock direct communication between the human brain and AI \- starting with medical applications such as stroke recovery and moving toward cognitive enhancement for healthy users. Headquartered in Palo Alto, Subsense brings together leading scientists and engineers to redefine the future of human–machine interaction. ### **The Opportunity** Design, develop, and integrate electronics and hardware for emerging neurotechnology, biotechnology, and medical\-device systems. You will contribute to the development of experimental platforms, proof\-of\-concept devices, data acquisition systems, and integrated hardware supporting a range of research and development activities. Projects may involve electronics for optical, magnetic, sensing, and other biomedical technologies as technical needs evolve. This role offers an opportunity for an early\-career engineer to gain hands\-on experience across electrical engineering, biomedical instrumentation, and multidisciplinary system development. You will work on hardware from initial concepts and circuit designs through prototyping, integration, characterization, and testing, with opportunities to independently develop electrical subsystems and experimental solutions. Working closely with specialists in engineering, neuroscience, biology, and software, you will help translate experimental requirements into functional hardware systems. The ideal candidate is curious, enjoys building and troubleshooting physical systems, and has a strong interest in applying engineering principles to biotechnology, biomedical research, and neurotechnology. ### **What You'll Own** * Assist engineers with the assembly, integration, and testing of electronic circuits and hardware prototypes for biomedical instrumentation and neurotechnology applications. * Build and modify circuits, cables, and test assemblies using schematics, wiring diagrams, and team guidance, including soldering, component installation, and basic rework. * Support PCB bring\-up and debugging by performing initial checks, taking measurements, recording results, and helping investigate issues. * Assist with schematic updates, circuit simulation, component research, and straightforward PCB layout tasks under engineering supervision. * Help set up and operate data acquisition systems, including connecting sensors, configuring equipment, and checking acquired signals. * Support the integration of sensors, actuators, power supplies, embedded controllers, and other components into team\-developed experimental platforms. * Write or modify small scripts for instrument control, data collection, and test automation using existing code, examples, and team guidance. * Perform electrical measurements using oscilloscopes, multimeters, function generators, and bench power supplies, following established procedures. * Help troubleshoot circuit and system issues, document observations, and work with engineers to identify next steps. * Apply basic signal analysis and filtering techniques to review measurement quality and help identify noise or unexpected behavior. * Assist with the assembly and modification of fixtures, enclosures, mounts, and other mechanical components used in laboratory setups. * Maintain clear records of hardware configurations, wiring, test procedures, measurements, and changes to support repeatable experiments. * Follow laboratory safety practices and team procedures for handling, powering, and testing electronic hardware. * Participate in design reviews and team discussions, communicate progress and questions, and incorporate feedback into your work. ### **What You'll Bring** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, biomedical engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline with coursework in electronics. * 0–2 years of relevant experience. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Coursework, academic research, internships, laboratory work, and personal projects all count as relevant experience. * Foundational understanding of circuit analysis, analog and digital electronics, and basic electronic components. * Hands\-on experience assembling and testing circuits through coursework, laboratory work, or projects. * Basic ability to read circuit schematics and use common laboratory equipment, such as multimeters and oscilloscopes. * Some experience with soldering, wiring, or electronic assembly, and a willingness to develop these skills. * Basic programming experience in Python, C, or C\+\+, with a willingness to learn tools used for hardware control and data acquisition. * A methodical approach to troubleshooting, including taking measurements, recording observations, and asking for guidance when needed. * Ability to follow test procedures, maintain clear technical notes, and communicate results and questions. * Willingness to learn from feedback and work collaboratively with engineers and scientists from different backgrounds. * Interest in biomedical engineering, biotechnology, neurotechnology, or scientific instrumentation. Nice to have * Exposure to schematic capture, circuit simulation, or PCB layout tools through coursework or projects. * Experience with microcontrollers, development boards, or basic embedded programming. * Familiarity with communication interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, or USB. * Experience using Python to collect, plot, or analyze experimental data. * Exposure to sensors, signal conditioning, data acquisition, or basic signal processing. * Experience with 3D CAD, 3D printing, or assembling mechanical fixtures and enclosures. * Introductory knowledge of optics, electromagnetics, bioelectrical signals, or biomedical instrumentation. * Familiarity with version control or collaborative technical documentation. * Academic research, internships, or personal projects involving electronics, robotics, biomedical devices, or laboratory equipment. * These are helpful starting points, not expectations that you have experience in every area. ### **Why You’ll Thrive at Subsense** You'd be joining a small team developing a non\-surgical, bidirectional brain\-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. You’ll help translate early research into working technology, with the opportunity to influence both the platform and how we build it. **A few things that make this different:** * **Own meaningful technical work:** Take projects from early R\&D through functional prototypes, with room to test ideas, solve complex problems, and shape design decisions. * **Build across disciplines:** Work hands\-on with ultrasound, electronics, and instrumentation alongside scientists and engineers in neuroscience, nanotechnology, and AI. * **Help shape a novel platform:** Contribute to technology with the potential to restore neurological function and, over time, enable direct brain\-to\-AI communication. * **Make a visible impact:** Join a team where your contributions directly influence technical progress, with equity that lets you share in the company’s growth. ### **Benefits that support life beyond work** * **Health coverage with meaningful employer support** – Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * **Time to rest and recharge** – 15 vacation days, 7 sick days, and 10 paid holidays, plus a company\-wide winter shutdown from Christmas Eve through New Year’s Day. * **An easier commute** – Commuter benefits to help make getting to work a little easier. * **Support for growing families** – Paid parental leave includes 4 weeks of maternity disability leave and 8 weeks of baby\-bonding leave, subject to eligibility. * **Time together as a team** – Team outings, lunches, happy hours, and celebrations that create opportunities to connect beyond day\-to\-day work. ### **Help build what comes next** If you’re drawn to hard problems, hands\-on discovery, and the opportunity to turn research into working technology, we’d like to hear from you. *Subsense is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
